display.title: The Doubt
display.description: One day, a question crossed through my mind. Where do we come from? We were given life and left in this world against our own volition.

display.title: The Process of Understanding
display.description: In the end, they were bound to life. We existed only to express despair and ire.

display.title: Where We Must Reach
display.description: We constructed a looming tower to return whence we came.

display.title: Helix of the End
display.description: The tower is touched by the sky, and nothing will remain on the ground.

display.title: The Path of Belief
display.description: We didn't get the answer; however, we now understand that heaven is something we must create ourselves, so we will take all the land and turn it into the heaven we desire.

display.title: The Final Bell Tolls
display.description: We shall toll the last bell of the old world, and the first of the new. Prepare thyself, for you shall finally be free

display.title: FINALITAS
display.description: We fuse flesh and thought into a single truth, a single purpose, a single end.

display.title: TÉLOS
display.description: There wasn't an answer. We didn't find a single thing we wanted. We only witnessed the death of life itself.

zh_cn.text: 加速渲染客户端配置项

en_us.text: Configurations of features provided by Accelerated Rendering

zh_cn.text: 用于配置由加速渲染提供的优化特性的配置项目录

en_us.text: Core Settings allows you to change setting that are related to all rendering features.

zh_cn.text: 核心配置包含了能影响所有渲染特性的配置

en_us.text:
Maximum amount of same meshes in a draw before it is switched to dense uploading method.
Changing this value may affects your FPS in certain situation. Smaller value means meshes will use dense mesh uploading with fewer occurrences, while larger values means meshes will use sparse mesh uploading even with higher occurrences.

zh_cn.text:
单次绘制中一个模型在被切换到密集模型上传模式前的最大出现次数.
修改此项数值可能会在特定情况下影响FPS, 越低的值代表当模型出现次数更低时模型仍然会被切换到密集模型上传模式, 反之亦然.

en_us.text: Changing this value may affects your FPS. Smaller value means less in-flight frames, while larger values means more in-flight frames. More in-flight frames means more FPS but more VRAM.

zh_cn.text: 修改此项数值可能会影响FPS, 越高的值代表允许越多"in-flight frames", 反之亦然. 允许的"in-flight frames"越多, 提升的FPS越多, 但占用的显存也越多.
单次绘制最大允许合批数量

en_us.text: Changing this value may affects your FPS. Smaller value means less batches allowed in a draw call, while larger values means more batches. More batches means more FPS but more VRAM and more CPU pressure on handling RenderTypes.

zh_cn.text: 修改此项数值可能会影响FPS, 越高的值代表允许越多RenderType合并在一次绘制中, 反之亦然, 允许的数量越多, 提升的FPS越多, 但是占用的显存越多, 并且消耗更多CPU资源处理合批.

en_us.text: Changing this value may affects your FPS. Smaller value means less images allowed to be cached, while larger means more cached images. More cached images means more FPS but more RAM pressure.

zh_cn.text: 修改此项数值可能会影响FPS, 越高的值代表允许越多缓存贴图, 反之亦然, 允许的数量越多, 提升的FPS越多, 但是占用的内存越多.

en_us.text: Dynamic Render Type Cache UV Resolution

Changing this value may affects your visual effects and VRAM usage. Smaller value means lower resolution in UV scrolling and less cached render types, while larger means higher resolution and more cached render types. Higher resolution means smoother animations on charged creepers and breezes but more VRAM usage.

zh_cn.text: 修改此项数值可能会影响和显存占用. 越小的值代表越低的UV滚动分辨率和越少的被缓存的RenderType, 反之亦然. 分辨率越高, 闪电苦力怕和旋风人的动画越流畅, 但是占用的显存越多.

en_us.text:
- INDIRECT: Indices of vertices will be generated automatically every draw call, which allows advanced orientation culling to be applied before the actual draw call. But it could be slightly slower when there are too many draw calls present in a frame.
- BASEVERTEX: Indices of vertices will be cached across the draw calls and frames, which will be faster when there are too many draw calls present in a frame. But orientation culling will be disabled when using this method.

zh_cn.text:
- INDIRECT: 顶点的索引将会在每次绘制调用前自动生成, 因此可以在绘制前使用更高级的面朝向剔除. 但它可能会在每帧有过多绘制调用时有轻微的性能下降.
- BASEVERTEX: 顶点的索引将在绘制调用与帧之间复用缓存, 在每帧有过多绘制调用时能保证良好的性能. 但使用此方法会自动禁用面朝向剔除.

en_us.text:
- SIMPLE: All faces including invisible faces of the model will be included in the final mesh of the model. It might be slower when rendering some models but it allows same models with different textures to be merged more effectively.
- CULLED: Invisible faces of the model will be excluded from the final mesh of the model. It will speed up the rendering of some specific models but it might break the merging of same models with different textures.

zh_cn.text:
- SIMPLE: 包括不可见面在内的所有面都将被纳入最终生成的模型中. 部分特殊模型可能会因此渲染速度较慢, 但这个方法能保证不同贴图的相同模型能更有效地被合并.
- CULLED: 不可见面将被剔除出最终生成的模型. 部分特殊模型的渲染速度会因此加快, 但拥有不同材质的相同模型可能会因此无法合并.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Debug context will be disabled, which may cause significant rendering glitches on some NVIDIA cards because of the "theaded optimization".
- ENABLED: Debug context will be enabled, which can prevent NVIDIA driver from applying the "threaded optimization" that causes the glitches.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 调试上下文将会被禁用, 可能会在部分启用"theaded optimization"的NVIDIA显卡上有严重视觉错误.
- ENABLED: 调试上下文将会被启用, 以阻止会NVIDIA显卡驱动应用会导致严重视觉错误的"threaded optimization".

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Translucent RenderType will fallback to vanilla rendering pipeline if the accelerated pipeline does not support translucent sorting unless mods explicitly enable force translucent acceleration temporarily when rendering their own faces.
- ENABLED: Translucent RenderType will still be rendered in accelerated pipeline even if the pipeline does not support translucent sorting unless mods explicitly disable force translucent acceleration temporarily when rendering their own faces.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其面片时显示声明加速半透明, 否则被标记为半透明的RenderType将会在加速管线不支持半透明排序时使用原版渲染管线.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其面片时显式声明关闭强制半透明加速, 否则即使加速管线不支持半透明排序, 被标记为半透明的RenderType依然会使用加速管线进行渲染.

en_us.text:
- SIMPLE: The most basic implementation of cache. Usually used for testing if other cache types are working correctly.
- HANDLE: Faster implementation of cache using VarHandle and flatten values to improve performance on read/write operations.
- UNSAFE: Fastest implementation of cache using unsafe memory operations that skip multiple safety checks to read/write.

zh_cn.text:
- SIMPLE: 最基础的缓存实现, 通常用来检测其他缓存类型是否正常工作.
- HANDLE: 更快的缓存实现, 使用VarHandle和扁平化数据来提高读写性能.
- UNSAFE: 最快的缓存实现, 使用了不安全的内存操作来跳过多项检查进行读写.

en_us.text:
- SORTED: The basic implementation of batching layer storage that renders opaque and translucent geometries together in a single stage with better performance but slight visual glitches on translucent geometries.
- SEPARATED: The visually-precise implementation of batching layer storage that separates opaque and translucent geometries into two rendering stages to prevent visual glitches, slightly slower than basic implementation.

zh_cn.text:
- SORTED: 最基础的实现, 将不透明与半透明模型一同在一个单独的阶段中进行渲染, 性能更好但可能造成半透明模型的视觉错误.
- SEPARATED: 视觉上更精确的实现, 将不透明与半透明模型分至两个单独的阶段渲染以防止视觉错误, 略慢于基础实现.

en_us.text:
- IGNORED: Meshes with identical vertices will not be merged, which will use less RAM but more VRAM in storing duplicated meshes.
- MERGED: Meshes with identical vertices will be merged together, which will use less VRAM more RAM in storing the data of meshes used in merging.

zh_cn.text:
- IGNORED: 拥有完全一致顶点的模型将不会被合并, 占用的内存更少但是为储存重复模型占用的显存更多.
- MERGED: 拥有完全一致顶点的模型将会被合并, 占用的显存更少但为储存合并所需要的信息所占用的内存更多.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Meshes that is going to be accelerated will be collected and uploaded together at the end for choosing better uploading method and increasing memory access efficiency to reach the best performance. Also this method allows mesh cache with bigger capacity (up to VRAM limit), but it may not follow the correct draw order.
- ENABLED: Meshes that is going to be accelerated will be uploaded immediately after the draw command. It is less efficient and only have about 2GB mesh cache (generally enough) but will follow the original draw order to get the most compatibility.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 将要被加速的模型将会被统计收集并在最后统一上传以选择更好的上传方法和更好的内存访问效率, 同时这个方法允许更多(2GB以上直到显存限制)的模型缓存容量, 但这个方式可能不会按照正常渲染顺序并造成部分渲染异常.
- ENABLED: 将要被加速的模型将会在绘制指令后立即上传, 这样相对更低效, 且只有通常2GB左右的模型缓存(大多数情况下足够了), 但是能保证绘制顺序一致以提供最好的兼容性.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Dynamic render types like lightning on charged creepers and winds on breezes will not be accelerated for less VRAM usage and smoother animations, but may exceptionally skip acceleration in modded geometries using these render types.
- ENABLED: Dynamic render types like lightning on charged creepers and winds on breezes will be accelerated to accelerate modded geometries using these render types, but may have more VRAM usage and less smooth animations based on resolution settings.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 诸如闪电苦力怕的闪电和旋风人的风所使用的动态RenderType将不会被加速, 占用更少显存的同时动画更流畅, 但可能意外跳过其他MOD使用这些动态RenderType进行渲染的模型的加速.
- ENABLED: 诸如闪电苦力怕的闪电和旋风人的风所使用的动态RenderType将会被加速以加速其他MOD使用这些动态RenderType进行渲染的模型, 但是占用更多显存, 以及基于分辨率设置可能导致的不太流畅的动画.

en_us.text:
- IGNORED: Viewport settings that will be modified by other mods will not be restored after the acceleration, which is faster but reduces compatibility with them.
- MOJANG: Viewport settings that will be modified by other mods will be recorded and restored using Mojang's GLStateManager to work correctly with them.
- OPENGL: Viewport settings that will be modified by other mods will be recorded and restored using OpenGL to work correctly with them even if they don't set viewport using Mojang's GLStateManager, which is slower but has most compatibility.

zh_cn.text:
- IGNORED: 禁用可视区域还原, 更快, 但可能降低了对修改了可视区域的MOD兼容性.
- MOJANG: 使用Mojang提供的GLStateManager对可能被其他MOD修改的可视区域进行记录和还原, 以改善兼容性.
- OPENGL: 使用OpenGL对可能被其他MOD修改的可视区域进行记录和还原, 以在即使MOD不使用Mojang提供的GLStateManager的情况下改善兼容性, 略慢但能保证最佳兼容性.

en_us.text:
- IGNORED: Scissor settings that will be modified by other mods will not be restored after the acceleration, which is faster but reduces compatibility with them.
- MOJANG: Scissor settings that will be modified by other mods will be recorded and restored using Mojang's GuiGraphics to work correctly with them.
- OPENGL: Scissor settings that will be modified by other mods will be recorded and restored using OpenGL to work correctly with them even if they don't set viewport using Mojang's GuiGraphics, which is slower but has most compatibility.

zh_cn.text:
- IGNORED: 禁用裁切区域还原, 更快, 但可能降低了对修改了裁切区域的MOD兼容性.
- MOJANG: 使用Mojang提供的GuiGraphics对可能被其他MOD修改的裁切区域进行记录和还原, 以改善兼容性.
- OPENGL: 使用OpenGL对可能被其他MOD修改的裁切区域进行记录和还原, 以在即使MOD不使用Mojang提供的GuiGraphics的情况下改善兼容性, 略慢但能保证最佳兼容性.

en_us.text:
A few mods and shader packs will use their on block buffers when rendering, which may introduce conflicts when working with Accelerated Rendering that also uses block buffers.
Block Buffer Restoring can record the binding of block buffers before the acceleration and restore them after the acceleration to work correctly with them.

zh_cn.text:
部分MOD和光影会使用块缓冲进行渲染, 可能会与同样使用块缓冲的加速渲染造成冲突.
块缓冲还原可以在加速前记录块缓冲绑定, 在加速后还原成加速前的块缓冲绑定以实现更好的兼容性

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Disable block buffer restoring, which is faster but may cause visual glitches with mods and shaders that uses block buffers.
- ENABLED: Enable block buffer restoring, which may be slower due to recording and restoring block buffer bindings that ensures working correctly with mods and shaders that use block buffers.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁用块缓冲还原, 速度更快但可能与使用块缓冲的MOD和光影冲突.
- ENABLED: 启用块缓冲还原, 速度可能由于需要记录和还原块缓冲绑定而略慢, 但能确保在使用了块缓冲的MOD和光影的环境中正常工作.

en_us.text:
- SIMPLE: The most basic implementation of cache. Usually used for testing if other cache types are working properly.
- HANDLE: Faster implementation of cache using VarHandle and flatten values to improve performance on read/write operations.
- UNSAFE: Fastest implementation of cache using unsafe memory operations that skip multiple safety checks to read/write.

zh_cn.text:
- SIMPLE: 最基础的缓存实现, 通常用来检测其他缓存类型是否正常工作.
- HANDLE: 更快的缓存实现, 使用VarHandle和扁平化数据来提高读写性能.
- UNSAFE: 最快的缓存实现, 使用了不安全的内存操作来跳过多项检查进行读写.
着色器储存缓冲还原类型

en_us.text:
- IGNORED: Shader storage buffers will not be restored which improves FPS but reduces compatibility with mods and shaders that ues shader storage buffers.
- RESTORED: Shader storage buffers will be restored, which is slight slower but has better compatibility with mods and shaders that ues shader storage buffers.

zh_cn.text:
- IGNORED: 着色器储存缓冲的还原将被忽略, 可以改善FPS但可能降低与使用了着色器储存缓冲的MOD和光影的兼容性.
- RESTORED: 着色器储存缓冲将被记录和还原, 可能略微降低FPS但与使用了着色器储存缓冲的MOD和光影有更好的兼容性.
原子计数器缓冲还原类型

en_us.text:
- IGNORED: Atomic counter buffers will not be restored which improves FPS but reduces compatibility with mods and shaders that ues atomic counter buffers.
- RESTORED: Atomic counter buffers will be restored, which is slight slower but has better compatibility with mods and shaders that ues atomic counter buffers.

zh_cn.text:
- IGNORED: 原子计数器缓冲的还原将被忽略, 可以改善FPS但可能降低与使用了原子计数器缓冲的MOD和光影的兼容性.
- RESTORED: 原子计数器缓冲将被记录和还原, 可能略微降低FPS但与使用了原子计数器缓冲的MOD和光影有更好的兼容性.
着色器储存缓冲还原范围

en_us.text:
Range of shader storage buffer bindings that will be restored.
Changing this value may affects your FPS. Smaller value means less shader storage buffer restored but less compatibility, while larger values means more shader storage buffer restored and better compatibility. More shader storage buffers means less FPS.

zh_cn.text:
将要被记录和还原的着色器储存缓冲绑定点范围.
修改此项数值可能会影响FPS. 越高的值代表越大的着色器储存缓冲还原范围和更好的兼容性, 越小的值代表越少的着色器储存缓冲还原范围但更差的兼容性, 还原范围越大, 开销造成的FPS降低越大.
原子计数器缓冲还原范围

en_us.text:
Range of atomic counter buffer bindings that will be restored.
Changing this value may affects your FPS. Smaller value means less atomic counter buffer restored but less compatibility, while larger values means more atomic counter buffer restored and better compatibility. More atomic counter buffers means less FPS.

zh_cn.text:
将要被记录和还原的原子计数器缓冲绑定点范围.
修改此项数值可能会影响FPS. 越高的值代表越大的原子计数器缓冲还原范围和更好的兼容性, 越小的值代表越少的原子计数器缓冲还原范围但更差的兼容性, 还原范围越大, 开销造成的FPS降低越大.

en_us.text: Accelerated Entity Rendering uses GPU to cache and transform vertices whiling rendering entities, instead of generating and transforming vertices every time the entities are rendered in CPU.

zh_cn.text: 加速实体渲染使用GPU对ModelPart进行缓存和顶点变换, 而非原版在CPU每次渲染时重建和变换顶点.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Disable accelerated entity rendering.
- ENABLED: Enable accelerated entity rendering.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁用加速实体渲染.
- ENABLED: 启用加速实体渲染.

en_us.text:
- VANILLA: Entities will not be rendered into the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own entities.
- ACCELERATED: All entities will be rendered in the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own entities.

zh_cn.text:
- VANILLA: 除非其他MOD在渲染其实体时显式声明临时开启加速渲染, 否则实体将不会通过加速管线渲染.
- ACCELERATED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其实体时时显式声明临时关闭加速渲染, 否则实体将始终通过加速管线渲染.

en_us.text:
- CLIENT: Cached mesh will be stored on the client side (CPU), which will use less VRAM but take more time to upload to the server side (GPU) during rendering.
- SERVER: Cached mesh will be stored on the server side (GPU), which may speed up rendering but will use more VRAM to store the mesh.

zh_cn.text:
- CLIENT: 模型将缓存在客户端(CPU)侧, 占用更少显存, 但渲染时可能会耗费额外时间上传至服务端侧(GPU).
- SERVER: 模型将缓存在服务端(GPU)侧, 获得更好的渲染性能, 但会占用更多显存.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerated Rendering will not accelerate entities when rendering it in a GUI unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own entities.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will still accelerate entities when rendering it in a GUI unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own entities.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其实体时显式声明临时开启GUI实体加速, 实体将不会在GUI绘制中被加速渲染.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其实体时显式声明临时关闭GUI实体加速, 实体将始终会在GUI绘制中被加速渲染.

en_us.text: Accelerated Item Rendering uses GPU to cache and transform vertices while rendering item models, instead of generating and transforming vertices every time the item models are rendered in CPU.

zh_cn.text: 加速物品渲染使用GPU对物品模型进行缓存和顶点变换, 而非原版在CPU每次渲染时重建和变换顶点.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Disable accelerated item rendering.
- ENABLED: Enable accelerated item rendering.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁用加速物品渲染.
- ENABLED: 启用加速物品渲染.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerated Rendering will not bake mesh for quads provided by dynamic item models (something that is not SimpleBakedModel) unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own item models.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will bake mesh for all quads provided by dynamic item models (something that is not SimpleBakedModel) unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own item models, which will accelerate the rendering of these models but will crash if they keep allocating new quad data. (but who will?)

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 除非MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明开启动态面缓存, 否则加速渲染将不会为动态物品模型(不属于SimpleBakedModel的模型)提供的面进行模型缓存.
- ENABLED: 除非MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明临时关闭动态面缓存, 否则加速渲染将会为所有动态物品模型(不属于SimpleBakedModel的模型)提供的面进行模型缓存, 加速动态物品模型的渲染, 但如果动态物品模型一直分配新的面数据则有可能崩溃. (没人这么干, 就算这么干了, 那也是他们的错)

en_us.text:
- VANILLA: Item models will not be rendered into the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own item models.
- ACCELERATED: All item models will be rendered in the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own item models.

zh_cn.text:
- VANILLA: 除非其他MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明临时开启加速渲染, 否则物品模型将不会通过加速管线渲染.
- ACCELERATED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其物品模型时时显式声明临时关闭加速渲染, 否则物品模型将始终通过加速管线渲染.

en_us.text:
- CLIENT: Cached mesh will be stored on the client side (CPU), which will use less VRAM but take more time to upload to the server side (GPU) during rendering.
- SERVER: Cached mesh will be stored on the server side (GPU), which may speed up rendering but will use more VRAM to store the mesh.

zh_cn.text:
- CLIENT: 模型将缓存在客户端(CPU)侧, 占用更少显存, 但渲染时可能会耗费额外时间上传至服务端侧(GPU).
- SERVER: 模型将缓存在服务端(GPU)侧, 获得更好的渲染性能, 但会占用更多显存.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerated Rendering will not accelerate item models that are marked as "too small to make up the cost of acceleration" when rendering it in hand unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own item models.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will still accelerate item models that are marked as "too small to make up the cost of acceleration" when rendering it in hand unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own item models, which may slightly reduce the FPS but accelerate vanilla-like modded item models with large amount of vertices.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明临时开启手中物品加速, 否则加速渲染将不会在渲染手中物品时加速那些被标记为"太过简单加速后无法弥补加速带来的开销"的模型.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明临时关闭手中物品加速, 否则加速渲染将仍然会在渲染手中物品时加速那些被标记为"太过简单加速后无法弥补加速带来的开销"的模型, 这可能会造成额外开销轻微降低FPS, 但是允许加速那些拥有大量顶点的类原版MOD物品模型.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerated Rendering will not accelerate item models that are marked as "too small to make up the cost of acceleration" when rendering it in a container GUI unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own item models.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will still accelerate item models that are marked as "too small to make up the cost of acceleration" when rendering it in a container GUI unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own item models, which may slightly reduce the FPS but accelerate vanilla-like modded item models with large amount of vertices.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明临时开启GUI物品加速, 否则加速渲染将不会在渲染容器GUI时加速那些被标记为"太过简单加速后无法弥补加速带来的开销"的模型.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明临时关闭GUI物品加速, 否则加速渲染将仍然会在渲染容器GUI时加速那些被标记为"太过简单加速后无法弥补加速带来的开销"的模型, 这可能会造成额外开销轻微降低FPS, 但是允许加速那些拥有大量顶点的类原版MOD物品模型.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Items in the container GUI will be rendered as per item per batch if the GUI Acceleration is enabled, which is inefficient and may cause reduction in FPS, but it has better compatibility in modded container GUI.
- ENABLED: Items in the container GUI will be rendered together in a single batch if the GUI Acceleration is enabled, which is much more efficient but has little compatibility in modded container GUI.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 当GUI物品加速开启时, 在容器GUI中被渲染的物品将以每渲染一次物品就执行一次绘制的方式进行渲染, 这样比较低效并对FPS造成较大影响, 但拥有更好的MOD兼容性.
- ENABLED: 当GUI物品加速开启时, 在容器GUI中被渲染的物品将会统一收集至一次合批中绘制, 这样极大提升了渲染效率但是对MOD的容器GUI兼容性较差.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Items rendered in background and slots will be separated into two batches when accelerate container GUI, which is inefficient any may cause slight reduction in FPS, but it has better compatibility in modded container GUI.
- ENABLED: Items rendered in background and slots will be merged into a single batch when accelerate container GUI, which is much more efficient but has less compatibility in modded container GUI.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 当GUI物品合批时, 背景和物品栏渲染的物品将独立分为两个批次进行绘制, 这样比较低效并对FPS有轻微影响, 但拥有更好的MOD兼容性.
- ENABLED: 当GUI物品合批时, 背景和物品栏渲染的物品将合并为一个单独的批次进行绘制, 这样提升了渲染效率但是对MOD的容器GUI兼容性较差.

en_us.text: Accelerated Text Rendering uses GPU to cache and transform vertices whiling rendering text through BakedGlyph, instead of generating and transforming vertices every time the text are rendered in CPU.

zh_cn.text: 加速文字渲染使用GPU对BakedGlyph进行缓存和顶点变换, 而非原版在CPU每次渲染时重建和变换顶点.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Disable accelerated text rendering.
- ENABLED: Enable accelerated text rendering.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁用加速文字渲染.
- ENABLED: 启用加速文字渲染.

en_us.text:
- VANILLA: Text will not be rendered into the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own text.
- ACCELERATED: All text will be rendered in the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own text.

zh_cn.text:
- VANILLA: 除非其他MOD在渲染其文字时显式声明临时开启加速渲染, 否则文字将不会通过加速管线渲染.
- ACCELERATED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其文字时时显式声明临时关闭加速渲染, 否则文字将始终通过加速管线渲染.

en_us.text:
- CLIENT: Cached mesh will be stored on the client side (CPU), which will use less VRAM but take more time to upload to the server side (GPU) during rendering.
- SERVER: Cached mesh will be stored on the server side (GPU), which may speed up rendering but will use more VRAM to store the mesh.

zh_cn.text:
- CLIENT: 模型将缓存在客户端(CPU)侧, 占用更少显存, 但渲染时可能会耗费额外时间上传至服务端侧(GPU).
- SERVER: 模型将缓存在服务端(GPU)侧, 获得更好的渲染性能, 但会占用更多显存.

en_us.text: Simple orientation face culling uses an compute shader before the draw call to discard faces that is not visible on screen by checking if it is facing to the screen using a determinant of 3 * 3 matrix.

zh_cn.text: 简单朝向面剔除在绘制调用前使用一个根据3x3矩阵行列式来判断面是否朝向屏幕的ComputeShader(计算着色器)来剔除在屏幕上不可见的面, 减少需要绘制的面数.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Disable simple orientation face culling.
- ENABLED: Enable simple orientation face culling.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁用简单朝向面剔除.
- ENABLED: 启用简单朝向面剔除.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Faces will not be culled unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own geometries.
- ENABLED: All faces will be culled unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own geometries.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其模型时显式声明临时开启简单朝向面剔除, 否则面片将不会被剔除
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其模型时显式声明临时关闭简单朝向面剔除, 否则面片将始终被剔除.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Simple orientation face culling will not cull entities that are not declared as "cullable".
- ENABLED: Simple orientation face culling will cull all entities even if they are not declared as "cullable", which may cause slightly visual differences.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 简单朝向面剔除将不会剔除被声明为不可剔除的实体
- ENABLED: 简单朝向面剔除将会对所有实体进行强制剔除, 即使其被声明为不可剔除, 可能会造成轻微渲染差异.

en_us.text: Filters allows you to prevent specific entities/block entities/items from being accelerated when rendering for better compatibility.

zh_cn.text: 过滤器允许为了兼容性手动配置阻止部分实体/方块/物品在渲染时被加速

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Filters will be disabled and all entities, block entities and items will be accelerated when rendering.
- ENABLED: Filters will test if the entities, block entities and items should be accelerated when rendering based on the filter values and the filter type.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 过滤器将被禁用, 所有的实体/方块实体/物品都将在渲染时被加速.
- ENABLED: 过滤器将在渲染实体/方块实体/物品时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否为该实体/方块实体进行加速.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Menu filter will be disabled and geometries in all container GUI will be accelerated.
- ENABLED: Menu filter will test if geometries in specific container GUI should be accelerated when rendering based on the filter values and the filter type.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 容器GUI过滤器将被禁用, 所有容器GUI中的模型都将被加速.
- ENABLED: 容器GUI过滤器将在渲染对容器GUI中的模型时时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否为该模型进行加速.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Entity filter will be disabled and all entities will be accelerated.
- ENABLED: Entity filter will test if the entities should be accelerated when rendering based on the filter values and the filter type.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 实体过滤器将被禁用, 所有的实体都将在渲染时被加速.
- ENABLED: 实体过滤器将在渲染实体时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否为该实体进行加速.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Block entity filter will be disabled and all block entities will be accelerated.
- ENABLED: Block entity filter will test if the block entities should be accelerated when rendering based on the filter values and the filter type.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 方块实体过滤器将被禁用, 所有的方块实体都将在渲染时被加速.
- ENABLED: 方块实体过滤器将在渲染实体时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否为该方块实体进行加速.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Item filter will be disabled and all items will be accelerated.
- ENABLED: Item filter will test if the items should be accelerated when rendering based on the filter values and the filter type.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 物品过滤器将被禁用, 所有的物品都将在渲染时被加速.
- ENABLED: 物品过滤器将在渲染实体时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否为该物品进行加速.
启用自定义渲染阶段过滤器

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Custom rendering stage filter will be disabled and geometries in all custom rendering stages will be accelerated.
- ENABLED: Custom rendering stage filter will test if geometries in specific custom rendering stage should be accelerated when rendering based on the filter values and the filter type.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 自定义渲染阶段过滤器将被禁用, 所有自定义渲染阶段中的模型都将被加速.
- ENABLED: 自定义渲染阶段过滤器将在渲染对应自定义渲染阶段中的模型时时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否为该模型进行加速.

en_us.text:
- BLACKLIST: Container GUIs that are not in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
- WHITELIST: Container GUIs that are in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.

zh_cn.text:
- BLACKLIST: 不在容器GUI过滤器列表中的容器GUI将通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即黑名单).
- WHITELIST: 只有在容器GUI过滤器列表中的容器GUI才能通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即白名单).

en_us.text:
- BLACKLIST: Entities that are not in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
- WHITELIST: Entities that are in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.

zh_cn.text:
- BLACKLIST: 不在实体过滤器列表中的实体类型将通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即黑名单).
- WHITELIST: 只有在实体过滤器列表中的实体类型才能通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即白名单).

en_us.text:
- BLACKLIST: Block entities that are not in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
- WHITELIST: Block entities that are in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.

zh_cn.text:
- BLACKLIST: 不在方块实体过滤器列表中的方块实体类型将通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即黑名单).
- WHITELIST: 只有在方块实体过滤器列表中的方块实体类型才能通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即白名单).

en_us.text:
- BLACKLIST: Items that are not in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
- WHITELIST: Items that are in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.

zh_cn.text:
BLACKLIST: 不在物品过滤器列表中的物品将通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即黑名单).
- WHITELIST: 只有在物品过滤器列表中的物品才能通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即白名单).
自定义渲染阶段过滤器类型

en_us.text:
- BLACKLIST: Custom rendering stages that are not in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
- WHITELIST: Custom rendering stages that are in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.

zh_cn.text:
- BLACKLIST: 不在自定义渲染阶段过滤器列表中的自定义渲染通道将通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即黑名单).
- WHITELIST: 只有在自定义渲染阶段过滤器列表中的自定义渲染阶段才能通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即白名单).

en_us.text:
You can configure the menu filter by this list.
Menu filter will use this list and the filter type to determine if a container GUI can pass the filter.

zh_cn.text:
你可以通过这个列表配置容器GUI过滤器.
容器GUI过滤器将根据这个列表和过滤器类型来判断对应容器GUI能否通过过滤器.

en_us.text:
You can configure the entity filter by this list.
Entity filter will use this list and the filter type to determine if an entity can pass the filter.

zh_cn.text:
你可以通过这个列表配置实体过滤器.
实体过滤器将根据这个列表和过滤器类型来判断对应实体能否通过过滤器.

en_us.text:
You can configure the block entity filter by this list.
Block entity filter will use this list and the filter type to determine if a block entity can pass the filter.

zh_cn.text:
你可以通过这个列表配置方块实体过滤器.
方块实体过滤器将根据这个列表和过滤器类型来判断对应方块实体能否通过过滤器.

en_us.text:
You can configure the item filter by this list.
Item filter will use this list and the filter type to determine if an item can pass the filter.

zh_cn.text:
你可以通过这个列表配置物品过滤器.
物品过滤器将根据这个列表和过滤器类型来判断对应物品能否通过过滤器.
自定义渲染阶段过滤器列表

en_us.text:
You can configure the custom rendering stage filter by this list.
Custom rendering stage filter will use this list and the filter type to determine if a custom rendering stage can pass the filter.
It's not recommend to modify this list unless other mods adds their own custom rendering stages.

zh_cn.text:
你可以通过这个列表配置自定义渲染阶段过滤器.
自定义渲染阶过滤器将根据这个列表和过滤器类型来判断对应自定义渲染阶能否通过过滤器.
除非其他MOD添加了新的自定义渲染阶段, 否则不推荐修改次列表.

en_us.text: Iris Compatibility Settings allows Accelerated Rendering to work correctly with Iris.

zh_cn.text: Iris兼容性配置允许加速渲染在Iris环境下正常工作.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerated Rendering will be incompatible with Iris and cause visual glitches when working with Iris.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will use compute shaders that fits Iris's vertex formats, which make it compatible with Iris.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 加速渲染将与Iris不兼容, 并在与Iris一同工作时造成视觉错误.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将使用与Iris顶点格式匹配的兼容Shader用于在Iris环境中正常工作并兼容Iris.
启用朝向法线剔除兼容

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Simple orientation face culling will not work with Iris because the culling shader is for vanilla's vertex formats.
- ENABLED: Simple orientation face culling will use another culling shader that fits iris's vertex format, which make it compatible with Iris.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 在Iris环境下简单朝向面剔除将不可用, 因为其剔除Shader仅为原版顶点格式设计.
- ENABLED: 简单朝向面剔除将使用与Iris顶点格式匹配的兼容Shader用于在Iris环境中正常剔除.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Entities will not be culled when they are rendered as shadows unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own shadows. Which reduce FPS due to redundant faces.
- ENABLED: Entities will be culled when they are rendered as shadows unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own shadows. Redundant faces will be culled and improve FPS, but it may cause incorrect shadows.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其阴影时显示声明启用阴影剔除, 否则当实体渲染阴影时, 多余的面将不会被剔除, 这可能导致由多余面造成的FPS下降.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其阴影时显示声明禁用阴影剔除, 否则当实体渲染阴影时, 多余的面将会被剔除以提升FPS, 但这可能会导致不正确的阴影渲染.
启用多边形额外数据计算

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Extra information in vertices provided by Iris will not be included or calculated in the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own geometries, which may cause visual glitches or incorrect rendering.
- ENABLED: Extra information in vertices provided by Iris will be included and calculated in the accelerated pipeline by a compute shader unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own geometries.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其模型时显示声明启用额外数据计算, 否则加速渲染管线将不会计算或上传顶点中由Iris提供的额外信息, 可能会造成视觉错误或不正确的渲染结果.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其模型时显示声明禁用额外数据计算, 否则加速渲染管线将会使用ComputeShader(计算着色器)计算并上传顶点中由Iris提供的额外信息.

en_us.text: Curios Compatibility Settings allows Accelerated Rendering to work correctly with Curios.

zh_cn.text: Curios兼容性配置允许加速渲染在Curios环境下正常工作.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerated Rendering will not interrupt the acceleration of the Curios layer on entities.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will interrupt the acceleration of Curios layer on entities to prevent some mods using extremely bad rendering code that breaks the caching of Accelerated Rendering.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 加速渲染将不会中断对于实体中Curios层的加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会终止实体中Curios层的加速防止部分MOD因为过于离谱的渲染代码导致损坏加速渲染的缓存机制.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Curios layer will not be accelerated by default to prevent some mods using extremely bad rendering code that breaks the caching of Accelerated Rendering unless mods explicitly enable the acceleration when rendering their accessories or equipments.
- ENABLED: Curios layer will be accelerated by default unless mods explicitly enable the acceleration when rendering their accessories or equipments.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其饰品或装备时显式声明启用Curios层加速, 否则加速渲染将不会对Curios层进行加速, 以此确保加速渲染不会因为部分MOD过于离谱的渲染代码导致崩溃.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其饰品或装备时显式声明关闭Curios层加速, 否则加速渲染将会默认开启Curios层加速.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Curios item filter will be disabled and acceleration of the rendering of all curios accessories/equipments will be determined by the "layer acceleration" option.
- ENABLED: Curios item filter will test if the acceleration of the curios accessories/equipments should be prevented based on the filter values and the filter type.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: Curios物品过滤器将被禁用, 所有Curios饰品或装备是否加速都由"启用Curios层加速" (Enable Curios Layer Acceleration) 这个选项控制.
- ENABLED: Curios物品过滤器将在渲染Curios饰品或装备时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否阻止没通过过滤器的饰品或装备的加速.

en_us.text:
- BLACKLIST: Curios items that are not in the filter values can pass the filter and not being prevented to be accelerated."
- WHITELIST: Curios items that are in the filter values can pass the filter and not being prevented to be accelerated."

zh_cn.text:
- BLACKLIST: 不在Curios物品过滤器列表中的Curios物品将通过过滤器 (即黑名单).
- WHITELIST: 只有在Curios物品过滤器列表中的Curios物品才能通过过滤器 (即白名单).

en_us.text:
You can configure the curios item filter by this list.
Curios item filter will use this list and the filter type to determine if a curios item can pass the filter.

zh_cn.text:
你可以通过这个列表配置Curios物品过滤器.
Curios物品过滤器将根据这个列表和过滤器类型来判断对应Curios物品能否通过过滤器.

en_us.text: Miscellaneous Mod Compatibility Settings allows Accelerated Rendering to prevent negative optimization on specific mods by controlling whether Accelerated Rendering should accelerate the rendering of the corresponding mod.

zh_cn.text: 杂项MOD兼容性配置允许加速渲染通过控制是否对对应MOD启用加速以在对应MOD的环境下避免对其造成负优化

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of all mods listed in the miscellaneous mods compatibility settings will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will determine if a mod should be accelerated by the acceleration feature configuration item of this mod listed below.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 下列所有MOD的加速特性都将被禁用.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将根据这个MOD的加速特性配置项来决定是否为这个MOD启用加速.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Fixes for rendering order of armor trims and render layers in Vanilla Minecraft will be disabled, which is faster but cause slight visual inconsistency when rendering those features.
- ENABLED: Fixes for rendering order of armor trims and render layers in Vanilla Minecraft will be enabled, which is slower but has consistent and correct rendering order when rendering those features.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对原版Minecraft的盔甲纹饰和RenderLayer渲染顺序进行修复, 性能更好但是会造成轻微渲染不一致性.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对原版Minecraft的盔甲纹饰和RenderLayer渲染顺序进行修复, 性能可能略差但能确保渲染时的正确和顺序一致性.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of ModelPart models of Vanilla Minecraft will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of ModelPart models of Vanilla Minecraft will be enabled.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对原版Minecraft的ModelPart模型进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对原版Minecraft的ModelPart模型进行加速.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of animated ModelPart variants in Entity Model Features will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of animated ModelPart variants in Entity Model Features will be enabled.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对EMF(Entity Model Feature)的动画ModelPart变体进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对EMF的动画ModelPart变体进行加速.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of models in GeckoLib will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of models in GeckoLib will be enabled.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对GeckoLib模型进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将对GeckoLib模型进行加速.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of GeckoLib variant models in Touhou Little Maid will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of GeckoLib variant models in Touhou Little Maid will be enabled.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对车万女仆的GeckoLib模型变体进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对车万女仆的GeckoLib模型变体进行加速.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of bedrock models in Simple Bedrock Model will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of bedrock models in Simple Bedrock Model will be enabled.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对SBM(简单基岩版模型, SimpleBedrockModel)的基岩版模型进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对SBM的基岩版模型进行加速.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of UI driven by FTB Library will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of UI driven by FTB Library will be enabled.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对FTB Library驱动的UI界面(如FTB Quests)进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对FTB Library驱动的UI界面进行加速.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of UI driven by Sophisticated Core will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of UI driven by Sophisticated Core will be enabled.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对精妙核心驱动的UI界面(如精妙存储)进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对精妙核心驱动的UI界面进行加速.

en_us.text:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of text driven by ModernUI's modern text engine will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of text driven by ModernUI's modern text engine will be enabled.

zh_cn.text:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对现代化UI的现代化文字引擎所驱动的文字渲染进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对现代化UI的现代化文字引擎所驱动的文字渲染进行加速.

en_us.text: Accelerated Rendering is currently running in an unsupported environment. Accelerated Rendering will not take effect.

zh_cn.text: 加速渲染正运行在不受支持的环境中, 加速渲染将不会生效.
仅选择首个成功的条目
方块特定的动态掉落物

en_us.text: Selects entries sequentially until first failed

zh_cn.text: 按顺序选择条目直至失败
受魔咒影响的随机概率：
受抢夺影响的随机概率：
作为爆炸产物时，消失概率随爆炸范围衰减
堡垒遗迹疣猪兽棚箱子
新世界生成时的奖励箱
村庄热带草原房屋箱子
有概率躲避弹射物伤害

en_us.text: This is not a Falconry Glove
This is not a Falconry Glove

zh_cn.text: 寒霜潜伏者追随着号角

en_us.text: This is not a Vine Lasso
This is not a Vine Lasso
Enables gliding by jumping out of water

zh_cn.text: 支持跳出水面来进行滑翔
大多数的亡灵生物会变为中立

en_us.text: Make hostile arthropods neutral to the user.

zh_cn.text: 使得敌对的节肢动物对玩家保持中立。
允许使用者可以在天花板倒立行走。

en_us.text: An Effect which poisons the victim but paralyzes arthropods. It will stop if the victim is at half health and is not an arthropod. Inflicted by a Tarantula Hawk.

zh_cn.text: 一个会使受害者中毒但会使节肢动物麻痹的效果。若受害者不为节肢动物且生命值低于一半时，效果就会停止作用。受沙漠蛛蜂的攻击时会获得此效果。

en_us.text: After the effect runs out naturally, the user takes massive damage and an Enderiophage will spawn. Inflicted by an Enderiophage.

zh_cn.text: 当效果自然结束时，使用者会受到高额的伤害，并会生成一只末影噬菌体。受末影噬菌体的攻击时会获得此效果。

en_us.text: Makes the target unable to move. Effect applied when a Tiger reveals itself to the user.

zh_cn.text: 使目标无法移动。当老虎向玩家展示自己时会施以此效果。

en_us.text: Oil floats on water. Cover yourself in oil to float on the surface of water and outside in the rain.

zh_cn.text: 油是漂浮在水面上的。用油包裹住你自己，以便可以浮在水面上和飘在雨中。

en_us.text: Grants increased attack speed. Effect may be applied when swimming with an Orca.

zh_cn.text: 增加玩家的攻击速度。在与虎鲸一起游泳时会获得此效果。
赋予使用者免疫毒素的能力。

en_us.text: Grants the user attacks some life-steal.

zh_cn.text: 赋予玩家在攻击的时候可以窃取生命值的能力。

en_us.text: Decreases fall speed, prevents fall damage and makes it easier to fly with an Elytra or Tarantula Hawk Elytra. Effect is applied when near a Sunbird.

zh_cn.text: 减少下降速度，防止摔落伤害，使得穿戴鞘翅或者沙漠蛛蜂鞘翅的玩家可以更容易地进行飞行。在曦鹤附近时会获得此效果。

en_us.text: Increases fall speed, causing the user to hit the ground quicker. This effectively impedes the use of an Elytra. Effect is applied when attacking a Sunbird.

zh_cn.text: 增加下降速度，这导致玩家会更快地撞向地面。这实际上妨害了鞘翅的使用。在对曦鹤进行攻击时会获得此效果。

en_us.text: Tigers near the user will be neutral and will protect them from hostile foes. The effect will go away early when attacking a Tiger. Applied by feeding a Tiger chicken or pork chops.

zh_cn.text: 玩家附近的老虎会保持中立，并且还能保护玩家免遭敌人的攻击。在攻击老虎后，此效果就会消失。通过喂食老虎一些鸡肉或者猪排时会获得此效果。

en_us.text: Increases player speed whilst jumping and sprinting.

zh_cn.text: 在玩家同时跳跃和疾跑时，提升玩家的速度。

en_us.text: Hello, hello? Uhh, I wanted to record a message for you...

zh_cn.text: 嗨，嗨？ 额，我想给你录段信息……

en_us.text: Makes Crimson Mosquitoes avoid the player.

zh_cn.text: 使得绯红蚊子避开玩家。
被困在衣壳体中的幼虫

en_us.text: Increases the height of Straddleboard jumps.
Gives the rider of the Straddleboard Fire Resistance.
Makes Bone Serpents neutral towards the rider of the Straddleboard.

zh_cn.text: 当跨板手骑着跨板时可以令骨蟒保持中立。

en_us.text: Straddleboard returns instantly to the rider's inventory when broken.

zh_cn.text: 当跨板损坏时，自动收入跨板手的物品栏。

en_us.text: %s had the channels changed on them
%s had the channels changed on them by %s
%s was sent to the 4th dimension by %s
Discover the unique creatures of the world

zh_cn.text: 发现世上独一无二的生物。

en_us.text: Craft a Crimson Mosquito Larvae from a maggot and a special proboscis

zh_cn.text: 用一条蛆和一个特殊的口器来合成绯红孑孓。

en_us.text: Craft a Blood Sprayer from the drops of a Crimson Mosquito

zh_cn.text: 用绯红蚊子的掉落物来合成一个血液喷雾器。

en_us.text: Tame a Warped Toad, the perfect defense against any giant bug, with some larvae

zh_cn.text: 用一些幼虫来驯服一只对于任何巨型昆虫都具有完美防御的诡异蟾蜍。
用花儿来繁殖两只蜂鸟。

en_us.text: Craft a Hummingbird Feeder in order to keep hummingbirds nearby

zh_cn.text: 合成一个可以吸引蜂鸟们的蜂鸟喂食器。

en_us.text: Tame a Grizzly Bear by feeding it honey and salmon

zh_cn.text: 用蜂蜜和鲑鱼来喂食灰熊并驯服它。

en_us.text: Craft a Maraca with a Rattlesnake rattle

zh_cn.text: 用响尾蛇的响尾来合成一个沙槌。

en_us.text: Give a Maraca to a cockroach and enjoy the show. ¡La Cucaracha!

zh_cn.text: 把一个沙槌丢给蟑螂，然后享受表演吧！¡La Cucaracha!

en_us.text: Tame a capuchin monkey with bananas

zh_cn.text: 用香蕉驯服一只卷尾猴。

en_us.text: Receive a blessing from the great and noble sunbird

zh_cn.text: 接受来自崇高无上的曦鹤的祝福。

en_us.text: Craft sopa de macaco with a banana peel

zh_cn.text: 用一块香蕉皮来合成一碗猴儿汤。

en_us.text: Craft a crocodile chestplate from many crocodile scutes

zh_cn.text: 用许多片鳄鱼鳞甲来合成一件鳄鱼鳞甲胸甲。

en_us.text: Tame a Mantis Shrimp with many feedings of Tropical Fish

zh_cn.text: 用许多热带鱼来喂食螳螂虾并驯服它。

en_us.text: Breed two crocodiles with rotten flesh. Careful not to trample their eggs!

zh_cn.text: 给两只鳄鱼喂食腐肉，注意别踩碎了它们的蛋！

en_us.text: Shear a moss-covered Alligator Snapping Turtle and obtain a Spiked Scute

zh_cn.text: 修剪一只披满苔藓的大鳄龟并得到一个锥形鳞甲。

en_us.text: Sneak and give a tamed Mantis Shrimp a bucket of water so that it can live on land indefinitely

zh_cn.text: 偷偷给一只被驯服过的螳螂虾一桶水，这样它就可以在陆地上一直生活了。

en_us.text: Be granted a blessing from a wild Orca

zh_cn.text: 得到来自野生虎鲸的祝福

en_us.text: Obtain an Acacia Blossom from breaking Acacia Leaves

zh_cn.text: 打碎金合欢树叶并得到一朵金合欢花。

en_us.text: Tame an elephant by feeding it Acacia Blossoms

zh_cn.text: 用金合欢花来喂食大象并驯服它。
陆地上最大的哺乳动物

en_us.text: Tame a tusked elephant when it is a baby

zh_cn.text: 驯服一只处于婴儿时期的大象。

en_us.text: Place a colored carpet on an elephant

zh_cn.text: 把带有颜色的地毯放在大象身上。

en_us.text: Encounter a Soul Vulture in the nether

zh_cn.text: 在下界遇见一只灵魂鹫

en_us.text: Obtain a soul heart from slaying a bloated Soul Vulture

zh_cn.text: 通过杀死一只灵魂鹫来获得一个灵魂之心

en_us.text: Lure a Spectre in the end with a Soul Heart. Use a lead on them to hitch a ride!

zh_cn.text: 在末地用灵魂之心引诱一只灵翼。并用一根拴绳给拴起来！

en_us.text: Encounter a Guster during a stormy day in the desert

zh_cn.text: 当沙漠里刮起沙尘暴时遇见一只沙风怪

en_us.text: Craft a Gustmaker. Now you can make your own mini-storms!

zh_cn.text: 合成一个造风器。现在你可以制作一个属于你自己的小型风暴了！

en_us.text: Craft a Pocket Of Sand. Sha-sha!

zh_cn.text: 合成一个含沙射之袋。唦唦！

en_us.text: Feed a Crimson Mosquito a strange, fungal creature covered in Warped Fungus. Watch as the Crimson Mosquito transforms!

zh_cn.text: 给绯红蚊子喂食一种覆盖着诡异菌的真菌生物。然后看着绯红蚊子变化吧！

en_us.text: Slay the Warped Mosco, the swole defender of the Warped Forest.

zh_cn.text: 杀死诡异蚊鬼，诡异森林里强壮的保卫者。

en_us.text: Craft a Hemolyph Blaster, the ultimate upgrade to the Blood Sprayer.

zh_cn.text: 合成一个血淋巴喷射器，血液喷射器的最终版本。

en_us.text: Encounter a Straddler in the Basalt Deltas.

zh_cn.text: 在玄武岩三角洲中遇见一只跨座兽。

en_us.text: Feed a Stradpole some Mosquito Larva, in hopes of turning it into a Straddler.

zh_cn.text: 给跨座蝌蚪喂食一些孑孓，希望能把它变成跨座兽。

en_us.text: Craft a Straddleboard from some Netherite and Straddlerite.

zh_cn.text: 用一些下界合金和跨座晶石来合成一个跨板。
遇见一只鸸鹋。请谨慎行事。

en_us.text: See an emu dodge a launched projectile.

zh_cn.text: 看到过一只鸸鹋躲避发射出的弹射物。
我们实施了一次小型的拖捕行动……

en_us.text: Save a beached Cachalot Whale by pushing it into the water, and then have it reward you by coughing up some Ambergris

zh_cn.text: 把一头搁浅的抹香鲸推入水中, 然后它会吐出一些龙涎香作为回报。

en_us.text: Craft an Echolocator, which can reveal nearby caves

zh_cn.text: 合成一个可以寻找附近洞穴的回声定位器。

en_us.text: Craft an Endolocator, which can reveal nearby End Portal Frames

zh_cn.text: 合成一个可以寻找末地门的末影定位器。

en_us.text: Stomp on a Leafcutter Anthill - beware the angry denizens within!

zh_cn.text: 踩在切叶蚁丘上——得当心里面愤怒的住民！

en_us.text: Like a Truffle, with more Ant

zh_cn.text: 就像一块沾满了蚂蚁的松露

en_us.text: Harvest Gongylidia from a Leafcutter Ant Chamber underground. Place Shroomlight near the chamber to make sure you don't upset the locals

zh_cn.text: 从地下的切叶蚁室收集菌丝球。把菌光体放在蚁室的附近来确保不会惹怒它们。

en_us.text: Obtain a Leafcutter Ant Pupa, which can be placed on dirt to start a Leafcutter Ant colony.

zh_cn.text: 获得一个可以放在泥土上的切叶蚁蛹，以此来建立一个切叶蚁群。

en_us.text: Encounter an Enderiophage, a giant biomechanical construct found in the End Midlands. Be careful not to catch Ender Flu!

zh_cn.text: 在末地中型岛屿的一个巨大生物力学结构体里遇见一只末影噬菌体。小心别传染上末影流感！

en_us.text: Obtain a Capsid from a slain Enderiophage. Use it to display items or to transfer them upwards

zh_cn.text: 通过杀死末影噬菌体来获得一个衣壳体。使用它来展示物品或者往上传输物品。

en_us.text: Catch the Ender Flu effect. Cure it by eating many Chorus Fruit or drinking milk. Be sure not to let it run its toll!

zh_cn.text: 患上了末影流感。可以通过多吃紫颂果或者牛奶来治愈。确保别让它造成伤亡。
预备 末地 发射

en_us.text: Craft an Enderiophage Rocket, which can be used in place of Firework Rockets when in the End.

zh_cn.text: 合成一个末影噬菌体火箭，它可以代替烟花火箭在末地中发射。

en_us.text: Tame a bald eagle with fish oil.
Craft a Falconry Glove from Leather and Hair of Bear. Use it to pick up and launch tamed eagles!

zh_cn.text: 使用皮革和灰熊毛皮合成一双猎鹰手套。使用猎鹰手套可以与雕取得信任并驯服它！

en_us.text: Craft a Falconry Hood from Leather and a Roadrunner Feather. Eagles wearing one can be manually directed!

zh_cn.text: 使用皮革和走鹃羽毛合成一顶猎鹰兜帽。可以直接给雕手动戴上它。

en_us.text: Kill any creature from 100 blocks away with an eagle wearing a hood.

zh_cn.text: 让一只戴着兜帽的老鹰杀死 100 个方块以外的任意生物。

en_us.text: Receive a Tiger's Blessing after feeding it Porkchops, Chicken or other meats.

zh_cn.text: 在给老虎喂食猪肉、鸡肉或者其他肉类以后，获得来自老虎的祝福。

en_us.text: Encounter a Tarantula Hawk in a desert.

zh_cn.text: 在沙漠里遇见一只沙漠蛛蜂。

en_us.text: Tame a Tarantula Hawk by feeding it Spider Eyes.

zh_cn.text: 用蜘蛛眼来喂食一只沙漠蛛蜂并驯服它。

en_us.text: Create a Mysterious Worm by putting a Crimson Mosquito Larva in a Capsid.

zh_cn.text: 将一只绯红孑孓放进衣壳体中来创造出一种神秘的蠕虫。

en_us.text: Toss the Mysterious Worm into the void of the End, and prepare to meet the Void Worm.

zh_cn.text: 把神秘的蠕虫丢进末地的虚空里来准备迎接虚空蠕虫吧。

en_us.text: Split a void worm in half by attacking one of its body segments. More worms, more problems!

zh_cn.text: 攻击虚空蠕虫的身体使其一分为二，更多蠕虫，更多麻烦！

en_us.text: Using the drops of the Void Worm, create the Dimensional Carver, which allows you to dig through the fabric of reality to return home at any given point.

en_us.text: If you have 100%% or more stored in your Heart of Embers, pressing %s and %s will intensely imbue your weapon with flames and slam it against the ground, causing an explosion that summons a circle of flames beneath you and smaller circles of flames around all nearby entities, burning them and then exploding. This ability resonates with your Inner Flame, so the effect will change depending on your status. When the effect ends, the weapon will remain imbued with the fire element for a time.

zh_cn.text: 若你的余烬之心中储存了100%%或更多的热量，同时按下%s与%s，武器会被炽烈的烈焰附魔并猛砸向地面，引发爆炸——在你脚下召唤一圈火焰，并在附近所有实体周围召唤较小的火环，先将其灼烧、随后爆炸。该技能会与你的内在之焰共鸣，效果会随你的状态而改变。效果结束后，武器仍会附有火元素一段时间。

en_us.text:
For each entity struck, the heat from your Heart of Embers will be drained by 10%%. The area of effect is 10 blocks away. Casting the Incinerator ability will have a %s.

If cast while in Inner Flame state, the damage range and color will change, and it will no longer explode.

Additionally, if it has consumed at least 60%% of its temperature or more (Hit 6 entities or more), the weapon will be imbued with fire-type damage for a total of %s

zh_cn.text:
每命中一个实体，余烬之心中的热量便会被抽取10%%。作用范围为10格。施放焚烬技能将会有%s。

若在内在之焰状态下施放，伤害范围与颜色都会改变，且不再爆炸。

此外，若已消耗至少60%%的热量（命中6个及以上实体），武器将被赋予火焰类型伤害，共计%s

en_us.text: The blade of this weapon is engulfed in flames; these flames resonate with the life force of its victims. Inflicting damage or eliminating entities increases the amount of heat contained within the Heart of Embers.

zh_cn.text: 这把武器的剑刃被烈焰吞噬；这些火焰会与受害者的生命力产生共鸣。造成伤害或消灭实体会增加余烬之心所容纳的热量。

en_us.text:
Initially, 10% of the damage dealt is converted into heat, increased to 20% if the target is on fire.

Each level of Fire Aspect increases this base heat gain by +15%, and each piece of Ignitium armor adds an additional +5%.

Environmental conditions reduce the base heat gain as follows:

Water exposure (soaking, swimming, or being in water): −25%

Frozen biome: −10%

Rain: −15%

If the user is in the Inner Flame state, these environmental penalties are reduced by 65%. All environmental modifiers stack when applicable.

If the resulting base multiplier is below 0, no heat is generated.

After all base modifiers are applied, Inner Flame reduces the resulting heat gain by an additional 35%.

Finally, all heat gained is reduced by 60%, producing the final heat value.

zh_cn.text:
最初，所造成伤害的10%会转化为热量；若目标正在燃烧，则提升至20%。

火焰附加每提升一级，该基础热量获取便增加+15%，每件炽焰合金盔甲再额外增加+5%。

环境条件会按如下方式削减基础热量获取：

接触水（被浸湿、游泳或处于水中）：−25%

冰冻生物群系：−10%

降雨：−15%

若使用者处于内在之焰状态，这些环境惩罚会减少65%。所有环境修正值在满足条件时相互叠加。

若最终基础乘数低于0，则不会产生热量。

在应用所有基础修正后，内在之焰会将所得热量获取再削减35%。

最后，所有获取的热量会再减少60%，得出最终热量值。

en_us.text: Your inner fire, your will; those flames have manifested on the outside, enveloping the weapon, giving it even more strength than it ever had, in exchange for more power the final heat gain has dropped by 35%...

zh_cn.text: 你的内火，你的意志；那些火焰已显现于外，包裹着武器，赋予其前所未有的更强力量——作为获得更强力量的代价，最终热量获取降低了35%……

en_us.text: Increased heat gain per piece of armor: %s%%

zh_cn.text: 每件盔甲增加的热量获取：%s%%

en_us.text: Reduction of heat gain due to the environment: -%s%%

zh_cn.text: 因环境而降低的热量获取：-%s%%

en_us.text: Increases damage based on the heat stored in the Heart of Embers up to a maximum of 20%. This limit can be broken and increased to 35% while in Inner Flame state. Additionally, each piece of Ignitium armor increases damage by 1.25%.

zh_cn.text: 根据余烬之心中储存的热量提高伤害，最高可达20%。在内在之焰状态下，该上限可被突破并提升至35%。此外，每件炽焰合金盔甲可使伤害提高1.25%。
每件炽焰合金盔甲提升的伤害：%s%%

en_us.text:
Press %s to consume 15%% of the heat stored in your Emberheart. Upon doing so, you will precast a skill that awaits a target. Once one is found, Ignis orbs will rise into the sky to strike it. The amount of orbs increases based on the enchantment Fire Aspect.
It also marks nearby enemies, granting them the 'Blazing Mark' status if any, but doing so will cause the cooldown to increase by 25%%.

zh_cn.text:
按下%s，消耗余烬之心中储存热量的15%%。随后你会预施放一个等待目标的技能。一旦找到目标，焰魔宝珠便会升上天空并轰击目标。宝珠数量会随火焰附加附魔的等级而增加。
该技能还会标记附近的敌人，为其赋予「灼焰标记」状态（若存在），但这会使冷却时间增加25%%。

en_us.text:
Amount of orbs that will be generated: %s.

The orbs when launched will have an incorporeal body, that means that they will pass through until they enter the 'Impact state. The impact mode is reached once the orbs are close to the target entity, that means that the orbs pass through entities that are not the target, and only those that are close to it; the speed of movement of the orbs is dynamic and depends on the distance from the target as well as the time of incorporeal and impact.

Based on the number of orbs, each one will pounce with a small delay and will occupy a different position when over the user. If the entity dies, both orbs disappear. If the caster dies, the orbs will not disappear and will be launched towards the target until they are all consumed, or the target is killed.

zh_cn.text:
将生成的宝珠数量：%s。

宝珠发射后呈虚体状态，也就是说它们会直接穿透一切，直到进入「冲击状态」。当宝珠接近目标实体时便会进入冲击模式，也就是说宝珠会穿过并非目标的实体，只有接近目标者才会命中；宝珠的移动速度是动态的，取决于与目标的距离以及虚体与冲击阶段的时长。

根据宝珠数量，每颗宝珠会以微小延迟依次扑出，并在使用者上方占据不同的位置。若目标实体死亡，所有宝珠都会消失。若施放者死亡，宝珠不会消失，而是会继续飞向目标，直到全部耗尽或目标被击杀。

en_us.text: Once enough Kinetic Force has been stored in the Emberheart, and the latter contains at least 50%% Temperature in this same heart, it allows you to propel yourself strongly if you are looking down while pressing %s.

en_us.text: Once the effect is triggered, the user becomes effectively immortal during the skill duration fly or acceleration, and for 1 second after impact.

zh_cn.text: 效果触发后，使用者在技能持续期间的飞行或加速阶段处于无敌状态，并在撞击后1秒内保持无敌。

en_us.text: It allows the user to store kinetic energy while flying downwards. Once sufficient kinetic energy has been reached with a fall of more than 150 blocks and 'Champion of the Flames: Impact' has been launched, the user becomes immortal until impact with the ground. Upon impact, a fiery shockwave is activated. It burns enemies within a 15-block radius, dealing 26.5 damage. If the user is in the 'Inner Flame' state, the area damage is increased by 25%.

zh_cn.text: 使用者可以在向下飞行时储存动能。当坠落超过150格、储存了充足的动能，并且发动了「烈焰勇者：陨击」后，使用者在撞击地面之前处于无敌状态。撞击时会激活炽焰冲击波，灼烧15格半径内的敌人，造成26.5点伤害。若使用者处于「内在之焰」状态，范围伤害提高25%。

en_us.text: The amount of energy stored with a drop is relative, that means that even if it is 150 Blocks, starting from negative layers directly converts the value of the negative layer into a portion of the total drop, that means that if you start at Y = -60, the skill will start from Y = 60, and not from Y = 0, allowing the skill to be useful in caves, upon impact, an Impact Frame will be launched, which will affect all entities that have observed the drop. fall and the one who has fallen

zh_cn.text: 每次坠落所储存的能量是相对的，也就是说即使需要150格，从负高度层开始下落时，负高度层的数值会直接折算为总坠落距离的一部分——即如果你从Y = -60开始下落，技能会视为从Y = 60开始，而不是Y = 0，这使该技能在洞穴中也能派上用场。撞击时会触发一段冲击帧，影响所有目睹了此次坠落的实体以及坠落者本人。

en_us.text: Increases the maximum amount of heat by 10%
The effect is gained for each glove on each hand, therefore this effect is cumulative.

zh_cn.text: 每只手上的每只手套都会提供该效果，因此该效果可以叠加。

en_us.text: Modifies the behavior of the 'Glare' passive, allowing you to better exploit the radiance of each attack by more effectively catalyzing it in your hands. This modifies the damage bonus, increasing it for each catalyst you hold.

zh_cn.text: 改变「灼芒」被动的运作方式，让你能通过双手更有效地催化每次攻击的光芒，从而更好地利用它。这会修改伤害加成，每持有一件催化剂都会使其提高。

en_us.text:
The damage bonus modification is not linear; it operates according to the following logic:

One Artifact: The maximum damage bonus increases from 20% to 22%; in Inner Flame mode, it increases from 35% to 38.5%.

Two Artifact: The maximum damage bonus increases from 20% to 24%; in Inner Flame mode, it increases from 35% to 42%.

Based on the current temperature from the 'Glare' conversion.

zh_cn.text:
伤害加成的修改并非线性，而是遵循以下逻辑：

一件圣物：最大伤害加成从20%提升至22%；内在之焰模式下，从35%提升至38.5%。

两件圣物：最大伤害加成从20%提升至24%；内在之焰模式下，从35%提升至42%。

基于「灼芒」转化而来的当前热量生效。

en_us.text: On impact, you have a chance to infuse the target with the Blazing Brand status.

zh_cn.text: 命中时，你有一定概率使目标染上「灼焰烙印」状态。

en_us.text:
Harness the flames into your left hand and let your will shape their essence. As your control deepens, the fire shifts to a searing blue.

Crucible: Each enemy slain extends the duration of the Inner Flame state. However, this power comes at a cost: as time passes, the flame grows increasingly ravenous. Eventually, its hunger becomes insatiable, and further kills will no longer prolong the state.

Incandescent: While in this state, the user deals increased bonus damage based on the weapon's stored heat. However, each attack generates less heat than usual a trade-off for the heightened destructive power.

Champion: Activating Flame Champion-type abilities will change their fire type, increase their abilities, and reduce their cooldowns by 25%.

zh_cn.text:
将烈焰驾驭于你的左手之中，让你的意志塑造它们的本质。随着掌控的加深，火焰会转为炽烈的蓝色。

熔炉：每击杀一名敌人都会延长内在之焰状态的持续时间。然而这份力量伴随代价：随着时间的推移，火焰会愈发贪婪。最终，它的饥渴将无法满足，进一步的击杀将无法再延长该状态。

白炽：处于该状态时，使用者会根据武器储存的热量造成更高的额外伤害。但每次攻击产生的热量会低于寻常——这是强大破坏力的代价。

勇者：发动烈焰勇者类技能时，会改变其火焰类型、增强其效果，并使其冷却时间缩短25%。

en_us.text: When the user performs an attack, the weapon consumes durability to summon small sandstorms that surge forward in the direction the user is facing.

zh_cn.text: 使用者发动攻击时，武器会消耗耐久度，召唤小型沙暴朝使用者面朝的方向涌去。

en_us.text: Upon impact, the damage dealt by the weapon is stored as a positive electrical charge within its wielder. This charge increases depending on the environment and the target's condition.

zh_cn.text: 命中时，武器造成的伤害会以正电荷的形式储存在持有者体内。电荷的积蓄量取决于环境与目标的状态。

en_us.text: The charge gain is 30% of the damage dealt. If you are underwater or swimming, you gain an additional 20% charge gain. Furthermore, being in the rain grants an additional 10% charge gain. These effects stack with each other.

zh_cn.text: 电荷获取量为所造成伤害的30%。若你处于水下或游泳中，电荷获取量额外提高20%。此外，处于雨中会额外提高10%。这些效果可以相互叠加。

en_us.text: The positive charge stored within the wielder is converted into an attack speed bonus, scaling from 0%% to 35%% as the charge reaches maximum.

zh_cn.text: 持有者体内储存的正电荷会被转化为攻击速度加成，随电荷趋于最大值，加成从0%%提升至35%%。

en_us.text: After landing 3 successful hits on an enemy, the wielder generates a negative charge on the target. When this negative charge interacts with the wielder’s positive charge, a lightning bolt is triggered upon impact. If the enemy is underwater or in the rain, the lightning spreads but becomes weaker, dealing less damage.

zh_cn.text: 对敌人成功命中3次后，持有者会在目标身上产生负电荷。当该负电荷与持有者的正电荷相互作用时，命中便会触发闪电。若敌人处于水下或雨中，闪电会扩散但威力减弱，造成的伤害更低。

en_us.text:
Electrical charges are only deposited on the target if the attack is a basic attack; AirSlash, Dash Attack, or Innate Skills do not add negative charges, Although these attacks DON'T add charges to the target, they do allow the effect to be triggered.

The damage caused by overload is %s + %s.

If the target is in the rain or underwater, the effect spreads in an area, causing %s + %s to the target and %s + %s damage to surrounding entities.

The propagation radius of Overload is 5

zh_cn.text:
只有普通攻击才会将电荷沉积到目标身上；空中斩、冲刺攻击或天生技能不会附加负电荷。虽然这些攻击不会为目标附加电荷，但它们仍可触发该效果。

过载造成的伤害为%s + %s。

若目标处于雨中或水下，该效果会向周围区域扩散，对目标造成%s + %s伤害，对周围实体造成%s + %s伤害。

过载的扩散半径为5

en_us.text: During rain or storms, if the wielder is sufficiently charged and falls from a great height, they can envelop themselves in electricity, negating fall damage and electrifying nearby enemies upon landing. This consumes 50%% of the weapon's charge.

zh_cn.text: 在雨天或雷暴期间，若持有者充能充足并从高处坠落，便能以电流包裹自身，抵消摔落伤害，并在着陆时使附近的敌人触电。这会消耗武器50%%的电荷。

en_us.text:
The ability can only be activated after the user has fallen a total of 30 blocks in absolute distance. An absolute fall means that negative coordinates are treated as positive values (e.g., a fall from Y = -10 counts as 10 blocks). While this rule reduces the required distance to 20 blocks for other mechanics, it does not apply to this ability.

If, at any point during the fall, rain becomes unavailable, the ability is immediately canceled. Once the effect is triggered, the user becomes effectively immortal during the fall and for 1 second after landing.

zh_cn.text:
该技能仅在使用者以绝对距离累计下落30格后才能激活。绝对下落是指负坐标被视为正值（例如，从Y = -10开始下落算作10格）。虽然该规则会将其他机制所需距离缩短至20格，但不适用于此技能。

若在下落过程中的任意时刻不再下雨，该技能会立即取消。效果一旦触发，使用者在下落期间及着陆后1秒内处于无敌状态。

en_us.text: Allows switching between the weapon’s internal abilities by pressing %s + %s.

zh_cn.text: 按下%s + %s，即可在武器的内在技能之间切换。

en_us.text:
Skill effects can stack with one another; however, only one instance of an effect may be active per state.

Casting additional skills without switching weapons will not override the currently active skill. Instead, newly cast skills are placed into a queue.

Once the active skill ends, the next queued skill with the same type is automatically activated.

This behavior does not apply to Eikon, as it is an attack skill rather than an enchantment-type skill like the others.

zh_cn.text:
各技能效果可以相互叠加；但同一种效果在同一状态下只能存在一份。

在不切换武器的情况下施放其他技能并不会覆盖当前生效的技能，新施放的技能会进入队列。

当前技能结束后，队列中下一个同类型技能会自动激活。

此机制不适用于神像（Eikón），因为它是攻击型技能，而非其他技能那样的附魔型技能。

en_us.text:
No skills have been linked.

The eyes of eternity are watching you for rejecting the gifts of heaven...

zh_cn.text:
尚未链接任何技能。

永恒之眼正注视着你，只因你拒绝了上天的馈赠……

en_us.text: Pressing %s consumes 15%% of the charge. The wielder channels lightning into their left hand, preparing to release a beam in the direction they are facing.

zh_cn.text: 按下%s，消耗15%%的电荷。持有者将闪电汇聚于左手，准备朝面向的方向释放一道光束。

en_us.text: Once Eikon is cast, Astrape in %s Cooldown

zh_cn.text: 神像（Eikón）施放后，阿斯特拉珀进入%s冷却

en_us.text: Pressing %s consumes 30%% of the charge, granting increased movement speed in +18%% while holding the weapon.

zh_cn.text: 按下%s，消耗30%%的电荷，在持有武器期间移动速度提高+18%%。

en_us.text: Upon casting and gaining the movement speed bonus for a total of %s seconds. The movement speed bonus cannot be recast while the ability is still active; the buff duration is only reduced while holding the weapon, going into standby mode if Astrape is no longer held.

zh_cn.text: 施放后获得移动速度加成，总计持续%s秒。该技能生效期间无法重复施放；加成的持续时间仅在持有武器时减少，若不再持有阿斯特拉珀，则会进入待机状态。

en_us.text: Pressing %s consumes 60%% of the charge, enveloping the weapon in lightning and altering its damage type from physical damage to electrical damage.

zh_cn.text: 按下%s，消耗60%%的电荷，以闪电包裹武器，将其伤害类型从物理伤害转变为雷电伤害。

en_us.text:
The time of the effect is %s.

The damage modification is not merely on Astrape. It affects not only the weapon’s direct damage, but all damage dealt by the user while holding Astrape and while the weapon is imbued with Electric damage. All such damage is effectively converted into Electric damage, inheriting all associated properties.

This includes damage from the Overload Passive, Eikón, Dikerávnos, In general, all the damage caused by the user.

The effect cannot be recast while it is active, and its remaining duration is reduced only while Astrape is being held. When Astrape is not in hand, the effect enters a suspended state.

The imbuement applies exclusively while holding Astrape; releasing it temporarily removes the imbuement, which is automatically restored once Astrape is held again.

zh_cn.text:
效果的持续时间为%s。

该伤害改动并非只作用于阿斯特拉珀。它不仅影响武器的直接伤害，还影响持有者在持有阿斯特拉珀且武器附带雷电伤害期间造成的所有伤害。所有此类伤害实际上都会转化为雷电伤害，并继承其所有相关特性。

这包括来自过载被动、神像、双叉雷霆的伤害——总而言之，包括使用者造成的所有伤害。

效果生效期间无法重复施放，其剩余持续时间仅在持有阿斯特拉珀时减少。当阿斯特拉珀不在手中时，效果会进入暂停状态。

该附魔仅在持有阿斯特拉珀时生效；松开武器会暂时移除附魔，再次持有时会自动恢复。

en_us.text:
The essence of the storm lies within this weapon, yearning to be unleashed—free as its master once was...

Channels stored lightning energy into the left hand. Depending on how long the energy is charged before being released to the heavens, the ability changes: a low charge unleashes Neféli, while a high charge triggers Katáigis.

Neféli:
Summons a thundercloud above the wielder. While present, the cloud launches lightning spears toward targeted entities upon impact.

The cloud does NOT vanish if the wielder switches weapon categories; it persists over time. Spears are triggered by impacts, not necessarily from the weapon that activated this Innate Skill.

It is only lost if the caster died, or the wielder leaves the dimension and it becomes unloaded.

Katáigis:
Launches an electric helix into the sky. Upon reaching a certain height, it explodes, leaving ionized sparks in the air and electrifying the environment. This generates sparks and arcs, and applies the 'Conductor' status to nearby entities.

All hostile entities can be affected by the lightning. Entities impacted by the lightning released from the explosion will receive a total of %s of damage.

Additionally, the area damage from these charges will be %s + %s when standing on electrical residue.

Subsequently, upon receiving the ionization impact, all targeted entities will receive %s + %s.

If the wielder targets a neutral or peaceful entity while casting, the lightning and status will target that entity's group as well as nearby hostile entities.

The 'Conductor' status increases all Electro damage received by 20%%. Entities with this status may be struck by lightning; when struck, they lose the status.

Sources of Electro damage include the weapon itself when using the 'Dýna' Internal Subskill, which imbues it with lightning.

Both the Electric Cloud and the Ionized environment are combinable, the caster can have the effects several times at the same time, however, each effect has its own identity, time, cooldowns, calculations, etc; This prevents skills from overwriting themselves.

zh_cn.text:
风暴的本质蕴藏于这件武器之中，渴望被释放——如同它的主人曾经那般自由……

将储存的闪电能量汇聚于左手。根据能量在释放上天之前的充能时长，技能效果会发生变化：低充能释放雷云（Neféli），高充能则触发雷暴（Katáigis）。

雷云（Neféli）：
在持有者头顶召唤一朵雷云。雷云存在期间，会在命中时向目标实体发射闪电长矛。

即使持有者切换武器类别，雷云也不会消失；它会随时间持续存在。长矛由命中触发，不一定要由激活此天生技能的武器触发。

只有当施放者死亡，或持有者离开该维度导致雷云被卸载时，它才会消失。

雷暴（Katáigis）：
向天空发射一道电能螺旋。达到一定高度后便会爆炸，在空气中留下离子化火花并使环境带电。这会产生火花与电弧，并为附近的实体施加「导体」状态。

所有敌对实体都可能受到闪电影响。被爆炸释放的闪电击中的实体将受到总计%s点伤害。

此外，站在电气残留物上时，这些电荷的范围伤害将为%s + %s。

随后，在受到离子化冲击时，所有目标实体将受到%s + %s伤害。

若持有者施放时锁定的是中立或和平生物，闪电与状态将以该实体所在的群体以及附近的敌对实体为目标。

「导体」状态会使受到的所有雷电伤害提高20%%。拥有该状态的实体可能会被闪电击中；被击中后便会失去该状态。

雷电伤害的来源包括使用「神力」（Dýna）内在子技能时的武器本身——该子技能会使武器附带闪电。

雷电云与离子化环境均可叠加，施放者可以同时拥有数份相同效果；但每个效果都有各自的判定、持续时间、冷却与计算方式等，这能防止技能自我覆盖。

en_us.text: On hit, the sawteeth burrow into the target, severely hindering their attack speed and weapon handling. Upon impact, it unleashes slashes that tear from within, dealing %s damage that bypasses invulnerability frames.

zh_cn.text: 命中时，锯齿会嵌入目标体内，严重削弱其攻击速度与武器操控。命中之际，它会释放自内撕裂的斩击，造成%s点无视无敌帧的伤害。

en_us.text:
Attack speed while passing through an entity is randomly reduced and locked between 0.15 and 0.3.

During this time, weapon damage bypasses the target’s invulnerability frames.

I-Frame ignoring damage scales with base damage, with its ratio varying depending on the attack type.

zh_cn.text:
穿透实体期间的攻击速度会被随机削减并锁定在0.15至0.3之间。

在此期间，武器伤害会无视目标的无敌帧。

无视无敌帧的伤害会随基础伤害缩放，其比例因攻击类型而异。

en_us.text:
The faint metallic whir of the spinning saw stirs a thirst for slaughter, eager to stain its teeth once more...

On cast, it emits a subtle shockwave that gently repels nearby entities (excluding the primary target) and grants temporary crowd-control immunity.

Upon impact, the saw impales the target, holding them in place as it accelerates and closes in. Depending on the target’s weight, one of the following effects occurs:

Vertical Slash (Light Enemies): Lifts the target into the air, over-accelerates the saw, and deals continuous damage each tick of the animation. This damage ignores invulnerability frames.

If the target is slain, a portion of its innate ability’s energy and resources is restored.

Horizontal Slash (Heavy Enemies): Drives the saw deep into the target, dealing reduced damage. No energy or resource recovery occurs upon their death.

While impaled, the target remains under crowd control — vertical or horizontal cuts keep them bound to the saw.

zh_cn.text:
旋转锯片发出的微弱金属嗡鸣搅动着嗜血的渴望，它急欲再度染污自己的锯齿……

施放时，它会散发出一道微妙的冲击波，轻柔地击退附近的实体（主要目标除外），并赋予短暂的控制免疫。

命中时，锯片会将目标钉在原地，并在加速逼近时将其固定。根据目标的重量，会触发以下效果之一：

纵斩（轻型敌人）：将目标挑向空中，使锯片超速运转，并在动画的每个游戏刻造成持续伤害。该伤害无视无敌帧。

若目标被击杀，会恢复天生技能的部分能量与资源。

横斩（重型敌人）：将锯片深深贯入目标体内，造成降低后的伤害。目标死亡时不会恢复能量或资源。

被钉住期间，目标始终处于控制之下——纵斩或横斩都会将其束缚在锯片上。

en_us.text: The blade of this weapon is wreathed in fire and a spectral glow. When it strikes a living being, it has a chance to tear out a soul fragment and summon spectral spears from the ground to deal damage. The likelihood of summoning spears increases with the 'Sweeping Edge' enchantment.

zh_cn.text: 这把武器的剑刃缠绕着火焰与幽魂般的辉光。当它击中活物时，有一定概率撕裂出灵魂碎片，并从地面召唤幽魂长矛造成伤害。召唤长矛的概率会随「横扫之刃」附魔提高。

en_us.text:
The default probability is 25%%. This increases by a base amount thanks to 'Sweeping Edge'.

The increases are as follows: %s. If the spell breaks the enchantment limiter and achieves IV or IV+, the probability increases to %s.

 Additionally, each piece of Cursium Armor increases the probability by a total of 2.5%% per piece.

zh_cn.text:
默认概率为25%%。得益于「横扫之刃」，它会以基础数值提升。

提升如下：%s。若该附魔突破附魔等级上限、达到IV或IV+，概率将提升至%s。

 此外，每件诅咒合金盔甲可使概率提高2.5%%。

en_us.text: The spectral power that surrounds your body due to the Cursium Armor has extended the attack 'Soul Field' to hit a larger area and branches.

zh_cn.text: 诅咒合金盔甲所产生的、环绕你周身的幽魂之力扩展了「灵魂场」攻击，使其命中范围更广、分叉更多。

en_us.text: Press %s to reveal all nearby living entities, marking them and causing them to glow.

zh_cn.text: 按下%s，显现附近所有活着的实体，将其标记并使其带上发光效果。
被标记的敌人会受到8%的额外伤害。

en_us.text: The damage bonus applies to any marked entity, including those not marked by the user and the ability; it also applies to any being under the effect of Glow.

zh_cn.text: 该伤害加成适用于任何被标记的实体，包括并非由使用者和该技能标记的实体；同样适用于任何处于发光效果影响下的生物。

en_us.text: Press %s to sacrifice 3 hearts of health in exchange for a temporary 25.0%% damage boost for 20 seconds.

zh_cn.text: 按下%s，献祭3颗心的生命值，换取持续20秒的25.0%%临时伤害提升。

en_us.text: When casting, it enters %s and sacrificing, the user CANNOT die, regardless of the current amount of life, they will always be left with half a heart; the damage caused by the sacrifice cannot be reduced under any circumstances except by the user's current life.

zh_cn.text: 施放时将进入%s并执行献祭。使用者不会死亡——无论当前生命值为多少，最终都会剩下半颗心；献祭造成的伤害在任何情况下都无法减免，除非受使用者当前生命值所限。

en_us.text: The skill time is only reduced while holding Soul Render in your hand; while the weapon is not being held, the counter will NOT be reduced, allowing the bonus not to dissipate if you switch to any other item.

zh_cn.text: 技能时间仅会在手持裂魂者时减少；未持有该武器时，计时不会减少，因此切换为其他任何物品都不会使加成消散。

en_us.text:
Once killed, the user will return to life with 5 hearts and will cycle through spiritual phases.

Path of the Imperishable: The user is intangible, but their attacks are also intangible. They will be unable to attack and will have bonus movement speed for 5 seconds.

Path of the Wandering : The user has an attack speed boost from 25% to 10%, this threshold is reduced over time. This path takes 6 minutes to complete, and the user cannot be revived during this period.

Path of the Perishable: The user can be brought back to life through this armor.

zh_cn.text:
死亡后，使用者会以5颗心的生命值复活，并循环经历各个灵魂阶段。

不朽之径：使用者变为虚体，但其攻击同样为虚体。他们将无法攻击，并在5秒内获得移动速度加成。

游荡之径：使用者拥有25%至10%的攻击速度加成，该数值会随时间递减。此阶段需要6分钟完成，期间使用者无法复活。

可灭之径：使用者可以通过这件盔甲再次复活。

en_us.text: The spiritual phases continue to progress even if the user is not holding Soul Render or no longer has the armor equipped. These conditions only limit the effects themselves; the phase counter continues to decrease regardless.

en_us.text:
The multiplier effect for the bonus offered by 'Path of the Wandering ' is not permanent while traversing it. Each recursion point lasts for a total of 2 minutes and is updated with each resurrection. After 2 minutes, it is reduced by only one point, meaning that not all charges are lost after that time. However, all charges are lost upon completion of the 'Path of the Wandering '.

Recursion points cannot be gained outside of this path, and resurrections via totems will not be taken into account.

「游荡之径」所提供加成的乘数效果在该阶段期间并非永久。每个轮回点总共持续2分钟，并随每次复活而刷新。2分钟后仅减少一个点数，也就是说时限过后并不会失去所有充能。然而，在「游荡之径」完成时，所有充能都会失去。

轮回点无法在此路径之外获得，通过图腾进行的复活也不会被计入。

This ability can also cancel the current animation without needing to learn the 'Emergency Escape' skill. Furthermore, it can be cast in two ways: one while retaining the takeoff momentum to increase displacement, and another without retaining it upon cast in order to reset the current animation.

en_us.text:

en_us.text:
The clamor of the spirits contained within this weapon, faintly escaping the spirit seal, cries out to be freed. Will you be the one to free them? Unleash their power through the aspects of the soul...

Soul's Wrath: Unleash the wrath of the souls by casting this skill and crouching at the end of the cast. This will allow you to wield your weapon and slam it into the ground, instantly summoning an explosion of spectral spears. Upon impact, you will deal %s of damage.

Soul's Surge: Unleash the souls in a wave and move at high speed. You will achieve this by running at the end of the cast. This will allow you to generate a long-distance dash that will deal %s of damage to the impacted entities and leave a trail of spectral spears.

Soul's Fields: Unleash the contained souls in the form of a field of spectral spears. This field is massive, but its damage is only due to the spears generated.

Soul's Wrath and Soul's Surge can create Spectral Spears with the same probability as their normal attacks, while Soul's Fields cannot.

封存于这件武器中的灵魂喧嚣不止，自灵魂封印的缝隙中隐约逸出，哭喊着渴求自由。你会是解放它们的人吗？以灵魂之形态，释放它们的力量……

灵魂场：以幽魂长矛之场的形式释放封存的灵魂。此场规模巨大，但其伤害仅来自所生成的长矛。

灵魂之怒与灵魂奔涌能以与普通攻击相同的概率生成幽魂长矛，而灵魂场则不能。

en_us.text:
How should vanilla Minecraft fade into Distant Horizons LODs? 

NONE: Fastest, there will be a pronounced border between DH and MC rendering. 
SINGLE_PASS: Fades after MC's transparent pass, opaque blocks underwater won't be faded. 
DOUBLE_PASS: Slowest, fades after both MC's opaque and transparent passes, provides the smoothest transition.

en_us.text:
What is the maximum fog thickness?

雾的最大浓度是多少？

en_us.text:
How should the fog thickness should be calculated? 

LINEAR: Linear based on distance (will ignore 'density')
EXPONENTIAL: 1/(e^(distance*density)) 
EXPONENTIAL_SQUARED: 1/(e^((distance*density)^2))

zh_cn.text:
雾浓度应如何计算？

LINEAR：基于距离的线性计算（将忽略 'density'）
EXPONENTIAL：1/(e^(distance*density))
EXPONENTIAL_SQUARED：1/(e^((distance*density)^2))

en_us.text:
Defines how height effects fog. 
When in doubt start with SPHERICAL, ADDITION, or MAX. 

SPHERICAL: Fog is calculated based on camera distance. 
CYLINDRICAL: Ignore height, fog is calculated based on horizontal distance. 
MAX: max(heightFog, farFog) 
ADDITION: heightFog + farFog 
MULTIPLY: heightFog * farFog 
INVERSE_MULTIPLY: 1 - (1-heightFog) * (1-farFog) 
LIMITED_ADDITION: farFog + max(farFog, heightFog) 
MULTIPLY_ADDITION: farFog + farFog * heightFog 
INVERSE_MULTIPLY_ADDITION: farFog + 1 - (1-heightFog) * (1-farFog) 
AVERAGE: farFog*0.5 + heightFog*0.5

zh_cn.text:
定义高度对雾的影响方式。
不确定时建议从 SPHERICAL、ADDITION 或 MAX 开始。

SPHERICAL：基于相机距离计算雾。
CYLINDRICAL：忽略高度，基于水平距离计算雾。
MAX：max(heightFog, farFog)
ADDITION：heightFog + farFog
MULTIPLY：heightFog * farFog
INVERSE_MULTIPLY：1 - (1-heightFog) * (1-farFog)
LIMITED_ADDITION：farFog + max(farFog, heightFog)
MULTIPLY_ADDITION：farFog + farFog * heightFog
INVERSE_MULTIPLY_ADDITION：farFog + 1 - (1-heightFog) * (1-farFog)
AVERAGE：farFog*0.5 + heightFog*0.5

en_us.text:
Where should the height fog be located? 

ABOVE_CAMERA: Height fog starts from camera to the sky 
BELOW_CAMERA: Height fog starts from camera to the void 
ABOVE_AND_BELOW_CAMERA: Height fog starts from camera to both the sky and the void 
ABOVE_SET_HEIGHT: Height fog starts from a set height to the sky 
BELOW_SET_HEIGHT: Height fog starts from a set height to the void 
ABOVE_AND_BELOW_SET_HEIGHT: Height fog starts from a set height to both the sky and the void

雾的最大浓度是多少？

en_us.text:
Determines how far from the camera Distant Horizons will start rendering. 
Measured as a percentage of the vanilla render distance.
