空洞最有可能在飞越未加载地形时出现。

提高原版渲染距离可增强此设置的效果。
快速移动时减少过度绘制

en_us.text:
If set to true the overdraw prevention radius will get closer 
to the camera when flying/moving quickly. 

This helps reduce issues where Minecraft can't load or 
generate chunks fast enough to keep up with DH.

zh_cn.text:
启用后，在快速飞行/移动时，过度绘制预防半径
会更靠近相机。

这有助于缓解 Minecraft 加载或生成区块的速度
跟不上 DH 的问题。

en_us.text:
If enabled caves will be culled 

Additional Info: Currently this cull all faces 
 with skylight value of 0 under the cave culling height in dimensions that 
 do not have a ceiling.

zh_cn.text:
启用后，洞穴将被剔除。

补充信息：目前此功能会在没有天花板（顶盖）的维度中，
剔除洞穴剔除高度以下
所有天光值为 0 的面。

en_us.text: At what Y value should cave culling start?

zh_cn.text: 洞穴剔除应从哪个 Y 值开始？

en_us.text:
If true beacons near the camera won't be drawn to prevent vanilla overdraw. 
If false all beacons will be rendered.

zh_cn.text:
启用后，相机附近的信标将不会被绘制，以防止原版过度绘制。
禁用后将渲染所有信标。

en_us.text:
If false LODs outside the player's camera 
aren't drawn, increasing GPU performance. 

If true all LODs are drawn, even those behind 
the player's camera, decreasing GPU performance. 

Disable this if you see LODs disappearing at the corners of your vision.

zh_cn.text:
禁用（false）时，玩家视野外的 LOD
不会被绘制，从而提高 GPU 性能。

启用（true）时，所有 LOD 都会被绘制，
包括玩家视野背后的 LOD，从而降低 GPU 性能。

如果你发现 LOD 在视野边缘消失，请禁用此项。
禁用阴影通道视锥体剔除

en_us.text:
Identical to the other frustum culling option except that it is 
only used when a shader mod is present using the DH API 
and the shadow pass is being rendered. 

Disable this if shadows render incorrectly.

zh_cn.text:
与另一个视锥体剔除选项相同，区别在于它仅在
使用 DH API 的光影模组存在
且正在渲染阴影通道时使用。

如果阴影渲染不正确，请禁用此项。

en_us.text:
A comma separated list of block resource locations that won't be rendered by DH. 
Air is always included in this list. 

Note: 
If you see gaps, or holes you may have to change 
worldCompression to [MERGE_SAME_BLOCKS] and re-generate the LODs.

zh_cn.text:
以逗号分隔的方块资源位置列表，DH 不会渲染这些方块。
空气始终包含在此列表中。

注意：
如果你看到缝隙或空洞，可能需要将
worldCompression 更改为 [MERGE_SAME_BLOCKS] 并重新生成 LOD。
忽略渲染的洞穴方块 CSV

en_us.text:
A comma separated list of block resource locations that shouldn't be rendered 
if they are in a 0 sky light underground area. 
Air is always included in this list. 

Defaults to an empty list since most cave blocks will be automatically ignored due to being: 
transparent, non-solid, or liquids, but new blocks can be added here if needed.

zh_cn.text:
以逗号分隔的方块资源位置列表，当这些方块
位于天光值为 0 的地下区域时不会被渲染。
空气始终包含在此列表中。

默认为空列表，因为大多数洞穴方块会因以下特性被自动忽略：
透明、非固体或液体，但如有需要可在此添加新方块。

en_us.text:
A comma separated list of block resource locations that will be replaced by water 
if they're visible on the water's surface.

zh_cn.text:
以逗号分隔的方块资源位置列表，当这些方块
在水面可见时将被替换为水。

en_us.text:
A comma separated list of block resource locations that will be removed 
when on top of water.

zh_cn.text:
以逗号分隔的方块资源位置列表，当这些方块
位于水面上时将被移除。

en_us.text:
Defines what blocks should be rendered as LODs. 

§NONE:§r Include all blocks in the LODs
§NON_COLLIDING:§r Only render solid blocks in the LODs (tall grass, torches, etc. will be ignored)

zh_cn.text:
定义哪些方块应渲染为 LOD。

§NONE：§r 在 LOD 中包含所有方块
§NON_COLLIDING：§r 仅在 LOD 中渲染固体方块（草丛、火把等将被忽略）

en_us.text:
§4Note: makes snow, carpet, and trapdoors look really bad§r
Should the blocks underneath avoided blocks gain the color of the avoided block?
§6True:§r a red flower on grass will tint the grass below it red
§6False:§r skipped blocks will not change color of surface below them

zh_cn.text:
§4注意：会让雪、地毯和活板门看起来非常糟糕§r
被忽略方块下方的方块是否应获得被忽略方块的颜色？
§6启用：§r 草地上的红花会将其下方的草染成红色
§6禁用：§r 被跳过的方块不会改变其下方表面的颜色

en_us.text:
If true some vanilla graphics settings will be automatically changed 
during DH setup to provide a better experience. 

IE disabling vanilla clouds (which render on top of DH LODs), 
and chunk fading (DH already fades MC chunks).

zh_cn.text:
启用后，在 DH 初始化期间会自动更改部分原版图形设置
以提供更好的体验。

例如禁用原版云（会渲染在 DH LOD 之上），
以及区块渐隐（DH 已对 MC 区块进行渐隐）。

en_us.text:
A value of 1 is equivalent to the curvature of Earth in real life. 
The minimum accepted value is 50 and the maximum value is 5000. 
Everything between 1 and 49 will be rounded up to 50.

zh_cn.text:
数值 1 相当于现实中的地球曲率。
可接受的最小值为 50，最大值为 5000。
1 到 49 之间的所有数值都会被向上取整为 50。

en_us.text:
A comma separated list of dimension resource locations where DH won't render. Example: "minecraft:the_nether,minecraft:the_end" 

For Minecraft 1.12.2 and older:
Open the F3 screen and copy the dimension_name:ID shown in yellow. Example: "overworld:0" 

Note: 
Some DH settings will be disabled and/or changed to improve 
visuals when DH rendering is disabled.

zh_cn.text:
以逗号分隔的维度资源位置列表，DH 不会在这些维度中渲染。示例："minecraft:the_nether,minecraft:the_end"

对于 Minecraft 1.12.2 及更旧版本：
打开 F3 界面并复制以黄色显示的 dimension_name:ID。示例："overworld:0"

注意：
在 DH 渲染被禁用时，部分 DH 设置将被禁用
和/或更改以改善视觉效果。

en_us.text: Automatically updates the mod when an update is available

zh_cn.text: 当有可用更新时自动更新该模组

en_us.text:
Where to download the latest update from. 

Auto: Downloads either stable or nightly builds based on the current jar. 
Stable: Stable builds from Modrinth. 
Nightly: Nightly builds from Gitlab.

zh_cn.text:
从何处下载最新更新。

Auto：根据当前 jar 文件下载稳定版或夜间版。
Stable：来自 Modrinth 的稳定版本。
Nightly：来自 Gitlab 的夜间版本。

en_us.text:
Determines the folder format for local multiplayer data.

§6Name Only:§r
Uses the server browser name. Ex: "Minecraft Server"
§6IP Only:§r
"192.168.1.40"
§6Name IP:§r
"Minecraft Server, IP 192.168.1.40"
§6Name, IP, Port:§r
"Minecraft Server, IP 192.168.1.40:25565"
§6Name, IP, Port, MC Version:§r
"Minecraft Server, IP 192.168.1.40:25565, GameVersion 1.18.1"

§c§lCaution:§r changing while connected to a multiplayer server may cause glitches.

zh_cn.text:
决定本地多人游戏数据的文件夹格式。

§6仅名称：§r
使用服务器列表中的名称。例："Minecraft Server"
§6仅 IP：§r
"192.168.1.40"
§6名称 IP：§r
"Minecraft Server, IP 192.168.1.40"
§6名称、IP、端口：§r
"Minecraft Server, IP 192.168.1.40:25565"
§6名称、IP、端口、MC 版本：§r
"Minecraft Server, IP 192.168.1.40:25565, GameVersion 1.18.1"

§c§l注意：§r 连接多人服务器时更改此选项可能导致异常。

en_us.text:
If enabled this will disable (most) vanilla Minecraft rendering. 

NOTE: Do not report any issues when this mode is on! 
This setting is only for fun and debugging. 
Mod compatibility is not guaranteed.

zh_cn.text:
启用后将禁用（大部分）原版 Minecraft 渲染。

注意：在此模式开启时不要报告任何问题！
此设置仅供娱乐和调试。
不保证模组兼容性。

en_us.text: If enabled the LODs will render as wireframe.

zh_cn.text: 启用后，LOD 将以线框形式渲染。

en_us.text:
If true several keys can be used to toggle debug states. 
F6 - enable/disable LOD rendering 
F7 - enable/disable LOD only rendering 
F8 - cycle through the different debug rendering modes

zh_cn.text:
启用后，可以使用多个按键切换调试状态。
F6 - 启用/禁用 LOD 渲染
F7 - 启用/禁用仅 LOD 渲染
F8 - 循环切换不同的调试渲染模式

en_us.text:
If enabled, vertex color will not be passed.
Useful for debugging shaders.

zh_cn.text:
启用后，顶点颜色将不会被传递。
有助于调试着色器。

en_us.text:
If true overlapping quads will be rendered as bright red for easy identification. 
If false the quads will be rendered normally.

zh_cn.text:
启用后，重叠的四边形将以亮红色渲染，便于识别。
禁用后，四边形将正常渲染。

en_us.text:
If true OpenGL Buffer garbage collection will be logged 
this also includes the number of live buffers.

zh_cn.text:
启用后，将记录 OpenGL 缓冲区的垃圾回收，
其中还包括活动缓冲区的数量。

en_us.text:
If enabled, very limited config input validation will be performed. 

Warning: enabling this can cause instability or crashing, use at your own risk. 
Note: this option isn't saved between sessions.

zh_cn.text:
启用后，将仅执行非常有限的配置输入验证。

警告：启用此选项可能导致不稳定或崩溃，风险自负。
注意：此选项不会在会话之间保存。

en_us.text: If enabled, various wireframes for debugging internal functions will be drawn.

zh_cn.text: 启用后，将绘制各种用于调试内部功能的线框。

en_us.text: Show Network Sync On Load Queue

zh_cn.text: 显示网络加载同步队列
显示完整数据更新状态
覆盖原版 GL 日志记录器

en_us.text:
Defines how OpenGL errors are handled. 
Requires rebooting Minecraft to change. 
Will catch OpenGL errors thrown by other mods.

zh_cn.text:
定义 OpenGL 错误的处理方式。
更改需要重启 Minecraft。
会捕获其他模组抛出的 OpenGL 错误。
仅记录一次 GL 错误

en_us.text:
If true each Open GL error will only be logged once. 
TEnabling this may cause some error logs to be missed. 
Does nothing if overrideVanillaGLLogger is set to false. 

Generally this can be kept as 'true' to prevent log spam. 
However, Please set this to 'false' if a developer needs your log to debug a GL issue.

zh_cn.text:
启用后，每个 OpenGL 错误只会被记录一次。
启用此项可能会遗漏一些错误日志。
若 overrideVanillaGLLogger 设为 false 则无效。

通常可以保持 'true' 以防止日志刷屏。
但如果开发者需要你的日志来调试 GL 问题，请将其设为 'false'。

en_us.text:
Defines how OpenGL errors are handled. 
 Requires rebooting Minecraft to apply. 
May incorrectly catch OpenGL errors thrown by other mods.

zh_cn.text:
定义 OpenGL 错误的处理方式。
 需要重启 Minecraft 才能生效。
可能会错误地捕获其他模组抛出的 OpenGL 错误。
列构建器限制 - 细节等级
列构建器限制 - X 坐标
列构建器限制 - Z 坐标
列构建器限制 - X 行
列构建器限制 - Z 行
列构建器限制 - 列索引
玩家区段坐标细节等级

en_us.text: This screen is to debug features of the config screen

zh_cn.text: 此界面用于调试配置界面的功能

en_us.text: The value of this should be the same as in Category Test

zh_cn.text: 此处的值应与类别测试中的值相同

en_us.text:
§6True:§r in single player LODs will be created outside the vanilla render distance.
Depending on the Generator Mode pre-existing chunks will be important and/o
missing chunks will be generated.
Note: this can use a large amount of CPU.

§6False:§r LODs will only generate within the vanilla render distance.

zh_cn.text:
§6启用：§r 在单人游戏中，LOD 将在原版渲染距离之外生成。
根据生成器模式的不同，将导入已有的区块
和/或生成缺失的区块。
注意：这可能占用大量 CPU。

§6禁用：§r LOD 仅在原版渲染距离内生成。

en_us.text:
Defines how LODs will be generated 
outside the vanilla render distance 
in singleplayer. 

Some options may be unavailable depending on MC version. 

§6SURFACE_THEN_CHUNKS§r 
Recommended for modded or vanilla worlds. 

§6SURFACE_ONLY§r 
Recommended for computers that don't have 
enough CPU power or RAM space to handle 
chunk generation. 

§6CHUNKS_ONLY§r 
Recommended for custom worlds 
where the surface generator would 
generate incorrect terrain. 

§6DISABLED§r
Recommended if you experience lag.

zh_cn.text:
定义在单人游戏中
如何在原版渲染距离之外生成 LOD。

部分选项可能因 MC 版本而不可用。

§6SURFACE_THEN_CHUNKS§r
推荐用于模组或原版世界。

§6SURFACE_ONLY§r
推荐用于没有足够 CPU 性能
或内存来处理
区块生成的电脑。

§6CHUNKS_ONLY§r
推荐用于表面生成器
会生成错误地形的自定义世界。

§6DISABLED§r
如果你遇到卡顿，推荐使用此项。

en_us.text: How complicated the generation should be when generating LODs outside the vanilla render distance.

zh_cn.text: 在原版渲染距离之外生成 LOD 时，生成应复杂到什么程度。

en_us.text:
Requires a world restart to change. 

If enabled Distant Horizons will very quickly generate a 
rough estimate of the terrain surface to 
fill out the render distance. 

After the surface has been generated Distant Horizons 
will then generate the individual chunks as defined 
by your "distantGeneratorMode" config to get 
trees and structures. 

It is recommended to disable this option 
if you have a completely custom world, 
to prevent seeing normal terrain.

zh_cn.text:
更改需要重启世界。

启用后，Distant Horizons 将非常快速地生成
地形的粗略估计表面
以填满渲染距离。

表面生成完成后，Distant Horizons 会按照
你的 "distantGeneratorMode" 配置的定义生成各个区块
以获取树木和结构。

如果你使用完全自定义的世界，
建议禁用此选项，
以免看到正常地形。

en_us.text: Determines how should distant generator progress be displayed.

zh_cn.text: 决定远景生成器进度的显示方式。

en_us.text: Determines how long between progress update displays.

zh_cn.text: 决定进度更新显示之间的时间间隔。

en_us.text: Seconds To Show Progress Hiding Instructions

zh_cn.text: 显示进度隐藏说明的秒数

en_us.text:
For how many seconds should instructions for disabling the distant generator progress be displayed? 
Setting this to 0 hides the instructional message so the world gen progress is shown immediately when it starts.

zh_cn.text:
关于如何禁用远景生成器进度显示的说明应显示多少秒？
将其设为 0 将隐藏说明消息，世界生成进度开始时立即显示。

en_us.text:
When logging generation progress also include the rate at which chunks 
are being generated. 
This can be useful for troubleshooting performance.

zh_cn.text:
记录生成进度时，同时显示区块
生成的速度。
这有助于排查性能问题。
服务器负载过高时限制

en_us.text:
If the Minecraft server thread is taking too long 
Distant Horizons will pause world gen to reduce server stuttering/lag.

zh_cn.text:
如果 Minecraft 服务器线程耗时过长，
Distant Horizons 将暂停世界生成以减少服务器卡顿/延迟。

en_us.text:
If the player/camera are moving quickly 
Distant Horizons will pause world gen to improve loading speed 
and reduce lag.

zh_cn.text:
如果玩家/相机移动速度较快，
Distant Horizons 将暂停世界生成以提高加载速度
并减少卡顿。
表面重新生成最大距离百分比

en_us.text:
If the player/camera are moving quickly 
Distant Horizons will pause world gen to improve loading speed 
and reduce lag.

zh_cn.text:
如果玩家/相机移动速度较快，
Distant Horizons 将暂停世界生成以提高加载速度
并减少卡顿。

en_us.text:
Disabling this check may fix issues where LODs aren't updated after
blocks have been changed.

zh_cn.text:
禁用此检查可能修复方块更改后
LOD 未更新的问题。

en_us.text:
What algorithm should be used to compress new LOD data? 
This setting will only affect new or updated LOD data, 
any data already generated when this setting is changed will be 
unaffected until it needs to be re-written to the database. 

Fastest: LZ4 
Highest Compression: LZMA2

zh_cn.text:
应使用什么算法压缩新的 LOD 数据？
此设置仅影响新的或已更新的 LOD 数据，
更改此设置时已生成的数据
在需要重写至数据库之前不受影响。

最快：LZ4
最高压缩率：LZMA2

en_us.text:
How should block data be compressed when creating LOD data? 
This setting will only affect new or updated LOD data, 
any data already generated when this setting is changed will be 
unaffected until it is modified or re-loaded. 

Most Accurate: Merge Same Blocks 
Highest Compression: Visually Equal

zh_cn.text:
创建 LOD 数据时应如何压缩方块数据？
此设置仅影响新的或已更新的 LOD 数据，
更改此设置时已生成的数据
在被修改或重新加载之前不受影响。

最准确：合并相同方块
最高压缩率：视觉等同

en_us.text:
Requires a level restart to apply. 

Setting this to a less strict mode increases DB read/write 
speed at the cost of potential data loss/corruption if 
the computer looses power 
(unexpected program shutdown should be safe for all options). 

§6FULL§r 
ACID - data will never be lost or corrupted 
Slow 

§6NORMAL§r 
Some data may be lost on power loss, but database shouldn't be corrupted. 
Fast 

§6OFF§r 
Database may be corrupted during power loss 
Faster

zh_cn.text:
需要重启世界才能生效。

将此设置改为较宽松的模式可提高数据库读写速度，
代价是电脑断电时可能出现数据丢失/损坏
（所有选项对于程序意外关闭都是安全的）。

§6FULL§r
ACID - 数据永远不会丢失或损坏
慢

§6NORMAL§r
断电时可能丢失部分数据，但数据库不应损坏。
快

§6OFF§r
断电时数据库可能损坏
更快

en_us.text: Upsample Lower Detail LODs To Fill Holes

zh_cn.text: 上采样低细节 LOD 以填补空洞

en_us.text:
When active DH will attempt to fill missing LOD data 
with any data that is present in the tree, preventing holes when moving 
when a N-sized generator (or server) is active. 

§6EXPERIMENTAL§r Will increase harddrive use and may cause rendering issues. 
See the config file for more details.

zh_cn.text:
启用后，DH 将尝试用树中已有的数据
填补缺失的 LOD 数据，防止在 N 大小的生成器
（或服务器）运行时移动出现空洞。

§6实验性§r 会增加硬盘使用量，并可能导致渲染问题。
更多详情请参阅配置文件。

en_us.text: How many threads DH will use.

zh_cn.text: DH 将使用的线程数量。

en_us.text:
What Java thread priority should DH's primary thread pools run with?

You probably don't need to change this unless you are also 
running C2ME and are seeing thread starvation in either C2ME or DH.

zh_cn.text:
DH 的主要线程池应以何种 Java 线程优先级运行？

除非你同时运行 C2ME 并且在 C2ME 或 DH 中
出现线程饥饿问题，否则无需更改此项。

en_us.text:
If C2ME is present, set DH's thread count to match C2ME. 

This is necessary to prevent thread starvation issues when C2ME is present.

zh_cn.text:
如果安装了 C2ME，DH 的线程数将与 C2ME 保持一致。

这对于防止安装 C2ME 时出现线程饥饿问题是必要的。

en_us.text: Controls how logging should be handled.

zh_cn.text: 世界生成事件 - 文件
世界生成加载事件 - 文件
网络连接配置更改 - 文件

en_us.text: Show Low Memory Warning On Startup

zh_cn.text: 启动时显示内存不足警告
显示对象池内存不足警告

en_us.text: If DH detects that pooled objects are being garbage collected this will send a chat warning.

zh_cn.text: 如果 DH 检测到池化对象被垃圾回收，将发送聊天警告。

en_us.text: Show High Vanilla Render Distance Warning

zh_cn.text: 显示原版渲染距离过高警告
启动时显示 Replay 模组警告
显示更新队列过载警告
显示世界生成过慢警告
启动时显示模组兼容性警告
启动时显示已弃用渲染器警告
记录显式 GC 已禁用警告
显示显式 GC 已禁用警告

en_us.text:
Makes the server send level keys for each world.
Disable this if you use alternative ways to send level keys.

When enabled, Embeddium will apply shading to non-vanilla block faces based on the true direction they are facing, not their axis-aligned direction. This can improve lighting quality when the Forge experimental light pipeline is disabled (which is recommended for best performance).

It has no effect if the experimental light pipeline is enabled.

zh_cn.text:
启用后，Embeddium 将根据非原版方块面的真实朝向（而非其轴向对齐方向）对其进行着色。当 Forge 实验性光照管线被禁用时（建议禁用以获得最佳性能），这可以提高光照质量。

若实验性光照管线已启用，则此选项无效。

en_us.text: The render distance controls how far away terrain will be rendered. Shorter distances mean that less terrain will be rendered, improving frame rates.

zh_cn.text: 渲染距离控制地形会被渲染到多远。较短的渲染距离意味着渲染的地形更少，从而提高帧率。

en_us.text: The simulation distance controls how far away terrain and entities will be loaded and ticked. Shorter distances can reduce the internal server's load and may improve frame rates.

zh_cn.text: 模拟距离控制地形与实体在多远距离内被加载并运算。较短的模拟距离可以减轻内部服务器的负载，并可能提高帧率。

en_us.text: Controls the brightness (gamma) of the game.

zh_cn.text: 控制游戏的亮度（Gamma 值）。

en_us.text: Sets the maximum scale factor to be used for the user interface. If 'auto' is used, then the largest scale factor will always be used.

zh_cn.text: 设置用户界面所使用的最大缩放比例。若使用“自动”，则将始终使用最大的缩放比例。

en_us.text: If enabled, the game will display in full-screen (if supported).

zh_cn.text: 如果启用，游戏将以全屏显示（如果受支持）。

en_us.text: If enabled, the game's frame rate will be synchronized to the monitor's refresh rate, making for a generally smoother experience at the expense of overall input latency. This setting might reduce performance if your system is too slow.

zh_cn.text: 如果启用，游戏的帧率将与显示器的刷新率同步，通常会带来更流畅的体验，但会增加输入延迟。如果你的系统性能不足，此设置可能会降低性能。

en_us.text: Limits the maximum number of frames per second. This can help reduce battery usage and general system load when multi-tasking. If VSync is enabled, this option will be ignored unless it is lower than your display's refresh rate.

zh_cn.text: 限制每秒帧数的最大值。这有助于在多任务处理时降低电量消耗与系统整体负载。如果已启用垂直同步，则此选项将被忽略，除非该值低于显示器的刷新率。

en_us.text: If enabled, the player's view will sway and bob when moving around. Players who experience motion sickness while playing can benefit from disabling this.

zh_cn.text: 如果启用，玩家的视角在移动时会摇晃和起伏。容易晕 3D 的玩家可以通过禁用此选项来缓解。

en_us.text: Controls where the Attack Indicator is displayed on screen.

zh_cn.text: 控制攻击指示器显示在屏幕上的位置。

en_us.text: If enabled, an indicator will be shown when the game is saving the world to disk.

zh_cn.text: 如果启用，当游戏正在将世界保存到磁盘时会显示一个指示器。

en_us.text: The default graphics quality controls some legacy options and is necessary for mod compatibility. If the options below are left to "Default", they will use this setting.

zh_cn.text: 默认画质控制一些旧式选项，并且是模组兼容性所必需的。如果下方的选项保持为“默认”，它们将使用此设置。

en_us.text: Controls the presence of rendered clouds in the sky.

zh_cn.text: 控制天空中是否渲染云。

en_us.text: Controls the quality of rain and snow effects.
Controls the maximum number of particles which can be present on screen at any one time.

zh_cn.text: 控制屏幕上同一时间可存在的最大粒子数量。

en_us.text: Controls whether blocks will be smoothly lit and shaded. This slightly increases the amount of time needed to re-build a chunk, but doesn't affect frame rates.

zh_cn.text: 控制方块是否被平滑地照亮和着色。这会略微增加重建区块所需的时间，但不会影响帧率。

en_us.text: Controls the range which biomes will be sampled for block colorization. Higher values greatly increase the amount of time it takes to build chunks for diminishing improvements in quality.

zh_cn.text: 控制方块着色时对生物群系的采样范围。较高的值会大幅增加构建区块所需的时间，而画质提升却越来越不明显。

en_us.text: Controls how far away entities can render from the player. Higher values increase the render distance at the expense of frame rates.

zh_cn.text: 控制实体渲染时离玩家的最远距离。较高的值会增加渲染距离，但会降低帧率。

en_us.text: If enabled, basic shadows will be rendered beneath mobs and other entities.

zh_cn.text: 如果启用，将在生物和其他实体下方渲染简单的阴影。

en_us.text: If enabled, a vignette effect will be rendered on the player's view. This is very unlikely to make a difference to frame rates unless you are fill-rate limited.

zh_cn.text: 如果启用，将在玩家的视野上渲染晕影效果。除非你的显卡填充率受限，否则这几乎不会影响帧率。

en_us.text: Controls the number of mipmaps which will be used for block model textures. Higher values provide better rendering of blocks in the distance, but may adversely affect performance with many animated textures.

zh_cn.text: 控制方块模型纹理使用的多级纹理（Mipmap）数量。较高的值可以更好地渲染远处的方块，但在有较多动态纹理时可能会对性能产生负面影响。

en_us.text: If enabled, only the sides of blocks which are facing the camera will be submitted for rendering. This can eliminate a large number of block faces very early in the rendering process, saving memory bandwidth and time on the GPU. Some resource packs may have issues with this option, so try disabling it if you're seeing holes in blocks.

zh_cn.text: 如果启用，只有面向相机的方块面才会被提交渲染。这可以在渲染过程的早期就剔除大量方块面，从而节省显存带宽和 GPU 时间。某些资源包可能与此选项不兼容，如果你看到方块上出现空洞，请尝试禁用此选项。

en_us.text: If enabled, a more compact vertex format will be used for rendering chunks. This can reduce graphics memory usage and bandwidth requirements significantly, especially for integrated graphics cards, but can cause z-fighting with some resource packs due to how it reduces the precision of position and texture coordinate attributes. Disabling this has no effect if Oculus is installed.

zh_cn.text: 启用后，游戏将使用更紧凑的顶点格式来渲染区块。这可以显著减少显存使用和带宽需求，尤其是对于集成显卡而言。但是，由于它降低了位置和纹理坐标属性的精度，可能会导致一些资源包出现深度冲突（z-fighting）的问题。

en_us.text: If enabled, translucent effects from surfaces such as stained glass and water will be applied correctly.

zh_cn.text: 启用后，游戏将正确应用彩色玻璃、水等方块表面的半透明效果。

en_us.text: If enabled, chunks which are determined to be fully hidden by fog effects will not be rendered, helping to improve performance. The improvement can be more dramatic when fog effects are heavier (such as while underwater), but it may cause undesirable visual artifacts between the sky and fog in some scenarios.

zh_cn.text: 如果启用，被判定为完全被雾效遮挡的区块将不会被渲染，有助于提高性能。当雾效较重（例如在水下）时提升会更明显，但在某些情况下可能导致天空与雾之间出现不理想的视觉瑕疵。

en_us.text: If enabled, entities determined not to be in any visible chunks will be skipped during rendering. This can help improve performance by avoiding the rendering of entities located underground or behind walls.

zh_cn.text: 如果启用，渲染时将跳过被判定为不在任何可见区块内的实体。这可以通过避免渲染位于地下或墙后的实体来提高性能。

en_us.text: If enabled, only animated textures determined to be visible will be updated. This can provide a significant boost to frame rates on some hardware, especially with heavier resource packs. If you experience issues with some textures not being animated, try disabling this option.

zh_cn.text: 如果启用，只有被判定为可见的动态纹理才会被更新。这在某些硬件上可以显著提升帧率，尤其是在使用较重的资源包时。如果你遇到某些纹理没有动画的问题，请尝试禁用此选项。

en_us.text: Specifies the maximum number of frames the CPU can be waiting on the GPU to finish rendering. Very low or high values may create frame rate instability.

zh_cn.text: 指定 CPU 可以等待 GPU 完成渲染的最大帧数。过低或过高的值都可能导致帧率不稳定。

en_us.text:
If enabled, a small amount of memory will be persistently mapped as a staging buffer for chunk uploading, helping to reduce CPU overhead and frame time instability when loading or updating chunks.

Requires OpenGL 4.4 or ARB_buffer_storage.

zh_cn.text:
如果启用，将把少量内存持久映射为区块上传用的暂存缓冲区，有助于降低 CPU 开销，并减少加载或更新区块时的帧时间波动。

需要 OpenGL 4.4 或 ARB_buffer_storage。

en_us.text: Specifies the number of threads to use for chunk building. Using more threads can speed up chunk loading and update speed, but may negatively impact frame times.

zh_cn.text: 指定用于区块构建的线程数。使用更多线程可以加快区块的加载与更新速度，但可能会对帧时间产生负面影响。

en_us.text: If enabled, rendering will never wait for chunk updates to finish, even if they are important. This can greatly improve frame rates in some scenarios, but it may create significant visual lag in the world.

zh_cn.text: 如果启用，渲染将永远不会等待区块更新完成，即使这些更新很重要。这在某些情况下可以大幅提高帧率，但可能在游戏世界中造成明显的视觉延迟。

en_us.text: If enabled, the OpenGL context will be created with error checking disabled. This may slightly improve performance, but it also increases the risk that the game will crash instead of gracefully handling OpenGL errors. You should disable this option if you are experiencing sudden unexplained crashes.

zh_cn.text: 如果启用，创建 OpenGL 上下文时将禁用错误检查。这可能会略微提升性能，但也会增加游戏因无法妥善处理 OpenGL 错误而崩溃的风险。如果你遇到原因不明的突然崩溃，应禁用此选项。

en_us.text: The game must be restarted to apply one or more video settings!

zh_cn.text: 必须重启游戏才能应用一项或多项视频设置！

en_us.text:
Your NVIDIA graphics drivers are out of date!
  * This will cause severe performance issues and crashes when Embeddium is installed.
  * Please update your graphics drivers to the latest version (version 536.23 or newer.)

zh_cn.text:
你的 NVIDIA 显卡驱动已过时！
  * 在安装 Embeddium 的情况下，这会导致严重的性能问题和崩溃。
  * 请将显卡驱动更新至最新版本（536.23 或更新版本）。

en_us.text:
PojavLauncher is not supported when using Embeddium.
  * You are very likely to run into extreme performance issues, graphical bugs, and crashes.
  * You will be on your own if you decide to continue -- we will not help you with any bugs or crashes!

zh_cn.text:
使用 Embeddium 时不支持 PojavLauncher。
  * 你极有可能遇到极端的性能问题、图形错误和崩溃。
  * 如果你决定继续，后果自负 —— 我们不会为任何错误或崩溃提供帮助！

This option will re-print all the encountered EMF loading errors, from the last resource reload, back into the log in the order they were encountered
Not all errors here will be very helpful as they may be missing surrounding log context

zh_cn.text:
此选项将按出现顺序重新输出
最后一次资源重载时EMF遇到的所有加载错误日志
由于缺少上下文环境，并非所有错误信息都具有参考价值

en_us.text:
OptiFine floors all UV values in custom box UV's
i.e. it makes them all whole numbers.
This setting will make EMF do the same
EMF will also log if it finds a model that doesn't have floored UVs

zh_cn.text:
OptiFine会对自定义立方体的UV值执行取整操作
（即转为整数）
此设置将使EMF采取相同行为
EMF会同时记录未取整UV值的模型信息

en_us.text:
If enabled this will enforce OptiFine's CEM syntax limitations, such as
bone ids in animations cannot start with _ or numbers.
numbers cannot start with '.' such as '.9'
bones named 'render' cannot be referenced by animations
This setting when enabled will log errors for any animations that violate these rules and invalidate them.

zh_cn.text:
启用后将强制实施OptiFine的CEM语法规范，例如：
动画中的骨骼ID不能以_或数字开头
数字不能以.开头（如.9）
名为'render'的骨骼不能被动画引用
启用时，将记录违反规则的动画错误并使其失效

en_us.text:
Not all parts visible here may export
only declared parts will.
You can find out the missing part's transform details by checking the game log after exporting.

zh_cn.text:
此处可见的部件不一定都能导出
仅声明过的部件可以导出
导出后可通过游戏日志查看缺失部件的变换详情
子文件夹模型必须存在变体

en_us.text:
In OptiFine the subfolder option for model files only works if that model variates.
E.G. 'optifine/cem/skeleton/skeleton.jem' will only load if it has variants
such as 'optifine/cem/skeleton/skeleton2.jem' or a .properties file
This setting will make EMF also enforce this,
EMF will log this if it finds a model that doesn't variate

zh_cn.text:
在OptiFine中，模型文件的子文件夹选项
仅在该模型存在变体时生效
例如：'optifine/cem/skeleton/skeleton.jem'仅在存在
'skeleton2.jem'变体或.properties文件时才会加载
此设置将使EMF同样强制执行该规则
EMF会记录未配置变体的模型信息

en_us.text: Debug options, can be helpful to figure some things out

zh_cn.text: 调试选项，可用于排查问题

the log and chat when an entity is right clicked.

zh_cn.text:
启用后，右键点击实体时

增强方块实体(EBE)模组补丁

en_us.text:
If enabled, this will allow EMF to modify the EBE Mod's config
to disable EBE for certain block entities if that
Block Entity actually has a custom EMF model loaded.
EMF cannot automatically re enable these settings afterwards,
 you will have to do that manually if desired.

zh_cn.text:
启用后，当方块实体已加载自定义EMF模型时
允许EMF修改EBE模组配置来禁用对应方块实体的增强渲染
EMF无法自动恢复这些设置
如需恢复需手动操作

en_us.text: Try to prevent EMF models being overridden

Will try and force entity renderers to use the models set by EMF

 this wont work with all mods

zh_cn.text:
尝试强制实体渲染器使用EMF设置的模型
这将覆盖其他模组修改的原版模型
不保证对所有模组生效

en_us.text:
Sets the distance at which animations will begin to skip frames,
lower the Level of Detail (LOD), This can help with performance
None = no frame skipping
16 = will skip 1 frame for every 16 blocks distance from player
Lower numbers mean more skipped frames and more performance gain
but of course animations will become more noticeably lower
framerate the closer the LOD distance is set

zh_cn.text:
设置动画开始跳帧的触发距离
降低细节层级(LOD)可提升性能
无 = 不跳帧
16 = 每远离玩家16格跳1帧
数值越小跳帧越多性能越好
但动画帧率下降会越明显

en_us.text:
Model variables are specified in the format
 "<model>.<variable_name>"

The model can be:
 "this" - current custom model
 "part" - the original part model to which the custom model is attached
 "<part>" - original model by part name
 "<id>" - custom model by ID
 "<part>:<sub_id>:<sub_sub_id>:..." - (hierarchical) start with original model by part name, then find children by ID
 "<id>:<sub_id>:<sub_sub_id>:..." - (hierarchical) start with model by ID, then find children by ID

The first model found by part name or ID is used if there are duplicates.
The model search by ID is deep, also when used in a hierarchical specification. 

The hierarchical specification allows model groups (json part models) to be reused for different parts. 
For example one hand model ("shoulder:upper_arm:elbow:forearm:palm:finger[1.5]" can be used for both left and right hand.
The animation can use "left_hand:finger1" for the left thumb and "right_hand:finger1" for the right thumb. 
The intermediate parents in the hierarchical specification can be skipped. 

Variable names
 tx, ty, tz    - Translation x, y, z
 rx, ry, rz    - Rotation x, y, z
 sx, sy, sz    - Scale x, y, z
 visible       - Show model and submodels (boolean)
 visible_boxes - Show model only, does not affect submodels (boolean)

zh_cn.text:
模型变量格式为
"<模型>.<变量名>"

可用模型标识：
"this" - 当前自定义模型
"part" - 自定义模型附加的原始部件模型
"<部件名>" - 通过部件名指定原始模型
"<ID>" - 通过ID指定自定义模型
"<部件名>:<子ID>:<子子ID>:..." - (层级结构)从部件名开始查找子级
"<ID>:<子ID>:<子子ID>:..." - (层级结构)从模型ID开始查找子级

存在重复时使用首个匹配的模型
ID搜索为深度搜索

层级结构允许模型组(json部件模型)复用
例如手部模型("shoulder:upper_arm:elbow:forearm:palm:finger[1.5]")可同时用于左右手
动画可使用"left_hand:finger1"指代左手拇指
"right_hand:finger1"指代右手拇指
层级中的中间父级可省略

可用变量名：
tx, ty, tz - 平移坐标
rx, ry, rz - 旋转角度
sx, sy, sz - 缩放比例
visible - 显示模型及子模型(布尔值)
visible_boxes - 仅显示当前模型(不影响子模型)

It is a best practise with OptiFine to require a 'base' model for variation, as this can be very inconsistent with OptiFine. With the setting enabled this will mean 'pig2.jem' will not variate without a 'pig.jem'.
EMF does not require this, but will enforce it if enabled here as it is best to preserve OptiFine compatibility where possible.

Sets where the ETF settings button will appear in the resource pack menu.
or disable it entirely.

No settings available
The Entity Model Features mod is needed if you want OptiFine format Custom Entity Models.

zh_cn.text:
无可用设置
如需OptiFine格式的自定义实体模型，需要安装实体模型特性模组。

en_us.text:
No settings available
The Entity Sound Features mod is needed if you want Varied Entity Sounds.

zh_cn.text:
无可用设置
如需多样化实体音效，需要安装实体音效特性模组。

This setting will prevent ETF from loading overrides for the 'base' texture if present in the optifine/etf directories
E.G. optifine/random/entity/chicken.png will not act as an override to the vanilla texture.
ON is the default OptiFine behaviour.

此设置将阻止ETF加载'基础'纹理的覆盖（如果存在于optifine/etf目录中）

开启是OptiFine的默认行为。

en_us.text:
These options are for backwards compatibility with OptiFine.
Some will put limitations on certain features because OptiFine does.
Some will enable some odd behaviours because OptiFine does.

zh_cn.text:
这些选项用于保持与OptiFine的向后兼容性。
部分选项会因OptiFine的限制而禁用某些功能。
部分选项会启用某些异常行为以匹配OptiFine。

en_us.text:
OptiFine limits random .properties file rule numbers such that in
sequential order the rule numbers do not exceed a gap of 9.
This setting enforces this limit in ETF if enabled, for OptiFine compatibility.

zh_cn.text:
OptiFine限制随机.properties文件规则编号的间隔，
要求连续规则编号之间的差值不超过9。
此设置将强制ETF遵守此限制以确保OptiFine兼容性。
允许随机后缀编号跳过

en_us.text:
OptiFine allows random suffix variants, when not using .properties, to skip some numbers
Doing so is considered a bad practise, they should always be sequential.
This setting will allow ETF to skip numbers like OptiFine.

zh_cn.text:
OptiFine允许不使用.properties文件时，随机后缀变体可以跳过某些编号
这种做法被认为是不规范的，编号应该始终保持连续。
此设置将允许ETF像OptiFine一样跳过编号。
这些方块实体渲染器可能
不会实际使用这些功能

en_us.text:
Enables ETF to try and override the render layer of an entity.
Allowing transparency for example.
This will not always work properly...

zh_cn.text:
允许ETF尝试覆盖实体的渲染层。
例如实现透明效果。
这可能无法始终正常工作...

en_us.text: Enables ETF to try and override the default light level of an entity. E.G. you can stop Blazes & Allays from being bright by setting this to 0.

zh_cn.text: 允许ETF尝试覆盖实体的默认光照等级。例如：通过设为0可以阻止烈焰人和Allay发光。

Whether or not to allow or deny property
restrictions on a mob with a property that
is restricted to its spawn conditions

是否允许或禁止对生物应用
受其生成条件限制的属性
例如生物群系限制

This setting allows you to overwrite the
Vanilla behaviour of prohibiting all
non [a-z0-9/._-] characters in texture paths.
This means textures with spaces or capitals
are allowed to be used.
Disabled by default as these problems should really
be fixed by the resource pack creator

此设置允许覆盖原版禁止在纹理路径中使用

默认禁用，因为这些问题应该由
资源包创建者自行修复
允许限制未知纹理属性

Sets whether or not to allow spawn condition restrictions
For all additional ETF, EMF, or other mod added properties

设置是否允许对所有额外ETF、EMF
或其他模组添加的属性应用生成条件限制

Most resource packs use the emissive suffix _e
however this can be overridden by packs if they
want to use a different suffix.

'_e' suffixes even when set differently by a resource pack

大多数资源包使用_e作为发光纹理后缀

如果启用，模组将始终检查'_e'后缀

when enabled ETF will not tamper with any

currently only if MoreMcmeta mod is present.

启用时ETF不会干预任何
带有动画的纹理

注意：根据着色器不同可能导致深度冲突

ETF's armor code is know to cause some issues with modded armor and it uses the old ETF system
 this setting exists to allow you to disable emissive armor and trims if you have an incompatibility
 until I am able to reimplement ETF into armor a better way

此设置允许在出现不兼容时禁用发光盔甲功能
直到我能用更好的方式重新实现ETF盔甲系统

Sets how often textures will randomly blink
If set to 100 mobs will blink randomly after
1 second delay and then at a random time from
1 to 100 ticks (0-5 seconds).
This can be set / overridden per mob
by the resource pack.
See the mod download page for details.

详见模组下载页面说明

Sets how long textures will blink for
0 = 1 tick, 19 = 20 ticks / 1 second
This can be set / overridden per mob
by the resource pack.
See the mod download page for details.

0=1刻，19=20刻/1秒
资源包可为每个生物单独设置此值
详见模组下载页面说明

Sets whether or not mobs will try to blink

closed named 'textureName_blink2.png'.

需要准备名为"纹理名_blink.png"的闭眼纹理

Allows block entities to use a custom textures

允许方块实体使用OptiFine/ETF格式的随机纹理

启用后会将右键点击实体的相关ETF数据

此设置会将ETF当前所有纹理数据输出到日志

This is hard to describe, just try it out in-game :)
Bright rendering makes the emissive appear at max brightness if need be
and is only partially compatible with shaders, etc.
Default rendering respects the default renderers effects on entities,
the direction of each surface will have slight brightness variation

en_us.text:
Name
Matches to an entities name.
A value starting with "!" performs a negative match (not).
Examples:
 - Match string: "name=Pinky pinkyyy"
 - Match special formatting: "name=\u00a74\u00a7oPinky"
   (for best compatibility, use the escape sequence '\u00a7' instead of "§")
 - Wildcards using "?" and "*": "name=pattern:Pinky*"
 - Wildcards, case insensitive: "name=ipattern:Pinky*"
 - Java regular expressions: "name=regex:Pin(k)+y"
   (see http://docs.oracle.com/javase/6/docs/api/java/util/regex/Pattern.html)
 - Java regular expressions, case insensitive: "name=iregex:Pin(k)+y"
Any backslashes in the match string must be doubled.
Literal backslashes within a regular expression or wildcard must be quadrupled.
Correct:
  name=regex:\\d+
  name=regex:\\\\
  name=/\\/\\
Wrong:
  name=regex:\d+
  name=regex:\\
  name=/\/\
§anames.<n>=<name_list|regex|pattern>

en_us.text:
NBT 
Select whether a mob must have matching NBT data values
Note: this is an OptiFine feature that has not yet received official documentation,
ETF has copied the syntax listed in https://optifine.readthedocs.io/syntax.html#nbt for now.
NBT requires an additional value in the key this is called <nbtPath>.
- nbtPath must match the exact name of the nbt element and is case-sensitive
- nbtPath supports matching nested nbt elements by defining the full nbt path with '.' marking a separation
- E.G. the Villager profession level nbtPath is "VillagerData.level" meaning the full property key would be "nbt.<n>.VillagerData.level"
NBT can be used in several ways see this link https://optifine.readthedocs.io/syntax.html#nbt for details
Additionally ETF adds a variation to the "raw:" syntax called "print_raw:" which will act just like "raw:" but will
also print what that raw value is to the log for testing purposes,
ETF also allows you to start the string with "print:" to always print the full NBT data of the entity
§anbt.<n>.<nbtPath>=<exists:|raw:|print_raw:|print:|range:|regex:|iregex:|pattern:|ipattern:|string_list>

- bed (color)
- shulkerbox (color)

en_us.text:
Tweaks the vanilla skin transparency code to make it not affect all the extra pixels that aren't actually used in your skin
This allows transparency in these extra pixels without affecting the vanilla skin behaviour
Very useful for custom player models

调整原版皮肤透明代码，避免影响未使用的像素区域

对自定义玩家模型非常有用
跳过被剔除的 Tick 更新

en_us.text: Entities selected in this tab will not have their tick method optimized when culled. This can be useful for entities that need to tick for certain functionality, such as Boats.

zh_cn.text: 此选项卡内的实体不参与 Tick 更新。这适用于需要刻更新来实现某些功能的实体，例如实体船。

en_us.text: Entities selected in this tab will not be culled at all. This is mainly needed for client-side entities or entities that need to be rendered regardless of their visibility.

zh_cn.text: 在这个选项卡中选中的实体根本不会被剔除。这主要用于客户端实体，或者那些无论是否可见都需要被渲染的实体。

en_us.text: Block entities selected in this tab will not be culled at all. This is mainly needed for block entities that need to be rendered regardless of their visibility.

zh_cn.text: 在这个选项卡中选中的方块实体根本不会被剔除。这主要用于那些无论是否可见都需要被渲染的方块实体。
透过墙壁渲染名字标签

en_us.text: When turned off, culled entities will not have their nametags rendered through walls.

zh_cn.text: 关闭后，被剔除的实体的名字标签将不会透过墙壁渲染。

en_us.text: When turned on, entities that are culled will not tick. This can improve performance in some cases, but may cause issues with certain mods. Consider the finer control options in the other tab.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，被剔除的实体将不会进行 Tick 更新。这在某些情况下可以提高性能，但可能会导致某些模组出现问题。可以考虑在其他选项卡中使用更精细的控制选项。

en_us.text: When turned on, the F3 debug info will not show culling information.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，F3 调试信息将不会显示剔除信息。

en_us.text: When turned on, culling of entities will be skipped entirely. This can be useful for debugging or when you want to disable culling temporarily.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，将完全跳过实体的剔除。这在你调试时很有用，或者当你想要临时禁用剔除实体功能时也很方便。

en_us.text: When turned on, culling of block entities will be skipped entirely. This can be useful for debugging or when you want to disable culling temporarily.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，将完全跳过方块实体的剔除。这在你调试时很有用，或者当你想要临时禁用剔除功能时也很方便。

en_us.text: When turned on, block entity state extraction will be culled based on the camera's view frustum. This can improve performance in case your modloader/another mod doesn't do this already.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，将根据摄像机的视锥体对方块实体状态提取进行剔除。如果你的模组加载器或其他模组尚未执行此操作，这可以提高性能。

en_us.text: When turned on, display entities without a bounding box will get assigned a default bounding box for culling purposes. This can improve performance for maps/servers that do not configure their display entities correctly, but can cause visual issues.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，将为没有边界框的展示实体分配默认边界框以用于剔除目的。这可以提高未正确配置展示实体的地图/服务器的性能，但可能会导致视觉问题。

en_us.text: When turned on, leaves will be treated as solid for culling purposes. This can improve performance in forests, but also cause visual issues. Useful when setting 'See-Through Leaves' to Off, or using a bushy leaves resource pack.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，将树叶视作固体方块。此功能将提升森林中的渲染性能，但也会导致视觉上的问题。若同时关闭了“透过树叶渲染”选项，或同时加载了修改树叶视觉效果，使其显得更“茂盛”的资源包，此选项用起来会更舒服。

§8Attempt to grab a target in front of you. Upon success, you may follow up with:

 10 之时,即会获得狼神的庇护,强化自身攻击,并且有概率中断敌人的攻击

en_us.text: New version technical update, this skill is useless

zh_cn.text: 新版本技术更新,这个技能也就没用了

en_us.text: Specially made parry, I don't know how to make it, don't ask

zh_cn.text: 专门特制的格挡,我也不会做,别问

en_us.text: A powerful ground-shaking attack that knocks down all enemies within range

zh_cn.text: 强力的震地攻击,击倒所有在范围里的敌人

en_us.text: Allows you to adjust your defensive stance and block all blockable attacks during the skill duration. Each defeated enemy restores one layer of defense points (the base value of defense points is 4, the Sweeping Blade enchantment can increase defense points)

zh_cn.text: 允许你调整防御姿态,并且在技能持续期间,格挡所有可以格挡的攻击,每击败一名敌人回复一层防御点数(防御点数的基础数值为4,横扫之刃附魔可以提高防御点数)

en_us.text: A swift thrust that pierces through enemies in its path. In a running state, you can sheathe the sword and deliver a powerful strike.

zh_cn.text: 迅猛的突刺,刺穿路径的敌人,在奔跑状态下可以收起鞘斩出强力的一击

en_us.text: Adopt a stance to block the enemy's attack and then execute a killing blow.

zh_cn.text: 竖起架势,挡住敌人的攻击并且将敌人斩杀

en_us.text: Stun the enemy and deliver a powerful strike. The number of strikes varies depending on the number of enemies.

zh_cn.text: 击晕敌人并斩出强力的一击,根据敌人的数量斩击的次数也不同

en_us.text: Allows you to use different actions to dodge. A successful dodge can trigger special effects and restore weapon charge.

zh_cn.text: 允许你使用不同的动作进行闪避,闪避成功可以触发特效.并恢复武器充能.

en_us.text: Use the shield to block the enemy's attack and stun the enemy.

zh_cn.text: 使用盾牌,抵挡住敌人的攻击,并且眩晕敌人

en_us.text: Grab surrounding enemies and deliver a powerful knockdown.

zh_cn.text: 抓取周围的敌人并且强力的击倒

en_us.text:
A meaningless dodge skill book, maybe the author was too lazy to delete it. It doesn't differ much from dodging, except that it reduces stamina consumption by 1.

(Stamina: %d)

zh_cn.text:
意义不明的闪避技能书,也许是作者太懒了忘记删掉了吧,和闪避没什么区别,就是闪避消耗减少了 1 耐力。

（耐力：%d）

en_us.text: Spin forward and deliver a powerful strike.

zh_cn.text: 向前旋转斩出强力的一击

en_us.text: Raise your greatsword and slash all surrounding enemies.

zh_cn.text: 举起你的大剑,斩开周围的所有敌人

en_us.text:
Teleport in a specified direction. Dodge all dodgeable attacks.

(Stamina: %d)

zh_cn.text:
向指定方向闪现。 闪避所有可以闪避的攻击。

（耐力：%d）

en_us.text: During the preparation phase of normal skill usage, being attacked by the enemy can trigger a counterattack. After 1a, 2a, 3a, you can release additional combos, and after a parry, you can release the Illusory Blade Realm for a counterattack.

zh_cn.text: 普通技能在使用过程的准备阶段受到敌人的攻击可以反击,1a,2a,3a后均可释放追加连段,在招架之后可以释放虚幻刀界进行反击

en_us.text: Depending on the attack, the combo delivered is different.

zh_cn.text: 根据攻击的不同,打出的连击也不同

en_us.text: Exclusive dodge skill for Yamato  (Without Yamato, you cannot use this skill. When holding the Yamato , and dodge is set to Phantom, this skill will activate automatically)

zh_cn.text: 阎魔刀专属闪避技能 (没有阎魔刀,你无法使用此技能,当持有阎魔刀时,并且闪避为阎魔刀闪避时,此技能会自动激活)

en_us.text: Lock onto a low-health enemy and perform a kill, which cannot be interrupted during execution (Weapons allowed: uchigatana, katana, tachi, longsword)

zh_cn.text: 锁定低血量的敌人并进行斩杀,斩杀期间不可被打断(可用武器:打刀,武士刀,太刀,长剑)

en_us.text: After a brief charge, stun the enemy, deal a fatal attack, and effectively push back the enemy.

zh_cn.text: 短暂的蓄力之后,眩晕敌人,造成致命攻击,并有效地击退敌人
史诗战斗：觉醒 物品

en_us.text: An assassin lurking in the shadows of the night, dodging enemy strikes with nimble movements and striking back in return.

zh_cn.text: 潜伏于黑夜之中的刺客，用其灵巧的动作躲避敌人的攻击并给予反击

en_us.text: Warning: Normal Attack and Heavy Attack are currently bound to the same key. It is strongly recommended to bind Heavy Attack to a different key.

zh_cn.text: 当前普攻与重击为同一个按键，强烈建议将重击绑定至其他按键

en_us.text: -[Phantom Dance] §f N N N H H H ... H

zh_cn.text: -[幽影乱舞] §f N N N H H H ... H

-[暗影步] §f 攻击后 S1 H
-[暗影步-追击] §f 暗影步GP + N

en_us.text: -[Shadow Step-Throwing Blade] §f Shadow Step GP + H

zh_cn.text: -[暗影步-暗器] §f 暗影步GP + H
-[暗影交换] §f 招架后 S1 + D
-[地面突进连斩] §f 钩锁滑铲 + N/H

en_us.text: -[Aerial Spinning Slash] §f Grappling Hook Flight + N/H

zh_cn.text: -[空中回旋连斩] §f 钩锁飞行 + N/H
雷霆将会审判你的罪行

en_us.text: -[Normal Attack] §f N N N N N

zh_cn.text: -[普攻] §f N N N N N
-[闪避追击] §f 闪避反击 + H

en_us.text: -[Normal Attack] §f N N N N N

zh_cn.text: -[普攻] §f N N N N N
-[闪避追击] §f 闪避反击 + H
-[闪避追击] §f 闪避反击 + H

en_us.text: -[Inferno of Thunder and Flame] §f S2 H
[Battle Breath] §f Whenever you successfully use a dodge counter or defensive counter to dodge an enemy attack, you immediately recover a small amount of stamina and begin restoring stamina

zh_cn.text: [战斗呼吸] §f 每当你成功使用闪避反击或者防御反击闪避敌人攻击，立即恢复少量耐力并开始恢复耐力

en_us.text: [Turning The Tide] §f Each time you successfully parry an enemy's attack, your next defensive counter deals 20% more damage for 3 seconds, up to a maximum of 100%

zh_cn.text: [逆转攻势] §f 每当你成功招架敌人的攻击，3秒内使你的下一次防御反击伤害提升20%，最多提升100%

en_us.text:
Press [%s + %s] to release

Strike lightning on up to 10 targets within a 16-block radius

Deal [5 + 8%% of Max Health + 300%% of ATK] damage

Damage is doubled if the target has less than 25%% health remaining

Each enemy killed with this skill reduces its cooldown by 10 seconds

zh_cn.text:
按下[%s + %s]释放

对半径16格内最多10名目标释放雷击

造成[5 + 最大生命值8%% + 攻击力300%%]的伤害

如果目标的生命值低于25%%则伤害翻倍

每使用技能击杀一名敌人，冷却时间缩短10秒

en_us.text:
Whenever your health decreases, gain damage absorption equal to
[2 + 5% of Max Health].
If health is below 50%, the effect is doubled.

zh_cn.text:
每当你生命值降低时，获得
[2 + 最大生命值5%]
的伤害吸收量。
如果生命值低于50%，效果翻倍

en_us.text: When an attack successfully hits an enemy, gain a stack of a buff that increases attack speed by %s%% for %s seconds, stacking up to %s times.

zh_cn.text: 攻击成功命中敌人时，获得一层攻击速度提升%s%%的增益，持续%s秒，最多叠加%s层

en_us.text: Every 10 seconds, toggle between %s and %s stamina regeneration rate.

zh_cn.text: 每10秒，使自身在耐力回复速度%s和%s之间切换

en_us.text: During an enemy's attack wind-up, increase damage dealt to them by %s%% and impact by %s%%.

zh_cn.text: 在敌人攻击前摇时，对其造成的伤害增加%s%%，冲击力增加%s%%

en_us.text:
Upon entering any stun state, immediately begin regenerating stamina and gain a brief stun immunity.
If in a broken state, gain a brief Resistance effect at level 2.

zh_cn.text:
进入任意硬直状态时，立即开始回复耐力并获得短暂霸体。
如果处于破防状态，获得短暂的抗性提升2效果

en_us.text: When about to take fatal damage, negate that damage, restore 40% of your health, and gain a brief Resistance effect at level 4.

zh_cn.text: 即将受到致命伤害时减免当次伤害，并回复自身40%的生命值、获得短暂的抗性提升4效果

en_us.text:
Weapon worn on the fist comprised of sharp parallel blades favored by those who lurk in the dark.

Claws can be equipped in both Hands.

zh_cn.text:
戴在拳头上的武器，由锋利的平行刃组成，深受潜伏于黑暗中者的青睐。

爪类武器可装备于双手。

en_us.text: A Skill used by the Bloody Finger hunter Yura. (Milady only) Press Z for Wingstance. Sneak + Innate for special Attackmove. Sprint + Innate for special Attackmove.

zh_cn.text: 血指猎人尤拉所用的技能。（仅限米蕾蒂）按 Z 进入翼之架势。潜行+固有技能可发动特殊攻击。疾跑+固有技能可发动特殊攻击。
不留任何还站着的对手。

en_us.text: Legends say that the name of this skill was invented by a being who had the power to change the laws of the world.

zh_cn.text: 传说这一技能的名字，是一位拥有改写世界法则之力的存在所取的。

en_us.text: This skill is only intended for particularly strong arms. Difficult for you.

zh_cn.text: 这一技能只适合臂力特别出众的人。对你来说太难了。

en_us.text: Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot. Can be used to hurt Grass.

zh_cn.text: 深受狡黠敏捷者喜爱的技能。可以用来伤害草方块。

en_us.text: A skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a long thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.

zh_cn.text: 让穿刺类武器突破敌人盾牌的技能。蓄力后向前突进，使出贯穿敌人格挡的长距离突刺。

en_us.text: An extremely realistic skill that destroys everything in its path.

zh_cn.text: 一个极其写实的技能，能摧毁其路径上的一切。

en_us.text: This skill pierces part of the armour and knocks enemies down.

zh_cn.text: 这一技能可穿透部分护甲，并将敌人击倒。

en_us.text: Take a quick step forward to stagger your opponents with your heavy weapon!

zh_cn.text: 快速向前跨出一步，用你的重型武器将对手震得踉跄！

en_us.text: Land a few quick attacks and finish off your opponent with the final strike

zh_cn.text: 打出数次快速攻击，以最后一击终结你的对手

en_us.text: Channel your accumulated energy using the staff to create a shockwave on the ground.

zh_cn.text: 以战杖引导积聚的能量，在地面掀起一道冲击波。

en_us.text: A precise strike, which pierces the Armor of the Target.

zh_cn.text: 一记精准的打击，可穿透目标的护甲。

en_us.text: Land a few quick attacks and finish off your opponent with the final strike

zh_cn.text: 打出数次快速攻击，以最后一击终结你的对手

en_us.text: Stronger version of Battojusto because why not

zh_cn.text: 居合的强化版——就因为可以，所以做了

en_us.text: Channel all your energy into a powerful kick that neutralises your opponents

zh_cn.text: 将全部能量灌注于一脚强力踢击，使你的对手丧失战力

en_us.text: Sacrifice 1,5+ 30% of your Health in exchange for 30% Damage Boost for 30 seconds. Once the Sepukku effect has worn off, you gain the Drained effect. Whilst this effect is active, you will receive double damage if you activate Sepukku again.

zh_cn.text: 献祭 1.5 颗心外加 30% 的生命值，以换取 30 秒内 30% 的伤害加成。切腹效果消退后，你会获得虚脱效果。在此效果生效期间，若再次发动切腹，你将受到双倍伤害。

en_us.text:
Halberd of Gundyr the Champion, received when he was charged with his duty.

This old cast-iron halberd has the power to break poise, and is said to never crumble, seeming to suggest that Gundyr was fated to eternal service from the beginning.

zh_cn.text:
冠军古达受命履行职责时获赐的戟。

这把老旧的铸铁戟拥有崩坏韧性的力量，据说永不崩坏，仿佛暗示古达从一开始就注定要永恒侍奉。

en_us.text: Gives you the ability to escape your opponents and knock them over

zh_cn.text: 赋予你摆脱对手并将其击倒的能力

en_us.text: This Weapon Art was invented by Yura, allowing the Blood Cult to kill enemies more efficiently

zh_cn.text: 这一武技由尤拉所创，令血祭教团得以更高效地猎杀敌人

en_us.text: Use the power emanating from the halberd to deliver a powerful stroke that will kill your opponents.

zh_cn.text: 运用从戟中散发出的力量，施以足以斩杀对手的强力一击。

en_us.text: And Tyhros said: Those who stand in the way will be utterly destroyed.

zh_cn.text: 泰洛斯有言：挡我路者，必将灰飞烟灭。

en_us.text:
"And those who are prideful, and refuse to bow down, shall be laid low and made unto dust."
Your attacks become stronger, you can't be stunned, and you regain 25% of your health.
 "Revenge is a dish best served cold."

zh_cn.text:
“骄傲自大、拒不低头之人，终将被击倒在地，化为尘土。”
你的攻击变得更强，你不会陷入眩晕，并恢复 25% 的生命值。
 “君子报仇，十年不晚。”

en_us.text:
If your health falls below 3 Hearts, negative effects will be reflected back at the last attacker and you will be cleansed. You also become more resistant to damage and regain half your stamina.

But this skill will not protect you from death...

zh_cn.text:
当你的生命值降至 3 颗心以下时，负面效果会被反弹给最后一名攻击者，而你将被净化。你还会变得更耐打，并恢复一半的体力。

但这个技能无法保你不死……

en_us.text: If you parry an attack, your next strike will deal %s%% more damage.

zh_cn.text: 如果你招架了一次攻击，你的下一次打击将造成%s%%的额外伤害。

en_us.text: Splash Potion of Stronger Stamina Regeneration

zh_cn.text: 喷溅型强效体力恢复药水

en_us.text: Lingering Potion of Stronger Stamina Regeneration

zh_cn.text: 滞留型强效体力恢复药水

en_us.text: Splash Potion of Longer Stamina Regeneration

zh_cn.text: 喷溅型长效体力恢复药水

en_us.text: Lingering Potion of Longer Stamina Regeneration

zh_cn.text: 滞留型长效体力恢复药水

en_us.text: This weapon restores stamina when you execute a target. This effect is more effective in moonlight.

zh_cn.text: 这把武器会在你处决目标时恢复体力。在月光下，这一效果更强。

en_us.text: Like its counterpart, this weapon was forged from mithril, but under the influence of moonlight. It was therefore consecrated to Nox Obscura, the goddess of darkness. What became of this dagger afterwards, no one knows.

zh_cn.text: 与其姊妹武器一样，这把武器以秘银锻造，却是在月光的沐浴下完成。因此，它被供奉给黑暗女神诺克丝·奥布斯库拉。此后这把匕首的下落，无人知晓。

en_us.text: This weapon restores health to the wielder when they take another’s life.

zh_cn.text: 当持有者夺走他人性命时，这把武器会为其恢复生命值。

en_us.text: This was once a sacred weapon, forged from mithril, but it was misused for cruel rituals by high-ranking figures in the Blood Cult.

zh_cn.text: 这曾是一件以秘银锻造的圣器，却被血祭教团的高层人物滥用于残忍的仪式之中。

en_us.text: The blade of this weapon is so transparent that you might think it were made of glass. There is a glowing, bright-red ruby on the hilt.

zh_cn.text: 这把武器的刀刃如此通透，你会以为它是玻璃制成的。剑柄上镶有一颗散发光芒的鲜红红宝石。

en_us.text: This weapon was used by the Blood Cult’s elite soldiers during the Unholy War. After that, it vanished without a trace and was never found…

zh_cn.text: 这把武器曾在渎神战争期间由血祭教团的精锐士兵使用。此后，它消失得无影无踪，再无人寻获……

en_us.text: "Tantum qui viam mali ambulant ei digni erunt."

zh_cn.text: "Tantum qui viam mali ambulant ei digni erunt."

en_us.text: This weapon was primarily used by the Eques Mortis as an instrument of execution. After the Revolution, these weapons became a symbol of atrocity and were subsequently banned. Nevertheless, some of these examples are still in circulation today.

zh_cn.text: 这把武器主要被“死亡骑士”（Eques Mortis）用作处刑工具。革命之后，这类武器沦为暴行的象征，随后遭到封禁。尽管如此，如今仍有少数几把流传于世。

en_us.text:
This weapon was used for torture by the dungeon guards of the old kingdom.
The pointed prongs make it look like a fist-sized version of the Iron Maiden.

zh_cn.text:
这把武器曾被旧王国的地牢看守用作拷问刑具。
那些尖锐的尖刺让它看起来就像一个拳头大小的铁处女。

en_us.text: It is lightly smeared with blood...

zh_cn.text: 上面隐约抹着一层血迹……

en_us.text: Following reunification, a neutral party was established to uphold peace. To meet this challenge, they were entrusted with sacred sabres, whose ornamentation embodies the imagery of justice.

zh_cn.text: 统一之后，一个中立的势力被建立起来以维护和平。为应对这一使命，神圣的军刀被托付给他们，刀身上的纹饰正是正义的具象。

en_us.text:
A light greatsword; that is, a sword whose blade matches the length of a greatsword, while being constrained to a minimal weight.
Nicknamed after ladies of noble status for its refined appearance. With cultivated form, one can wield this weapon as swiftly as one might a straight sword.

zh_cn.text:
轻重大剑；即剑刃长度堪比大剑、重量却被压至极低的剑。
因其精致的外观，得名于出身高贵的贵妇。只要锻炼出娴熟的姿势，便能如直剑般迅捷地挥舞此剑。

en_us.text: It appears to be part of an ancient weapon

zh_cn.text: 它似乎是某件古代武器的一部分

en_us.text: Bright green, but no more dangerous than a pebble

zh_cn.text: 鲜亮的绿色，却并不比一颗鹅卵石更危险

en_us.text: This is just a normal stick, right?

zh_cn.text: 这只是根普通的木棍，对吧？

en_us.text: The blade of this spear is made of pure electrum, also known as water gold. The shaft itself is made of volcanic glass. Nightingale once belonged to a High Magistrate of the Night Cult.

zh_cn.text: 这把长枪的枪刃由纯琥珀金铸成，琥珀金亦称“水金”。枪杆本身则由火山玻璃制成。夜莺曾属于黑夜教团的一位高阶裁判官。

en_us.text: This deep wine-red stone seems to absorb all light.

zh_cn.text: 这块深酒红色的石头似乎能吸纳一切光线。

en_us.text: One might think this stone had captured the sun, as it looks as though it’s glowing a bright orange.

zh_cn.text: 你可能会以为这块石头捕捉了太阳——它看上去仿佛正绽放着明亮的橙色光芒。

en_us.text: Parents place these stones under their children’s pillows to protect them from nightmares.

zh_cn.text: 父母们会把这种石头放在孩子的枕头下，以保护他们远离噩梦。

en_us.text: You’re not sure what materials this piece is made of, but there must be plenty of various materials.

zh_cn.text: 你不确定这块板材是用什么材料做成的，但它必定含有不少各种各样的材料。

en_us.text: This piece of metal is so badly rusted that it is no longer suitable for forging. However, there may be other uses for it.

zh_cn.text: 这块金属锈蚀得非常严重，已经不适合用来锻造了。不过，它或许还有别的用处。

en_us.text: The metal still seems to be glowing in certain places, even though this weapon is probably thousands of years old!

zh_cn.text: 这件武器恐怕已有数千年的历史，它的金属在某些地方却似乎仍在发光！

en_us.text: It is a rather old scythe that was once used on farms. However, the blade appears to have been reinforced.

zh_cn.text: 这是一把相当古老的大镰刀，曾在农田里使用。不过，它的刀刃似乎经过加固。

en_us.text:
Adds a Delay Gate block. On the first reach, it starts a one-time timer and skips its contained actions. The surrounding script continues immediately.

This block does not schedule an execution. Its timer is checked only when the script reaches the same block instance again. Reaches before the timer expires skip the contained actions. The first reach at or after expiry opens the gate and runs them; every later reach runs them immediately.

Delay time is in milliseconds. A resolved delay of 0 or less, including invalid values, opens the gate immediately.

The gate resets only when that action-script instance is reconstructed or replaced.

Use Execute Later instead when every reach should schedule a fresh delayed execution.

zh_cn.text:
添加一个 Delay 方块，它会在运行其中包含的动作前等待指定时间。

在延迟倒计时的同时，脚本的其余部分会继续运行。
延迟时间以毫秒为单位。

记住，界面重新初始化时延迟会重置（例如调整窗口大小，或关闭后重新打开界面）。

这对定时序列、冷却时间或动作间隔很有用。
添加 EXECUTE LATER 方块

en_us.text:
Adds an Execute Later block that schedules its contained actions to run after the specified delay.

Delay time is in milliseconds.

Every time the script reaches this block, it schedules a new execution on the main thread.

This is useful for delayed actions in scripts that only run once.

zh_cn.text:
添加一个 Execute Later 方块，会把其中包含的动作安排在指定延迟后运行。

延迟时间以毫秒为单位。

每次脚本走到这个方块时，都会在主线程上安排一次新的执行。

这对只运行一次的脚本里的延迟动作很有用。

en_us.text:
This action copies a file or folder in the game directory, which starts at the root of the Minecraft instance directory. This action is limited to work only inside the game directory for safety reasons.

It is also possible to access the default '.minecraft' directory with this action. For that, just start paths with the '.minecraft/' prefix.

Append '*' to the end of the source path to copy every file directly inside that folder. This wildcard ignores sub-directories and requires the destination to be a directory.

zh_cn.text:
这个动作会在游戏目录中复制一个文件或文件夹，游戏目录从 Minecraft 实例目录的根目录开始。出于安全原因，这个动作只能在游戏目录内部使用。

这个动作也可以访问默认的 ".minecraft" 目录。只要把路径以 ".minecraft/" 前缀开头就行。

在源路径末尾追加 '*'，可以复制该文件夹内直接包含的所有文件。这个通配符会忽略子目录，并要求目标位置必须是一个目录。

It is also possible to access the default '.minecraft' directory with this action. For that, just start paths with the '.minecraft/' prefix.
