en_us.text: Conjure a stationary shield of arcane energy where you look that will block projectiles and prevent creatures from passing.

zh_cn.text: 在你注视的位置召唤一道无法移动的魔法盾牌，阻挡投射物和生物通过。

en_us.text: Recast to place anchor points, which erupts into a wall of fire when the cast finishes, or when the maximum length is reached. This wall blocks projectiles and ignites creatures that pass through it.

zh_cn.text: 按住以选择火墙路径，完成时火焰将从所选路径升起。达到最大距离或提前取消施法可立即召唤火墙。火墙可以阻挡投射物，并点燃穿过它的生物。

en_us.text: Conjure a projectile of holy energy that will float towards nearby targets and deal damage upon impact.

zh_cn.text: 召唤一枚圣光能量弹，飘向附近目标并在击中时造成伤害。

en_us.text: Funnel the power of the heavens into a beam of holy energy from above, smiting targets in an area.

zh_cn.text: 将天堂之力汇聚成光束，从天空射向目标区域。

en_us.text: Conjure a line of evoker fangs in front of you, in classic illager fashion.

zh_cn.text: 在你面前召唤一排唤魔者尖牙，经典的唤魔者风格。

en_us.text: Conjure protective rings of evoker fangs around you, in classic illager fashion.

zh_cn.text: 在你周围召唤唤魔者尖牙的保护圈，经典的唤魔者风格。

en_us.text: Target a creature or block to conjure a spiraling zone of evoker fangs in a radius.

zh_cn.text: 选中目标生物或方块，召唤一个以其为中心在一定半径内螺旋生成一列唤魔者尖牙的区域。

en_us.text: Cast to imbue yourself with ender energy. Upon being attacked while under its effects, you will immediately teleport within a short radius and avoid taking any damage. Only a finite amount of hits can be dodged before the effect immediately wears off.

zh_cn.text: 施放后注入末影能量。受到攻击时，你会立即瞬移到短半径范围内，躲避伤害。只能躲避有限次数的攻击，之后效果消失。

en_us.text: Cast to inflict yourself with Heartstop, an effect that makes you temporarily invulnerable. However, once it wears off, you take 50% of all damage accumulated while under its effects.

zh_cn.text: 施放后获得“止心术”效果，暂时无敌。效果结束后，你将受到效果期间累积总伤害的 50%。

en_us.text: Hold to charge a spear made of lightning. Release to throw it like a javelin, dealing high damage to the creature it hits.

zh_cn.text: 按住为闪电长枪充能。释放时投掷，对击中的生物造成高额伤害。

en_us.text: Down from the heavens, summon a bolt of lightning.

zh_cn.text: 从天而降，召唤一道闪电。

en_us.text: Cast to summon undead minions from the earth beneath you. The higher the power, the better equipment they will have.

zh_cn.text: 施放后从脚下召唤亡灵随从。法术强度越高，它们的装备越好。

en_us.text: Launch a wither skull forward that explodes in a small radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.

zh_cn.text: 向前发射凋灵骷髅的头颅，在撞击位置周围造成小范围爆炸。法术等级越高，射速越快。

en_us.text: A more powerful but much slower version of heal, this spell will completely heal yourself upon being casted.

zh_cn.text: 更强大但更缓慢的治疗术，施放后完全治愈自己。

en_us.text: Hold to slowly heal friendly creatures within a radius around you.

zh_cn.text: 按住以缓慢治疗周围一定半径内的友方生物。

en_us.text: Hold to cast a ray of necrotic energy that siphons health from creatures it hits, damaging them and healing you for 100% of damage done.

zh_cn.text: 按住以射出一束亡灵能量，从击中的生物身上汲取生命值，对其造成伤害并以100%的造成伤害量治疗你。

en_us.text: Hold to charge a piercing arrow made of arcane energy. This arrow has no gravity and can travel through blocks.

zh_cn.text: 按住以充能一支奥术能量构成的穿刺箭。不受重力影响，可以穿透方块和盾牌。

en_us.text: Lob the head of a creeper forward that explodes in a medium radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.

zh_cn.text: 向前发射苦力怕的头，撞击后在中等半径范围内爆炸。等级越高，射速越快。

en_us.text: The creeper tryna steal my stuff again

zh_cn.text: 苦力怕又想偷我的东西了。

en_us.text: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a ring of creeper heads that falls to the ground and explodes. Any creature killed by this blast will conjure another, smaller, ring of creeper heads. This can chain multiple times.

zh_cn.text: 在目标生物或方块周围召唤一圈苦力怕的头，掉落在地上并爆炸。被爆炸炸死的生物会召唤另一个更小的苦力怕的头，效果可以连锁多次。

en_us.text: Teleport to where you are looking, leaving behind a shadow of ice. This shadow will take nearby aggro, and shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.

zh_cn.text: 传送到你注视的位置，留下一个冰雕。冰雕会吸引附近敌对生物的仇恨，并在5秒后或受到伤害时碎裂成冰柱。

en_us.text: Cloak yourself with the shadows of the abyss, granting the ability to evade any attack for a short duration of time.

zh_cn.text: 用深渊的阴影庇护自己，短时间内躲避任何攻击。

en_us.text: Hold to unleash a barrage of blaze fireballs, shooting rapidly but wildly in front of you and igniting any creatures or blocks hit.

zh_cn.text: 按住释放一连串炽热火球，快速但狂乱地射向前方，点燃击中的生物或方块。

en_us.text: Cast to strike lightning at your feet and ascend quickly into the air, and gain reduced gravity for a short duration. The lightning bolt deals damage and knocks back creatures struck.

zh_cn.text: 施放后在脚下产生闪电并迅速升空，短时间内获得重力减免效果。闪电造成伤害并击退生物。

en_us.text: Cast to briefly grant yourself true invisibility, which hides armor and held items, but immediately wears off upon dealing damage. Mobs also lose aggro.

zh_cn.text: 施放后短暂地获得真实隐形效果，隐藏盔甲和持有的物品，但在造成伤害后立即消失。怪物也会丢失仇恨。

en_us.text: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, or directly behind any targeted creature. Gain a short duration of true invisibility upon reaching your destination.

zh_cn.text: 瞬间传送到你注视的位置，或目标生物的正后方。到达目的地后获得短暂的真实隐形效果。

en_us.text: Cast to summon a polar bear who will follow, protect, and fight for you, as well as providing a mount.

zh_cn.text: 召唤一只北极熊，它将跟随、保护你，为你战斗，也可以作为坐骑。

en_us.text: Cast to target any creature, showing a glowing outline. Completing the cast will heal this creature.

zh_cn.text: 对目标生物施放，会显示发光轮廓。完成施法后将治愈该生物。

en_us.text: Hold to spew a cone of dragon breath forwards. Each time a creature is hit, there is a chance to create a pool of dragon breath at their feet.

zh_cn.text: 按住向前方喷出锥形龙息。每次生物被击中时，有几率在其脚下形成龙息池。

en_us.text: Upon casting, fortify every friendly creature within a radius around you, giving them temporary HP.

zh_cn.text: 施放后，强化你周围半径内的所有友方生物，给予它们临时生命值。

en_us.text: Cast to interrupt any targeted magical process, such as a casting creature or a magical projectile.

zh_cn.text: 用于中断目标施法或魔法效果。

en_us.text: Imbue yourself with the power of lightning, increasing your speed and combat abilities.

zh_cn.text: 召唤雷霆之力充满自身，持续时间内提高移动速度和战斗能力。

en_us.text: From where you look, erupt a mass of void energy in the form of wailing tentacles, damaging and blinding creatures caught in the chaos.

zh_cn.text: 在你注视之处撕开虚空裂隙，召唤出触手，持续伤害和致盲陷入其中的生物。

en_us.text: From where you look, erupt a mass of sculk energy in the form of wailing tentacles, damaging and blinding creatures caught in the chaos.

zh_cn.text: 在你注视之处喷发幽匿能量，化为哀嚎的触手，伤害并致盲陷入混乱中的生物。

en_us.text: Conjure a giant chunk of ice above a targeted creature or block. After a short delay, it will fall down and explode for area frost damage, doing additional damage to any creatures hit on the way down.

zh_cn.text: 在目标生物或方块上方召唤一大块冰块。短暂延迟后冰块掉落并爆炸，造成范围霜冻伤害，掉落途中也会对击中的生物造成额外伤害。

en_us.text: Spew forth a cone of poison, damaging and poisoning creatures in its reach

zh_cn.text: 喷射出一道毒雾锥体，伤害并使命中的生物中毒。

en_us.text: Charge a powerful arrow, imbued with poison magic, that will release a poisonous cloud upon impact

zh_cn.text: 充能一支注入毒药魔法的箭矢，撞击时释放一片毒云。

en_us.text: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a wave of poisonous magic that splashes down, damaging creatures hit and leaving behind a poisonous cloud

zh_cn.text: 在目标生物或方块周围，召唤一波毒性魔法，溅落并对击中的生物造成伤害，留下毒云。

en_us.text: Spit an orb of acid, splashing in a radius upon impact and rending creatures hit, melting away and reducing their armor

zh_cn.text: 吐出一团强酸，落地后炸开，对一定半径内的敌人造成伤害，并融化它们的盔甲，减少护甲值。

en_us.text: Instill yourself with poisonous magic, dealing additional melee, ranged, or spell damage creatures that are poisoned

zh_cn.text: 向自身注入剧毒之力，持续时间内获得额外的剧毒伤害加成。

en_us.text: Target a creature to blight them, reducing their incoming healing and outgoing damage

zh_cn.text: 对你瞄准的生物施放枯萎之力，减少其受到的治疗和造成的伤害。

en_us.text: Around a targeted location, create a fissure into the void, manifesting a black hole that will suck in nearby creatures and slowly crush them to death

zh_cn.text: 召唤一个黑洞，将周围除你以外的实体吸入并碾碎。

en_us.text: Around a targeted creature, sprout magical roots than entangle them and completely prevent non-magical movement

zh_cn.text: 在目标生物周围生长出魔法根须，使其无法进行非魔法效果的移动。

en_us.text: Create a ring of needles made from blood and fire them forward, skewering targets and healing you for 25% of damage done

zh_cn.text: 引导猩红魔法，凝聚成猩红之针向前发射，命中生物后造成伤害，并为你恢复相当于所造成伤害的25%的生命值。

en_us.text: Around a targeted creature, create a field of blood needles in every direction, shooting down and healing you for 25% of damage done

zh_cn.text: 引导猩红魔法，凝聚成猩红之针围绕目标，随后刺穿目标，并为你恢复相当于所造成伤害的25%的生命值。

en_us.text: Launch a bomb made from magma, exploding on impact and leaving a field of fire where it lands

zh_cn.text: 发射一枚岩浆炸弹，落地爆炸并留下灼烧区域。

en_us.text: Target a single area and continuously rain down arcane comets from above for the duration of the spell

zh_cn.text: 选中目标区域，在法术持续时间内持续落下奥术彗星，伤害区域内的所有生物。

en_us.text: Around a targeted creature or block, place a stationary circle of holy magic that heals allies within

zh_cn.text: 在目标或区域周围召唤一个神圣之环，持续为区域内的盟友恢复生命值。

en_us.text: Fire a slow bolt of holy energy. Creatures hit will gain the Guided effect, homing nearby projectiles in towards them

zh_cn.text: 发射一道缓慢的神圣光球，使被击中的生物获得“神圣指引”效果，附近的投射物会被引导向其方向。

en_us.text: Conjure a strong gust of wind, knocking back creatures in a conical shape, causing damage if they impact a wall

zh_cn.text: 召唤一阵强风击退前方生物，撞到方块会受到伤害。

en_us.text: Start a chain of lightning from a targeted creature, causing waves of zapping magic to cascade to nearby creatures

zh_cn.text: 从目标生物身上发射一道闪电链，在附近的生物之间跳跃。

en_us.text: Pull in a nearby creature and attack them with a bite, leeching 15% of damage done as health. If the creature is killed, you temporarily gain additional max HP. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Yorhavich.

zh_cn.text: 将周围的一名实体拉到你身边并啃咬，恢复相当于所造成伤害的15%的生命值。如果击杀该实体，则获得临时最大生命值。此法术由远古魔法师Yorhavich创造。

en_us.text: Emanate a swarm of violent fireflies, following a targeted creature and dealing aoe damage. If the initial target dies, the last harmed creature will be targeted.

zh_cn.text: 施放一群凶猛的萤火虫，跟踪目标生物并造成范围伤害。如果最初的目标死亡，将以最后受伤的生物为目标。

en_us.text: The great power of oak infuses itself into your skin, granting damage reduction of any incoming damage for a duration.

zh_cn.text: 橡树的力量融入你的皮肤，一段时间内减少受到的所有伤害。

en_us.text: Conjure an earthquake around a targeted creature or location, causing tremors to ripple through the ground, damaging and slowing creatures in the area.

zh_cn.text: 在目标生物或位置周围召唤地震，使地面震动，伤害并减慢区域内的生物。

en_us.text: Apparate your Ender Chest inventory upon casting.
Fire a beam of cold energy, dealing low damage but immediately applying freeze to the creature hit.

zh_cn.text: 发射一束寒冷能量，造成低伤害并立即冻结被击中的生物。

en_us.text: Blast forth a sonic boom of immense power, passing through solid material and harming all creatures in its path.

zh_cn.text: 施放一记威力巨大的音爆，穿透固体方块，对路径上的生物造成伤害。

en_us.text: Shift your vision in between planes, gaining the ability to see creatures through solid material.

zh_cn.text: 在不同位面之间转换视界，透视固体物质看到生物。

en_us.text: Reach out with a spectral force and grip a creature, forcing them towards your gaze. Creatures are susceptible to kinetic damage.

zh_cn.text: 用幽灵之力抓住生物，将其牵引至你的凝视之处。生物易受动能伤害。

en_us.text: With a fervor of holy energy, swing forth your weapon, doing a melee area attack. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

zh_cn.text: 借助神圣能量挥动武器进行近战攻击，不可被打断。伤害取决于手持武器的近战伤害。

en_us.text: Teleport a short distance forward, creating a wake of lightning that damages creatures you teleport through.

zh_cn.text: 向前短距离传送，产生一道雷霆尾迹，对传送过的生物造成伤害。

en_us.text: Creates two portals that allows players to travel back and forth between them.

zh_cn.text: 创造两个传送门，允许实体在它们之间穿梭。

en_us.text: To a targeted creature, or yourself if no creature is targeted, apply the Hastened effect, increasing movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction for a duration.

zh_cn.text: 对目标生物或自己施加急速效果，提高移动速度、攻击速度、挖掘速度，并减少施法时间。

en_us.text: Apply the Slowed effect to a targeted creature, decreasing its movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction for a duration.

zh_cn.text: 对目标生物施加迟缓效果，降低移动速度、攻击速度、挖掘速度，并增加施法时间。

en_us.text: Cascade a wave of frost magic in a radius around you, afflicting creatures with chilled. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.

zh_cn.text: 向你周围一定范围内释放冰霜魔法，使生物受到冰冻效果的影响。被冰冻的生物在完全冻结后会被冰封。

en_us.text: Emanate a surge of fiery magic, igniting and rending creatures in a radius around you. Rended creatures have reduced armor.

zh_cn.text: 释放一股炽热魔法，点燃并撕扯你周围的生物。被撕扯的生物护甲降低。

en_us.text: Around a targeted creature or block, summon a rolling wave of magical arrows from the sky.

zh_cn.text: 在目标生物或方块周围，召唤大量魔法箭从天空射下。

en_us.text: Warps you back to your spawn location, or world spawn if there is none.

zh_cn.text: 将你传送回重生点，如果没有重生点则传送回世界出生点。

en_us.text: Fire rays of pure, devastating energy.

zh_cn.text: 发射出纯粹的、带有毁灭性能量的邪术冲击波。

en_us.text: With a magic force, stomp the ground in front of you and send a short tremor forward through the ground, damaging creatures in its path.

zh_cn.text: 用魔法力量踩踏地面，向前发送一个短暂的地震波，对其路径上的生物造成伤害。

en_us.text: Turn your stomach into an arcane furnace, turning eaten food into mana for a duration.

zh_cn.text: 将你的胃变成奥术熔炉，在效果持续时间内将吃下的食物转化为法力值。

en_us.text: Unleash a sweeping melee attack in the form of a wreath of flames. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

zh_cn.text: 以火焰环的形式施展横扫近战攻击，伤害基于手持武器的近战伤害和附魔效果。该法术的吟唱不会被打断。

en_us.text: Coalesce a surge of electrical power, and unleash it in a devastating shockwave, blasting exposed creatures.

zh_cn.text: 凝聚电力能量，并以毁灭性的震荡波施放出来，对范围内的生物造成爆炸性伤害。

en_us.text: Non-magical attacks will create an echo, producing a spectral sword to slam down in an area, or a piercing magical arrow to shoot the same target. Echoes do a percent of the original attack's damage.

zh_cn.text: 非魔法攻击会留下末影能量的回响，随后形成一把打击一定范围的幽冥剑或一根射向相同目标的魔法箭矢。回响造成的伤害等于一定百分比的该非魔法攻击伤害。
Wololo是《帝国时代》中的一个著名声音效果，通常由僧侣间谍在转换策反敌人单位时发出。这个词本身并没有特定的含义，用来表示僧侣施展转换技能的声音。

en_us.text: In a targeted area, erupt a scorch of fiery magic, damaging creatures in the zone and leaving a field of fire.

zh_cn.text: 在指定区域爆发炽热火焰魔法，对区域内的生物造成伤害并吸引它们。

en_us.text: Cast to conjure a thunderstorm centered around yourself, which strikes nearby creatures within sight with a small bolt of lightning every 2 seconds for the spell's duration.

zh_cn.text: 施法召唤以自身为中心的雷暴，持续时间内每隔2秒对视野内的附近生物施放一道小型闪电。

en_us.text: Repeatedly cast to shoot individual small fireballs, which home towards your cursor, or the creature your cursor is targeting.

zh_cn.text: 重复施法以一颗一颗地召唤小型火球，它们会追踪你的十字准星，或者十字准星所指向的生物。

en_us.text: Conjure an orb of lightning that slowly moves forward, damaging creatures it phases through and bouncing off blocks.

zh_cn.text: 召唤一颗缓慢向前移动的闪电球，伤害穿过的生物并在碰到方块时反弹。

en_us.text: Target one of your magic summons to cause them to explode, killing them instantly, and dealing large damage in the area around them. The summon's remaining health boosts the damage dealt and radius of explosion.

zh_cn.text: 将此法术施放至你的魔法召唤物上使其自爆，召唤物会立即消失并在周围区域造成巨大伤害。召唤物剩余的生命值会增加造成的伤害和爆炸范围。

en_us.text: Pray to a divine magic to cleanse yourself and nearby allies of harmful status effects.

zh_cn.text: 向神圣魔法祈祷，净化自己和附近玩家的有害状态效果。

en_us.text: Unleash a cascading line of ice magic, creating ice crystals that emerge from the ground. The final spike does full damage, and will emerge early if a creature within range is targeted.

zh_cn.text: 施放一连串冰霜魔法，生成从地面冒出的冰晶。最后一个冰晶造成全额伤害，如果范围内有生物目标，它会提前出现。

en_us.text: Aim an arrow made of fiery magic that will deal direct damage on impact and explode for half damage in a small radius around it. It flies straight for a duration before gravity affects it.

zh_cn.text: 凝聚炽焰魔法发射爆炎箭，击中时直接造成伤害，并制造造成一半伤害的小范围爆炸，爆炎箭会受到重力影响。

en_us.text: Slam down your weapon to wreath a fiery shockwave in a large radius around you. Damage scales based on the held weapon.

zh_cn.text: 使用武器猛击地面，在以你为中心的大范围内产生炽焰冲击波，伤害根据持有的武器提升。

en_us.text: Conjure a trio of spectral armaments to aid in battle: a brawling shortsword, a quick rapier, and a tanking claymore. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Hazentouvel.

zh_cn.text: 召唤三把魔法剑来辅助战斗：阔剑、刺剑和双刃剑。此法术由远古魔法师Hazentouvel。

en_us.text: Use magic to break a block. Held items affect drops.

zh_cn.text: 在旋转攻击中向前跳跃，在你击中的第一个生物或方块上造成伤害，并在周围一小块区域造成爆炸。

zh_cn.text: 向前猛冲，挥出一道弧形奥术能量斩击，伤害一定范围内的生物。被斩击击中的弹射物会发生偏转，斩击伤害基于所持武器的近战伤害和附魔效果。

en_us.text: Cast to throw your held item, dealing a base damage plus damage normally inflicted by the item.

zh_cn.text: 在目标位置引导一场快速旋转同时缓慢移动的暴风雪，让冰冷的风雪把生物拖拽至漩涡中心。

en_us.text: 1.16 only. **A key optimization.** Patches JEI to perform its reloading on a background thread, completely eliminating the long delay it adds to world loading.

zh_cn.text: 仅1.16。§l一项关键优化。§r对JEI进行了调整，让其于后台线程上重载，完全消除了它在载入世界时造成的巨大延迟。

en_us.text: 1.16 only. Backports the Async Locator mod's patches to eliminate server freezes associated with `/locate`, loot table generation, etc.

zh_cn.text: 仅1.16。向后移植了Async Locator模组的补丁，以消除与§b/locate§r、战利品表生成等相关事物的服务端冻结现象。

en_us.text: 1.16 only. Minor optimization to improve the performance of the biome zoomer using logic from 1.18.

zh_cn.text: 仅1.16。使用1.18版本的逻辑进行微优化，以提高生物群系缩放器（注：用于巨型生物群系）的性能。

en_us.text: All versions. If REI or JEI are installed, construction of the vanilla search trees for creative searching is disabled, and searching is instead done using these mods' search implementations. This saves several seconds during world loading, and probably also saves some RAM as well (although I have not measured).

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。原版会构造用于创造模式搜索功能的搜索树，如果安装了REI或者JEI，将禁用原版构造，用这两种模组中的搜索实现取而代之。这在加载世界时会节省几秒钟，并且可能（虽然我没有测试）会减少一点内存占用。

en_us.text: 1.16 only. Removes the hardcoded cap on worker thread count, similarly to what Mojang did in 1.18.

zh_cn.text: 仅1.16。移除被硬编码的工作线程数量上限，类似于Mojang在1.18中所做的。

en_us.text: All versions. Avoids creating fresh copies of enum arrays each time a blockstate cache is initialized. Minor optimization, but easy to do.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。避免每次初始化方块状态缓存时都创建枚举数组的新副本。只是微优化，但它很容易做到（注：所以顺手做了）。

en_us.text: All versions. Memoizes the `RenderMaterial` (texture) collection and dependency list that models return instead of requiring them to be recalculated on each request. Helps accelerate the model load/bake process.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。模型会返回§bRenderMaterial§r（纹理）的集合和依赖项列表，现在游戏会记忆它们，而不是要求它们在每次请求中都重新计算一次。这有助于加速模型加载/烘焙的进程。

en_us.text: All versions. Saves the generated list of stronghold positions with the world, instead of regenerating it on every world load. Saves a little bit of time on 1.16, and quite a bit more on 1.18 and 1.19.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。将生成的要塞位置列表与世界一起保存，免得每次加载世界时都重新生成。在1.16版本中可以减少一点世界加载时间，在1.18和1.19中减少的会多得多。

en_us.text: All versions. Many mods ship outdated structure files, which requires the game to upgrade them using DFU every single time they are loaded. This can be quite slow. This patch adds logic to instead save the upgraded version of the structure, and reuse it on the next load. To handle the case that the mod changes a structure file but not the name, the original file's hash is compared against the cached version, and if they do not match the structure will be upgraded again.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。许多模组的结构文件已经过时，这就要求游戏在每次加载它们时都要用DFU来升级它们。这个升级过程可能会很慢。此补丁添加了一些逻辑，保存结构的升级版本，并在下次加载时直接重用它们。为了处理模组改变了结构文件但没有改变名称的情况，原始文件的哈希值将与被缓存的版本进行比较，若不匹配，该结构将被再次升级。

en_us.text: 1.16 only. Minor optimization borrowed from Hydrogen, which attempts to save space in the biome container when possible. This gets disabled automatically if conflicting mods like BetterEnd or Chocolate are installed.

zh_cn.text: 仅1.16。微优化，借鉴了氢（Hydrogen）模组，试图尽可能节省生物群系容器的空间。如果安装了更好的末地或Chocolate Fix等与此功能冲突的模组，此功能会自动禁用。

en_us.text: All versions. Reduces log spam and possibly slightly improves loading speed by not printing the stacktraces for some commonly thrown exceptions during datapack reload (e.g. missing items in loot tables/recipes). The message is still printed.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。数据包重载过程中不再打印一些常见异常（如战利品表/配方中的物品丢失）的堆栈跟踪，减少日志刷屏，且可能稍微提高了启动速度。只是不打印堆栈，一条异常消息依然会被打印出来。

en_us.text: All versions. Moves resource pack and data pack reloading to a dedicated worker pool instead of using the default `Worker-Main` threads. This allows mods to Smooth Boot to still potentially improve singleplayer performance at runtime while not slowing down launch due to a limited thread count.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。将资源包和数据包的重载任务转移到一个专门的工作线程上，而不是使用默认的主工作线程。这让流畅加载（Smooth Boot）模组在运行时仍然可能提高单人游戏的性能，同时不会因为线程数量限制减慢启动速度。

en_us.text: All versions, but disabled by default due to load time impact. Deduplicates resource location namespaces and paths. This saves RAM but also increases the cost of constructing a new `ResourceLocation` by quite a bit.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有，但由于会影响加载时间，默认禁用。对资源位置的命名空间和路径进行去重。这节省了内存，但也大大增加了新资源位置的构造成本。

en_us.text:
All versions. Modifies DFU initialization to happen the first time something needs to be upgraded. This sounds similar to LazyDFU but is distinctly implemented, as it avoids loading *any* DFU classes/data structures, while LazyDFU only disables rule optimization. Essentially, this option is a safer version of DataFixerSlayer as it will still load DFU when needed.

You should typically continue to use LazyDFU even with this option enabled, as otherwise DFU rule optimization will cause lag.

zh_cn.text:
全版本共有。修改了DFU的初始化，使其仅在第一次需要升级数据时加载。这听起来类似DFU载入优化，但实现方式截然不同，因为它能避免加载§o任何§rDFU类/数据结构，而DFU载入优化只是禁用其规则优化。本质上说，这是一个DataFixerSlayer的安全版本，因为它仍然会在需要时加载DFU。

即使启用了这个选项，你也应该继续使用DFU载入优化，否则DFU规则优化依然会导致卡顿。
全版本共有。详见https://github.com/Kasualix/ModernFix/wiki/动态资源加载---常见问题解答。

en_us.text: All versions. Allows the game to unload sounds, instead of sounds indefinitely persisting after being loaded.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。允许游戏卸载声音，而不是在加载声音后无限期地保留它们。

en_us.text: All versions. Allows the game to unload structure files after generation concludes instead of keeping them loaded forever.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。允许游戏在结构生成结束后卸载结构文件，而非让它们永远处于已加载状态。

en_us.text: All versions. Forge needlessly looks up a method via reflection every single time a registry is validated. This patch simply caches the returned value since it will be the same every time.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。每次验证注册时，Forge都会通过反射来查找一个方法，这完全没必要。这个补丁简单地缓存了方法的返回值，因为它每次都是一样的。

en_us.text: All versions. Optimizes the font renderer to load fonts faster, speeding up resource reload.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。优化字体渲染器，以更快地加载字体，加快资源重载速度。

en_us.text:
All versions. Avoids rendering the sides of items in GUIs. (Yes, vanilla appears to do that.)

This can triple FPS with a mod like REI/JEI installed on weaker GPUs, if enough items are visible. Disabled by default since it's new and not tested much, but should be safe. The most likely issue is items being completely invisible in GUIs, or appearing flat in the world.

zh_cn.text:
全版本共有。避免在GUI中渲染物品的侧面。（是的，原版似乎就是这样做的。）

如果你的显卡比较差，又安装了REI/JEI这类模组，且GUI中显示了有够多的物品，此功能甚至可以使FPS增加2倍。由于此优化刚刚诞生，没有经过很多测试，所以默认情况下是禁用的，但应该能安全使用。最有可能出现的问题是物品在GUI中完全不可见，或者在世界中显示为平面。

en_us.text: All versions pre 1.19.4. Avoids reading textures twice (the first time using a very slow code path) and instead does one faster load (similar to 1.19.3+).

zh_cn.text: 所有1.19.4之前的版本。避免读取两次纹理资源（第一次读取使用的是非常慢的代码路径），仅使用更快的第二次读取逻辑（类似于1.19.3+）。

en_us.text: All versions. Enables the game to use a faster texture stitching system originally written by SuperCoder79 for lwjgl3ify on 1.7.10, which can save some time during loading. Rarely, it's been reported to cause weird artifacts on blocks or in GUIs, this may be a Sodium bug.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。使游戏能够使用一个效率更高的纹理拼接系统，该系统最初由SuperCoder79在1.7.10上为lwjgl3ify编写，此项可以减少一点加载时间。偶尔，有人报告说这会在方块或GUI上引起奇怪的显示假象，这可能是钠（Sodium）模组的程序错误。

en_us.text: 1.16 only. Optimizes Just Enough Resources to not needlessly recreate villager entities many times for the same profession, which saves time during JEI startup.

zh_cn.text: 仅1.16。优化了JER（Just Enough Resources），让其不需要为同一职业多次创建村民实体，这在JEI启动时可以节省时间。

en_us.text: 1.16 only. Optimizations to KubeJS to avoid needless `ItemStack` copying, etc., which reduces the time taken to load datapacks.

zh_cn.text: 仅1.16。对KubeJS进行了优化，以避免不必要的§bItemStack§r复制等，减少了数据包加载时间。

en_us.text: All versions. Implements optimizations to speed up the model loading process.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。通过优化以加快模型加载过程。

en_us.text: All versions. Uses a more efficient backing map for compound NBT tags that deduplicates key names and also uses an array map for very small compounds. This reduces the overhead of storing many compound tags in memory.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。对复合NBT标签使用一个更加高效的支持映射（backing map），从而消除重复键名，对小型复合 NBT 也使用数组映射。这减少了在内存中存储许多复合NBT标签的开销。

en_us.text: 1.16 only, inspired by Hydrogen. Avoids storing chunk sections that are full of air in memory, instead marking them as empty.

zh_cn.text: 仅1.16。灵感来自氢（Hydrogen）模组。将存储充满空气的区块部分标记为空（empty），避免在内存中存储它们。

en_us.text:
All versions. **A key optimization.** Newer Minecraft versions (after 1.12) implemented a blockstate cache system that caches frequently used information about a blockstate, such as whether it is solid, its collision shape, etc. Rebuilding this cache is quite fast in vanilla (it takes only a second or two) but is quite slow with many mods installed, as there are many more blockstates present in the game which all must have their caches rebuilt.

This problem is exacerbated by Forge as the cache is rebuilt at many points when the data would almost certainly be unused before the next rebuild. Examples include right before reaching the main menu (during the "Freezing data" stage), as well as multiple (!) times when a world is being loaded.

ModernFix solves this performance bottleneck by instead making cache rebuilds lazy. Each blockstate rebuilds its cache the first time the data would be accessed. At any point when vanilla or Forge would attempt to rebuild caches for all blockstates, this is redirected to simply invalidate the cache on each blockstate instead.

This should not have any impact on TPS after startup concludes.

zh_cn.text:
全版本共有。§l一项关键优化。§r较新的Minecraft（1.12以上）实现了一个方块状态缓存系统，它可以缓存方块状态的常用信息，譬如其是否为固体方块，它的碰撞箱形状等等。原版中重建此缓存非常快（只要一两秒钟），但在安装了许多模组后就相当慢了，因为游戏中多了很多其它的方块状态，它们的缓存都需要被其重建。

在Forge的影响下，这个问题变得更加严重，因为缓存会在很多地方重建，但这些数据在下一次重建前几乎肯定不会被用到。至于在哪儿，比如，在到达主菜单之前（在“Freezing data”阶段），以及在加载世界时（会出现很多次！）。

通过让缓存重建转为惰性，现代化修复解决了这个性能瓶颈问题。每个方块状态在第一次访问数据时都会重建其缓存。无论何时，原版或Forge试图重建所有方块状态缓存的行为都会被重定向，变成简单地使每个方块状态的缓存失效。

此项优化应该不会对启动后的TPS产生任何影响。

en_us.text: All versions. Removes the biome temperature cache as Lithium does on modern versions.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。移除生物群系温度缓存，以减少内存占用，就像新版本的锂所做的那样。

en_us.text:
All versions. **A key optimization.** Launches on modern versions are heavily bottlenecked by filesystem access. Many requests are frequently made to resource packs to list resources or check if a given resource exists, and each of these result in a very slow file API call.

ModernFix completely eliminates most of the bottleneck here by simply caching a listing of all resources that exist within mod-provided and vanilla resourcepacks. The cache is rebuilt on resource reload (except for the vanilla resources, since they should never change while the game is running).

There are no known compatibility issues with this patch except for OptiFine (its CTM resources do not load correctly). However I do not recommend using OptiFine in any scenario, as it adds several minutes to launch time by itself and is not tested with ModernFix at all.

zh_cn.text:
全版本共有。§l一项关键优化。§r高版本的启动严重受到文件系统访问的瓶颈限制。资源包经常接受到很多请求，要列出资源或检查一项给定的资源是否存在，而每次请求都会调用一个效率极低的文件API。

现代化修复通过简单地缓存模组和原版提供的所有资源的列表，完全消除了此处的大部分瓶颈。缓存在资源重载时会进行重建（除了原版资源，因为它们在游戏运行时不应改变）。

高清修复不能正确加载它的连接纹理（CTM）资源，除此之外此补丁没有已知的兼容问题。不过，我不建议在任何情况下使用高清修复，因为它本身就会增加几分钟的启动时间，而且根本没有与现代化修复进行过任何测试。

en_us.text: 1.16 only. Attempts to speed up switching between singleplayer worlds by skipping the datapack reload when possible. May cause compatibility issues with some mods, but is currently enabled by default.

zh_cn.text: 仅1.16。试图尽可能跳过数据包重载，来加快单人世界切换/重进时的速度。可能会导致一些模组的兼容性问题，但目前默认启用。

en_us.text: All versions. **Currently semi-broken.** Aggressively replaces some internals of the Forge registry system with faster versions, however it currently causes freezes when loading some modpacks. Off by default for obvious reasons.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。§l目前处于半残状态。§r非常暴力地使用更快地版本替换了Forge注册系统的一些内部结构，但目前在加载一些整合包时会导致冻结。默认关闭，原因显而易见。

en_us.text:
1.16 & 1.19 only. **A key optimization.**

In the middle of the 1.16 development cycle, Forge patched the game to reload datapacks twice when loading an existing world, in order to fix an issue with biome ID shifting. Unfortunately, datapack reloads often take upwards of 30 seconds and so this very severely affects world loading times.

ModernFix makes the necessary changes to avoid this reload, based on the unfinished Forge PR #8163.

This change was removed by Forge in 1.18, but then a similar patch was added *again* in 1.19 to fix mod datapacks not being loaded when creating new singleplayer worlds. Fortunately, the issue is localized to the world creation screen in 1.19, and existing worlds only require a single reload. However, this still doubles the length of the lag spike when clicking "Create New World" in 1.19, and so ModernFix again makes changes to not perform a redundant reload.

zh_cn.text:
仅1.16&1.19。§l一项关键优化。§r

在1.16开发周期的中期，Forge对游戏打了补丁，在加载现有世界时重载两次数据包，来解决生物群系ID转移的问题。不幸地是，数据包重载往往需要30秒以上的时间，所以这非常严重地影响了世界加载时间。

基于未完成的Forge PR#8163，现代化修复做了必要的修改来避免这种重载。

Forge在1.18版本删除了此改动，但随后在1.19版本中§o又再次§r添加了一个类似补丁，来修复新建单人世界时无法加载模组数据包的问题。幸运的是，在1.19版本中此问题仅限于世界创建屏幕，现有的世界只需要重载一次。然而，在1.19版本中点击“创建新世界”时，这依然使卡顿峰值的长度翻倍，因此现代化修复再次做出修改，不执行多余的重载。

en_us.text: All versions. Enabled only if FerriteCore is installed. Takes advantage of FerriteCore's handling of blockstates to speed up their creation. This can help speed up launch with mods that add lots of blockstates, such as furniture mods.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。只在安装铁氧体磁芯时启用。利用铁氧体磁芯处理方块状态，加快方块状态的创建速度。在你安装了添加大量方块状态的模组（例如家具模组）时，此项优化有助于加快启动速度。

en_us.text: All versions. Avoids having the main thread spin idly consuming one CPU core while waiting for the modloading workers to finish.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。主线程在等待模组加载工作线程结束时，不再占着一个CPU核心在那空转。

en_us.text: All versions. Adjusts the worker and server thread priorities to be lower than the client thread. This helps improve FPS stability on machines with few CPU cores, provided that the Java implementation in use respects priorities.

zh_cn.text: 全版本共有。调整工作线程和服务端线程的优先级，使其低于客户端线程。这有助于使CPU核心较少的电脑FPS更稳定，只要其使用的Java实现能尊重优先级。

en_us.text: Mostly for 1.16. Patches JEResources to use the integrated server's loot table data if playing singleplayer, rather than pointlessly reloading loot tables. Saves a couple more seconds during JEI startup.

zh_cn.text: 主要针对1.16版本。为JER（Just Enough Resources）打补丁，使其在单人游戏中直接使用内置服务端的战利品表数据，而不是无意义地重载战利品表。可以减少几秒钟的JEI启动时间。

en_us.text: The patches in this group fix concurrency-related issues within Minecraft and/or Forge. Most of them result in rare, hard-to-diagnose crashes during loading.

zh_cn.text: 这组补丁修复了MC和/或Forge中的一些并发问题。其中大部分问题都会导致在加载过程中出现罕见的、难以诊断的崩溃。

en_us.text: This option is a port of SuperCoder's Chunk Saving Fix mod (because I didn't realize it was already available for Forge at the time).

zh_cn.text: 此项是SuperCoder的区块保存修复（Chunk Saving Fix）模组的移植（因为我当时没发现它其实有Forge版本）。

en_us.text: This option fixes a deadlock that can occur if an exception is thrown while processing entity data. Vanilla does not correctly unlock the data manager when it should. This is tracked as MC-218112 on the bug tracker, and was fixed by Mojang in 1.17.

zh_cn.text: 在处理实体数据时抛出异常可能导致死锁，此项修复了这个问题。原版在应该解锁数据管理器的时候却不能正常解锁。问题追踪器链接：MC-218112，由Mojang在1.17中修复。

en_us.text: **Experimental**, not enabled by default. An attempted fix for the memory leak issue that occurs after playing long enough on 1.16.

zh_cn.text: §l实验性功能§r，默认禁用。尝试修复在1.16版本上长时间游玩后出现的内存泄漏问题。

en_us.text: 1.18 and newer. **A key optimization.** Ports a patch from Paper that fixes issues on 1.17 with chunkloading requiring huge amounts of memory and generating many `CompletableFuture` instances. 1.18+ are now able to load worlds on only 400MB of memory like 1.16 could.

zh_cn.text: 仅1.18+。§l一项关键优化§r。移植了Paper服务端的一个补丁，修复了1.17版本中区块加载需要大量内存和产生许多§bCompletableFuture§r实例的问题。1.18以上版本现在能够像1.16版本那样仅用400MB的内存加载世界。

en_us.text: Patches Twilight Forest to perform non-thread-safe client setup using the main thread as it should, rather than the FML worker thread.

zh_cn.text: 给暮色森林模组打了补丁，对于非线程安全的客户端启动，执行时，不再使用FML工作线程，转用它本该用的主线程。

en_us.text: Adds ModernFix to the branding list on the title screen, and also to the F3 screen.

zh_cn.text: 将现代化修复相关信息添加到标题界面和F3屏幕中。

en_us.text: Normally off, can be enabled to force the raw stack trace to be dumped to the log when a crash occurs. Occasionally vanilla's crash report system fails to work properly and gives an entirely irrelevant stack trace/report.

zh_cn.text: 通常关闭，启用后，在发生崩溃时，它会将原始堆栈踪迹强制转储到日志里。因为原版的崩溃报告系统偶尔不能正常工作，只能给出一个完全不相关的堆栈跟踪/报告。

en_us.text: Uses a couple injections to measure world load time, datapack reload time, resource reload time, bootstrap time, and adds the necessary hooks to enable vanilla's unused profiler logic for resource reloading if so configured.

zh_cn.text: 借助几个注入来测量世界加载时间、数据包重载时间、资源重载时间、启动时间，并添加必要的挂钩，以启用原版未使用的分析器逻辑，该逻辑用于分析资源重载过程。

en_us.text: **To be used for debugging purposes only.** Causes a thread dump to be output to the log every 60 seconds. This can help to diagnose unexplained freezes during loading/gameplay.

zh_cn.text: §l仅用于调试目的。§r使线程转储每60秒向日志输出一次数据。这可以帮助诊断加载/游戏过程中无法解释的冻结现象。

en_us.text: Attempts to prevent chunk system deadlocks or provide additional debug information in the log when they occur. These deadlocks usually manifest as the server freezing indefinitely (e.g. entities not moving), while the client continues to work just fine.

zh_cn.text: 尝试预防区块系统死锁，或者，仍然发生死锁时，在日志中提供额外的调试信息。这些死锁通常表现为服务端无限期冻结（其表现例如实体不移动），而客户端继续正常工作。

en_us.text: Patches Valhesia Structures to fix an issue in its code that causes frequent worldgen/chunkloading deadlocks.

zh_cn.text: 为Valhesia Structures模组打补丁，修复其代码的问题，具体表现：频繁产生世界生成/区块加载死锁。

en_us.text: Fixes a multithreading issue in CoFH Core that can cause rare crashes during launch.

zh_cn.text: 修复了CoFH核心（CoFH Core）模组的一个多线程问题，具体表现：启动游戏时偶尔崩溃。

en_us.text: Fixes a multithreading issue in ConnectedTexturesMod that can cause rare crashes during launch.

zh_cn.text: 修复了连接纹理（ConnectedTexturesMod）模组的一个多线程问题，具体表现：启动游戏时偶尔崩溃。

en_us.text: Fixes a memory leak in vanilla caused by the ender dragon retaining a reference to the previous client world.

zh_cn.text: 修复了一处原版内存泄漏，它由末影龙保留对先前客户端世界的引用而产生。

en_us.text: Fixes many issues where EntityJoinWorldEvent/EntityJoinLevelEvent cause a worldgen deadlock, by slightly deferring entity loading. Should not, however, cause any noticeable behavior changes in-game.

zh_cn.text: 针对§b实体加入世界事件（EntityJoinWorldEvent/EntityJoinLevelEvent）§r，稍微推迟了实体加载，修复了许多会产生世界生成死锁的问题。不过，这应该不会在游戏中引起任何明显的行为变化。

en_us.text: Fixes Forge configs occasionally becoming corrupted when launching the game.

zh_cn.text: 修复了Forge配置在启动游戏时偶尔损坏的问题。
修复了MC-258939（非原子缓存状态可能产生多线程崩溃）

en_us.text: Makes the game window retain its existing size when control is handed over from Forge's early loading to Minecraft code. Fixes the window teleporting back to the center of the screen after being dragged, etc.

zh_cn.text: 在控制权被从Forge的早期加载移交给Minecraft代码时，使游戏窗口保留其现有大小。修复了窗口被拖动后还会传送回屏幕中央等问题。

en_us.text: Fixes Refined Storage external storage blocks occasionally failing to show contents of drawers, etc. when loaded. Backport of Refined Storage PR #3435, which was only applied to 1.18 and later.

zh_cn.text: 如果安装了精致存储模组，会修复它的一些问题，比如，外部存储总线偶尔无法显示抽屉内容。这是精致存储PR #3435的向后移植，仅适用于1.18及更高版本。

en_us.text: Fixes zombie pigmen keeping the 0, 0 chunk loaded perpetually on Forge. Backport of Forge PR #8583.

zh_cn.text: 修复了Forge上僵尸猪人使（0, 0）区块永久加载的问题。这是Forge PR #8583的向后移植。

en_us.text: Fixes an occasional Starlight crash due to emptiness maps not being initialized. Backport of the same fix in Starlight for 1.18.x.

zh_cn.text: 修复了星光偶尔崩溃的问题，崩溃元凶是空地图未初始化。这是星光（Starlight）1.18.x中相同修复的向后移植。

en_us.text: Core patches required for ModernFix to work

zh_cn.text: 现代化修复正常运作所需的核心补丁

en_us.text: Patches used when running in a development environment, for speed improvement and/or testing

zh_cn.text: 在开发环境中运行时，用于提高速度和/或测试目的的补丁

en_us.text: Concurrency patches to prevent crashes during launch

zh_cn.text: 并发补丁，用于预防启动时崩溃

en_us.text: Adds the vanilla watchdog to singleplayer worlds as well, but just prints out the stacktraces rather than forcefully terminating the world. This version includes the functionality of Fullstack Watchdog, but the latter is still needed for multiplayer.

zh_cn.text: 将原版看门狗添加到单人游戏世界中，但只是打印出堆栈跟踪，而不会强制终止世界。此版本包括全栈看门狗的功能，但多人游戏仍然需要后者。

en_us.text: Adds easter egg features (does not affect any vanilla visuals or behavior) when running on a snapshot version.

zh_cn.text: 在快照版本上运行时，添加复活节彩蛋功能（不影响任何原版视觉效果或行为）。

en_us.text: If enabled, and a compatible version of Spark is installed, the entire launch sequence will be profiled until the main menu.

zh_cn.text: 如果安装了兼容版本的火花（Spark）模组，启用后将分析主菜单之前的完整启动序列。

en_us.text: Shows a warning on startup if other performance mods considered essential and highly compatible are not present

zh_cn.text: 一些性能模组被认为是必不可少且高度兼容的，如果没有安装这些模组，会在启动时显示警告

en_us.text: Replaces Forge's resource finder (used to find game and a mod code) with a significantly faster version, speeding up launch

zh_cn.text: 将Forge的资源查找器（用于查找游戏和模组的代码）替换为明显更快的版本，从而加快启动速度

en_us.text: Reduces memory usage by clearing mapping data structures in Fabric Loader that are either redundant or rarely used by mods. Off by default for compatibility reasons.

zh_cn.text: 清除Fabric加载器中冗余或很少被模组使用的映射数据结构，来减少内存占用。出于兼容性原因，默认关闭。

en_us.text: Force-loads all mixins when launch finishes and then clears out mixin data structures to remove most of Mixin's memory footprint. Disabled by default for compatibility reasons.

zh_cn.text: 在启动结束时强制加载所有mixin，然后清除mixin数据结构，使Mixin减少大半内存占用。出于兼容性原因，默认禁用。

en_us.text: Makes most wall blocks share the same shape object instead of each one having its own copy. Can reduce memory usage substantially when lots of wall blocks are added by mods.

zh_cn.text: 使大多数墙方块共享同一个形状对象，而不是每个墙方块都拥有属于自己的副本。当模组添加大量墙方块时，可以大大减少其带来的内存占用。

en_us.text: AE2 compatibility patch for dynamic resources

zh_cn.text: 动态资源功能的兼容性补丁，用于应用能源2模组

en_us.text: CTM compatibility patch for dynamic resources

zh_cn.text: 动态资源功能的兼容性补丁，用于连接纹理（CTM）模组

en_us.text: LDLib compatibility patch for dynamic resources

zh_cn.text: 针对动态资源的 LDLib 兼容性补丁

en_us.text: Refined Storage compatibility patch for dynamic resources

zh_cn.text: 动态资源功能的兼容性补丁，用于精致存储模组

en_us.text: SuperMartijn642CoreLib compatibility patch for dynamic resources

zh_cn.text: 动态资源功能的兼容性补丁，用于SuperMartijn642CoreLib模组

en_us.text: Diagonal Fences compatibility patch for dynamic resources

zh_cn.text: 动态资源功能的兼容性补丁，用于对角线栅栏（Diagonal Fences）模组

en_us.text: Rewrites the advancement checking logic to be faster and not cause StackOverflowError in large packs. Port of Advancements Debug from Fabric.

zh_cn.text: 重写进度检查逻辑，使其更快，且在大型整合包里不再会产生§b堆栈溢出错误（StackOverflowError）§r。这是Fabric进度调试功能的移植。

en_us.text: Fix Patchouli books storing many empty items with NBT tags, reducing memory usage.

zh_cn.text: 针对帕秋莉手册模组，修复其书籍会存储许多带有NBT标签的空条目的问题，减少了内存占用。

en_us.text: Completely removes spawn chunks from the game. They are no longer loaded at all, unlike Ksyxis.

zh_cn.text: 从游戏中完全删除出生点区块（spawn chunks）。它们彻底不再加载了，这点与Ksyxis不同。

en_us.text: Fixes Blueprint's ObjectModificationManager leaking vanilla resources, reducing memory usage. Despite the fix being contributed in PR #195 a release was not yet made.

zh_cn.text: 针对蓝图（Blueprint）模组，修复其§bObjectModificationManager§r泄漏原版资源的问题，减少了内存占用。尽管我已经贡献了修复代码（PR #195），但包含此修复代码的新版本尚未发布。

en_us.text: Fixes the game failing to load worlds if dimension mods are removed. Backport of Forge PR #8959.

zh_cn.text: 修复了删除维度模组后游戏无法加载世界的问题。这是Forge PR #8959的向后移植。

en_us.text: Fixes memory waste caused by some legacy servers (e.g. Hypixel) sending empty chunks as if they contain blocks. Reduces memory usage significantly on these servers.

zh_cn.text: 某些传统服务器（例如Hypixel）会认为空区块包含方块，照常发送这些区块，从而浪费内存。此项修复了这个问题，显著减少了这些服务器上的内存占用。

en_us.text: Deduplicates climate parameter objects used by the new biome system, can save ~2MB but also slows down datapack reload somewhat.

zh_cn.text: 新的生物群系系统使用了气候参数（climate parameter）对象，对其进行去重，可以节省约2MB内存，但也在一定程度上减慢了数据包的重载速度。

en_us.text: Constructs entity models the first time they are seen instead of during launch. Some mods are not compatible with this option and will cause EntityRenderer crashes.

zh_cn.text: 实体模型在实体首次出现时构造，而不是在启动时构造。某些模组与此项不兼容，会导致§b实体渲染器（EntityRenderer）§r崩溃。

en_us.text: Fixes lag caused by Twilight Forest worldgen checking structures very inefficiently

zh_cn.text: 针对暮色森林模组，修复了其世界生成检查结构效率极低导致卡顿的问题

en_us.text: Speeds up Forge registry freezing during launch by using a faster code path

zh_cn.text: 使用更快的代码路径，加快启动时Forge注册表的冻结速度

en_us.text: Speeds up uses of tag entries by caching the location object instead of recreating it every time

zh_cn.text: 缓存位置对象，不再每次都重新创建它，这可以加快标签条目的使用速度

en_us.text: Stores the glyphs for the Unicode font more efficiently. Kudos to @AnAwesomGuy for the trick.

zh_cn.text: 以更高效的方式存储 Unicode 字体的字形。感谢 @AnAwesomGuy 提供的技巧。

en_us.text: Reduces the memory usage of old client-side worlds that aren't needed after switching dimensions. These are normally garbage collected in vanilla, but mods sometimes retain references to them.

zh_cn.text: 减少切换维度后不需要的旧客户端世界的内存占用。这部分内存在原版中通常会被垃圾回收，但有时模组会保留对它们的引用。

en_us.text: (Fabric) Experimental option that reduces the memory usage of registries by roughly 50%. Not useful in most modpacks unless they contain millions of blocks and items.

zh_cn.text: （Fabric）实验性选项，可将注册表的内存占用减少约 50%。在大多数整合包中没什么用，除非它们包含数百万个方块和物品。

en_us.text: Avoids storing a codec for every block(state) and instead generates and caches it on the fly when needed. Generally not worth enabling unless you have a million blocks/items.

zh_cn.text: 不再给每个方块（状态）都存储一个编解码器，只在需要时动态生成、缓存它。通常不值得启用，除非你有一百万个方块/物品。

en_us.text: Mitigate lag when there are hundreds of thousands of suggestions while typing a command

zh_cn.text: 在输入命令时，若有数十万个建议，可以缓解卡顿。

en_us.text: Fixes an issue causing registration of blocks/items to slow down proportional to the number already registered. This improves startup time.

zh_cn.text: 修复了一个问题，它会导致方块/物品的注册速度减慢，减慢的程度与已注册的数量成正比。这缩短了启动时间。

en_us.text: Avoids pointlessly creating a URL object and speeds up skull block rendering.

zh_cn.text: 避免毫无意义地创建一个URL对象，加速头颅方块的渲染。

en_us.text: Fixes Forge issue #9118, where mods can cause undebuggable render crashes by pushing the matrix stack without popping it.

zh_cn.text: 修复了Forge的#9118号问题，这个问题会导致模组在不弹出已经推入的MatrixStack时有概率触发无法诊断的渲染崩溃。

en_us.text: Fixes a security issue with the worldgen settings file dialog

zh_cn.text: 修复了在世界生成设置的文件选择对话框中的一个安全问题。

en_us.text: Fixes a bug introduced by a Forge patch that causes excessive amounts of chunk data packets to be sent to the player if they are riding a vehicle on a chunk border.

zh_cn.text: 修复了一个由Forge补丁引入的问题，此问题会导致玩家在区块边界上乘坐交通工具时，服务器向该玩家发送非常大量的区块数据包。

en_us.text: Fixes a bug in Mantle that can cause random ConcurrentModificationException crashes when rendering Tinkers Construct content.

zh_cn.text: 修复了地幔（Mantle）的一个问题，此问题会导致渲染匠魂相关内容时毫无规律地触发并发修改异常（ConcurrentModificationException）而崩溃。

en_us.text: Works around design flaws in the Forge ModelDataManager system that can cause unexpected concurrency issues.

zh_cn.text: 规避Forge的ModelDataManager的一些设计缺陷，这些缺陷可能导致突发性的并发问题。

en_us.text: Fixes Forge clients being disconnected when connecting to a vanilla server if mods add custom recipe book entry types.

zh_cn.text: 修复具有模组额外添加的配方书条目类型的Forge客户端在连接到原版服务器时强制断连的问题。

en_us.text: Fixes various ConcurrentModificationExceptions that can occur in content mods when computing block shapes

zh_cn.text: 修复内容型模组在计算方块形状时可能发生的并发修改异常（ConcurrentModificationException）

en_us.text: This option may help to detect the cause of chunkloading freezes. However, leaving it enabled may cause slightly worse performance.

zh_cn.text: 此选项对检测区块加载冻结可能有所帮助。不过，开启此选项也可能导致轻微性能下降。

en_us.text: Fixes Minecraft's built-in wait function consuming excessive amounts of CPU resources.

zh_cn.text: 修复Minecraft内置的wait函数（方法）消耗过量CPU资源的问题。

en_us.text: Small micro-optimization that makes retrieving custom entity data slightly more efficient on Forge.

zh_cn.text: 微优化，让Forge在获取自定义实体数据上更有效率一点。

en_us.text: Fixes oversights in Forge that lead to excessive allocation in hot registry methods.

zh_cn.text: 修复Forge注册系统的一些疏漏，其会使得其中的热点方法产生过量的内存分配需求。

en_us.text: Fixes MC-272431, which tracks the ender dragon being unable to dive to the portal as it did in 1.13 and older. This causes the dragon to fly quite a bit differently from what modern players are used to and also patches out one-cycling, so it's not enabled by default. Thanks to Jukitsu for identifying the regression in the vanilla code.

zh_cn.text: 修复 MC-272431：末影龙无法像 1.13 及更早版本那样俯冲向传送门。这会使末影龙的飞行方式与现代玩家所熟悉的明显不同，同时会修掉“one-cycling”（单循环速杀）打法，因此默认不启用。感谢 Jukitsu 找出原版代码中的这次回归。

en_us.text: Hypixel sends chunks to the client that are missing some block entity data, which makes chests etc. appear invisible. This 'fixes' the problem by creating the needed data on the client. Has no effect for properly behaved servers or in singleplayer.

zh_cn.text: Hypixel 发送给客户端的区块缺少部分方块实体数据，导致箱子等看起来不可见。此选项通过在客户端上创建所需的数据来“修复”该问题。对行为规范的服务器或单人游戏没有影响。

en_us.text: Attempts to work around mods constructing BufferBuilder objects that leak memory. This can cause the JVM to crash with an hs_err_pid file in some rare cases. If you experience this type of crash, try disabling this option.

zh_cn.text: 尝试规避某些模组构造会泄漏内存的 BufferBuilder 对象的问题。在某些罕见情况下，这可能导致 JVM 崩溃并生成 hs_err_pid 文件。如果你遇到此类崩溃，请尝试禁用此选项。

en_us.text: Fixes the experimental feature warning being shown still being shown the first time you reopen a world that was created as experimental.

zh_cn.text: 修复了重新打开以实验性功能创建的世界时，第一次仍会显示实验性功能警告的问题。

en_us.text: Fixes a major oversight in Forge's early error handling code that causes some parts of mods to load, but not others, which usually results in the game crashing rather than displaying the intended error screen. This issue was fixed in NeoForge, and eventually fixed in new enough versions of Forge.

zh_cn.text: 修复了 Forge 早期错误处理代码中的一个重大疏漏：它会导致模组的某些部分加载而另一些部分不加载，通常结果是游戏崩溃而非显示预期的错误界面。此问题已在 NeoForge 中修复，并最终在足够新的 Forge 版本中得到修复。

en_us.text: Fixes MC-251068, where deleting the last world takes you back to an empty world list.

zh_cn.text: 修复 MC-251068：删除最后一个世界后会返回一个空的世界列表。

en_us.text: **This is a debug option and should not be enabled for regular gameplay.** Attempts to detect mods interacting with block entities on the wrong thread and crash the game with more information, rather than an unclear ConcurrentModificationException

zh_cn.text: **这是一个调试选项，不应在正常游戏中启用。** 尝试检测在错误线程上访问方块实体的模组，并携带更多信息使游戏崩溃，而不是抛出含义不明的 ConcurrentModificationException

en_us.text: Disables the game's use of worker threads for the server and for chunk rendering. **This will make performance worse on almost all hardware**, and should only be enabled on a client, when you know exactly what you are doing, and probably only on hardware with very few (2 or less) physical CPU cores. In those rare cases, it can reduce lag spikes since there is less contention over the limited cores.

zh_cn.text: 禁用游戏在服务端和区块渲染上对工作线程的使用。**这几乎会让所有硬件的性能变差**，仅应在你确切知道自己在做什么时于客户端启用，而且大概只适用于物理 CPU 核心极少（2 个或更少）的硬件。在这类罕见情况下，由于对有限核心的争用更少，它可以减少卡顿尖峰。

en_us.text: Runs the Forge loading screen on a background thread for part of the loading process, to allow progress to be shown while content is being registered. May have compatibility issues with some GPU drivers (e.g. macOS), so do not enable it by default in a modpack.

zh_cn.text: 在加载过程的部分阶段将 Forge 加载界面放到后台线程上运行，以便在注册内容时显示进度。可能与某些 GPU 驱动存在兼容性问题（例如 macOS），因此不要在整合包中默认启用。

en_us.text: Prevents the Minecraft client from obtaining the keypair for chat signing. This disables the client's ability to sign chat messages (like No Chat Reports, but in a simpler, albeit less user-friendly way).

zh_cn.text: 阻止 Minecraft 客户端获取用于聊天签名的密钥对。这会禁用客户端签署聊天消息的能力（类似 No Chat Reports，但方式更简单，尽管对用户不那么友好）。

en_us.text: Prevents the Minecraft client from sending telemetry to Mojang. The telemetry is generally not relevant to them anyway for a modded instance.

zh_cn.text: 阻止 Minecraft 客户端向 Mojang 发送遥测数据。对于模组实例来说，这些遥测数据本来也帮不到他们什么。

en_us.text: Implements some minor optimizations to the vanilla chunk meshing logic (they will have no effect with a mod that replaces chunk rendering entirely).

zh_cn.text: 对原版区块网格构建逻辑进行了一些小幅优化（如果区块渲染已被其他模组完全替代，则不会有任何效果）。

en_us.text: Improves the speed at which structures like buried treasure can be located.

zh_cn.text: 提高定位埋藏宝藏等结构的速度。

en_us.text: Fixes more oversights in Forge that lead to excessive allocation in hot registry methods.

zh_cn.text: 修复了 Forge 中更多会导致热点注册表方法过度分配内存的疏漏。

en_us.text: Improves on vanilla's existing caching for creative tab contents in a way that is compatible with the timing requirements of mods like JEI/EMI. This can reduce the lag spike when opening the creative inventory for the first time in a modpack.

zh_cn.text: 以与 JEI/EMI 等模组的时序要求兼容的方式改进原版已有的创造模式物品栏内容缓存。这可以减少整合包中首次打开创造模式物品栏时的卡顿尖峰。

en_us.text: Optimizes the Forge event for finding potential mobs that can spawn. This reduces allocations and the overhead of rebuilding a weighted list when no mods modify the potential spawns.

zh_cn.text: 优化用于查找可能生成生物的 Forge 事件。当没有模组修改潜在生成物时，可以减少内存分配以及重建加权列表的开销。

en_us.text: Optimizes chunk ticking in vanilla to reduce allocations.

zh_cn.text: 优化原版中的区块运算以减少内存分配。

en_us.text: Optimizes some world generation logic in vanilla to reduce object allocations.

zh_cn.text: 优化原版中的部分世界生成逻辑，以减少对象分配。

en_us.text: Prevents the game from logging a very long stacktrace when the narrator fails to load on Linux (usually caused by not having libflite installed).

zh_cn.text: 阻止游戏在 Linux 上讲述人加载失败时记录极长的堆栈跟踪（通常由未安装 libflite 导致）。
删除Unicode字体，可以节省10MB内存，但会导致特殊字符不再渲染
木栖羽龙皇家装饰头饰
木栖羽龙皇家装饰胸饰
木栖羽龙皇家装饰尾饰
木栖羽龙高帽装饰头饰
木栖羽龙骷髅装饰头饰

en_us.text: Hewn from the mountain's patience, it only knows how to move forward.

zh_cn.text: 由山岳的耐心凿成，它只懂得前进。

en_us.text: Charge. Impact deals damage and inflicts Bleeding.

zh_cn.text: 冲锋。撞击造成伤害并施加流血。

en_us.text: You're able to block attacks which would disable or ignore shields. (Large monsters excluded)

zh_cn.text: 你可以格挡通常会使盾牌失效或被忽略的攻击。（大型怪物除外）

en_us.text: The ground shook first. Then you did.

zh_cn.text: 大地先颤抖了。然后是你。

en_us.text: Forged from the dusk's claw, it moves faster than its shadow.

zh_cn.text: 以暮色之爪锻造而成，其速快过自身阴影。

en_us.text: Open a brief parry window. Absorb a direct hit to retaliate with a counter-dash.

zh_cn.text: 开启短暂的招架窗口。吸收一次直接攻击后发动反击突刺。

en_us.text: The dusk hunts with silent grace.

zh_cn.text: 暮色以无声的优雅狩猎。

en_us.text: Hammered from winter's bone, it buries what it touches and lifts what it breaks.

zh_cn.text: 一把凝聚冰川怒意的重锤。

en_us.text: Inflict Frostvein, stacking up to 3 layers of slowing chill.

zh_cn.text: 施加霜寒脉络，层层寒意使敌人减速麻木。

en_us.text: Charge a slam that erupts rings of ice spikes ahead. Longer charge spawns more rings. Launches you skyward on release.

zh_cn.text: 释放一道带有冰刺的极寒冲击波。

en_us.text: The chill in the air isn't the weather.

zh_cn.text: 你感觉周围的空气变得寒冷...

en_us.text: Hammered out fast and pointed forward, it has always preferred the direct approach.

zh_cn.text: 快速锻造而成，指向明确，它一直偏爱直截了当的方式。

en_us.text: Channel a fiery burst that detonates ahead, dealing heavy damage in a wide radius.

zh_cn.text: 引导一道烈焰爆裂，在前方引爆，对大范围区域造成巨额伤害。

en_us.text: Subtlety is a skill. You'll learn it later.

zh_cn.text: 含蓄是一种技巧。你以后会学会的。

en_us.text: Rung from a cry that split the earth, it hasn't quieted since.

zh_cn.text: 由一声撕裂大地的呐喊铸就，自此再未平息。

en_us.text: Plant a Sound Mine in front of you. It detonates when enemies draw near, sending out a shockwave.

zh_cn.text: 在你前方放置一个声波地雷。敌人接近时会引爆，释放冲击波。

en_us.text: You don't blow it. You give it permission.

zh_cn.text: 不是你吹响它。而是你允许它发声。

en_us.text: A compact cluster of flash arrows, thrown by Kobeko who can't be bothered with bows.

zh_cn.text: 一捆紧凑的闪光箭，由懒得用弓的科贝蜥投掷。

en_us.text: A battered Kobeko shield, more noise than metal, perfect for drawing attention.

zh_cn.text: 一面破旧的科贝蜥盾牌，噪音多于金属，非常适合吸引注意力。

en_us.text: A Skrythe-alloy horn that releases a burst of wind, bolstering its Kobeko wielder.

zh_cn.text: 一把肆空龙合金制成的号角，能释放一阵狂风，增强其科贝蜥主人。

en_us.text: A sturdy belt rigged to carry potions, letting a Kobeko mend itself or its master on the fly.

zh_cn.text: 一条坚固的腰带，用于携带药水，让科贝蜥能在战斗中为自己或主人疗伤。

en_us.text: Allows you to teleport your tamed Kobeko to you from anywhere!

zh_cn.text: 允许你将驯服的科贝蜥从任何地方传送到你身边！

en_us.text: An armor piece crafted from the Skrythe's materials.

zh_cn.text: 一件用肆空龙的材料制作的护甲。

en_us.text: You gain Skrythe's resilience; increased knockback resistance.

zh_cn.text: 获得肆空龙的韧性；增加击退抗性。

en_us.text: You gain Skrythe's might; resistance to fall damage, falls erupt into shockwaves.

zh_cn.text: 获得肆空龙的力量；抵抗摔落伤害，落地时产生冲击波。

en_us.text: An armor piece crafted with Skrythe's materials for the Kobeko.

zh_cn.text: 一件为科贝蜥用肆空龙材料制作的护甲。

en_us.text: Kobeko becomes resistant to fall damage.

zh_cn.text: 科贝蜥获得摔落伤害抗性。

en_us.text: An armor piece crafted from the Ignathos's materials.

zh_cn.text: 一件用燃羽鸟的材料制作的护甲。

en_us.text: You gain Ignathos's precision; attacks at optimal range deal increased damage. (3.5 - 5 Blocks)

zh_cn.text: 获得燃羽鸟的精准；在最佳距离攻击造成额外伤害。（3.5 - 5格）

en_us.text: You gain Ignathos's reach; increased block and entity reach.

zh_cn.text: 获得燃羽鸟的延伸；增加方块和实体触及距离。

en_us.text: An armor piece crafted from the Rhyza's materials.

zh_cn.text: 一件用锐爪兽的材料制作的护甲。

en_us.text: You gain Rhyza's dazzle resistance; you are immune to blinding light.

zh_cn.text: 获得锐爪兽的炫光抗性；免疫致盲光线。

en_us.text: You gain Rhyza's cloaking; you become invisible on low hp.

zh_cn.text: 获得锐爪兽的隐匿；低生命值时隐身。

en_us.text: An armor piece crafted with Rhyza's materials for the Kobeko.

zh_cn.text: 一件为科贝蜥用锐爪兽材料制作的护甲。
科贝蜥获得移动速度提升。

en_us.text: An armor piece crafted from the Leivekilth's materials

zh_cn.text: 一件用凛冰兽的材料制作的护甲。

en_us.text: You gain Leivekilth's frost control; you have permanent frostwalker.

zh_cn.text: 获得凛冰兽的霜冻控制；永久拥有冰霜行者附魔。

en_us.text: You gain Leivekilth's ice armor; chance of bursting ice, damaging whatever attacked you.

zh_cn.text: 获得凛冰兽的冰甲；有几率迸发冰刺，伤害攻击者。

en_us.text: An armor piece crafted with Leivekilth's materials for the Kobeko.

zh_cn.text: 一件为科贝蜥用凛冰兽材料制作的护甲。

en_us.text: Kobeko stagger's shatter ice, damaging those near.

zh_cn.text: 科贝蜥的踉跄会震碎寒冰，伤害附近的敌人。

en_us.text: An armor piece crafted from the Rakoth's materials

zh_cn.text: 一件用岩壳巨兽的材料制作的护甲。

en_us.text: You gain Rakoth's steadfastness; you can step over full blocks.

zh_cn.text: 获得岩壳巨兽的稳健；可以跨过完整方块。

en_us.text: You gain Rakoth's unyielding mass; sprinting builds momentum to deflect projectiles.

zh_cn.text: 获得岩壳巨兽的不屈质量；冲刺积累动量以偏转弹射物。

en_us.text: An armor piece crafted with Rakoth's materials for the Kobeko.

zh_cn.text: 一件为科贝蜥用岩壳巨兽材料制作的护甲。

en_us.text: Kobeko's regular attacks become area of effect.

zh_cn.text: 科贝蜥的普通攻击变为范围效果。

en_us.text: An armor piece crafted with Ignathos's materials for the Kobeko.

zh_cn.text: 一件为科贝蜥用燃羽鸟材料制作的护甲。

en_us.text: A fainted Kobeko can be revived with Ignathos fuel blocks.

zh_cn.text: 可以使用燃羽鸟燃料块复活昏倒的科贝蜥。

en_us.text: An armor piece for the Kobeko.
A razor-sharp fang broken from the Skrythe's jaw.

zh_cn.text: 一颗从肆空龙颌上折断的锋利尖牙。

en_us.text: A dense fragment of scale dropped from the Skrythe.

zh_cn.text: 一块从肆空龙身上掉落的致密鳞片碎片。

en_us.text: A torn stretch of wing membrane dropped from the Skrythe.

zh_cn.text: 一片从肆空龙身上撕下的破损翼膜。

en_us.text: A vibrant blue frill dropped from the Skrythe.

zh_cn.text: 一片从肆空龙身上掉落的鲜艳蓝色头冠。

en_us.text: Skrythe's tail piece dropped by severing the beast's tail from its body.

zh_cn.text: 通过切断野兽尾巴获得的肆空龙尾部材料。

en_us.text: A magical fragment of Skrythe's throat, humming with the wyvern's lingering roar.

zh_cn.text: 一块带有魔力的肆空龙喉咙碎片，萦绕着飞龙残留的咆哮。

en_us.text: A curved, sharp talon ripped from the Ignathos.

zh_cn.text: 一只从燃羽鸟身上扯下的弯曲利爪。

en_us.text: A thick slab of fire-resistant hide stripped from the Ignathos.

zh_cn.text: 一块从燃羽鸟身上剥下的厚实防火皮革。

en_us.text: A soot-darkened feather plucked from the Ignathos.

zh_cn.text: 一根从燃羽鸟身上拔下的烟熏色羽毛。

en_us.text: A jagged fragment of the Ignathos's reinforced beak.

zh_cn.text: 一片燃羽鸟强化喙部的锯齿状碎片。

en_us.text: The volatile organ the Ignathos uses to ignite its internal furnace. It still radiates heat.

zh_cn.text: 燃羽鸟用来点燃体内熔炉的挥发性器官。它仍在散发着热量。

en_us.text: Ignathos's tail piece dropped by severing the beast's tail from its body.

zh_cn.text: 通过切断野兽尾巴获得的燃羽鸟尾部材料。

en_us.text: A razor-sharp claw dropped from the Rhyza.

zh_cn.text: 一只从锐爪兽身上掉落的锋利爪子。

en_us.text: A thick piece of fur dropped from the Rhyza.

zh_cn.text: 一块从锐爪兽身上掉落的厚实皮毛。

zh_cn.text: 一段从锐爪兽身上掉落的硬化外骨骼。

en_us.text: A hard shard of scale dropped by the Rhyza.

zh_cn.text: 一片从锐爪兽身上掉落的坚硬鳞片。

en_us.text: Rhyza's tail piece dropped by severing the beast's tail from its body.

zh_cn.text: 通过切断野兽尾巴获得的锐爪兽尾部材料。

en_us.text: A radiant core pulsing with blinding light, dropped by the Rhyza.

zh_cn.text: 一颗脉动着致盲光芒的光辉核心，由锐爪兽掉落。

en_us.text: A jagged claw from Rhyza, edged with unnatural precision and highly prized.

zh_cn.text: 一只来自锐爪兽的锯齿状利爪，边缘带着异常的锋利，备受珍视。

zh_cn.text: 一块从凛冰兽身上掉落的致密鳞片碎片。

zh_cn.text: 一张从凛冰兽身上脱落的覆霜毛皮。

zh_cn.text: 一根从凛冰兽身上撕下的巨大冰冻长牙。
