zh_cn.text: 通过切断野兽尾巴获得的凛冰兽尾部材料。

en_us.text: A crystalline shard infused with biting hoarfrost dropped from the Leivekilth.

zh_cn.text: 一枚从凛冰兽身上掉落的、注入了刺骨寒霜的水晶碎片。

en_us.text: A subzero organ harvested from the Leivekilth. It secretes an essence cold enough to freeze steel solid.

zh_cn.text: 一个从凛冰兽身上采集的零下器官。它分泌的精华足以将钢铁冻结。

en_us.text: A dense, scarred armor plate torn from the Rakoth's underside.

zh_cn.text: 一块从岩壳巨兽腹部撕下的致密、布满伤痕的装甲板。

en_us.text: A hardened segment of exoskeleton dropped by the Rakoth.

zh_cn.text: 一段从岩壳巨兽身上掉落的硬化外骨骼。

en_us.text: A jagged horn broken from the Rakoth's crown.

zh_cn.text: 一根从岩壳巨兽头顶折断的锯齿状角。

en_us.text: Rakoth's tail piece dropped by severing the beast's tail from its body.

zh_cn.text: 通过切断野兽尾巴获得的岩壳巨兽尾部材料。

en_us.text: A layered, stone-hard shell fragment broken from the Rakoth.

zh_cn.text: 一块从岩壳巨兽身上破碎的多层岩石般坚硬的壳。

en_us.text: A dense, ancient core formed under unimaginable pressure. It carries the unyielding strength of the earth.

zh_cn.text: 一个在难以想象的压力下形成的致密远古核心。承载着大地不屈的力量。

en_us.text: A sturdy piece of bone dropped by a Large Monster.

zh_cn.text: 一块由大型怪物掉落的结实骨头。

en_us.text: Makes you unable to move nor attack for a short duration. This status is very common and can be inflicted by most monsters' roars. However as common as it is, the monsters also do not attack when roaring, making the status not as dangerous. As the effect will likely end before the monster can finish roaring.

zh_cn.text: 使你在短时间内无法移动或攻击。这种状态非常普遍，大多数怪物的咆哮都能造成此效果。但同样普遍的是，怪物在咆哮时也不会攻击，因此该状态并不危险。因为效果很可能在怪物结束咆哮前就已消失。

en_us.text: Makes you unable to move nor attack for a short duration. This can be inflicted by all monsters if the hunter is often hit by attacks. The effect instantly ends if the hunter is hit again. The damage source does not matter, making allies and self-inflicted damage a viable way to end the effect early. However this effect is still very dangerous as the monster may follow up with a devastating attack before the hunter can recover.

zh_cn.text: 使你在短时间内无法移动或攻击。如果猎人频繁被击中，所有怪物都可能造成此效果。如果猎人再次被击中，该效果会立即结束。伤害来源不限，因此友军或自伤都是提前结束效果的可行方法。然而此状态仍然非常危险，因为怪物可能在猎人恢复前发动毁灭性的追击。

en_us.text: Makes you take damage over time. This effect can stack, making the damage interval shorter. On its own, the damage isn't anything to be afraid of, but it can be devastating if its allowed to stack up. This status' duration will go down slower depending on how fast you are moving. To get rid of it the fastest, the hunter must crouch while staying still.

zh_cn.text: 使你持续受到伤害。此效果可以叠加，缩短伤害间隔。单独来看伤害不足为惧，但如果任其叠加则可能致命。该状态的持续时间会根据你的移动速度而减缓消退。为了最快消除它，猎人必须蹲下并保持静止。

en_us.text: Makes you take damage over time. This effect can stack, making the damage interval shorter. On its own, the damage isn't anything to be afraid of, but it can be devastating if its allowed to stack up. This status' duration will go down slower depending on how slow you are moving. To get rid of it the fastest, the hunter must be sprinting, or even better, roll around until the status is cured. The hunter must be careful as to not stay still, as doing so will increase the duration instead.

zh_cn.text: 使你持续受到伤害。此效果可以叠加，缩短伤害间隔。单独来看伤害不足为惧，但如果任其叠加则可能致命。该状态的持续时间会根据你的移动速度缓慢而减缓消退。为了最快消除它，猎人必须冲刺，或者更好的是，翻滚直到状态解除。猎人必须小心不要静止不动，否则反而会增加持续时间。

en_us.text: Makes you move slower, attack slower and jump lower. This effect can stack, making the movement speed decrease more severe. This effect can really be devastating if its allowed to stack up as you may not be able to jump over even a singular block. This status currently does not have a remedy making it incredibly dangerous if the hunter is fighting in rough terrain.

zh_cn.text: 使你的移动变慢、攻击变慢、跳跃变低。此效果可以叠加，使移动速度降低更严重。如果任其叠加，此效果可能极具毁灭性，因为你可能连一个方块都跳不过去。此状态目前没有治疗方法，使得在不平整地形作战时极其危险。

en_us.text:
A highly territorial carnivorous Wyvern characterized by its dense, ash-grey scales and striking azure wing membranes. The Skrythe thrives in most regions and can be sighted throughout the world migrating or looking for food.

Rather than relying on a breath weapon, its throat houses a highly specialized organ capable of generating devastating, high-frequency vibrations. The prominent blue frills crowning Skrythe's head are not merely for display. They are highly complex biological parabolic reflectors. When the wyvern produces a sound, these frills flare outward to amplify, focus, and aim the vibrations, turning a deafening roar into a localized, kinetic shockwave capable of pulverizing solid rock and shattering the bones of its prey.

To counterbalance the force of its own sonic blasts, Skrythe has developed a heavily calcified, rigid tail. While it prefers to fight at a distance using acoustics, it will ruthlessly swing this hardened tail like a mace to crush anything that manages to get too close.

Skrythe was the very first apex predator officially documented by early explorers. Before humanity understood the true dangers of the world, a massive grey shadow blotted out the sun, accompanied by a deafening roar that shattered village windows. It was the creature that taught the world to look up and fear the skies. Which is why its titled 'First King of The Skies'

zh_cn.text:
一种领地意识极强的肉食性飞龙，以其密集的灰烬色鳞片和醒目的蔚蓝翼膜为特征。肆空龙在大多数地区都能繁衍生息，可以在世界各地看到它们迁徙或觅食的身影。

它的喉咙中没有吐息武器，而是拥有一个高度特化的器官，能够产生毁灭性的高频振动。肆空龙头顶那显眼的蓝色头冠并非仅仅用于展示。它们是高度复杂的生物抛物面反射器。当飞龙发出声音时，这些头冠会向外张开，放大、聚焦并引导振动，将震耳欲聋的咆哮转化为局部的动能冲击波，足以粉碎坚硬的岩石和猎物的骨骼。

为了平衡自身音爆的力量，肆空龙进化出了一条高度钙化、僵硬的尾巴。虽然它更喜欢利用声学进行远程战斗，但它也会无情地挥舞这条坚硬的尾巴，像钉锤一样碾碎任何靠得太近的东西。

肆空龙是早期探险家正式记录的第一种顶级掠食者。在人类理解世界真正的危险之前，一道巨大的灰色阴影遮蔽了太阳，伴随着震碎村庄窗户的震耳欲聋的咆哮。正是这种生物教会了世界仰望天空并为之恐惧。这就是为什么它被称为“天空初代王”。

en_us.text: When engaging a Skrythe, avoid lingering in mid-range, as this is where its attacks, particularly its roar, are most devastating. Fighting at close range prevents you from simply outrunning strikes, forcing you to rely on diagonal dodge rolls to evade. This dynamic completely shifts when the Skrythe becomes enraged. You must abandon close-quarters combat during this state, as it can unleash a Seismic Roar at any moment. This attack is instantly fatal at point-blank range and still inflicts massive damage further out, so your best strategy is to keep your distance and bait the attack. If you back away too far while the enraged beast is airborne, it will trigger an Aerial Assault. As it ascends to fire sound spheres, do not waste stamina dodging them, as they deal negligible damage. Instead, immediately sprint directly underneath the Skrythe. The true threat is its subsequent angled dive, which boasts an incredibly long forward reach. Positioning yourself directly below the monster is the most reliable way to evade the dive completely.

zh_cn.text: 与肆空龙交战时，避免停留在中距离，因为那里是其攻击（尤其是咆哮）最具毁灭性的范围。近距离战斗让你无法简单地跑开躲避攻击，迫使你必须依靠斜向翻滚来闪避。当肆空龙进入愤怒状态时，这一动态会完全改变。你必须在此状态下放弃近身缠斗，因为它随时可能释放地震咆哮。该攻击在零距离下瞬间致命，即使在远处也会造成巨额伤害，所以你最好的策略是保持距离并引诱它出招。如果愤怒的野兽在空中时你退得太远，会触发它的空中突击。当它上升发射音波球时，不要浪费体力去躲避它们，因为它们造成的伤害微不足道。相反，立即冲刺到肆空龙正下方。真正的威胁是随后的倾斜俯冲，其向前突进的距离极长。将自己置于怪物正下方是最可靠的完全躲避俯冲的方法。

en_us.text:
Often referred to by frustrated locals as the "Brushfire Vandal," Ignathos is a medium-sized, flightless Avian covered in dense, heat-resistant plumage. Unlike most predators, this highly specialized creature is an obligate consumer of combustibles, sustaining itself entirely on a diet of raw wood, coal, and other flammable materials. Its anatomy is perfectly adapted for this bizarre ecological niche; it possesses unusually long arms ending in inward-pointing, vice-like claws that allow it to effortlessly grip, uproot, and pull solid blocks of fuel directly from the earth or human structures.

Once consumed, the materials enter a highly specialized stomach that acts as a biological furnace. Ignathos does not digest its food in a traditional sense; instead, it literally burns it, absorbing the resulting thermal and kinetic energy to fuel its own body. Because of its voracious appetite for fuel, particularly during the harsh winter months, unprepared villages often fall victim to its pillaging. However, Ignathos is naturally docile and strongly prefers to flee from confrontation. Over time, settlements situated near birch forests and other natural habitats have learned to coexist with the beast, leaving designated piles of scrap wood and coal on the outskirts of town to prevent the creature from dismantling their houses or raiding freshly mined stockpiles.

Despite its somewhat dopey appearance and timid nature, Ignathos is not defenseless. If it detects genuine hostility and feels it cannot safely escape (or if it is fiercely protecting a particularly rich meal) it will fight back. By hyper-ventilating and forcefully expelling the burning contents of its stomach furnace, Ignathos can spew globs of highly adhesive, flaming goo over a wide area.

While Ignathos is considered physically weaker than most large monsters, seasoned hunters actively avoid confronting them whenever possible. This is not out of fear of the beast itself, but rather the catastrophic environmental damage it causes when panicked. A frightened or cornered Ignathos will spray its flaming goo wildly, easily igniting massive, uncontrollable forest fires that can devastate an entire biome.

zh_cn.text:
常被沮丧的当地人称为“野火破坏者”，燃羽鸟是一种中等体型、不会飞的鸟类，覆盖着浓密的耐热羽毛。与大多数掠食者不同，这种高度特化的生物是燃烧物的专性消费者，完全依赖生木材、煤炭和其他可燃材料的饮食生存。它的解剖结构完美适应了这一奇特的生态位；它拥有异常长的前肢，末端是向内弯曲的虎钳般的爪子，使其能够轻松抓取、拔起并从地面或人造建筑中拉出整块的固体燃料。

一旦被吞下，这些材料会进入一个高度特化的胃，充当生物熔炉。燃羽鸟不以传统方式消化食物；相反，它实际上是在燃烧它们，吸收由此产生的热能和动能来驱动自己的身体。由于其贪婪的食欲，尤其是在严酷的冬季，毫无准备的村庄常常沦为它掠夺的受害者。然而，燃羽鸟天生温顺，强烈倾向于逃离冲突。随着时间的推移，位于桦树林及其他自然栖息地附近的定居点已经学会了与这种野兽共存，在城镇外围留下指定的废木料和煤堆，以防止这种生物拆毁他们的房屋或抢劫新开采的库存。

尽管外表有些呆萌且天性胆小，燃羽鸟并非没有防御能力。如果它察觉到真正的敌意并感到无法安全逃脱（或者正在激烈保护一顿特别丰盛的大餐），它会奋起反抗。通过过度换气并用力排出胃炉中燃烧的内容物，燃羽鸟可以在大范围内喷出一团团粘性极强的火焰粘液。

虽然燃羽鸟被认为在物理上弱于大多数大型怪物，但经验丰富的猎人会尽可能避免与之对抗。这并非出于对野兽本身的恐惧，而是因为它惊慌失措时造成的灾难性环境破坏。受惊或被逼入绝境的燃羽鸟会疯狂喷洒其火焰粘液，轻易引发大规模、失控的森林火灾，足以摧毁整个生物群系。

en_us.text: Ignathos' base attacks can be easily evaded using dodge rolls. As the fight progresses, Ignathos will search for and consume any valid fuel blocks nearby. Upon eating the fuel, it enters an ignited state, unlocking new flame-based abilities and empowering its standard moves. While ignited, both its beak strikes and its newly acquired flame-spitting attacks deal Fire damage and have a chance to inflict the Flarevein effect. The primary danger here is Flarevein, which will ramp up in severity if not addressed quickly. To cure the affliction, simply sprint or perform dodge rolls until it dissipates. When enraged, Ignathos gains the ability to spew a massive glob of flaming goo. Although this attack boasts increased damage and a wider area of effect, the beast suffers from a short recovery period afterward, providing an excellent opening for a counterattack.

zh_cn.text: 燃羽鸟的基础攻击可以通过翻滚轻松躲避。随着战斗进行，燃羽鸟会寻找并消耗附近任何有效的燃料块。食用燃料后，它会进入点燃状态，解锁新的火焰能力并强化其标准招式。在点燃状态下，它的喙击和新获得的喷火攻击都会造成火焰伤害，并有几率施加焰脉效果。这里的主要危险是焰脉，如果不迅速处理，其严重程度会不断升级。要治愈此症状，只需冲刺或进行翻滚直到其消散。当愤怒时，燃羽鸟获得了喷出一大团火焰粘液的能力。尽管这次攻击具有更高的伤害和更广的范围效果，但野兽之后会有短暂的恢复期，提供了一个绝佳的反击机会。

en_us.text:
A highly elusive, carnivorous Chimeran native to the barren, floating islands of the End. Characterized by its twin tails and specialized forelimbs, the Rhyza is a deadly anomaly in an already alien landscape. Unlike other predators that rely on crushing jaws, this beast rarely utilizes its sharp teeth in combat. Instead, it wields elongated, jagged claws with terrifying precision, evolved specifically to slash and perforate. Even if a target manages to deflect the brunt of a physical strike, the deep, serrated lacerations left behind inflict severe and continuous bleeding.

Despite its lethal anatomy, the Rhyza is naturally cautious and actively avoids unnecessary confrontation. It navigates the desolate void using advanced evasion tactics, primarily shifting into complete invisibility, to stalk small prey or bypass threats. Ecologists have recently discovered that what appears to be pale, white fur is actually a dense coat of microscopic, incredibly complex mirror-like structures. These organic, yet-to-be-understood prisms perfectly bend light around the creature's body, rendering it entirely unseen in its environment.

If cornered, it reveals its secondary defense mechanism: the bulbous, gleam-infused cores at the ends of its twin tails. By smashing these cores together or against the ground, the Rhyza detonates a blinding, disorienting flash of light, allowing it to vanish. However, if the creature is provoked into a lethal encounter, these evasive tools are weaponized, allowing the beast to blind its target and strike from unseen angles with terrifying, omnidirectional leaps.

This timid nature completely inverts during mating season. Expectant female Rhyzas become hyper-aggressive, entirely abandoning their natural invisibility to ruthlessly hunt down anything that moves within their territory. Ecologists theorize this violent behavioral shift is a preemptive evolutionary imperative, a brutal campaign to purge the surrounding islands of any potential threats before giving birth, ensuring the absolute safety of its vulnerable offspring.

zh_cn.text:
一种极为隐秘的肉食性嵌合种，原产于末地荒芜的浮岛。以双尾和特化的前肢为特征，锐爪兽在本已异域的环境中是一个致命的异类。与其他依赖粉碎性颚骨的掠食者不同，这种野兽很少在战斗中使用其锋利的牙齿。相反，它挥舞着细长、锯齿状的爪子，具有可怕的精确度，专门用于切割和穿刺。即使目标成功格挡了物理攻击的大部分力量，留下的深层锯齿状伤口也会造成严重且持续的出血。

尽管拥有致命的解剖结构，锐爪兽天生谨慎，积极避免不必要的冲突。它利用先进的规避战术在荒凉的虚空中导航，主要通过进入完全隐形状态来潜行追踪小型猎物或绕过威胁。生态学家最近发现，看似苍白、白色的皮毛实际上是一层由微观、极其复杂的镜面结构组成的致密外套。这些有机的、尚未被理解的棱镜能够完美地弯曲光线，使其在环境中完全不可见。

如果被逼入绝境，它会展现出第二套防御机制：双尾末端那充满光辉的核心。通过将这些核心相互碰撞或砸向地面，锐爪兽会引爆一阵致盲、令人迷失方向的强光，使其得以消失。然而，如果该生物被激怒至生死搏杀，这些规避工具就会被武器化，使野兽能够致盲目标，并从看不见的角度发动可怕的全方位跳跃。

这种胆小的天性与繁殖季节完全相反。怀孕的雌性锐爪兽会变得极度攻击性，完全放弃其天生的隐形能力，无情地猎杀其领土内任何移动的东西。生态学家推测，这种暴力的行为转变是一种先发制人的进化需求，一场在分娩前清除周围岛屿任何潜在威胁的残酷行动，以确保其后代的绝对安全。

en_us.text: Much like Ignathos, most of Rhyza's base attacks can be easily evaded using dodge rolls, though its overall attack speed is noticeably faster. When enraged, Rhyza gains access to two new abilities: Flash and Invisibility. Avoiding the Flash is simple; Rhyza will deliberately dash into your field of vision, so simply look away, preferably in the opposite direction of its dash, to avoid being blinded. Invisibility is a bit trickier, as there is no way to predict where Rhyza will emerge around you. Rather than trying to guess, it is better to rely on a reactive dodge roll. If you do not immediately see the beast, assume it is preparing to strike from behind and roll accordingly.

zh_cn.text: 与燃羽鸟类似，锐爪兽的大部分基础攻击可以通过翻滚轻松躲避，但其整体攻击速度明显更快。当愤怒时，锐爪兽会获得两个新能力：闪光和隐形。躲避闪光很简单；锐爪兽会故意冲入你的视野，所以只需看向别处，最好是与其冲刺方向相反，即可避免被致盲。隐形则稍显棘手，因为你无法预测锐爪兽会从哪里出现。与其试图猜测，不如依赖反应性的翻滚。如果你没有立即看到野兽，假设它正准备从背后袭击并相应地进行翻滚。

en_us.text:
A colossal, solitary Therian bearing the traits of a walrus, but equipped with membranous wings, a heavy tail, and devastating saber-like tusks. Its fangs serve as a visual marker of its age and dominance.

Leivekilth possesses highly specialized organs that secrete volatile fluids capable of rapidly stripping salt from seawater and shifting freezing points. This also allows the creature to exhale sweeping jets of pure frost. Its thick blubber is laced with a sponge-like tissue, enabling it to absorb water and cloak itself in a dense armor of regenerative ice.

Despite its immense weight, Leivekilth is terrifyingly agile in short bursts, the sheer muscle mass of the creature allows it to leap great distances and even take flight for brief periods. However when enraged, utilizing its blowholes to push freezing air at high speeds, it can temporarily transition into its flying state. This phase is extremely dangerous, as its bodily fluids can now rapidly drip below, flash freezing the ground at impact and creating razor sharp ice spikes. Or increasing the rate and pressure of its blowhole exhalations to supercool the ground below it, creating a massive icy shockwave.

Leivekilth are notoriously brutal with its prey, preserving them in ice and impaling them upon its jagged back spines. These macabre displays serve to store food, assert dominance, and attract mates. During breeding season, its lairs are decorated with mountainous heaps of frozen corpses, a grim warning that stepping foot into its territory is an absolute death sentence.

zh_cn.text:
一种巨大的独居兽族，具有海象的特征，但配备了膜状翅膀、沉重的尾巴和毁灭性的军刀般的长牙。它的獠牙是其年龄和统治地位的视觉标志。

凛冰兽拥有高度特化的器官，能分泌不稳定的液体，可以迅速从海水中剥离盐分并改变冰点。这也使该生物能够呼出扫荡一切的纯霜冻气流。其厚厚的脂肪中交织着海绵状的组织，使其能够吸收水分，并将自己包裹在一层致密的再生冰甲中。

尽管体重惊人，凛冰兽在短距离内却拥有可怕的敏捷性，其纯粹的肌肉质量使它能够跳跃很远的距离，甚至短暂飞行。然而当愤怒时，利用其呼吸孔高速推出冷冻空气，它可以暂时过渡到飞行状态。这个阶段极其危险，因为它的体液现在会迅速滴落，在撞击时瞬间冻结地面并形成锋利的冰刺。或者增加呼吸孔呼气的速率和压力，使其下方的地面过冷，产生巨大的冰霜冲击波。

凛冰兽以其对猎物的残忍而闻名，将它们保存在冰中，并串在其锯齿状的背棘上。这些恐怖的展示用于储存食物、彰显统治地位和吸引配偶。在繁殖季节，它的巢穴装饰着堆积如山的冰冻尸体，这是一个严峻的警告：踏入其领土绝对是死路一条。

en_us.text: Leivekilth's attacks are slow, but its sheer size makes up for the lack of speed. Shattering its ice armor quickly is crucial, as breaking each section increases the damage the monster takes. Watch out for its belly flop attacks; the safest way to evade these is to run diagonally underneath the beast. Be equally cautious of its ice attacks, which can inflict Frostvein. This effect is highly dangerous if allowed to stack, eventually preventing you from jumping over blocks altogether. Upon enraging, Leivekilth will flip onto its back and begin to hover. Do not waste your resources trying to outrun it. Instead, the safest approach is to remain at its sides. This positioning keeps you clear of the ice spikes erupting directly beneath it, while also preventing the monster from targeting you with its ice breath or tail sweeps.

zh_cn.text: 凛冰兽的攻击速度很慢，但其庞大的体型弥补了速度的不足。快速击碎它的冰甲至关重要，因为打破每个部分都会增加怪物受到的伤害。注意它的肚皮拍击攻击；躲避这些攻击最安全的方法是斜向跑到野兽下方。同样要警惕它的冰霜攻击，这可能会施加霜脉效果。如果任其叠加，此效果极其危险，最终会使你完全无法跳过方块。愤怒时，凛冰兽会翻身仰面开始悬浮。不要浪费资源试图跑赢它。相反，最安全的做法是保持在它的侧面。这个位置既能让你远离其正下方迸发的冰刺，也能防止怪物用冰霜吐息或尾巴横扫来瞄准你。

en_us.text:
A massive, four-legged Lacertian geovore characterized by the heavily armored, rocky shell covering its back. Rakoth primarily roams the arid expanses of badlands and deserts, relentlessly searching for exposed mineral veins and precious metals to sustain itself.

Equipped with a thick, reinforced skull and prominent frontal horns, this beast routinely headbutts solid cliff faces to excavate its metallic diet. While typically docile toward humans, its insatiable hunger for ore makes it extremely dangerous to fully equipped hunters. Rakoth is known to mistake the glint of metallic armor for a walking feast, charging relentlessly to crack open the hunter and consume the raw iron or gold within.

Despite its cumbersome, rocky exterior, hunters must not be deceived by its apparent sluggishness. Rakoths can launch into a terrifyingly swift gallop. If severely threatened, it will tuck its head and tail inward, transforming into a massive, rolling boulder of pure physical destruction. While this rolling charge delivers devastating blunt-force trauma capable of flattening anything in its path, the beast's vision and turning radius are severely compromised in this state, allowing nimble hunters to evade and counterattack.

Beyond its horns and rolling charge, Rakoth boasts a remarkably thick, armored tail used for crushing blows. During mating season, the arid plains echo with rhythmic, thunderous tremors as rival males repeatedly slam their heavy tails into the dirt. This display of raw physical power serves both as a call to potential mates and a violent warning to any competing males in the territory.

zh_cn.text:
一种巨大的四足蜥蜴食岩生物，以其覆盖背部的厚重装甲岩壳为特征。岩壳巨兽主要游荡在恶地和沙漠的干旱地带，不知疲倦地寻找暴露的矿脉和贵金属以维持自身。

配备着厚实的强化头骨和突出的额角，这种野兽经常用头撞击坚实的悬崖面来挖掘其金属饮食。虽然通常对人类温顺，但它对矿石的贪得无厌使其对全副武装的猎人极其危险。岩壳巨兽常会将金属盔甲的反光误认为是一顿行走的大餐，会无情地冲锋以撞开猎人并吞噬其中的生铁或黄金。

尽管外表笨重多石，猎人们切莫被其表面的迟缓所欺骗。岩壳巨兽可以发起可怕的高速奔驰。如果受到严重威胁，它会将头和尾巴向内蜷缩，变成一个纯粹物理破坏的巨大滚动巨石。虽然这种滚动冲锋能造成毁灭性的钝力创伤，足以夷平其路径上的任何东西，但野兽在这种状态下的视野和转弯半径会受到严重限制，让灵活的猎人得以躲避并进行反击。

除了它的角和滚动冲锋，岩壳巨兽还拥有一条异常粗壮、覆盖装甲的尾巴，用于毁灭性打击。在繁殖季节，干旱的平原上回荡着有节奏的雷鸣般震动，因为竞争的公兽们反复将其沉重的尾巴猛击地面。这种原始力量的展示既是对潜在配偶的呼唤，也是对该领土上任何竞争公兽的暴力警告。

en_us.text: Rakoth excels at mid-to-short range, so it is best to avoid lingering at these distances. Watch out for its tail attacks, which possess a wide area of effect and can be devastating if caught off guard. Rakoth inflicts more stun than any other monster; taking damage three times in quick succession will almost certainly leave you immobilized. Because the beast is typically very slow, most of its attacks can be easily dodged with proper positioning. After sustaining enough damage, Rakoth will occasionally curl into a ball and attempt to crush you. If you see it suddenly running in an unusual direction, it is preparing to initiate this rolling attack. Do not allow it to create distance, as this gives it the space needed to freely turn and home in on you. Instead, chase after it. If you stay close enough, its turning radius will be restricted, forcing it to helplessly circle around you instead of landing a direct hit.

zh_cn.text: 岩壳巨兽擅长中短距离作战，因此最好避免在这些距离停留。注意它的尾巴攻击，其范围效果很广，如果被打个措手不及可能会是毁灭性的。岩壳巨兽造成的眩晕比任何其他怪物都多；连续快速受到三次伤害几乎肯定会让你动弹不得。由于该野兽通常非常缓慢，通过适当的定位，大部分攻击都可以轻松躲避。在承受足够伤害后，岩壳巨兽偶尔会卷成一个球并试图碾压你。如果你看到它突然朝不寻常的方向奔跑，说明它正准备发动滚动攻击。不要让它拉开距离，因为这给了它自由转向并锁定你的空间。相反，要追赶它。如果你保持足够近的距离，它的转弯半径就会受到限制，迫使它无助地绕着你打转，而不是直接命中。

en_us.text: Listen here, rookie! I know we're supposed to leave out scrap wood to keep those dopey birds happy, but a particularly greedy Ignathos just broke into my yard and made off with a whole stack of my premium crafting coal! I can't forge any armor if my fuel keeps getting treated like an all-you-can-eat buffet. Head out to the woods and teach that overgrown turkey a lesson. Just... try not to panic it near the tree line, yeah? We don't need a forest fire today.

zh_cn.text: 听好了，菜鸟！我知道我们本该留些废木料让那些呆鸟开心，但一只特别贪心的燃羽鸟刚刚闯进了我的院子，偷走了我一整堆优质工艺煤！如果我的燃料老是被人当成自助餐吃掉，我还怎么打造盔甲？去林子里给那只大火鸡一点教训。只是……尽量别在林线附近把它吓慌了，行吗？我们今天可不想来一场森林大火。

en_us.text: I know the End isn't exactly a peaceful garden, but normally those pests just turn invisible and run away when I come to harvest Chorus Fruit. Well, not this one. I barely took two steps before it dropped its camouflage, flashed me blind, and came at me swinging those awful claws. The ecologists at camp told me she must be nesting, which means no one is safe near her territory. I need you to go clear it out so I can get back to my research. And hey, bring some bandages, those scratches do NOT stop bleeding!

zh_cn.text: 我知道末地不是什么和平花园，但通常我来收割紫颂果的时候，那些害虫只会隐身逃跑。嗯，这只可不一样。我还没走两步，它就解除了伪装，闪瞎了我的眼，然后挥舞着那可怕的爪子扑了过来。营地的生态学家告诉我，它一定是在筑巢，这意味着它的领地附近没人安全。我需要你去把它清理掉，这样我才能回去继续我的研究。嘿，带上些绷带，那些抓伤根本止不住血！

en_us.text: WHAT? YOU'LL HAVE TO SPEAK UP! MY EARS ARE STILL RINGING! I was hauling a premium shipment of glass panes through the crossing when this massive grey shadow dropped out of nowhere. It flared up these blue things on its head and just... screamed! The sheer force of the sound shattered my entire cargo into dust! When I tried to scare it off, it swung a tail the size of an anvil and smashed my cart to splinters. I don't care what the guild calls it, just go out there and shut that flying menace up so I can do my job in peace!

zh_cn.text: 什么？你大声点！我耳朵还在嗡嗡响！我当时正拖着一批高级玻璃板穿过隘口，这时一个巨大的灰色影子不知从哪冒了出来。它展开头上那些蓝色的东西，然后就……尖叫了起来！那声音的纯粹力量把我的整批货物震成了粉末！我想把它吓跑，它却挥动了一条铁砧大小的尾巴，把我的车砸成了碎片。我才不管公会叫它什么呢，赶紧出去把那个飞行祸害给灭了，让我能安安静静地干活！

en_us.text: Ravines out here are dangerous, so I spent my life savings on a brand-new set of heavy Iron armor. Turns out, to a Rakoth, that just makes me look like a premium, canned meal! I was barely swinging my pickaxe before this massive, rocky lizard charged at me, trying to crack me open like a geode. I dropped my tools and ran, but the overgrown pebble curled up into a boulder and literally flattened my entire campsite. I can still hear it slamming its tail out there. Go deal with it!

zh_cn.text: 这里的峡谷很危险，所以我花了一生的积蓄买了一套全新的重型铁甲。结果呢，对岩壳巨兽来说，那只是让我看起来像一份高档罐头大餐！我还没来得及挥几下镐，这只巨大的岩石蜥蜴就冲了过来，想把我像晶洞一样敲开。我扔下工具就跑，但那块大卵石居然蜷成了一个球，literally 把我的整个营地夷为平地。我现在还能听到它在外面甩尾巴的声音。去搞定它！

en_us.text: We thought it was just a rogue iceberg drifting into the shipping lanes. Then it turned and rammed our hull. It's a leviathan, Hunter, a colossal beast cloaked in thick frost, with tusks that sheared right through our reinforced bow. As we abandoned ship, the fog cleared enough for me to see its back. It had massive marine predators, sharks and whales, completely frozen and skewered along its spine like grim trophies. It blasted the water with a freezing wind, locking our ruined ship in the floe to mark its new territory. Hunt it down before it pushes any further south.

zh_cn.text: 我们以为只是一座冰山漂进了航道。然后它转身撞穿了我们的船壳。那是只利维坦，猎人，一只裹着厚厚冰霜的巨兽，它的獠牙直接切开了我们加固的船首。当我们弃船时，雾气散去了一些，让我看到了它的背部。上面有巨大的海洋掠食者，鲨鱼和鲸鱼，被完全冰冻并像阴森的战利品一样串在它的脊椎上。它用一阵寒风轰击水面，将我们毁坏的船只锁在浮冰中，以此标记它的新领地。在它进一步向南推进之前，猎杀它。

en_us.text: Winter is setting in early, and one of those fire-birds just raided our communal woodpile again. We need to restock our firewood, but more importantly, the local tanner says Ignathos plumage makes for incredible thermal insulation. Head into the woods, track it down, and bring back enough feathers to line our winter coats.

zh_cn.text: 冬天来得早，那些火鸟又袭击了我们的公共柴堆。我们需要补充柴火，但更重要的是，当地的皮匠说燃羽鸟的羽毛是极好的隔热材料。去林子里，找到它，带回足够的羽毛来填我们的冬衣。

en_us.text: I thought I was tough enough to take on a Skrythe solo. I was wrong. It shattered my iron shield with one of those sonic blasts and nearly took my head off. I plan on getting my revenge eventually, but first, I need an upgrade. Go hunt one down and bring me back a few of its calcified tail-bones. I'm going to forge a new hammer out of the very thing that beat me.

zh_cn.text: 我以为自己够强，可以独自狩猎一只肆空龙。我错了。它用一发音爆击碎了我的铁盾，差点把我的脑袋也炸飞。我迟早会报仇的，但首先，我需要升级装备。去猎一只回来，给我带几根它的钙化尾骨。我要用打败我的东西来锻造一把新锤子。

en_us.text: We finally struck a massive raw gold vein in the badlands ravine, but the noise of our pickaxes attracted a Rakoth. It started eating the ore straight out of the cavern walls! Get in there and crack its shell before it devours our entire payout. Feel free to keep any of the heavy carapace you break off of it, I hear it makes fantastic plating.

zh_cn.text: 我们终于在恶地峡谷里找到了一条巨大的天然金矿脉，但镐子的噪音引来了一只岩壳巨兽。它开始直接从洞穴壁上啃矿石！进去在它吞掉我们全部收益之前敲碎它的壳。你从它身上敲下来的厚重甲壳可以随意留着，我听说那是做装甲的好材料。

en_us.text: I've finally figured out how to weave that microscopic mirrored fur into a stealth cloak, but my workshop is completely out of materials. I need you to head into the Outer Islands and track down a Rhyza. They are going to be incredibly evasive. You'll have to keep a sharp eye out for their shimmering silhouettes and strike before they flashbang you and vanish.

zh_cn.text: 我终于弄清楚了如何用那种微观镜面皮毛编织隐形斗篷，但我的工作室已经完全没材料了。我需要你去外岛追踪一只锐爪兽。它们会极其难以捉摸。你必须时刻留意它们 shimmer 的轮廓，并在它们用闪光弹晃晕你并消失之前发动攻击。

en_us.text: I'm trying to design a new type of cooling forge, and I need intact Leivekilth materials to make it work. I know hunting a Leivekilth is a massive risk, but if you can isolate one and bring me its parts, I'll forge you a weapon that'll freeze the sea itself.

zh_cn.text: 我正在尝试设计一种新型冷却熔炉，需要完整的凛冰兽材料才能让它工作。我知道猎杀凛冰兽风险极大，但如果你能引开一只并带回它的部件，我会为你锻造一把足以冻结大海的武器。
击杀一只炽热化燃羽鸟

en_us.text: We have a massive problem on the dry plains. An Ignathos was sighted in the Savanna. Between the scorching sun and the dry brush, its internal furnace has completely overheated. It is permanently ignited, hyper-aggressive, and turning the grass to ash with every step. If we don't put this bird down immediately, the entire biome is going to go up in smoke.

zh_cn.text: 我们在干燥的平原上遇到了大麻烦。有人在稀树草原目击到了一只燃羽鸟。在炎炎烈日和干燥灌木丛的影响下，它的内部熔炉已经完全过热。它处于永久点燃状态，极度攻击性，每一步都将草地化为灰烬。如果我们不立刻解决这只鸟，整个生物群系都要烧起来了。

en_us.text: Slay a Leivekilth and Tempered Ignathos

zh_cn.text: 击杀一只凛冰兽和一只炽热化燃羽鸟

en_us.text: An Ignathos has wandered far outside its natural habitat, tracking deep into the frozen shores. That kind of reckless, erratic behavior leads us to believe it is a Tempered specimen. There is a Leivekilth territory dangerously close to a nearby coastal settlement. If the Ignathos agitates the leviathan, the resulting rampage will cause great harm to the village. We cannot take any chances. Head to the coast and take them both out before the situation escalates.

zh_cn.text: 一只燃羽鸟远远离开了它的自然栖息地，深入到了冰冻海岸。这种鲁莽、不稳定的行为让我们相信这是一只炽热化个体。有一处凛冰兽的领地距离附近的沿海定居点非常近。如果燃羽鸟激怒了那头利维坦，由此引发的暴怒将对村庄造成巨大伤害。我们不能冒任何风险。前往海岸，在事态升级之前把它们两个都干掉。

en_us.text: I was clearing out a new tunnel in the badlands and found this round, heavy rock blocking the tracks. It was about the size of a minecart, so I gave it a good whack with my pickaxe to break it up. Big mistake. The 'rock' uncurled, roared, and headbutted my actual minecart off the rails! It's a Rakoth, but it's only half the size of the massive ones we usually see on the surface. Don't let the compact size fool you, it still hits like a runaway train. Go clear it out of our shaft so we can get back to work!

zh_cn.text: 我在恶地清理一条新隧道时，发现了一块堵在轨道上的圆形沉重岩石。它大概有矿车那么大，于是我抡起镐子给它狠狠来了一下，想把它敲碎。大错特错。那块“石头”展开了身体，咆哮着，一头把我真正的矿车撞下了轨道！那是一只岩壳巨兽，但只有我们通常在地面上看到的那些大家伙的一半大小。别被它紧凑的体型骗了，它打人还是跟脱缰的火车一样猛。去把它从我们的矿道里清掉，好让我们回去干活！

en_us.text:
Rush in to your enemy kicking him to do a backflip.
After the backflip rush into your enemy a second time to give him a lethal stab.

zh_cn.text:
冲向敌人并踢中他进行后空翻。
后空翻后，再次冲向敌人给予致命一击。

en_us.text:
Rush in to your enemy kicking him to go into a end portal.
After entering the portal you will use the end lost energy to shatter your enemy in pieces.

zh_cn.text:
冲向你的敌人，踢他进入末影空间。
进入传送门后，你将利用末地之力将敌人击碎。

en_us.text:
Rush in to your enemy kicking him and gaining the height of the rain.
After you reach the sky you will make sure that the rain on your blade will puncture into your enemy's armor.

zh_cn.text:
冲向敌人并踢中他，利用雨水获得高度。
到达天空后，你将确保雨水附着的剑刃穿透敌人的盔甲。

en_us.text:
Rush in to your enemy kicking him and smelling his death wishes.
After listening to your victim, you will please his wishes in the most demonic and brutal way.

zh_cn.text:
冲向敌人并踢中他，感受他的死亡气息。
在聆听受害者的心声后，你将以最恶魔般和残忍的方式满足他的愿望。

en_us.text:
Rush in to your enemy kicking him going high with magic.
After that you will rush with the ancient mana collected inside the amethyst to behind your enemies armor.

zh_cn.text:
冲向敌人并踢中他，利用魔法升空。
之后，你将利用紫水晶中收集的古老魔力穿透敌人的盔甲。

en_us.text: Earned when leveling up the relic and used to upgrade abilities.
You need to upgrade the relic to level %1$s to use this!
This ability has no upgradeable stats and does not affect the relic's quality!
This ability is ready to be upgraded!

Relic quality is the arithmetic average of all currently unlocked abilities' quality and is measured in points from 1 to 5 with a step of 0.5. It is purely a visual metric that shows how close the item's initial random characteristics are to the best possible. To improve the overall quality of the relic, each ability needs to be considered separately.

Earned by using the relic's abilities for their intended purpose, as well as gaining experience from other relics. When the maximum experience value is reached, the relic level and leveling points increase by 1, allowing you to unlock previously unavailable abilities or upgrade existing ones.

Ability quality, similar to relic quality, is the arithmetic average of all the ability's current characteristics and is measured in points from 1 to 5 with a step of 0.5. It is purely a visual metric that shows how close the ability's initial random characteristics are to the best possible. To improve the ability's quality, you need to reset its random characteristics until you get a better value.
The ability has reached its max level.
To use you need to level-up this ability at least 1 time.

zh_cn.text: 使用该能力需要升级一次技能

en_us.text: +1 experience point for each piece eaten from the ability «Regeneration».

zh_cn.text: 使用“再生”时增加1点经验

en_us.text: Using a relic consumes one of the regeneratable charges, replenishing the hunger of the wearer.

zh_cn.text: 使用遗物时回复使用者的饱食度。

en_us.text: Using a potion on the relic in the inventory remembers its effect by spending the potion. Subsequent use of the «Regeneration» ability will impose a summable effect of the associated potion on the wearer. In the complete absence of charges, the relic loses the properties of the associated potion.

zh_cn.text: 把药水倒在遗物上面，遗物会记录药水的效果，之后再次使用“再生”会把记录的药水效果释放给使用者。如果遗物没有充能，将失去记录的药水效果

en_us.text: +1 experience point for using the ability «End Transposition», +1 experience point for every 10 blocks from the distance to the target when using.

zh_cn.text: 使用“移行换位”时增加1点经验，距离目标10格远使用技能额外增加1点经验

en_us.text: Makes endermen neutral with respect to the wearer.

zh_cn.text: 把末影人变为中立生物。

en_us.text: Swaps the wearer with the target along the line of sight.
Grants the wearer the ability to turn enemy healing against them.

zh_cn.text: “祝福”触发时增加1点经验，每治疗1点血增加1点经验。

en_us.text: A toggleable ability with two modes: Sanctity and Unholiness. Activating the ability in any mode fills the internal buffer by 1 unit. In Sanctity mode, redirects a portion of the bearer's healing as damage to nearby targets and reduces incoming damage by 1% per charge. In Unholiness mode, absorbs a portion of the healing of nearby targets and increases damage dealt by 1% per charge.
Burns the health of nearby undead.
Grants the bearer temporary invincibility upon activation, consuming charges from the relic's internal buffer each second.
+1 experience point for each use of the «Wormhole» ability, +1 experience point for every 50 blocks to the teleportation point.

zh_cn.text: 使用“虫洞”时增加1点经验，距离重生点50格方块传送时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: After use, teleports the wearer to their respawn point.

zh_cn.text: 将使用者传送至重生点。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for every 2 glaive bounces from the «Blind Justice» ability.

zh_cn.text: 当“盲正”发射出飞刃反弹时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Usage releases one of 8 glaive charges, bouncing between nearby targets. The missing charges are restored themselves after a certain amount of time.

zh_cn.text: 发射出8片刀刃中的一个，发射出的刀刃会在生物之间弹射。发射的刀刃会在一段时间后自动恢复。

en_us.text: Usage consumes all 8 glaive charges, summoning a saw that deals damage to nearby targets. Reuse will return the saw to the wearer, restoring all charges. Automatic charge regeneration is blocked while the ability is active.

zh_cn.text: 使用时消耗全部刀刃，召唤出暗影飞刃，在范围内持续对生物造成伤害，再次使用将会把暗影飞刃收回。当该技能激活时无法自动恢复刀刃。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for every 10 blocks to the target hit by the shot.

zh_cn.text: 距离至少10格远击中生物时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Shooting primarily uses arrows from the quiver's internal storage. Pressing the LMB with arrow on the quiver in the inventory will place it in the internal storage of the relic. Pressing the RMB on the quiver will get the last stack of arrows placed in it.

zh_cn.text: 在背包内把箭放到箭袋里。

en_us.text: Knocks the player away from the looking direction, inflicting a vanishing effect until landing. Using a bow will suspend the player in mid-air, increasing damage and nullifying gravity for the next critical shot.

zh_cn.text: 将玩家冲击至空中并隐身，落地解除隐身。如果在飞跃期间使用弓会将玩家暂时悬浮在空中，悬浮时增加箭矢的伤害。

en_us.text: Increases the speed of bowstring tension.

Calls on a point along the line of sight an area of falling homing arrows from the internal quiver storage from the «Arrow Storage» ability. The arrows themselves from the storage are not consumed. Only one area from this ability can exist at a time.

zh_cn.text: 召唤一个圆形区域射下箭雨，从“储箭”技能内的箭不会消耗。该技能只能存在一个圆形区域。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for every 5 seconds of flight within the scope of the ability «Eternal Fire».

zh_cn.text: 在“永恒真火”范围内飞行5秒增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Using a relic on a block will create a restricted flight zone, the size of which depends on the amount of fire in a certain radius around the center.

zh_cn.text: 对火焰使用会召唤出一个飘浮区域大小取决于火焰的数量。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for every 10 seconds of burning fuel when placing it in the internal buffer of the relic from the ability «Acceleration».

zh_cn.text: 当使用“加速”在空中飞行10秒时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Using any combustible fuel on a relic in the inventory replenishes its internal buffer. Using the ability during the flight on an elytra rushes the wearer forward, consuming fuel from the internal buffer.

zh_cn.text: 在背包内把任意燃料放到内部。穿戴鞘翅飞行时使用该技能会消耗放置的燃料助推。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for every 2 units of damage when attacking while being invisible from the «Disappearing» ability.

zh_cn.text: 使用“消声觅迹”每造成2次攻击增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Gives the wearer complete invisibility and increases the speed of their movement at a sufficiently low light level.

zh_cn.text: 穿戴时进入阴影，在亮度较低时提高移速。

en_us.text: An attack from the «Vanish» ability deals increased damage, outlining a circle around the target and dispelling the invisibility effect of the wearer. Reuse of the «Vanish» ability is possible only after the wearer leaves the circle.

zh_cn.text: 在生物周围划出一个区域，在区域内阴影解除并将“消声觅迹”的伤害翻倍。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for every 10 damage accumulated in the internal buffer of the relic from the ability «Infernal Hatred».

zh_cn.text: 用“痛苦循环”造成10点伤害时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Accumulates the damage received by the wearer into the internal buffer of the relic. 5 seconds after the last damage or in case of a buffer overflow, the relic explodes, throwing obsidian fragments in all directions, causing damage and stunning targets.

zh_cn.text: 受到伤害时积累本次伤害，在伤害积累到极限或5秒没有受到任何伤害时，向周围发射黑曜石碎片伤害附近生物。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for each activation of the ability «Electric Discharge».

zh_cn.text: 使用“电蛰”时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: The wearer does not sink in water.

zh_cn.text: 穿戴时在水中不会下沉。

en_us.text: Deals damage to targets when colliding with them.

zh_cn.text: 触碰到生物时对它造成伤害。

en_us.text: When the ability is triggered, «Electric Discharge» imposes a paralysis effect on the target.

+1 experience point for each spore released by the «Poison Synthesis» ability.
+1 experience point for each additional spore split by the «Decomposition» ability.

zh_cn.text:
“合毒”释放孢子时增加1点经验
“分裂”生效时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: When taking damage, throws a spore in a random direction that sticks to surfaces and explodes when a target approaches, dealing damage, poisoning, slowing, and blocking healing for 5 seconds.

zh_cn.text: 受到伤害时，向随机方向发射一个孢子，与方块接触时产生一片毒气云，在范围内的生物获得中毒、缓慢、治疗阻断效果。

en_us.text: Each time the «Poison Synthesis» ability cooldown triggers, accumulates one charge into the relic's internal buffer that can be used by other abilities to release spores. Adds a chance not to consume spores from the internal buffer when requesting charges for other abilities.

zh_cn.text: 当“合毒”进入冷却时，将会积累一次能量用于给其他技能。

en_us.text: Each spore can split into several smaller spores within a given range when it explodes. The maximum number of spores is determined by the degree of the main spore size, but the final number is limited by the first unsuccessful chance of spore division.

zh_cn.text: 当孢子爆炸时会分裂出几个小孢子，小孢子数量由孢子大小决定。

en_us.text: Empties the relic's buffer, releasing all accumulated spore charges into the world. The size of the released spores depends on the wearer's missing health.

zh_cn.text: 清空所有能量，将所有的孢子放出，孢子大小由玩家失去的生命值决定。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for every 3 blocks in the fall before triggering the ability «Earthquake».

zh_cn.text: 使用“地震”时每降落三格方块增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Increases the speed of falling, increases the knockback resistance and negates slippering.

zh_cn.text: 增加下落速度和击退抗性。

en_us.text: Using the ability in a fall will create a shockwave at the landing site, causing damage and throwing away nearby targets. Power of the wave depends on the distance that the wearer has flown.

zh_cn.text: 使坠落加快并在落点产生冲击波，伤害以及击退附近的生物，冲击波的强弱由玩家的坠落的高度决定。

en_us.text:
+1/5/10 experience point for each killed Zombified Piglin / Piglin / Piglin Brute.
+1 experience point for each additional trade from the ability «Respect».

zh_cn.text:
杀死僵尸猪灵、猪灵以及疣猪兽时增加1~10点经验。
“尊敬”触发时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Makes piglins neutral in relation to the wearer. The nearest piglin will indicate the location of a bastion nearby.

zh_cn.text: 把猪灵变为中立生物，猪灵会为你指出附近堡垒遗迹的位置。

en_us.text: Each trade with piglins gets a multiple chance of 50% to issue an additional trading result.

zh_cn.text: 与猪灵交易有50%的概率获得额外物品。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for every 25 blocks overcome by a horse called by the ability «Portable Stall».

zh_cn.text: 骑着“千里唤马”召唤出的马，行走25格方块增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Using a relic on the horse will move the animal to the internal storage. Reuse will release the creature. If the distance between the wearer and the summoned horse exceeds 16 blocks, it will automatically fit back into the flute.

zh_cn.text: 对马使用，将马放进马笛里，再次使用将召唤出马。如果召唤出的马与玩家的距离超过16格方块时，马将自动传送至马笛里。

en_us.text: A horse placed in the internal storage will slowly restore health.

zh_cn.text: 当马在马笛里时恢复生命值。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for every 5 units of heating from the ability «Fiery Tread».

zh_cn.text: “熔岩行者”过热值增加5点时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: For a certain amount of time allows you to walk on the lava surface without falling and taking damage. After the time limit expires, the boots begin to overheat and cause damage to the wearer proportional to the degree of overheating.

zh_cn.text: 穿戴时可暂时在熔岩上行走，一段时间后，靴将会过热。对玩家造成伤害

en_us.text: +1 experience point for every 5 units of getting wet from the ability «Moisture Resistance».

zh_cn.text: “潮涌”潮湿值增加5点时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: For a certain amount of time allows you to move on the surface of the water without falling. After the time limit expires, the boots begin to sink, dragging the wearer with them under the water.

zh_cn.text: 穿戴时可暂时在水面上行者，一段时间后，靴将会潮湿，玩家将会下沉。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for each level of enchantment «Riptide» on the trident when using it.

zh_cn.text: 使用三叉戟的“激流”时获得1点经验。

en_us.text: Increases the maximum number of slots for equipping relics.
Reduces the swimming speed and increases the sinking speed of the wearer.

zh_cn.text: 降低游泳速度，增加下沉速度。

en_us.text: Allows you to use the trident «Riptide» ability without rain or water, adding recharge time to it.

zh_cn.text: 允许你在没有雨或水的情况使用三叉戟的“激流”。增加激流的冷却时间。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for each attack made by the wearer's pet.

zh_cn.text: 宠物攻击时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Increases the maximum number of slots for equipping relics.
Increases the damage inflicted by the wearer's pets.
+1 experience point for each experience gained by equipped charms.

zh_cn.text: 装备护身符时获得1点经验

en_us.text: Increases the maximum number of slots for equipping relics.

+1 experience point for every 3 charges from the ability «Berserker Rage» when they are reset.
+1 experience point for each target hit by the «Spurt» ability.

zh_cn.text:
“狂暴”充能3次时增加1点经验。
“蛮撞”每击中1个生物增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Each wearer attack made within 3 seconds after the last one accumulates 1 charge into the internal buffer of the relic. The damage inflicted and received by the wearer, as well as its movement speed and dealt damage increases in proportion to the accumulated charges. After 3 seconds, the internal buffer of the relic is emptied, canceling all bonuses received.

zh_cn.text: 攻击后的3秒内每攻击一次会充能一次，如果受到伤害，增加移动速度和伤害。

en_us.text: Increases the wearer's attack and movement speed, as well as granting passive regeneration proportional to the percentage of the missing health.

zh_cn.text: 穿戴时提升攻击和移速，并根据生命损失的百分比获得生命恢复。

en_us.text: Dashes towards the direction of sight, setting enemies on fire, applying bleeding and attacking each target in its path with the item in the hand. Deals additional damage proportional to the number of charges in the relic's internal buffer from the «Berserker's Rage» ability and devastates it.

zh_cn.text: 冲向所看的方向，对经过的生物造成燃烧，流血效果。对“狂暴”的充能的比例造成额外伤害。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the ability «Skating».

zh_cn.text: “滑冰”每滑行1秒时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Increases the movement speed while on ice depending on the duration of sliding.

zh_cn.text: 在冰上滑行越久速度越快。

en_us.text: When colliding with targets, deals damage proportional to the duration of «Skating» ability usage.

zh_cn.text: “滑冰”撞击到生物会造成伤害。

en_us.text:
+1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the «Fins» ability.
+1 experience point for every second of acceleration from the «Slipping» ability.

zh_cn.text: “蛙泳”每加速1秒时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Accelerates the swimming speed depending on its duration.
Increases movement speed in the rain depending on its duration.
Grants player the ability to not consume air while underwater.
+1 experience point for each second of return from the ability «Time rift».

zh_cn.text: “时空回溯”每回溯1秒时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: When used, returns the wearer along the route traveled after a certain amount of time. Repeated use will terminate the ability.

zh_cn.text: 使用后，将玩家回溯走过的路线，回溯期间再次使用将中止回溯。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for every 10 blocks to the teleportation point from the «Teleportation Control» ability.

zh_cn.text: “可控传送”每传送10格方块时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Using the chorus fruit teleports the wearer to the block along the line of sight within reach.

zh_cn.text: 吃掉紫颂果时，玩家可传送到虚线的方块上。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for every 5 units of size when hit by a snowball from the ability «Mold».

zh_cn.text: “塑形”的冰雪球每增加5点大小并击中生物时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Collecting snow using RMB with an empty hand gradually forms special solid snowballs. Hitting such a snowball on the target will cause damage and stun it, as well as freeze targets nearby. Holding a snowball without an equipped relic also freezes the wearer.

zh_cn.text: 对雪右键可收集到冰雪球，击中生物会造成伤害和眩晕并让周围的生物被冻结。如果玩家没有装备该遗物，冰雪球将会冻结自己。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the ability «Acceleration».

zh_cn.text: “轮滑”每加速1秒时增加1点经验

en_us.text: Increases the movement speed depending on its duration. All blocks become slippery for the wearer.

zh_cn.text: 穿戴时所有方块都会打滑，移动时间越久速度越快。

en_us.text: +1 experience point for each created portal if there is no existing one

zh_cn.text: 创建传送门时增加1点经验。

en_us.text: Holding RMB creates a portal on a point along the line of sight, stopping holding RMB creates a second portal using the same principle, linking it to the first one. Bringing a living creature to one of the portals will move it to the linked portal. Portals don't work if there are any solid blocks in their path.

zh_cn.text: 使用时创建一个传送门，停止使用时创建第二个传送门，当生物进入传送门时会飞跃到另一个传送门，如果传送门的路径含有实体方块，传送门失效。

en_us.text: The item in hand must be a relic!

zh_cn.text: 手上的物品必须时遗物！

en_us.text: Working with the relic in this inventory is not possible. Move item to the player's main inventory and try again.

zh_cn.text: 用研究台查看更多信息
使用该技能需要遗物的等级提高到%1$s %2$s。
该技能没有可改变的属性，不会影响遗物的质量。
附近的生物恢复生命时，佩戴者有概率同时恢复生命。

en_us.text: Keeps the hunger bar always full

zh_cn.text: 使附近的作物快速生长

en_us.text: Pull xp orbs toward the player
Lets the player walk on water

zh_cn.text: 让玩家可以在水上行走

en_us.text: Predict structure locations based on world seed, filtered by whitelist/blacklist.

zh_cn.text: 基于世界种子进行结构位置预测，结合白名单/黑名单筛选。

en_us.text: Prediction radius centered at spawn, in chunks.

zh_cn.text: 以出生点为中心的预测半径（单位：区块）

en_us.text: Prefilter by allowed biomes of selected structures to reduce false positives and checks.

zh_cn.text: 根据所选结构允许生成的群系列表进行预筛，减少海上等不可能位置的错误预测并降低检查次数。
没有权限创建道路连接

en_us.text: No permission to open the map
OPs and explicitly allowed players only

zh_cn.text: 仅 OP 与额外授权玩家
地图开启权限已切换为：%s
已授权以下玩家打开地图：%s

en_us.text: These players already have map access: %s

zh_cn.text: 以下玩家已拥有地图权限：%s
已移除以下玩家的地图权限：%s

en_us.text: These players are not in the map access list: %s

zh_cn.text: 以下玩家当前不在地图权限名单中：%s

en_us.text: [RoadWeaver] Detected legacy road data. Migrating to SQLite...

zh_cn.text: [RoadWeaver] 检测到旧道路数据，正在迁移到 SQLite，请稍候...

en_us.text: [RoadWeaver] Legacy road data migration completed: %s roads.

zh_cn.text: [RoadWeaver] 旧道路数据迁移完成：%s 条。
每格：%s 区块（%s 方块）

en_us.text: At new world start, build network around spawn within this radius (in chunks).

zh_cn.text: 新建世界启动后，以出生点为中心，在该半径内构建初始路网，不要设置太大（建议64），否则新建世界会加载很久！！！

en_us.text: Periodically plan around players as new structures enter the configured radius.

zh_cn.text: 按固定频率围绕玩家进行增量规划，当新结构进入半径范围时加入规划。

en_us.text: Radius around each player (in chunks) to include structures in planning.

zh_cn.text: 以每位玩家为中心的动态规划半径（单位：区块）。

en_us.text: Master switch for the road system. When disabled, road planning/generation and feature placement will be skipped.

zh_cn.text: 道路系统总开关。关闭后将跳过道路规划/生成与 Feature 放置。

en_us.text: If enabled, the mod will pave road surfaces. Disable to prevent paving (useful for planning or markers only).

zh_cn.text: 开启后将铺设道路表面；关闭可仅用于规划/路标，不铺设路面。

en_us.text: If enabled, the mod will pave natural road surfaces. Disable to prevent paving (useful for planning or markers only).

zh_cn.text: 开启后将铺设自然道路表面；关闭可仅用于规划/路标，不铺设路面。与人工道路同时可开启，概率55开。

en_us.text: Only place waypoints/markers instead of paving the road surface.

zh_cn.text: 只放置路标/路点，而不铺设道路表面。

en_us.text: Enable connection to spawn point road
Connect the road from the spawn point to the surrounding structures.

zh_cn.text: 从出生点连接道路到周围结构点。

en_us.text: When enabled, place distance signs near both ends of a road and place warning signs when an over-long sea crossing is skipped.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，会在道路两端放置距离路牌，并在跨海被跳过时放置提示路牌。

en_us.text: Distance (in blocks) from road endpoints to structure centers. Roads will start/end this far from village centers.

zh_cn.text: 道路端点距结构中心的缩进距离（方块）。道路不会直接连到村庄中心，而是在此距离外落地。

en_us.text: Average height samples across N neighboring segments to reduce noise before smoothing.

zh_cn.text: 指定高度平滑半径（方块）

en_us.text: Maximum Y change allowed across 2 segments when slope limiting is enabled.

zh_cn.text: 启用限坡平滑时，连续两段允许的最大高度变化。

en_us.text: When enabled, the road height profile will be smoothed by limiting steep slopes.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，将通过限制最大坡度来平滑道路高度曲线。

en_us.text: Distance (in blocks) from road endpoints to village centers. Roads will start/end this far from villages.

zh_cn.text: 道路端点距村庄中心的缩进距离（方块）。道路不会直接连到村庄中心，而是在此距离外落地。

en_us.text: Distance (in blocks) from road endpoints to non-village structure centers.

zh_cn.text: 道路端点距其他结构（非村庄）中心的缩进距离（方块）。

en_us.text: When enabled, roads will automatically skip segments that fall within structure bounding boxes (e.g., village buildings), preventing roads from damaging structures.

zh_cn.text: 启用后，在道路放置阶段会自动检测并跳过位于结构（如村庄建筑）边界框内的路段，避免道路破坏建筑。

en_us.text: Place a lamp/marker every N segments; larger values place fewer lamps.
Vertical space cleared above the road surface in non-tunnel mode. Higher values carve more headroom but may cut into nearby terrain or structures.

zh_cn.text: 非隧道模式下，从路面上方开始向上清理的高度。数值越大，头顶挖空越高，但越容易切掉周围地形/结构。

en_us.text: When enabled, trees and large plants (bamboo, huge fungi) will not generate on or near roads. This prevents floating trees caused by road cutting.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，树木和大型植物（竹子、巨型蘑菇等）不会在道路上或道路附近生成，避免道路切削造成的浮空树。

en_us.text: Threads used for initial road generation when creating a new world. By default this uses the current machine's available CPU threads. Higher values finish initial loading faster but raise CPU and memory peaks.

zh_cn.text: 创建新世界时用于初始道路生成的线程数。默认充分利用当前电脑的可用 CPU 线程；数值越高初始加载越快，但 CPU 与内存峰值也越高。

en_us.text: Background worker threads used after entering a world by planning, coarse sampling, dynamic road generation, map tasks, and post-processing. This does not affect initial generation. Higher values improve throughput but increase CPU and memory peaks.

zh_cn.text: 进入世界后，规划、粗采样、动态道路生成、地图与后处理共享的后台工作线程数，不影响初始生成。数值越高吞吐越高，但 CPU 与内存峰值也越高。

en_us.text: When enabled, RoadWeaver continues expanding and generating roads near players at the lowest normal-worker priority.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，会在玩家附近无主动生成压力时继续扩张并生成道路。该任务使用普通后台工作池的最低优先级。
A* 寻路采样步长（方块）

en_us.text: Grid step between sampled neighbors for A*. Larger values reduce nodes and improve performance but may reduce path fidelity. Default 8.

zh_cn.text: A* 在网格上的邻居采样间距。数值越大节点越少，性能更好但路径精度降低。默认 8。

en_us.text: Cap the number of road generation tasks running in parallel after entering a world. This does not affect initial generation.

zh_cn.text: 进入世界后同时进行道路生成的最大任务数上限，不影响创建世界时的初始生成。

en_us.text: Maximum search steps for A* algorithm per generation to prevent infinite loops in complex terrain. Default 200000.

zh_cn.text: A* 算法单次搜索的最大步数限制，防止在复杂地形中无限搜索。默认 200000。

en_us.text: When high precision is enabled, how many extra chunk rings to sample around chunks touched by the coarse path. 0 = touched chunks only; 1 = sample one extra ring around them by default.

zh_cn.text: 高精度采样时，基于粗寻路路径，对命中区块向四周额外辐射的区块圈数。0 = 仅采样路过区块；1 = 默认额外辐射 1 圈区块。

en_us.text: Fast: everything for speed, may produce floating roads or land paths through water. Precise: high-precision sampling, best road quality, stable water detection.

zh_cn.text: 快速：一切为了速度，可能会出现浮空路或水中陆地；高精：高精度采样，道路质量最佳，水域判定稳定

en_us.text: Choose which pathfinding algorithm to use when generating roads.

zh_cn.text: 选择道路生成时所使用的寻路算法。
启用双向 A* 寻路（实验性）

en_us.text: Toggle between classic single-direction A* and bidirectional A* that searches from both endpoints.

zh_cn.text: 在经典单向 A* 与双向 A*（起点和终点同时搜索）之间进行切换。

en_us.text: No map data for this area yet. Wait for planning and coarse sampling to finish.

zh_cn.text: 该区域暂无地图数据，请先等待规划与道路粗采样完成。

en_us.text: Step size (in chunks) for triggering dynamic planning as players move; larger stride triggers less frequently.

zh_cn.text: 用于触发动态规划的步进（单位：区块）；步进越大，触发频率越低。

en_us.text: Choose the primary edge algorithm for road network planning: KNN = sparse local graph; Delaunay = more uniform but denser mesh; RNG = sparser skeleton; MST = tree with minimum total edge length; Snap-Branch = sparse trunk + point-to-line snapping branches (T-junction style).

zh_cn.text: 选择路网规划的主连边算法：KNN = 局部稀疏、近似街区；Delaunay = 稠密路网；RNG = 稀疏网状；MST = 最小总边长树；点线吸附三岔 = 先建稀疏主干，再把邻近点吸附到线段形成三岔路口。

en_us.text: Plan primary edges with MST (tree with minimum total edge length).

zh_cn.text: 使用最小生成树（总边长最小的树）规划主边。

en_us.text: When enabled, plan primary edges with Delaunay triangulation; otherwise use K-Nearest Neighbors.

zh_cn.text: 启用后使用德劳内三角剖分规划主边；否则使用 K 近邻算法。
使用 K 近邻算法

en_us.text: Plan primary edges with KNN (sparse, local connections).

zh_cn.text: 使用 KNN（稀疏的局部连接）规划主边。

en_us.text: Plan primary edges with RNG (sparser skeleton).

zh_cn.text: 使用相对邻域图（RNG，骨架更稀疏）规划主边。

en_us.text: Build elevated decks over water spans identified by the path analyzer.

zh_cn.text: 在路径分析标记的水域跨越区段上架设高架桥面。
桥面高度 = 海平面 + 净空。
桥梁跨度最大长度（方块）

en_us.text: If a water span is longer than this value, the entire span will be skipped (no bridge and no road). Set to 0 for unlimited.

zh_cn.text: 当单段水域跨度超过该值时，将跳过该跨度（不建桥也不铺路）。设为 0 表示不限制。

en_us.text: If enabled, place buoys on water spans instead of building a bridge.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，在水域跨度上放置浮标标记，而不是修建桥梁。

en_us.text: Use Buoys When Bridge Is Skipped
If enabled, when a bridge span is skipped due to exceeding max length, buoys will be placed on that span instead.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，当桥梁跨度因超过最大长度而被跳过时，将在该水域跨度上放置浮标作为标记。

en_us.text: Distance between buoys along a water span.

zh_cn.text: 沿水域跨度方向放置浮标的间隔距离。

en_us.text: Place supporting piers every N segments along the bridge.

zh_cn.text: 每隔 N 个桥面段放置一组桥墩。

en_us.text: Square cross-section width for each pier (1-3).
Stop extending a pier downward once this height is reached.

zh_cn.text: 向下延伸到遇到可承重方块或达到该高度上限即停止。

en_us.text: If enabled, keep road lamps/markers on bridge spans.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，在桥段允许保留路灯/路标。

en_us.text: Number of segments used to smoothly ramp from ground height to deck height at both bridge ends.
Press %s to open the RoadWeaver map.

zh_cn.text: 按 %s 打开 RoadWeaver 地图。

en_us.text: You can configure the initial planning radius in the RoadWeaver settings.

zh_cn.text: 你可以在 RoadWeaver 设置中配置初始规划半径。

en_us.text: A large initial planning radius may significantly slow down new world creation.

zh_cn.text: 较大的初始规划半径可能会显著降低新世界的创建速度。

en_us.text: Initial loading is to ensure you have a complete road when entering the world.

zh_cn.text: 初始加载是为了确保你进入世界时有完整的道路。

en_us.text: Don't tp into the area where the road has not been paved!

zh_cn.text: 不要 tp 到未铺设的道路区域！

en_us.text: Tectonic is installed. It can severely slow down pathfinding, so please be patient...

zh_cn.text: 您已加入 Tectonic 地形模组，会严重拖慢寻路速度，请耐心等待喵......

en_us.text: Base cost for orthogonal steps. Higher values discourage orthogonal movement.

zh_cn.text: 正交移动的基础成本。数值越高，越不倾向于正交移动。

en_us.text: Base cost for diagonal steps. Higher values discourage diagonal movement.

zh_cn.text: 对角移动的基础成本。数值越高，越不倾向于对角移动。

en_us.text: Weight for elevation changes. Higher values prefer flatter terrain.

zh_cn.text: 高度变化的成本权重。数值越高，越偏好平坦地形。

en_us.text: Weight for biome cost (e.g., rivers, oceans).

zh_cn.text: 特定生物群系（如河流、海洋）的成本权重。

en_us.text: Weight for terrain stability. Higher values avoid cliffs and pits.

zh_cn.text: 地形稳定性的成本权重。数值越高，越倾向于避开悬崖和坑洞。

en_us.text: Weight for water depth. Higher values avoid deep water.

zh_cn.text: 水深的成本权重。数值越高，越倾向于避开深水区。

en_us.text: Cost for being near water. Higher values prefer to stay away from water.

zh_cn.text: 靠近水源的成本。数值越高，越倾向于远离水源。

en_us.text: Graduated cost for proximity to water (0-3 layers). Higher values push paths further from shorelines. Each layer adds this cost.

zh_cn.text: 渐变式水域回避成本（0-3层）。数值越高，路径越远离水岸。每层距离会累加该成本。

en_us.text: Weight for the heuristic. Higher values push the path more directly towards the goal.

zh_cn.text: 启发式算法的权重。数值越高，路径越倾向于直接朝向目标。

en_us.text: Weight for deviation from a straight line. Higher values prefer straighter paths.

zh_cn.text: 路径偏离起点-终点直线的成本权重。数值越高，越偏好直线路径。

en_us.text: When enabled, decorative structures (benches, campfires, coffee houses) will be placed along roads based on biome and road length.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，道路旁会根据群系和道路长度放置装饰结构（长椅、营火、咖啡屋等）。

en_us.text: Maximum number of roadside structures to place per road. Set to 0 to disable structures.

zh_cn.text: 每条道路上最多放置多少个路边结构。设为0则不放置任何结构。

en_us.text: Minimum distance between roadside structures in blocks. Larger values result in sparser distribution.

zh_cn.text: 两个路边结构之间的最小间隔距离（方块）。数值越大，结构分布越稀疏。

en_us.text: Distance from road center for small structures (e.g., benches, campfires) in blocks.

zh_cn.text: 小型结构（如长椅、营火）距离道路中心的偏移距离（方块）。

en_us.text: Distance from road center for medium structures (e.g., coffee houses) in blocks.

zh_cn.text: 中型结构（如咖啡屋）距离道路中心的偏移距离（方块）。

en_us.text: Distance from road center for large structures in blocks.

zh_cn.text: 大型结构距离道路中心的偏移距离（方块）。

en_us.text: When enabled, generate clustered village pieces along suitable road sections.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，会在合适的道路区间旁生成成组的村庄结构。

en_us.text: Maximum number of roadside village clusters to precompute for each generated road. Higher values make villages more frequent.

zh_cn.text: 每条生成道路最多预计算多少个路边村庄集群。数值越高，村庄越频繁。

en_us.text: Probability for each road to generate a roadside village. 0.3 means 30% of roads will have villages.

zh_cn.text: 每条道路生成路边村庄的概率。0.3 表示 30% 的道路会生成路边村庄。

en_us.text: Only build bridges over water columns whose depth (sea level minus ocean floor) is at least this many blocks. Helps ignore shallow puddles.

zh_cn.text: 只有当水深（海平面高度减去海底高度）不少于该值时，才会考虑在其上架桥，用于忽略浅水坑。

en_us.text: Minimum span length (in road segments) required to actually place a bridge. Shorter water runs are treated as normal terrain.

zh_cn.text: 桥梁跨度（按道路段计）至少达到该长度才会实际生成，否则视为普通地形处理。

en_us.text: Merge nearby bridge spans whose gap is at most this many segments to avoid frequent up-and-down decks over small islands or sand bars.

zh_cn.text: 若两个桥梁区间之间的空档不超过该段数，则自动合并为一整段桥梁，以避免在小沙洲/小岛上频繁起伏。

en_us.text: CPU usage ratio for worker threads (1-100%). 100% = full speed; 50% = work 20ms then rest 20ms, etc. Lower values reduce CPU load but slow down road generation.

zh_cn.text: 工作线程的CPU占用比例（1-100%）。100% = 满载运行；50% = 工作20ms后休息20ms，以此类推。降低此值可减少CPU占用，但道路生成会变慢。

en_us.text: CPU duty cycle for low-priority idle generation tasks (1-100%). Default 20%. Lower values save CPU but generate idle roads slower.

zh_cn.text: 低优先级闲时生成任务的 CPU 占用比例（1-100%）。默认 20%。值越低越省资源，但闲时生成速度更慢。
启用 OpenCL 粗高度采样

en_us.text: When enabled, coarse terrain height sampling prefers OpenCL acceleration and falls back to CPU if unavailable or failed. When disabled, CPU is always used.

zh_cn.text: 开启后，粗地形高度采样优先使用 OpenCL 加速；不可用或失败时回退 CPU。关闭后始终使用 CPU。

en_us.text: Select the OpenCL device type for coarse height sampling. AUTO prefers GPU first, then CPU OpenCL.

zh_cn.text: 选择粗高度采样使用的 OpenCL 设备类型。AUTO 会优先 GPU，再尝试 CPU OpenCL。

en_us.text: Only try OpenCL when one coarse height request reaches this many samples. 0 means every coarse tile can try OpenCL.

zh_cn.text: 单次粗高度采样样本数达到该值才尝试 OpenCL。0 表示所有粗采样 tile 都尝试 OpenCL。

en_us.text: When enabled, CPU output is used to validate OpenCL results. On mismatch, OpenCL is disabled for this session and CPU is used. Debug option with high overhead.

zh_cn.text: 开启后会用 CPU 结果校验 OpenCL 输出；发现不一致时禁用本次会话的 OpenCL 并回退 CPU。调试用，性能开销较高。

en_us.text: Player ally management will appear here.

Raevyxians are ancient storm-bound apex predators whose dominance is expressed not through constant aggression, but through selective, overwhelming enforcement of territory. Emotionally aware and socially complex, they rely on inherited behaviors rather than instinct alone, making improper upbringing fatal. Their rarity is not due to weakness, but restraint.

zh_cn.text: 殷雷龙是古老的、 与风暴紧密相连的顶级掠食者， 它们不会不停地扩张领土 来确立地位，而是选择性的、 压倒性的统治领地杀鸡儆猴。 它们具有情感意识 和复杂的社会意识， 比起顺从本能 更倾向于选择学习继承的行为， 因此不当的抚养无异于自杀。 他们的稀有的原因是克制 绝非弱小。

en_us.text: Ignivoruses are primordial firebound titans whose presence reshapes environments through sheer thermal dominance. Unlike Raevyx, whose authority is enforced through restraint, Ignivoruses exert control by occupation. Where one settles, the land does not recover. Native primarily to the Nether, Ignivoruses are believed to have originated in extreme...

zh_cn.text: 噬焰龙是原始的、 与火焰相连的泰坦， 是一种纯粹用高温 就能重塑环境的存在。 不同于用克制树立权威的殷雷龙， 噬焰龙更喜欢用侵略来施加控制。 巨龙栖息之地亦是死寂荒芜之地。

en_us.text: ...volcanic ecosystems where constant exposure to magma and hellfire selected for organisms capable of converting ambient heat into sustained power. Their rare appearances in the Overworld are not migratory, but anomalous, often linked to ancient interdimensional traversal or forced displacement. Ignivoruses are not mindless engines of destruction. They are patient...

zh_cn.text: 噬焰龙主要出生在下界， 据信起源于极端火山生态系统， 那里永远暴露在岩浆和狱火中， 从而孕育出 能够用环境热量 维持自身力量的生命。 在主世界，它们的罕见出现 不是周期迁徙，是异常现象， 通常是因为古老的跨维度穿梭， 但也存在因其他原因而 被迫漂泊的情况。

en_us.text: and acutely aware of hierarchy. Aggression is not constant, but once provoked, escalation is absolute. An Ignivorus does not retreat. It overwhelms.

zh_cn.text: 噬焰龙并非无意识的毁灭引擎。 它们很耐心 且对等级制度高度敏感。 侵略偶有暂停，然而一旦被激怒， 怒火将袭来的更加澎湃。 噬焰龙不会撤退，只会碾碎。

en_us.text: Varasuchuses are adaptive abyssal predators whose threat lies not in overwhelming force, but in delayed commitment. Commonly encountered in coastal and aquatic regions, Varasuchus initially present as quadrupedal, semi-terrestrial hunters exhibiting restrained aggression and minimal energy expenditure. Early observers frequently misidentified this behavior...

zh_cn.text: 蜷鳄龙是适应性强的深海掠食者， 它们的威胁不在压倒性的力量， 而在于滞后的暴动。 常见于沿海和水域地区。 蜷鳄龙最初表现为四足、 半陆生的猎食者， 拥有克制的侵略欲望 和最小的能量消耗。

en_us.text: ...as docility or passivity. This assumption is universally fatal as Varasuchuses possess a unique phase-shifting physiology, allowing them to reconfigure posture, musculature, and combat behavior in response to sustained threat. The transition from quadrupedal to bipedal stance marks a decisive escalation, not an emotional one.

zh_cn.text: 早期观察者常将此行为 视为被动温顺， 然而这一假设是致命的错误。 蜷鳄龙拥有独特的 相位转换生理机能， 让它们能根据威胁调整身形姿态、 肌肉组织和战斗行为。 从四足到双足的转换是 关键的进化， 不是情绪主导的行为。

en_us.text: Once upright, Varasuchus abandon environmental tolerance and engage with deliberate, methodical violence. Their presence near civilization is rarely accidental. Records indicate that settlements which mistook Varasuchus’ initial restraint for safety rarely survived long enough to document its second phase.

zh_cn.text: 直立时，蜷鳄龙放弃 对环境的容忍， 展现出蓄意的、 有条不紊的暴力。 它们偶尔会出现在文明附近。 记录显示，那些误将蜷鳄龙的 容忍视为温顺的定居点， 很少能存活足够长的时间 来记录其第二阶段。

en_us.text: Cindervanes are not conquerors, nor guardians. They are carriers. Early trade routes, evacuation corridors, and messenger networks were built around known Cindervane migratory paths. Their eggs, scattered rather than hoarded, suggest deliberate dispersion, either by the dragons themselves or by civilizations that understood...

zh_cn.text: 烬翎龙既非征服者， 也非守护者。它们是载体。 早期的贸易路线、疏散通道 和信使网络都建立在 已知的烬翎龙迁徙路径上。 它们的蛋是零散分布的， 这显然是刻意的手笔， 要么由龙自己， 要么由深知其作为移动生命线 而非武器的文明所致。

en_us.text: ...their value as mobile lifelines rather than weapons. Cindervanes lack complex combat instincts not due to weakness, but specialization. They do not linger in battle. When threatened, they escalate vertically, ignite, and end the encounter in a single decisive descent. Survival over supremacy.

zh_cn.text: 烬翎龙缺乏复杂的战斗本领， 这不是因为它们软弱， 而是因为它们专精于别处。 它们从不恋战。 当受到威胁时，它们垂直上升， 耀炎附身， 用一次决定性的俯冲结束战斗。 对于他们而言，生存高于霸权。

en_us.text: Stegonauts' presence defines safe ground, forming mobile bastions around those they are bound to protect. Stegonauts exhibit strong social imprinting and defensive prioritization, willingly placing themselves between danger and allied entities without provocation. Historical accounts imply that early riders used Stegonauts as living shields during...

zh_cn.text: 坚甲龙是安全的标志， 它们把要保护的盟友围绕起来， 形成移动堡垒。 坚甲龙表现出强烈的社会性， 遵循防御优先的准则， 愿意在未被挑衅的情况下 用自己把危险和盟友隔开。

en_us.text: ...dragon-mounted assaults, charging alongside faster aerial units while absorbing retaliatory force. This explains their compatibility with other mounts and their unique ability to protect allied pets and players mid-engagement.

zh_cn.text: 历史记录表明， 早期的骑手进行龙骑兵攻坚时， 会把坚甲龙当作盾牌， 与更快的空中单位一同冲锋， 从而打出精彩的回击。 这解释了它们与 其他坐骑的兼容性， 以及它们在战斗中 保护盟友宠物和玩家的独特行为。

en_us.text: Volitans dwell where land and water blur into one another. Where water stagnates long enough, where rot settles and refuses to leave, where fish float belly-up and the air carries a metallic sting… something begins to form beneath the surface. Not immediately. Not quickly. But inevitably. Unlike other dragons, Volitans do not chase prey across great distances...

zh_cn.text: 蓑鲉龙栖息在 水陆交界模糊的地带， 死水淤积，腐烂沉蓄， 鱼群浮肚，锈臭刺鼻... 水面下神秘的轮廓孕育而生， 不骄不躁，也不可终止。 不同于其他龙种， 蓑鲉龙不会长距离的追逐猎物。

en_us.text: They choose a territory… and become part of it. The water settles around them. The soil softens. The air itself carries a weight that lingers in the lungs. Intruders often mistake this for decay. It is not decay. It is pressure. Volitans do not rely on speed alone to dominate their domain. Instead, they reshape the battlefield. Toxic spines erupt not as...

zh_cn.text: 他们会选择一片领地... 乃至成为其一部分。 水域在他们周围停滞， 泥沙变得松软， 就连空气本身也会成为肺的负担。 入侵者常会把这种现象视为腐烂， 但这其实是某种压力。 蓑鲉龙不单靠速度来巩固统治， 他们还会重塑战场。

en_us.text: ...wild attacks, but as warnings… lines drawn in space. Their breath hangs in the air and clings to the ground, forcing movement, limiting escape. Despite their overwhelming presence, Volitans are not needlessly destructive. They do not scorch, nor do they ravage endlessly. Once intruders are driven out, the waters calm, the air clears, and the land returns to stillness.

zh_cn.text: 喷射的毒棘不是攻击的信号， 而是一种警告，并划出界线。 他们的吐息紧贴地表，悬停半空， 迫使移动，限制脱逃。 尽管他们是一种令人窒息的存在， 但也不会无缘无故的破坏。 蓑鲉龙不会喷火，不会劫掠， 一旦闯入者被驱离， 水域便平静下来， 空气恢复清澈， 大地回归沉寂。

en_us.text: Nulljaws are quiet End drifters that spend almost their entire existence suspended in open air. They neither dive for dominance nor settle into territory in the way other dragons do. Instead, they linger, observe, and glide in loose groups through the void-touched barrens.

zh_cn.text: 虚颚龙是末地里孤寂的漂客， 它们几乎完全生活在悬浮的空间。 它们不像其他龙类， 既不争夺地位，又不占据领地。 相反的，他们飘泊，观察， 松散的族群泊过 与虚空相抵的蛮荒之地。
