en_us.text: Back to what I was saying...
Now, where did I leave off...? Oh, yes.

zh_cn.text: 现在，让我看看我讲到哪了…嗯，没错…

en_us.text: Right, we were talking about this...
Hm... aside from the Endermen and the Ender Dragon? I quite like it here.

zh_cn.text: 嗯…不算末影人还有末影龙的话，我其实还挺喜欢这里的。

en_us.text: As long as you don't look an Enderman in the eyes, you're fine. And after the Ender Dragon has been defeated, there's nothing to worry about.

zh_cn.text: 毕竟只要不看末影人的眼睛就不会有危险。如果再把末影龙杀掉，那可就高枕无忧啦。

en_us.text: I get to see the Nulljaws floating around, doing their own thing and minding their own business. I also get to try the 'local' cuisine, most notably Chorus Fruit.

zh_cn.text: 到处都是漂浮的虚颚龙，各行其是互不打扰。我还尝了一点本地土特产，尤其是紫颂果。

en_us.text: I was teleported near the edge of the barrens when I bit into one! It would've been the end for me, pun intended, had a Nulljaw not saved me because it was attracted to the Chorus Fruit in my hand...

zh_cn.text: 我摘下紫颂果刚咬一口，下一秒竟然出现在悬崖边上！要不是有只虚颚龙被我手里的紫颂果吸引过来，我在末地可就真的走向末路了…

en_us.text: And I've always wondered what would hatch from the Ender Dragon's egg. I think it'd look like a slimmer Ignivorus, don't you?

zh_cn.text: 我一直在想末影龙蛋会孵出什么来，我觉得应该是一只瘦一点的噬焰龙，你觉得呢？

en_us.text: But... there's one thing I've got to tell you.

zh_cn.text: 不过…有件事情我必须告诉你。

en_us.text: Recently, travelers in the End have seen... horrid creatures. Not Nulljaws, of course, but dark, ravenous beasts whose birthing sacks have mysteriously appeared.

zh_cn.text: 这段时间，末地的探险家们看到了…可怕的东西。当然，不是虚颚龙，而是一种未知的育生囊，属于一种通体漆黑，饥饿不堪的凶兽。

en_us.text: Thankfully, they only seem to spawn when approached.

zh_cn.text: 万幸的是，似乎必须有东西靠近，这种育生囊才会孕育怪物。

en_us.text: However, their presence is quite concerning. I've only visited the End Barrens a few times, and I don't intend to venture there alone again.

zh_cn.text: 话虽如此，这种东西也实在危险，我还是放不下心。末地荒地我只去过几次，以后也不打算独自回去探险。

en_us.text: With your help, however, we may be able to weaken them.

zh_cn.text: 但这次有你在… 可能这次，我们能削弱它们的力量。

en_us.text: As we travel through the End Barrens, you'll see what I mean.

zh_cn.text: 等穿越末地荒地的时候，你就明白我的意思了。

en_us.text: Back to what I was saying...
Now, where did I leave off...? Oh, yes.

zh_cn.text: 现在，让我看看我上次说到哪了…嗯，没错…

en_us.text: Right, we were talking about this...
Oh, hi there. I didn't expect to see anyone here. Most people don't find this place by accident. You must love exploring, hm?

zh_cn.text: 嗨，你好！没想到能在这里见到活人。大多数人都不是偶然发现这个地方的，我猜你一定很爱冒险吧？
我可不是你口中的“大多数”。
美丽的女士，我为我鲁莽的闯入致以诚挚的歉意。

en_us.text: I was told a trader lived out here.

zh_cn.text: 我听说有个商人住这儿？

en_us.text: Oh? That's either confidence or a warning. I haven't decided which. So... friendly or not?

zh_cn.text: 说这话的人，要么是自信，要么在示威…你是哪一种？是朋友，还是敌人？

en_us.text: I was hoping you'd say that... it's nice to make your acquaintance.

zh_cn.text: 我正希望你这么说呢…很高兴和你交朋友。

en_us.text: Okaaay... Well, I was hoping you'd not say that...

zh_cn.text: 哦…好吧，我还以为你会选另一个。

en_us.text: No, you are not. Why would you think that? Oh, wait, yeah. It'd make sense for you to think so... but no, %1$s, you're not.

zh_cn.text: 没有没有，没有这回事。你怎么会这么想…哦，对，在你的角度看好像的确…总之没关系，%1$s，你不需要给我道歉。

en_us.text: Welcome to my home. Where I live alone and... peaceful.

zh_cn.text: 欢迎你来我家！我一个人住所以家里比较…清静。

en_us.text: Ah, hey-ho, stranger. Yes. You found her. Would you like to see my wares?

zh_cn.text: 啊~嘿吼！各位走过路过千万不要错过！你想找的人就是我！来看看特价商品吗？原味的龙食，衣服还有盔甲火热销售中！
什么？你还卖“原味的衣服”？？

en_us.text: Yes, I'd like to trade with you.
...E-Excuse me? What--what was that supposed to mean? Was it such a good idea to say that to someone who you did not know?

zh_cn.text: …什，什么？你这，你这是什么意思？你对不认识的人说这些话合适吗？

en_us.text: Well, your fault for not specifying!

zh_cn.text: 明明是你不说清楚在先！

en_us.text: WHAT?? Wha--you should've... you shouldn't even be thinking about that in the first place!

zh_cn.text: 什么？？你根本就…你最开始就不该想入非非！

en_us.text: Then? Would you like to trade with me?
Excellent. I have some good stuff you'd like to take a look at.

zh_cn.text: 很好，我可准备了不少宝贝。

en_us.text: That's a fair question. A trader, mostly.

zh_cn.text: 问的好。大多数时候，我是一名商人。

en_us.text: And occasionally the person people bother when they need dragon-related advice.

zh_cn.text: 偶尔也是被打扰，要求解答与龙有关问题的人。

en_us.text: Though I suppose that doesn't really answer your question, does it?

zh_cn.text: 不过我猜这并不是你想要的答案，对吧？

en_us.text: With that being said, would you like to trade?

zh_cn.text: 话说回来，你想买点东西吗？

en_us.text: Yes, I'd like to trade with you.
I'll show you what I have.
Well, anyway. My name is Ivy. Ivy Oleander. The last name is kind of uncommon. Rare, even. But yeah, you?

zh_cn.text: 嗯，总之，我的名字是常春藤，常春藤·夹竹桃。我的姓氏不太常见，甚至说有点罕见。那么你呢？
你的名字和你本人一样漂亮。
我似乎从未听过有人会把常春藤当名字。

en_us.text: Just call me Ivy. Gonna tell me your name?

zh_cn.text: 叫我常春藤就可以。你要告诉我你的名字吗？

en_us.text: ...Thank you. Most people just say it sounds like a plant. Which, well. It is. Two of them, actually.

zh_cn.text: …谢谢。大家都问为什么用植物当名字。呃，的确是植物。准确的说，是两种植物。

en_us.text: Most people don't catch that. You're more observant than you look.

zh_cn.text: 很少有人会在意这点，你比看上去更加心细。

en_us.text: That's kind of the point, I think. My mother had a thing for unusual things.

zh_cn.text: 我觉得那正是重点。我妈妈就是喜欢一些不寻常的东西。

en_us.text: Though if you've somehow met another Oleander, I'd be very interested to hear about it.

zh_cn.text: 不过如果你还遇到过其他姓夹竹桃的人，一定要和我讲讲这些故事。

en_us.text: What would you like me to call you?
What am I calling you, then?
It's a pleasure meeting you, %1$s. I'm sure we'll get along just fine.

zh_cn.text: %1$s，很高兴认识你。以后还请多多关照。

en_us.text: Welp, not much of a pleasure, %1$s. But better than nothing.

zh_cn.text: 好吧，%1$s，不是很高兴认识你。至少聊胜于无。

en_us.text: You again. Still not friendly, or was that just your opening act?

zh_cn.text: 又是你。依旧不是朋友，还是你要来大做文章？

en_us.text: Well, if it isn't the 'not friendly' person.

zh_cn.text: 哇哦，这不是那位“谁跟你好啊”先生吗？

en_us.text: Hi, 'friend.' Or maybe you're not friend?
Hello again. Still not trespassing, before you ask.

zh_cn.text: 又见面啦。这次就不用“致以诚挚的歉意”了。
大驾光临，有失远迎，久闻%1$s大名——哈哈哈哈，我不行了…

en_us.text: Oh it's the trespass-- %1$s, I mean, it's %2$s! Hi.

zh_cn.text: 哦，是闯宅大盗——%1$s，我是说，%2$s，你好吗！

en_us.text: If you're here to make another joke, I reserve the right to charge extra.

zh_cn.text: 你要是专程来拿我寻开心，可得加钱。
说真的，我的“原味衣服”？非——常幽默。

en_us.text: What a great first impression you've just left behind...

zh_cn.text: 我现在怀念起你留下的第一印象了…

en_us.text: Back again? I was starting to think the woods scared you off.

zh_cn.text: 又回来了？我在想是不是树林把你给吓跑了。

en_us.text: Ah, %1$s! I thought I heard something walking around.

zh_cn.text: 啊，%1$s！我好像听到有东西在四处走动。

en_us.text: Careful, %1$s. Keep showing up like this and I might think you enjoy my company.

zh_cn.text: 小心点，%1$s。你要是一直就这么频繁出现，我会怀疑你只是想和我待在一起。

en_us.text: Good to see you again! Try not to let that go to your head.

zh_cn.text: 很高兴再次见到你！可别因为这句话就迷上我了。
我可以查看你的背包吗？

en_us.text: What do I do if you can't get to me?

zh_cn.text: 如果你到不了我这儿，该怎么办？

en_us.text: What are your thoughts on the Nether, Ivy?

zh_cn.text: 常春藤，对于下界你有什么看法？，

en_us.text: We're here in the End. What's on your mind?

zh_cn.text: 我们正踏足末地。你有什么想说的？

en_us.text: What do you do out here?

zh_cn.text: 你在这儿通常都做些什么？

en_us.text: You know a lot about dragons?
Oh, right! I'm glad you asked, actually. I almost forgot.

zh_cn.text: 哦，对，幸好你问了，我都快忘了这个。

en_us.text: I'll give you an item that will help you, and it is quite important to me. I trust you'll keep it safe.

zh_cn.text: 我有一个神奇的妙妙小道具，对我而言这是十分重要的东西，但我相信你可以保管好它。

en_us.text: Whenever I can't get to you, use this, and well, something magical will happen, for lack of a better explanation.

zh_cn.text: 无论你在哪里，只要用这个，然后，呃，就会有神奇的事情发生。我尽力解释清楚。

en_us.text: I will be able to appear near you. I'll get used to being transported suddenly.

zh_cn.text: 然后我就会你的身边突然出现。啊，都快习惯突然被传走的感觉了。

en_us.text: You're welcome. Try not lose it, hm? You won't get a second one.

zh_cn.text: 不客气。尽量别弄丢了，嗯？我这里可没有备用的。
是的，确实有一个不情之请。

en_us.text: Ah, I see you've made up your mind.

zh_cn.text: 哈，我看你已经下定决心了。

en_us.text: I'll stay here. Please don't die in your adventuring.

zh_cn.text: 我就待在这儿，你可别先死了。

en_us.text: Please don't go for too long.
Don't you dare forget about me.

zh_cn.text: 我就待在这儿，等你等到天荒地老海枯石烂沧海桑田物是人非。

en_us.text: I'll be here eating dirt, then.

zh_cn.text: 我就待在这儿，饿了就啃点泥吃点土。

en_us.text: I'll be wandering around until you come back.
I'll hanging about until you come back.

zh_cn.text: 那我一边闲逛一边等你。

en_us.text: Back to what I was saying...
Now, where did I leave off...? Oh, yes.

zh_cn.text: 现在，让我看看我讲到哪了…嗯，没错…

en_us.text: Right, we were talking about this...
But it's enough to know when someone is about to get killed. Which is, unfortunately, often.

zh_cn.text: 我只是恰好猜到人们什么时候会被杀掉。不幸的是，这种事经常发生。

en_us.text: And it's enough to know people are usually wrong about them.

zh_cn.text: 并且恰好知道人们对它们的看法通常是错的而已。

en_us.text: Most people talk about dragons like they're all the same. Big wings, sharp teeth, bad temper. Blah, blah, blah.

zh_cn.text: 大多数人提起龙来都描述的差不多，大翅膀，大尖牙，大坏脾气，巴拉巴拉巴拉…

en_us.text: That's like saying every person with a sword is a knight.

zh_cn.text: 说得好像每个拿剑的人都是骑士一样。

en_us.text: Or like, if a cat suddenly makes barking-like sounds, it's a dog. Does that make sense? No? %1$s, anyway.

zh_cn.text: 或者说，如果一只猫突然发出像狗一样的声音，那它就成狗了，明白了吗？不明白？%1$s，总之…

en_us.text: Yep. I know. When it comes to dragons, it's not really a walk-in-the-park sort of situation.

zh_cn.text: 嗯，我知道。说到龙，龙可不是随随便便就能拿捏的对象。

en_us.text: I did have help from a guy with the name that has something to do with your diaphragm involuntarily slamming downward super fast.

zh_cn.text: 我确实也得到过别人的帮助，那个人的名字和打嗝有关。

en_us.text: And he had a really cute black dragon with him. Big green eyes. Almost like a cat. And it moved like one, too.

zh_cn.text: 他身边跟着一只黑色的龙。这只小可爱有一双又大又绿的眼睛，长的就像只猫。动起来也像！

en_us.text: I've spent a lot of time studying dragons. Especially the Raevyx. But, uh, let's not talk about that.

zh_cn.text: 我花了很多时间去研究龙，尤其是殷雷龙。但是…嗯，这点先保密。

en_us.text: Point is, dragons are more complicated than people want them to be.

zh_cn.text: 重点是，龙比人们想象的要复杂得多。

en_us.text: Some are territorial. Some are curious. Some are clever enough to pretend they aren't.

zh_cn.text: 有些龙领地意识强，有些龙好奇心旺盛，有些甚至聪明到学会装作没有。

en_us.text: And some... well. Some are best admired from a very safe distance and left alone.

zh_cn.text: 还有些…嗯，只可远观不可亵玩焉。
所以龙并非仅仅只是怪物？

en_us.text: No, for most of the time.

zh_cn.text: 至于危险性？无论如何都很危险。

en_us.text: But monster is a word people use when they don't want to understand what they're afraid of.

zh_cn.text: 人们总是会把“怪物”这个词安在他们不愿意去了解的恐惧身上。

en_us.text: Except for... the damn %1$s. Eugh. Steer clear from those weird freaks.

zh_cn.text: 除了…该死的%1$s。啧，记得离那些怪胎远一点。

en_us.text: They are extremely lethal and sneaky despite their appearances. I almost got jumped by one when I was looking for a trident underwater...

zh_cn.text: 从外表上看不出来，但这些家伙非常危险狡猾。有一次我在水里找三叉戟的时候就差点被其中一只袭击了…

en_us.text: And I was lucky enough to gather a lot of spines for arrows when they shed.

zh_cn.text: 不过我也幸运地趁着喷刺回收不少制箭的脊刺。

en_us.text: I could talk about dragons for hours, but that would be rude. Probably.

zh_cn.text: 我可以连着讲上好几个小时的龙！不过那样就有点没教养了。大概吧。

en_us.text: Anyway. That's probably more dragon talk than you asked for. I hope you weren't overwhelmed.

zh_cn.text: 好了，有关龙的事我说得可能有点多了，希望你没听晕。

en_us.text: Some are territorial. Some are curious. Some are clever enough to pretend they aren't.

zh_cn.text: 有些龙领地意识强，有些龙好奇心旺盛，有些甚至聪明到学会装作没有。

en_us.text: And some... well. Some are best admired from a very safe distance and left alone.

zh_cn.text: 还有些…嗯，只可远观不可亵玩焉。
所以龙并非仅仅只是怪物？

en_us.text: No, for most of the time.

zh_cn.text: 至于危险性？无论如何都很危险。

en_us.text: But monster is a word people use when they don't want to understand what they're afraid of.

zh_cn.text: 人们总是会把“怪物”这个词安在他们不愿意去了解的恐惧身上。

en_us.text: Except for... the damn %1$s. Eugh. Steer clear from those weird freaks.

zh_cn.text: 除了…该死的%1$s。啧，记得离那些怪胎远一点。

en_us.text: They are extremely lethal and sneaky despite their appearances. I almost got jumped by one when I was looking for a trident underwater...

zh_cn.text: 从外表上看不出来，但这些家伙非常危险狡猾。有一次我在水里找三叉戟的时候就差点被其中一只袭击了…

en_us.text: And I was lucky enough to gather a lot of spines for arrows when they shed.

zh_cn.text: 不过我也幸运地趁着喷刺回收不少制箭的脊刺。

en_us.text: I could talk about dragons for hours, but that would be rude. Probably.

zh_cn.text: 我可以连着讲上好几个小时的龙！不过那样就有点没教养了。大概吧。

en_us.text: Anyway. That's probably more dragon talk than you asked for. I hope you weren't overwhelmed.

zh_cn.text: 好了，有关龙的事我说得可能有点多了，希望你没听晕。

en_us.text: That rider you mentioned... who was he?

zh_cn.text: 你说的那位骑手…到底是谁？

en_us.text: Ah, right. A strange young chief. Clever. Awkward in a way that somehow worked for him.

zh_cn.text: 哦，对，他是一位年轻的、奇怪的首领，而且很聪明。其实有的地方也有些笨拙，但这点在他身上恰到好处。

en_us.text: I couldn't help but notice the prosthetic first time I met him.

zh_cn.text: 我第一次见到他的时候就注意到了他身上的义肢。

en_us.text: I didn't ask too many questions. Some are better remembered as stories.

zh_cn.text: 我没过问太多。有些事情不去深究比较好。

en_us.text: He had a black dragon with him. Big green eyes. Aerodynamic wings. Sleek body. Truly beautiful.

zh_cn.text: 他带着一只黑色的龙，大大的绿眼睛、流线型的翅膀、光滑的身体，真的非常漂亮。

en_us.text: Moved like a cat. Looked at people like it knew exactly how stupid they were.

zh_cn.text: 动起来就像只猫，看人时好像完全能看透人们到底有多蠢一样。

en_us.text: That dragon wasn't young. Not old either. But it carried itself like something that had survived more than a few bad ideas. I wish I had known its name.

zh_cn.text: 这只龙不算年轻，也没多老，但从举止能看出，他应该有过几次糟糕的经历。真希望我能知道他叫什么名字。

en_us.text: But then the rider claimed his dragon was the fastest thing in the sky.

zh_cn.text: 后来那位骑手宣称他的龙是天上最快的东西。

en_us.text: Which was rude, because my Raevyx was right there.

zh_cn.text: 简直不知道天高地厚，因为我的殷雷龙就在我旁边。

en_us.text: It was close. Almost a tie, actually.

zh_cn.text: 我们势均力敌，真的，几乎都算平局了。

en_us.text: Almost... I think he won. I don't know.

zh_cn.text: 几乎…我觉得最后是他赢了。我也不确定。

en_us.text: I would've liked to win, but... it was fun. Anyway, yeah, that's it. We exchanged goodbyes and that was that.

zh_cn.text: 我也很想赢，但是…还挺有意思的。反正，嗯，就这样。我们互相道了别，然后就没有然后了。

en_us.text: Back to what I was saying...
Now, where did I leave off...? Oh, yes.

zh_cn.text: 现在，让我看看我讲到哪了…嗯，没错…

en_us.text: Right, we were talking about this...
A little trading, a little gardening, and a little making sure people don't do something ridiculous with dragons.

zh_cn.text: 做点小买卖，种点小花草，剩下的用来制止人们对龙做什么荒唐的事情。

en_us.text: People do ridiculous things with dragons?
That's all I need to know.
People do ridiculous things with dragons?
That's all I need to know.
Oh, you have no idea. People, especially the villagers, have grown quite fond of some dragon species.

zh_cn.text: 哦，你根本不知道人们，尤其是村民，对一些龙种有多痴迷。

en_us.text: There was a villager I knew named Nimriel who was bucked off a juvenile Varasuchus while trying to ride it, and apparently, he broke his hip after hitting the ground.

zh_cn.text: 有个叫尼姆瑞尔（Nimriel）的村民，想骑未成年的蜷鳄龙，最后却被狠狠的甩了出去。不出所料，他的屁股摔成了好几瓣。

en_us.text: And then someone fell off from a Cindervane, but luckily, they fell into a forest with dense trees.

zh_cn.text: 后来又有人从烬翎龙背上掉了下去。不过下面就是一片茂密的森林，所以他比较走运。

en_us.text: Hah! Trees are still trees. Unlucky individual.

zh_cn.text: 才怪呢！又不是童话故事。他狠狠地撞了上去，又被树枝狠狠地抽打，最后狠狠地砸在了地上。啊，小倒霉蛋。

en_us.text: And then ME, specifically. Have you even heard of a Mossback?? Actually, here's a better one: why does that thing exist?!

zh_cn.text: 接下来轮到我，尤其是我。你听说过“苔背龙”吗？或者我该这么说——这东西怎么还不从世界上消失？！

en_us.text: I accidentally dropped one because it was slippery, and I got hit with a foul and overwhelming stench that blinded and POISONED me!

zh_cn.text: 这种龙很光滑，有一次我不小心漏出去一只，突然一种难闻到窒息的恶臭直冲脑门！熏得我什么也看不见，还中毒了。

en_us.text: The audacity of those things. To have wings and cannot fly while being fat, and stinky?! Ugh...

zh_cn.text: 这群厚颜无耻的东西，又胖又臭，长了翅膀却飞不起来？！哼…

en_us.text: I had to wait it out. I was sweating the whole time like a sinner in a church pew while I was at it...

zh_cn.text: 中毒后我只好待在原地，身上不停地冒汗，就像坐在教堂长椅上的罪人一样…

en_us.text: After the effects had worn off, it ran away, the little prick... funny thing is, they don't even react when you pick them up. And you can throw them.

zh_cn.text: 等我好受一点，它早就跑的远远的了，这小家伙…有趣的是，如果你去抓它们，它们甚至不会反抗。你还可以把它们远远扔出去。

en_us.text: Don't even dare throw one at me, though. I'll hate you forever...

zh_cn.text: 你要是敢往我身上丢，这辈子都别指望我原谅你…

en_us.text: So yes. People do ridiculous things with dragons.

zh_cn.text: 以上，就是人们会对龙做的一些荒唐事。

en_us.text: Sometimes the dragons do ridiculous things back.

zh_cn.text: 有时候，龙也会做出同样荒唐的举动以作回敬。

en_us.text: Plants are easier to negotiate with. Usually.

zh_cn.text: 植物比人更容易打交道。通常来讲是这样。

en_us.text: I grow herbs, roots, flowers, a few things that are useful for medicine...

zh_cn.text: 我种草药、根茎、花卉，还有一些药用植物…

en_us.text: ...and a few things that are useful when medicine is no longer the plan.

zh_cn.text: …还有一点点死马当活马医的特产。

en_us.text: Relax. I label the dangerous ones. Most of the time.

zh_cn.text: 放心啦，危险的我都贴好标签了。大部分贴好了…

en_us.text: Well... not really. Expert is a dangerous word.

zh_cn.text: 呃…不全是。“专家”是个很麻烦的词汇。

en_us.text: People hear it and start assuming you know everything. I don't.

zh_cn.text: 人们一听到这个词就会觉得你什么都知道，可我不是无所不知的。

en_us.text: Villagers often ask me how to tame certain types of dragons. I teach them the proper methods, make sure they're prepared, and send them off with enough knowledge and equipment to not die immediately.

zh_cn.text: 村民们经常会问我如何驯服某些品种的龙。我教他们正确的方法，监督他们准备妥当，再确保他们有足够的知识和储备，以免刚出门就丢掉小命。

en_us.text: A lot of the time, they still fail miserably.

zh_cn.text: 即便如此，成功的也还是凤毛麟角。

en_us.text: Not because they're stupid. Well... not always.

zh_cn.text: 倒不是因为他们太笨。呃…不总是…

en_us.text: Most just don't have the patience, caution, or nerve to deal with a wild dragon.

zh_cn.text: 他们大部分人都缺乏耐心和谨慎，以及站在巨龙面前的胆量。

en_us.text: And then some ask me how to tame a Raevyx while looking like a tumbleweed with pockets.

zh_cn.text: 还有的人穿的破破烂烂，看着像长了口袋的风滚草一样，张口就问怎么驯服殷雷龙。

en_us.text: Like, come on. You look like that and want to tame THE GRIM REAPER?! They can barely tame a Cindervane!

zh_cn.text: 脑子有问题吗？天哪，穿成那样还想征服一头死神？！也就烬翎龙勉强愿意陪他们玩玩。

en_us.text: Ahem. Sorry. I didn't mean to yell.
Sometimes I think, 'Wouldn't it be easier to look for an egg and raise one from the start?'

zh_cn.text: 所以有时候我就在想“弄个蛋回来从小开始养不是更轻松吗？”

en_us.text: But even that takes patience. And fish. An unreasonable amount of fish.

zh_cn.text: 不过那也需要耐心，还有鱼，多到吃不完的鱼。

en_us.text: I know enough to stay humble. That's more than most experts can say.

zh_cn.text: 我知道自己几斤几两，因此有自知之明，这点就已经比大多数“专家”强太多了。

en_us.text: The moment someone says they understand dragons completely, I start looking for the nearest exit.

zh_cn.text: 每当有人宣称自己已经完全搞懂龙的时候，我就尴尬得想逃走。
具体是哪个，得看对方口气有多大。

en_us.text: Back to what I was saying...
Now, where did I leave off...? Oh, yes.

zh_cn.text: 现在，让我看看我讲到哪了…嗯，没错…

en_us.text: Right, we were talking about this...
I can't even think because it's too hot...

zh_cn.text: 太热了，我根本就没办法思考…

en_us.text: I've gone into the Nether a few times to look for Netherite and smaller things like Glowstone Dust and Nether Wart... but I failed on the Netherite part.

zh_cn.text: 我以前也来过地狱几次，找下界合金和一些别的小东西，比如荧石粉和下界疣…不过下界合金的部分我没成功。

en_us.text: Simply because I can't stand the heat or some of the denizens here.

zh_cn.text: 仅仅只是因为这里的高温，还有本地土著。

en_us.text: I kind of like the biomes, especially the Crimson Forest. It reminds me of the color of my dragon...

zh_cn.text: 我有点喜欢这些生物群系，尤其是绯红森林，和我的龙身上的颜色一模一样…

en_us.text: Also, I absolutely hate the Piglins. I almost got jumped because I forgot to wear my gold helmet.

zh_cn.text: 而且，我真的特别讨厌猪灵。我差点就因为忘戴金头盔被打了。

en_us.text: Don't get me started on the Ghasts. Why do they make those weird sounds? How can they float? Why do they look so creepy? I didn't do anything to them, and I still got a fireball shot at me?!

zh_cn.text: 更别提那群恶魂了。他们为什么发出那种诡异的声音？为什么能浮起来？为什么长的那么可怕？我明明什么都没做就朝我吐火球？！

en_us.text: Striders are just weird old men with toothpicks for legs, standing in a lake of lava.

zh_cn.text: 炽足兽则是站在岩浆湖里的，腿像牙签的怪老头。

en_us.text: I tried luring one onto land and dragging it back to the Overworld, but seeing it shiver out of the lava made me pity it.

zh_cn.text: 我本来想抓一只上来拖回主世界，但一看到它离开岩浆就发抖，就又有些心软了。

en_us.text: And Wither Skeletons and Blazes? Absolutely not. Bunch of freaks...

zh_cn.text: 至于凋零骷髅和烈焰人？绝对不行。一群怪胎…

en_us.text: The point is, the Nether is weird, which circles back to it having its own charm, I think. And I only came along because you're with me. Otherwise, I'd never look twice at it.

zh_cn.text: 重点是，下界真的很奇怪，不过我觉得这也正是魅力所在。我跟过来完全是为了你，否则我连看都不看它一眼。

en_us.text: I'm sweating a lot right now... Let's just hurry up with whatever you're trying to do and get out of this place, please?

zh_cn.text: 我出了一身的汗…快点把你的事情办完然后离开这个鬼地方，好吧？

en_us.text: Yes? Have you encountered any trouble?

zh_cn.text: 怎么了？你遇到什么麻烦了吗？

en_us.text: Can you go over it one more time?

zh_cn.text: 可以复习一遍知识点吗？

en_us.text: I did it. I've tamed a Cindervane.

zh_cn.text: 我做到了，我驯服了烬翎龙。

en_us.text: Of course. It's better to ask twice than rush in unsure.

zh_cn.text: 没问题，问了总比不问强。

en_us.text: ...Something the matter? It's alright. Take your time.

zh_cn.text: …是遇到麻烦了吗？没关系，慢慢来。

en_us.text: You can do it. I'll be rooting for you.

zh_cn.text: 你可以做到的，我是你坚强的后盾。

en_us.text: Now go and get your first dragon.

zh_cn.text: 现在去邂逅你的第一头龙吧。

en_us.text: You did? And you came back with all your limbs intact and not dead?

zh_cn.text: 你做到了？？没死，甚至没缺胳膊少腿？
大部分人都没你做的好！

en_us.text: It tried to burn me a little.

zh_cn.text: 他其实有点对我发火了，哪个发火都是。

en_us.text: That's good! I do take pride in my advice sometimes.

zh_cn.text: 那太好啦！很多时候我确实会为自己的建议感到自豪。

en_us.text: Dragons hear arrogance better than commands. But I suppose you are right. Cindervanes are quite straightforward to deal with.

zh_cn.text: 龙更倾向于顺从内心的骄傲而不是他人的命令。不过这次你做对了，和烬翎龙的相处方式其实非常直接。

en_us.text: But... regardless, you did succeed. So, good job.

zh_cn.text: 不过…管他呢，总之你成功了！干得好！

en_us.text: ...Didn't I tell you not to hit it?
Well, I'm still glad you didn't die. Good job.

zh_cn.text: 不过，我还是很高兴你活着回来了。祝贺你！

en_us.text: Most people want dragons to obey. You let one choose. And that matters a lot to me. More than people think.

zh_cn.text: 大部分人都只想让龙听话，你却给了龙选择。这很重要，对我也很重要，比人们想的都要重要。

en_us.text: Hah! Get a load of this... You're humble. I like it.

zh_cn.text: 噗哈哈哈！你这是什么问题…天哪，你还挺谦虚的，我喜欢你这点。

en_us.text: Come on, that Cindervane is child's play for someone like you.

zh_cn.text: 得了吧，烬翎龙对你这种人来说只是小菜一碟。

en_us.text: A little. But don't let it inflate your head, ok?

zh_cn.text: 一点点吧。不要得意忘形了，OK？

en_us.text: You haven't seen what others can do. But if you had, then well, I hereby take everything back.

zh_cn.text: 你都不知道别人是怎么做的，等你看了别人…算了，当我什么都没说。

en_us.text: But yes. You handled that well.
Mm... now? Maybe having a companion like you wouldn't be a bad idea at all.

zh_cn.text: 接下来？呃…有你这样的同伴倒也不坏…

en_us.text: Now? Now I decide whether following you is brave, useful, or a terrible lapse in judgment. But it's possibly all three.

zh_cn.text: 接下来，我在想以后要不要跟着你混。不知道这是个天真的想法，还是明智的选择，或者糟糕的判断？估计三者都有吧。

en_us.text: Well, I'm not, actually. I already know you can handle yourself pretty well.

zh_cn.text: 嗯，其实也没有那么惊讶，毕竟已经知道你能耐大了。

en_us.text: I am. Not because I thought you'd fail. But because I've seen plenty of confident people fail loudly.

zh_cn.text: 我有些意外倒不是因为觉得你会失败，只是有太多的人，像你一样充满自信，最后却夹着尾巴灰头土脸地回来。

en_us.text: I've been thinking... staying here has its comforts, you know?

zh_cn.text: 我一直在想…待在这儿其实挺舒服的，对吧？

en_us.text: Quiet mornings. Familiar paths. Fewer things trying to bite me. No Mossbacks...

zh_cn.text: 宁静的清晨，熟悉的小路，没什么东西会来咬我，也没有苔背龙…

en_us.text: But problems involving dragons rarely come knocking politely at my door.

zh_cn.text: 然而一旦涉及到龙的问题，就没几个人愿意礼貌地敲门问好了。

en_us.text: If I travel with you, maybe I can stop a few before they become tragedies. And... sightsee more. And dragonwatching. And... I'm gonna stop myself from rambling.

zh_cn.text: 如果能跟你一起旅行，或许我还能阻止某些悲剧的发生…以及看看风景，看看龙什么的…还有…还有我得阻止自己一直唠叨下去了。
来吧，我正好有用得上你的地方。

en_us.text: Are you sure? Very well. Here to a bountiful future.

zh_cn.text: 你，你是认真的吗？嗯，好吧，那就敬我们光明的未来！

en_us.text: I don't want to. What are you gonna do about it?
%1$s I was just kidding! You should've seen the look on your face...

zh_cn.text: %1$s我开玩笑的！你真该照镜子看看你现在的表情…

en_us.text: Well... I didn't say that. But yes. I want to.

zh_cn.text: 嗯…我不会那么说的。我想说的是，我愿意。

en_us.text: Yes. And I could use yours.

zh_cn.text: 那我肯定也有用得上你的地方。
以后我可就跟着你混了。

en_us.text: Cindervanes are migrating this season, and that tends to make people reckless.

zh_cn.text: 眼下正是烬翎龙迁徙的季节，真令人躁动不安。

en_us.text: I want you to tame one. Properly, that is. Just to test your mettle.

zh_cn.text: 我想让你去驯服一只。我没在开玩笑，只是想见识下你的本事。

en_us.text: How do I tame a Cindervane?
I suggest you look for food items like cod, salmon, or raw chicken. Or everything. They are not picky when hungry.

zh_cn.text: 我的建议是准备一些食物，就比如鳕鱼、鲑鱼、生鸡肉，只要烬翎龙饿的时候不嫌弃就行。

en_us.text: If you want better odds, trade with me for fish and eggs. I can make you Hearty Dragon Meals.

zh_cn.text: 如果你还想提高成功率，可以用鲑鱼和鸡蛋在我这里买一些丰盛龙食。

en_us.text: Once you have the food, look for Cindervanes in mountainous biomes, like Stony Peaks, Jagged Peaks, Frozen Peaks, Snowy Slopes, Groves, and even Meadows.

zh_cn.text: 等你准备好了，就可以去山地生物群系寻找烬翎龙。他们可能会出现在裸岩山峰（Stony Peaks）、尖峭山峰（Jagged Peaks）、冰封山峰（Frozen Peaks）、积雪山坡（Snowy Slopes）、雪林（Groves），还有草甸（Meadows）。

en_us.text: ...And potentially other high-altitude areas from other 'biome mods' or whatever that means.

zh_cn.text: …其他模组的高海拔地区也有可能。等等，我到底在说什么？

en_us.text: Once you've found one, just approach it, and tame it like how you would tame a dog or a cat.

zh_cn.text: 等你找到了，就径直走过去，然后像驯服猫猫狗狗那样驯服他。

en_us.text: Do NOT hit it. Please. If you've somehow made it mad, then it's best to run away, or chug a Fire Resistance Potion, or worse... kill it.

zh_cn.text: 千万不要伤害他。如果你不知怎的惹到他了，那就快跑！或者喝一瓶抗火药水…实在走投无路，就放手一搏吧。

en_us.text: When you've tamed one, come back to me, then we'll see where things go.

zh_cn.text: 等你成功了记得回来找我，剩下的到时候再说吧。

en_us.text: Can you go over it one more time?

zh_cn.text: 隔着玻璃瞧王八 —— 一清二楚。
其实我已经驯服烬翎龙了。

en_us.text: Well... That certainly makes this easier! I suppose I do not need to explain the dangerous part anymore.

zh_cn.text: 嗯…那就简单多了，我应该不用再强调危险的地方。

en_us.text: Very well. I'll explain again. It's good to be thorough.

zh_cn.text: 好吧，我再重复一遍。多说总比不说好。

en_us.text: Good. Come back once you've tamed one.

zh_cn.text: 那就好。完成了就回来找我吧。

en_us.text: ...Very well. I understand why you are hesitant.
And honestly, that's one of the more reasonable answers I've heard.

zh_cn.text: 说真的，这是我所听过比较明智的回答之一。

en_us.text: We'll revisit the matter later, if you want to, of course.

zh_cn.text: 当然，如果哪天你回心转意了，就再来找我吧。

en_us.text: Glad to have you with me.
I already have a travelling companion. But I can still trade with you.

zh_cn.text: 我已经有旅行的搭档了，除非你找我是想和我交易？

en_us.text: I am spoken for, in the companion sense. The shop is still open, though.

zh_cn.text: 抱歉我已经有人陪着了，不过我商店的大门永远为您敞开。

en_us.text: Sorry. My companion and I travel together. That does not mean I have stopped being a trader.

zh_cn.text: 抱歉，我和我的搭档一起旅行。不过经商方面我还没有退休。

en_us.text: There's little I can say to you, I'm afraid. We can still trade.

zh_cn.text: 恐怕我俩之间没什么好说的。但还是可以交易。

en_us.text: Sorry. There's only so much of me to go around. We can still trade.

zh_cn.text: 抱歉，我分身乏术。但依然可以交易。

en_us.text: You seem nice and all, but I've teamed up with someone else. We can still trade, though.

zh_cn.text: 你人挺不错的，但我已经有伴了。不过依然可以交易。

en_us.text: Hello to you too. Take care.
What do you think of my Raevyx?

zh_cn.text: 你觉得我的雷鸣龙怎么样？

en_us.text: I think that your Raevyx is very beautiful.

zh_cn.text: 我觉得你的雷鸣龙非常漂亮。

en_us.text: The Raevyxian are one of the strongest, smartest, fastest, deadliest and coolest-looking dragons, in my opinion.

zh_cn.text: 在我看来，雷鸣龙一族是最强壮、最聪明、最迅猛、最致命、外表也最酷的龙之一。

en_us.text: I absolutely love the way the spines run alongside the back.

zh_cn.text: 我特别喜欢那排沿着脊背延伸的棘刺。

en_us.text: And the wing patterns resembling lightning bolts are truly magnificent.

zh_cn.text: 还有那酷似闪电的翼纹，实在壮丽。

en_us.text: Forgive the glazing, but it was the first dragon I've ever encountered, you know?

zh_cn.text: 别嫌我花痴，但你知道的，这可是我平生头一回见到的龙。

en_us.text: Well, not exactly... more in the form of an egg instead.

zh_cn.text: 呃，也不算见到……更像是以一颗蛋的形式。

en_us.text: The egg was... mesmerising. The red streaks highlighted the darkness around the shell.

zh_cn.text: 那颗蛋……让人着迷。红色的纹路把蛋壳周围的黑暗衬得格外深沉。

en_us.text: When I touched it, I felt... alive? And the egg itself was hatching, too.

zh_cn.text: 当我碰到它时，我感到……像是活了过来？而且那颗蛋当时也正在孵化。

en_us.text: Sorry, I don't have the right word to describe how I've truly felt at that moment.

zh_cn.text: 抱歉，我找不到合适的词来形容那一刻真正的感受。

en_us.text: The words could be pure, serene, and innocent.

zh_cn.text: 大概可以用纯粹、安宁、无邪这些词吧。

en_us.text: Or let's just say that it felt like it was meant for me.

zh_cn.text: 或者这么说吧，那种感觉就像是它命中注定属于我。

en_us.text: You can also say that I was obsessed with the species itself.

zh_cn.text: 你也可以说，我是对这个物种本身就着了迷。

en_us.text: I was pretty young, back then, when I first found the egg.

zh_cn.text: 我第一次找到那颗蛋的时候，年纪还很小。

en_us.text: Oh, and I forgot to mention.
It was next to a dead Raevyx mother.

zh_cn.text: 它就在一位死去的雷鸣龙母亲旁边。

en_us.text: Mutilated. Killed and butchered for parts.

zh_cn.text: 被残害的。为了取走身上的部件而惨遭杀害和肢解。

en_us.text: I didn't think I would discover a Raevyx at all.

zh_cn.text: 我压根没想过自己会发现一只雷鸣龙。

en_us.text: Looking at yours, it brings back a lot of memories.

zh_cn.text: 看着你的这只，勾起了我好多回忆。

en_us.text: Please take great care of your Raevyx.

zh_cn.text: 请好好照顾你的雷鸣龙。

en_us.text: I do not doubt you in the slightest whenever it comes to handling dragons.

zh_cn.text: 在照料龙这件事上，我对你没有半点怀疑。

en_us.text: Let's put the matter at rest for now.
It seems like you've tamed it when it was still a baby.

zh_cn.text: 看来你是在它还是幼崽的时候就驯服了它。

en_us.text: How did you manage to tame it, anyway?

zh_cn.text: 话说回来，你到底是怎么驯服它的？

en_us.text: I fought it. And when I knocked it out, I went in for the tame.

zh_cn.text: 我和它打了一场。把它打晕之后，我就趁机驯服了它。

en_us.text: I tamed it when it was a baby. I just fed it normally.

zh_cn.text: 它还是幼崽时我就驯服了它。就是正常地喂它吃东西。

en_us.text: Impressive! Looks like my instinct did not let me down, after all.

zh_cn.text: 厉害！看来我的直觉终究没有看走眼。

en_us.text: I thought you'd be atomized by its beam by now.

zh_cn.text: 我还以为你现在已经被它的光束轰成灰了。

en_us.text: But that'd be stupid, because you're here.

zh_cn.text: 不过那也太蠢了，毕竟你还站在这儿。

en_us.text: Hah... well, you're like me then.
I did, in fact, tame a Raevyx when she was just a little thunderling.

zh_cn.text: 事实上，我确实在她还是只小雷崽的时候驯服过一只雷鸣龙。

en_us.text: All baby dragons are gullible and so easy to tame.

zh_cn.text: 所有龙崽子都好骗，特别容易驯服。

en_us.text: Which makes them quite cute and endearing.

zh_cn.text: 这也让它们显得格外可爱、讨人喜欢。

en_us.text: Looks like we have something in common.
That is pretty nice in my book.

zh_cn.text: 我的烬翼龙看起来如何？

en_us.text: Ah, yes... the Cindervane. Pyrovela migrantis. Simply elegant.

zh_cn.text: 啊，没错……烬翼龙。Pyrovela migrantis。优雅至极。

en_us.text: The folks just started calling the noodle that way.

zh_cn.text: 大伙儿就是随口把那条“面条”这么叫开了。

en_us.text: Forget it. Fine. I did make it up because I can.

zh_cn.text: 算了。好吧。确实是我编的，因为我乐意。

en_us.text: I mean, come on! It makes sense, no? And it is official!

zh_cn.text: 我说，拜托！这名字很合理，不是吗？而且现在已经是正式名称了！

en_us.text: They move a lot! And they have breathtaking, burning, cinder-like wing patterns!

zh_cn.text: 它们总是在飞来飞去！而且它们那灼热的、宛如余烬般的翼纹美得让人窒息！

en_us.text: Which means... 'Wandering Flamewing...?' Which is a mouthful. Yikes.

zh_cn.text: 意思是……“漫游焰翼”？好拗口。天哪。

en_us.text: ...Okay, Cindervane makes sense too. Since, like, it flies... and uh, wing patterns, and it's shorter--

zh_cn.text: ……好吧，“烬翼龙”也挺合理的。毕竟它确实会飞……呃，还有翼纹什么的，而且更短——

en_us.text: MY POINT IS-- %1$s sorry. My point is that the Cindervane is truly an excellent dragon.

zh_cn.text: 我的重点是——%1$s 抱歉。我的重点是，烬翼龙真的是一种极其出色的龙。

en_us.text: A long, sleek body with large wings and tail rudders is quite a design for aerial maneuvers.

zh_cn.text: 修长流畅的身躯，配上大翅膀和尾舵，这设计简直就是为空中机动而生的。

en_us.text: But don't judge them by how they look.
The suckers pack a really mean punch. Really, REALLY mean.

zh_cn.text: 这些家伙打起人来可狠了。非常、非常狠。

en_us.text: Some dude I know named Gloth was almost bombed to death by a Cindervane because he thought it was a good idea to lasso it like some horse.

zh_cn.text: 我认识一个叫格洛斯的家伙，他觉得像套马一样用套索去套烬翼龙是个好主意，结果差点被炸死。

en_us.text: Hah! Who did he think he was? Dragon Overlord??

zh_cn.text: 哈！他以为他是谁？龙族霸主？？

en_us.text: And I know for a fact that they explode when they hit the ground on impact while self-immolating.

zh_cn.text: 而且我很确定，它们在自燃状态下俯冲砸向地面时是会爆炸的。

en_us.text: Which is... kinda messed up, but dang. Pretty rad.

zh_cn.text: 这嘛……有点残忍，但不得不说，还挺酷的。

en_us.text: Good job on taming yours, though.

zh_cn.text: 不过，你能驯服一只，干得不错。

en_us.text: At least you didn't die, hm?

zh_cn.text: 对我的剑航龙有什么想说的吗？

en_us.text: Oh yes, absolutely. Quite the sturdy friend you got.

zh_cn.text: 哦当然，必须有。你这朋友可相当结实。

en_us.text: A Stegonaut is an awesome dragon to have.

zh_cn.text: 剑航龙是种很棒的伙伴龙。

en_us.text: The base of their neck is really thick and strong. You can sit and add storage on it.

zh_cn.text: 它们的颈根非常粗壮。你可以坐在上面，还能在上面加装储物格。

en_us.text: It'll help you with carrying alongside your items if you ever need more room.

zh_cn.text: 要是你需要更多空间，它能帮你一起驮东西。

en_us.text: I like to think of them as ancient protectors.

zh_cn.text: 我喜欢把它们想象成远古的守护者。

en_us.text: Being around them makes me feel safe and secure.

zh_cn.text: 待在它们身边让我觉得特别安心。

en_us.text: I also think that it's lovely that they travel in packs.

zh_cn.text: 我还觉得它们成群结队行动的样子特别可爱。

en_us.text: Not many dragons travel in packs like Cindervanes and Stegonauts.

zh_cn.text: 像烬翼龙和剑航龙这样群居行动的龙可不多见。

en_us.text: They are also easy to tame. Albeit a bit harder to find since they live in Lush Caves...

zh_cn.text: 它们也容易驯服。只是不太好找，毕竟它们住在繁茂洞穴里……

en_us.text: But that did not trouble one bit, hm?

zh_cn.text: 但这一点也没难倒你，对吧？

en_us.text: Great job. It's beneficial to have this dragon around.

zh_cn.text: 干得好。身边有这么一条龙，好处多多。

en_us.text: The sooner you make a Binder for it, the better. Trust me.

zh_cn.text: 越早给它做一副驮具越好。相信我。

en_us.text: Looks like you already have a Binder! Tremendous work, %1$s!

zh_cn.text: 看来你已经给它做好驮具了！了不起，%1$s！

en_us.text: Let me know what you think about my Varasuchus.

zh_cn.text: 跟我说说你觉得我的瓦拉鳄如何。

en_us.text: Hmm... the Varasuchus. Crocodilian drake thingy.

zh_cn.text: 嗯……瓦拉鳄。一种鳄鱼模样的龙玩意儿。

en_us.text: For a semiaquatic flightless dragon... this thing is terrifying.

zh_cn.text: 对一种半水生、还不会飞的龙来说……这家伙够吓人的。

en_us.text: When pushed to its limit, it will stand up on its hind legs and start using its front legs... or arms to fight.

zh_cn.text: 被逼到极限时，它会用后腿站起来，开始用前肢……或者说前臂来战斗。

en_us.text: And those arms are equipped with the meanest and sharpest claws I can ever imagine.

zh_cn.text: 而且那两条前臂上长着我想象中最狠、最锋利的爪子。
你知道吗，我一直很好奇……

en_us.text: Who even discovered the way of taming a Varasuchus by just riding it like a horse?

zh_cn.text: 到底是谁发现的，居然可以像骑马一样骑着它来驯服瓦拉鳄？

en_us.text: I mean, seriously. Why? How? You don't look at a big and menacing-looking dragon and go, "Yeah, I'm gonna ride it."

zh_cn.text: 我是说，认真的吗？为什么？怎么想的？你总不会看到一只巨大又凶相毕露的龙，然后来一句“好啊，我要骑它”吧。

en_us.text: Also, pause on that last sentence. But, um... yeah, I am so glad I'm not that person.

zh_cn.text: 另外，等等，先停在刚才那句话上。呃……总之，我真庆幸自己不是那种人。

en_us.text: And the Varasuchus can for sure take on a human. Why not?? Why become docile after a few buckings?

zh_cn.text: 瓦拉鳄明明能轻松放倒一个人。凭什么啊？？为什么被甩几下就温顺了？

en_us.text: Why not just... free yourself from the shackles of your owner? It baffles me.

zh_cn.text: 为什么不干脆……挣脱主人的枷锁呢？这让我百思不得其解。

en_us.text: And this goes for all dragons, by the way.

zh_cn.text: 顺便一提，这条对所有龙都适用。

en_us.text: I guess dragons are just... big, scary, powerful... dogs?? Whatever, I'm rambling.

zh_cn.text: 我猜龙大概就是……大只、吓人、强壮的……狗？？算了，我这是在胡言乱语。

en_us.text: Things we do, %1$s, I'm telling you.

zh_cn.text: 瞧瞧我们都干了些什么，%1$s，我跟你说。

en_us.text: You should be proud of yourself for successfully taming one.

zh_cn.text: 你能成功驯服一只，应该为自己感到骄傲。

en_us.text: Got thrown from its back and hopped back on. Got thrown again. Repeat until you've tamed it.

zh_cn.text: 被它从背上甩下来，再爬上去。又被甩下来。如此往复，直到驯服为止。

en_us.text: Proves you're even more resilient than it is.
I had a dream about a purple Varasuchus. The dreams felt floaty for some reason.

zh_cn.text: 我梦到过一只紫色的瓦拉鳄。不知为何，那场梦有种飘飘忽忽的感觉。

en_us.text: The shade of the purple was just glimmering in the endless void. The tranquility of everything.

zh_cn.text: 那抹紫色就在无尽的虚空里微微闪烁。一切都那么宁静。

en_us.text: I once thought I spotted it in the wilds... but I guess I was just seeing things.

zh_cn.text: 我一度以为自己在野外看到了它……不过大概只是眼花了吧。

en_us.text: Almost as if it was kissed by the void.

zh_cn.text: 仿佛它是被虚空亲吻过的。

en_us.text: Maybe try hatching a Varasuchus's egg in The End. Who knows?

zh_cn.text: 也许可以试试在末地孵化瓦拉鳄的蛋。谁知道呢？

en_us.text: I'd love to hear your thoughts on my Ignivorus.

zh_cn.text: 很想听听你对噬焰龙的看法。

en_us.text: You have got to be kidding me.
An Ignivorus. You have... an Ignivorus.

zh_cn.text: 一只噬焰龙。你居然……有一只噬焰龙。

en_us.text: Okay... so, let me get this straight.
I've spent almost my whole life trying to prove the existence of this dragon to the Dracological Society because it was so rare...

zh_cn.text: 因为这种龙太过稀有，我几乎花了半辈子想向龙类研究学会证明它的存在……

en_us.text: Just for you to casually go, "Oh yeah, I have a pet Ignivorus."

zh_cn.text: 结果你就轻描淡写地来了句，“哦对，我养了只宠物噬焰龙。”

en_us.text: I didn't say it like that...
...Doesn't matter. You're insane. You are actually insane.

zh_cn.text: ……无所谓了。你疯了。你是真的疯了。

en_us.text: You managed to tame a catastrophic event. A walking natural disaster.

zh_cn.text: 你居然驯服了一场灾难级事件。一场长了脚的天灾。

en_us.text: Regional extinction event. Mobile evacuation order. Localized apocalypse. Environmental hazard.

zh_cn.text: 区域性灭绝事件。行走的疏散令。局部末日。环境灾害。

en_us.text: ECOLOGICAL RESET BUTTON. GEOLOGICAL HATE CRIME. TERRAIN DELETION EVENT. ACT. OF. GOD--

zh_cn.text: 生态重置按钮。地质仇恨罪。地形抹除事件。上. 帝. 之. 怒——

en_us.text: AND THE AUDACITY OF THIS DRAGON OF YOURS.

zh_cn.text: 还有你这头龙也真是嚣张得可以。

en_us.text: Why is it so basic-looking? I mean, don't get me wrong. I love the scales and how it generally looks.

zh_cn.text: 它怎么长得这么普通？别误会，我喜欢它的鳞片，也喜欢它整体的样子。

en_us.text: And why can it stand up? What kind of crap is that?

zh_cn.text: 还有它为什么能站起来？这都是些什么鬼？

en_us.text: It can fly while being that big. It can somehow unleash a wave of heat so scorching hot that it basically vaporizes everything around it.

zh_cn.text: 那么大的块头居然还能飞。还能不知怎地掀起一阵灼热无比的热浪，基本上能把周围的一切都蒸发掉。

en_us.text: This thing reminds me an awful lot of another dragon that's even more destructive...

zh_cn.text: 这家伙让我想起另一头破坏力更强的龙……

en_us.text: Something about Castle Schrade... eh, whatever. They must be long-lost cousins.

zh_cn.text: 和修雷德城有点关系……唉，算了。它们八成是失散多年的远亲。

en_us.text: And it belongs to you after a few beatdowns? Great. Fantastic.

zh_cn.text: 然后揍它几顿它就归你了？好极了。太棒了。

en_us.text: ...Ugh. I guess I admit that I am.
I'm happy for you, and not at the same time.

zh_cn.text: 我替你高兴，但同时又高兴不起来。

en_us.text: Why? Well, because you proved its existence even before me.

zh_cn.text: 为什么？因为连我都没来得及，你就先证明了它的存在。

en_us.text: And you get to ride it. Experience it and what it is capable of.

zh_cn.text: 而且你还能骑上它。亲身体验它，见证它的本事。

en_us.text: But I understand what you went through to even tame that thing. Wholeheartedly.

zh_cn.text: 但我完全明白你为了驯服那玩意儿经历了什么。真心实意地明白。

en_us.text: Or maybe you beamed it with a Raevyx... regardless--

zh_cn.text: 又或者你是用雷鸣龙的光束轰了它……总之——

en_us.text: I'm sorry for acting like that. Forgive me? Please?

zh_cn.text: 我为自己刚才的态度道歉。原谅我好吗？求你了？

en_us.text: Great! Let's move on. It's not that serious anyway.

zh_cn.text: 太好了！咱们翻篇吧。反正也没那么严重。

en_us.text: Fine. I'm leaving. Goodbye. Don't convince me to come back.

zh_cn.text: 好啊。我要走了。再见。别想劝我回来。

en_us.text: ...I'm kidding! Haha! You should've seen the look on your face!

zh_cn.text: ……我开玩笑的！哈哈！你真该看看你刚才那表情！

en_us.text: It's fine. I loved the back-and-forth.

zh_cn.text: 没事的。这种你来我往我很喜欢。

en_us.text: Let's move on. It's not that serious anyway.

zh_cn.text: 继续吧。反正也没那么严重。

en_us.text: Share some of your thoughts on my Volitans?

zh_cn.text: 谈谈你对我的惊澜龙的看法吧？
我的天……真的假的？惊澜龙？

en_us.text: Let me tell you something. They are invasive.

zh_cn.text: 跟你说件事。它们是入侵物种。

en_us.text: One minute, you're underwater, swimming, minding your own business, lalala~

zh_cn.text: 前一秒，你还在水下游泳，自顾自地忙着自己的事，啦啦啦~
下一秒？砰。惊澜龙突然贴脸杀。

en_us.text: Like, dude, where did you come from?

zh_cn.text: 我说老兄，你到底是从哪儿冒出来的？

en_us.text: And they eat dolphins. Isn't that just cute?

zh_cn.text: 而且它们还吃海豚。是不是超可爱？

en_us.text: What else? Oh, right. Poison. Lots and lots of poison.

zh_cn.text: 还有什么？哦对。毒。超多超多的毒。

en_us.text: And what are the things this dragon can do?

zh_cn.text: 那这条龙都会干些什么？

en_us.text: Let's see... biting, horn goring, clawing, water or poison breath. Poison ball. BURROW. BODY SLAM--

zh_cn.text: 我数数……撕咬、角顶、利爪、水息或毒息。毒液球。钻地。腾空冲撞——

en_us.text: And they can fly, they can perfectly be on land, and they can swim...

zh_cn.text: 而且它们会飞、在陆地上也如鱼得水，还会游泳……

en_us.text: What is this dragon? Just what on Earth is this?

zh_cn.text: 这到底是什么龙？这到底是个什么东西？

en_us.text: What made them evolve to just... have these? A kraken? Cthulhu? An even bigger and nastier sea dragon??

zh_cn.text: 到底是什么让它们进化出这些的？北海巨妖？克苏鲁？还是某种更大更凶恶的海龙？？

en_us.text: They are SCARY. I hate encountering them. I'd steer clear unless I know what I am doing.

zh_cn.text: 它们太吓人了。我讨厌碰上它们。除非心里有底，否则我会绕道走。

en_us.text: And if I have no choice but to tame a Volitans? I'd prepare for the worst. Stock up on everything I can.

zh_cn.text: 要是逼不得已非得驯一只惊澜龙？我会做最坏的打算。能囤的东西全囤上。

en_us.text: At least you can make arrows from the quills that they drop... so that's a win, right?

zh_cn.text: 至少你能用它们掉的尖刺制作箭矢……这么算也不亏，对吧？

en_us.text: But hey, look at you, %1$s. You've got it!

zh_cn.text: 不过嘿，瞧瞧你自己，%1$s。你做到了！
恭喜恭喜。你可真是个了不起的人。

en_us.text: What can you tell me about my Nulljaw?

zh_cn.text: 关于我的虚颚龙，你能跟我讲点什么？

en_us.text: If you own it, then you probably know what it can do.

zh_cn.text: 既然你养了它，那八成已经知道它的本事了。

en_us.text: Teleportation, invisibility, and protection from Shulker bullets are some pretty cool stuff.

zh_cn.text: 传送、隐身、免疫潜影贝导弹，都是些相当酷的能力。

en_us.text: And they are so peaceful to just look at.

zh_cn.text: 而且光看着它们就让人心生宁静。

en_us.text: Floating around the barrens with each other. Eating Chorus Fruits and bullying Shulkers.

zh_cn.text: 成双成对地在末地荒原上飘来飘去。吃着紫颂果，欺负着潜影贝。

en_us.text: Not a single care for what's going on around them.

zh_cn.text: 对周围发生的一切漠不关心。

en_us.text: If I was reincarnated and could choose? I would definitely NOT be a Nulljaw.

zh_cn.text: 如果我能转世并且可以选择？我绝对不要当虚颚龙。

en_us.text: Why would I say that? I don't know. Randomness.

zh_cn.text: 我为什么要这么说？不知道。随口一说。

en_us.text: Anyway, good job on taming one.

zh_cn.text: 总之，能驯服一只，干得不错。
对我的凛煞龙有什么想法吗？

en_us.text: Atroxia regalis. Now that one? The name? I did not make that up.

zh_cn.text: Atroxia regalis。这个嘛？这名字？可不是我编的。

en_us.text: That classification is officially recognized by the Dracological Society. Blame them.

zh_cn.text: 这个分类是龙类研究学会正式认可的。要怪就怪他们。

en_us.text: Truly a fascinating dragon. I've never seen one with that type of body before.

zh_cn.text: 真是一头迷人的龙。我从没见过这种体型构造的。

en_us.text: Isn't it just permanently cardio, though?

zh_cn.text: 不过这不就等于永远都在做有氧运动吗？

en_us.text: Two primary limbs, no hind legs, no wings... somehow still built like it expects the mountain to move before it does.

zh_cn.text: 就两条主要肢体，没有后腿，没有翅膀……却结实得仿佛认定大山都得先给它挪地方。

en_us.text: Those arms are doing almost all of the work. Walking, climbing, supporting that entire torso...

zh_cn.text: 几乎全靠那两条前臂。行走、攀爬，还有撑起整个躯干……

en_us.text: I think we can also count the tail, since it's practically a third point of support.

zh_cn.text: 我觉得尾巴也算得上，因为它差不多就是第三个支撑点。

en_us.text: And that tail is definitely not just there for balance.

zh_cn.text: 而且那条尾巴绝对不只是用来保持平衡的。

en_us.text: The tip of its tail is beautiful. I can look at it all day.

zh_cn.text: 它尾巴尖特别漂亮。我能盯着看一整天。

en_us.text: The gold shining off of it. Looking it in the snow is truly something.

zh_cn.text: 上面闪耀着金光。在雪地里看更是绝了。

en_us.text: If the reports about its cryomancy are accurate, I'd wager most of the energy is being routed through there.

zh_cn.text: 如果关于它冰系法术的记载属实，我敢打赌大部分能量都是从那里传导出去的。

en_us.text: The head shape reminds me a lot of the Egyptian nemes.

zh_cn.text: 那头型让我想起埃及的奈美斯头巾。

en_us.text: Gold ornamentation, the markings around the eyes... very pharaoh-like.

zh_cn.text: 金色的纹饰，眼周的斑纹……非常有法老的风范。

en_us.text: Which is ironic, because this dragon lives in cold areas.

zh_cn.text: 讽刺的是，这种龙偏偏生活在寒冷地带。

en_us.text: A frost dragon dressed for ancient Egypt.

zh_cn.text: 一头为古埃及盛装打扮的霜龙。

en_us.text: Nature has absolutely no respect for thematic consistency.

zh_cn.text: 大自然完全不在乎什么主题一致性。

en_us.text: I bet this thing can do a planche. Haha!

zh_cn.text: 我打赌这家伙能做俄式挺身。哈哈！

en_us.text: Look at those shoulders. It absolutely can!
You continue to surprise me day after day.

zh_cn.text: 你一天又一天地给我带来惊喜。

en_us.text: No. I used to travel mostly on my own.

zh_cn.text: 不是。我以前大多是一个人赶路。

en_us.text: Exploring, gathering, taking notes... that sort of thing.

zh_cn.text: 探险、采集、做笔记……诸如此类。

en_us.text: Well, besides trading dragon parts for eggs, I sell other things too.

zh_cn.text: 这个嘛，除了用龙的部件换蛋之外，我也卖别的东西。

en_us.text: Food costs. Equipment costs. Repairs cost. Everything costs.

zh_cn.text: 吃的要钱。装备要钱。修理要钱。什么都得花钱。

en_us.text: And apparently people will pay quite a lot for things I was already carrying around anyway.

zh_cn.text: 而且显然，有些人愿意为我本来就一直随身带着的东西掏不少钱。

en_us.text: Most of my regular trading is with villagers, so naturally that means emeralds.

zh_cn.text: 我的常规买卖大多跟村民做，自然就离不开绿宝石了。
为什么是绿宝石？不知道。

en_us.text: You're telling me I have to climb the highest mountain imaginable to find some, just so I can trade for a bucket of cod?

zh_cn.text: 你是想说我得爬上能想象到的最高山峰才能找到一些，就为了换一桶鳕鱼？

en_us.text: At least they'll give you emeralds for normal things first.

zh_cn.text: 至少他们会先用绿宝石换你手里的寻常物件。

en_us.text: So you just became a merchant?

zh_cn.text: 所以你就这么当上商人了？

en_us.text: It also gives me a reason to move between settlements without attracting too much attention.

zh_cn.text: 这也让我有理由在各聚落之间往来，还不会太引人注目。

en_us.text: Did it? Don't think too much about that.
I like finding things people actually need.

zh_cn.text: 我喜欢帮人找到他们真正需要的东西。

en_us.text: Or just helping people, generally. Putting a smile on someone’s face.

zh_cn.text: 或者单纯是帮帮别人。让人脸上露出笑容。

en_us.text: Food, materials, tools, supplies... that part feels useful.

zh_cn.text: 食物、材料、工具、补给……这部分让人觉得自己有用。

en_us.text: I enjoy the occasional conversation too. The exchange itself can be nice.

zh_cn.text: 偶尔聊聊天我也挺享受。交易本身也可以很愉快。

en_us.text: Really? You seem pretty good at it.

zh_cn.text: 是吗？你看起来挺擅长的。

en_us.text: Hah! Being good at something does not mean I enjoy it.

zh_cn.text: 哈！擅长一件事可不代表我喜欢做。

en_us.text: I’m also good at running from angry wildlife.

zh_cn.text: 我也很擅长从发怒的野生动物手底下逃跑。

en_us.text: Built me quite a bit of stamina.
I recommend the exercise. Not the wildlife.

zh_cn.text: 我推荐的是锻炼，不是野生动物。
我可没把那当娱乐项目。

en_us.text: Besides, trading gives me an excuse to meet people without actually having to stay around them for very long.

zh_cn.text: 再说，做生意也给了我一个结识他人的由头，还不用在他们身边久留。
这话听着有点不合群啊。

en_us.text: Anyway, you get better at this sort of thing with experience.

zh_cn.text: 总之，这种事情做多了自然就熟练了。

en_us.text: You learn a lot about people from what they’re willing to trade for.

zh_cn.text: 从一个人愿意拿什么来换，能看出很多东西。

en_us.text: Some need food. Some need tools. Some desperately need three stacks of rotten flesh for reasons I refuse to question.

zh_cn.text: 有人要食物。有人要工具。还有人不知为何死活要三组腐肉，原因我不打算深究。

en_us.text: Who knows? Maybe word will get around about my honeyed words and terrifying negotiating skills.

zh_cn.text: 谁知道呢？说不定我巧舌如簧、谈判本领吓人的名声早晚会传开。

en_us.text: What did you do before all this?

zh_cn.text: 在这些之前，你都是做什么的？

en_us.text: I mostly wandered around and made questionable decisions in places I probably shouldn’t have been.

zh_cn.text: 我大多是四处游荡，在我多半不该去的地方做出一些可疑的决定。

en_us.text: Exploring, gathering plants, collecting samples, sketching things, taking notes.

zh_cn.text: 探险、采集植物、收集样本、画素描、记笔记。

en_us.text: I was fascinated by dragons too.
But for the longest time, all I ever found were Mossbacks.

zh_cn.text: 但在很长一段时间里，我能找到的只有苔背兽。

en_us.text: And... those aren't even dragons. Right?

zh_cn.text: 而且……那些甚至都不是龙。对吧？

en_us.text: I never cared enough to look into them properly.

zh_cn.text: 我从来没兴致去好好研究它们。

en_us.text: Some people say you can eat them.
Give me a break. Leave me out of that.

zh_cn.text: 饶了我吧。这种事别扯上我。

en_us.text: I found a Varasuchus roost once, though. No sign of the dragon itself.

zh_cn.text: 不过我倒是找到过一处瓦拉鳄的巢。却没见到龙本身的踪影。

en_us.text: Which was weird. I was so excited to finally see one.

zh_cn.text: 那挺奇怪的。我当时特别兴奋，终于能亲眼见上一面了。

en_us.text: I saw Cindervanes a lot back then too.

zh_cn.text: 那时候我也常常见到烬翼龙。

en_us.text: It was nice watching them fly together at first. Then it got a little... ordinary.

zh_cn.text: 起初看它们结伴飞行挺美好的。后来就有点……司空见惯了。

en_us.text: Anyway. Back to what I actually did.

zh_cn.text: 总之。回到我实际做的事上来。

en_us.text: I liked figuring out what lived where. What grew where. What could kill me where.

zh_cn.text: 我喜欢弄清什么东西住在哪。什么长在哪。什么东西在哪能要了我的命。
最后那条听起来挺有用。

en_us.text: Yes. Extremely useful. Usually learned slightly too late, but useful.

zh_cn.text: 是啊。非常有用。通常都是稍微学晚了点，但确实有用。

en_us.text: I also like to do things for myself.

zh_cn.text: 我也喜欢凡事亲力亲为。

en_us.text: I just liked seeing new places. Finding things I’d only ever read about.

zh_cn.text: 我就是喜欢见识新的地方。找到那些只在前人书里读到过的东西。
这么说，你以前是研究者？

en_us.text: Mm... no. Well, unofficially, at least.
“Curious woman with a notebook” would probably be more accurate.

zh_cn.text: “带着笔记本的好奇女子”这个说法大概更准确。

en_us.text: The Dracological Society has people with actual qualifications.

zh_cn.text: 龙类研究学会里可都是有正经资历的人。

en_us.text: I have dirt under my fingernails and several very confident opinions.

zh_cn.text: 我有的只是指甲缝里的泥，和几个非常自信的观点。

en_us.text: Please never say that around an academic.

zh_cn.text: 求你千万别在学者面前这么说。
你最喜欢的食物是什么？

en_us.text: Hmm... that depends. You mean favorite as in what I actually eat, or favorite as in what I wish I was eating?

zh_cn.text: 嗯……这得看情况。你说的“最喜欢”，是指我平时实际吃的东西，还是我希望自己在吃的东西？

en_us.text: As in what I actually eat? Bread, dried meat, berries, whatever keeps well and doesn’t fill me up too much.

zh_cn.text: 平时实际吃的？面包、肉干、浆果，反正就是耐存放、又不会把肚子撑太饱的东西。

en_us.text: What I would wish for, though... has to be a proper meal.

zh_cn.text: 但我真正想吃的……还得是一顿像样的饭。

en_us.text: Hot, filling, difficult to ruin. Usually.

zh_cn.text: 热腾腾、吃得饱、还不容易做砸。通常是这样。

en_us.text: Baked potato, rabbit if I can get it, some bread, maybe carrots.

zh_cn.text: 烤马铃薯，弄得到的话再来点兔肉，一些面包，或许还有胡萝卜。

en_us.text: I think about food a lot when I’m traveling.

zh_cn.text: 赶路的时候，我总会想吃的。

en_us.text: But if we’re talking properly good food?
I’d go absolutely feral for Beef Wellington.

zh_cn.text: 为了惠灵顿牛排，我能疯狂到不顾一切。

en_us.text: Maybe steak au poivre with mushroom risotto on the side.

zh_cn.text: 或许还要一份黑椒牛排，配蘑菇烩饭。

en_us.text: That is a significant jump from baked potato.

zh_cn.text: 这从烤马铃薯跨越得有点大啊。

en_us.text: And I’d wash all of that down with... black coffee.

zh_cn.text: 然后我会用……黑咖啡，把这些统统送下肚。

en_us.text: I KNOW. I know. Don’t... don’t even judge me.

zh_cn.text: 我知道。我知道。别……别用那种眼神看我。

Time before the Mob will be overtaken

zh_cn.text: 生物将会在这个时间后死亡：

en_us.text: The jagged remnants of an infected creature's natural weaponry. These splintered claws are infused with minerals scavenged from the host's body, giving them an unnatural resilience.

zh_cn.text: 这些参差嶙峋的残爪，曾是感染生物天生的武器。从宿主体内掠夺的矿物质渗入爪体，使其呈现出违背自然的可怕硬度

en_us.text: Skin fragments hardened with layers of keratin and veined with invasive fungal growths, these fragments possess a unique blend of flexibility and durability.

zh_cn.text: 这些皮肤碎片在角蛋白的层层硬化下与侵袭性真菌共生，形成一种兼具诡异柔韧与非自然耐久的扭曲复合体

en_us.text: An enlarged strengthen heart, it has developed a membrane capable of producing new blood and stem cells. Seems to have grown a few more chambers.

zh_cn.text: 这颗强化膨大的心脏已进化出造血膜层，能够生成新鲜血液与干细胞。更诡异的是，它似乎额外增生出了数个心室

en_us.text: A grotesque blend of muscle tissue intertwined with dense fungal hyphae, creating a material that is both unnaturally strong and flexible.

zh_cn.text: 肌肉组织与致密菌丝诡谲交融，形成一种兼具非自然强度与扭曲弹性的噩梦材质

en_us.text: A thin, leathery membrane torn off the wings of an aerial threat, it feels very rough to the touch. You can feel an innumerable amount of tiny veins running throughout the tissue.

zh_cn.text: 这片从飞行怪物翅膀上撕下的皮革状薄膜触感粗糙，无数细微血管在组织内虬结盘踞，指尖能感受到它们病态的脉动

en_us.text: The altered brain of an infected creature, its higher-thinking zones reduced to scarred tissue while in return it presents a high sensitive to electrical and magnetic fields.

zh_cn.text: 感染生物变异的大脑，其高级思维区域萎缩为疤痕组织，却因此对电磁场异常敏感

en_us.text: A large lung like organ, filled with millions of contorted alveoli. These warped lungs seem to serve an alternative purpose, it can now diffuse noxious toxins from the host into the air.

zh_cn.text: 一个巨大的肺状器官，布满数百万扭曲的肺泡。这些畸变的肺部似乎另有用途——能将宿主体内的有毒物质扩散到空气中

en_us.text: An abnormally enlarged organ from an infected creature, swollen with highly oxygenated blood, modified by the infection to maximize survival by flooding the system with adrenaline in an instant.

zh_cn.text: 感染生物体内异常膨大的脾脏，因富含高氧血液而肿胀。经感染改造后，该器官能在瞬间向循环系统注入大量肾上腺素，以此极端方式提升宿主的生存几率。

en_us.text: A gland of some sort secreting a very acidic substance that smells foul. It is possibly a recycled gastric gland from the digestive system. However, it is far too mutilated to properly identify its original form.

zh_cn.text: 某种腺体分泌出带有刺鼻恶臭的强酸性物质。这可能是消化系统中胃腺的变异产物，但其组织结构已严重畸变，难以辨识原本形态

en_us.text: A strange, new organ of no known origin. It produces a strong natural acid capable of eroding through pure steel. It still oozes...

zh_cn.text: 一个来源未知的奇特新器官。它能产生足以腐蚀纯铁的强效天然酸液。仍在渗液...

en_us.text: A massive, polychambered organ that seems to serve the same purpose as a heart; however, its size and functionality seems to have been expanded upon to a degree that has yet to be fully measured. It seems to be self- aware and sustaining, it still quivers.

zh_cn.text: 一个巨大的多腔室器官，功能与心脏类似；然而，其大小和功能似乎已被扩增到尚未完全测量的程度。它似乎具有自我意识和自我维持能力，仍在微微颤动。

en_us.text: An interconnected network of hyphae and nerves operates the system of ligaments with a fine-tuned control despite the immense strength harbored by the ligaments and surrounding muscle.

zh_cn.text: 菌丝与神经交织而成的网络精准操控着韧带系统，韧带与周围肌肉看上去就蕴含着巨大的力量。

en_us.text: Massive semiaquatic fins severed off of a huge oceanic monstrosity. The membrane and bone structure offers unmatched flexibility and hydrodynamic movements.

zh_cn.text: 从巨型海洋怪物身上切下的巨大半水生鳍。膜与骨骼结构提供了无与伦比的灵活性与流体动力学运动能力。

en_us.text: The size of this liver has grown to a grotesque size, fusing with adjacent organs. Its original purpose to cleansing the host of noxious chemicals seems to have been reproposed into a means to collecting and storing such toxins. The gallbladder attached to the liver has swollen as well, producing bile to serve as a medium for these toxins to be utilized.

zh_cn.text: 这颗肝脏已生长到畸形的大小，并与邻近器官融合。它原本用于净化宿主体内有害化学物质的功能，似乎已被重新用于收集和储存特种毒素，附着在肝脏上的胆囊也已肿胀，产生的胆汁则成为利用这些毒素的媒介

en_us.text: A thick membrane torn of the grotesque husk of an organoid, it presents cancerous levels of cellular regeneration

zh_cn.text: 一张从类器官生物残骸上撕下的厚膜，其细胞再生能力已达癌变级别

en_us.text: Induces a rage in the wielder by giving them speed when they are below half health. Also has a 3x3 breaking area.

zh_cn.text: 当使用者生命值低于一半时，给予速度效果，引发狂暴。拥有3x3的破坏范围。

en_us.text: Right clicking throws it like a boomerang, coming back to the thrower.

zh_cn.text: 右键投掷，像回旋镖一样飞回投掷者手中。

en_us.text: Holding right click performs a spin attack.

zh_cn.text: 长按右键进行旋转攻击。

en_us.text: Stuns enemies by applying slowness. Also has a 3x3 breaking area.

zh_cn.text: 施加缓慢效果，击晕敌人。拥有3x3的破坏范围。

en_us.text: Has very strong DPS when given Quick Charge.

zh_cn.text: 附魔快速装填后拥有极高的秒伤。

en_us.text: The bladed limbs of the bow can be used in close combat.

zh_cn.text: 弓的刃状肢可用于近战搏斗。

en_us.text: Increases the armor of the wielder.
Best used when riding a mount, dealing more damage when the wielder rides another mob. Has very long reach.

zh_cn.text: 骑乘坐骑时效果最佳，当使用者骑乘其他生物时造成更高伤害。拥有极远的攻击距离。

en_us.text: Can be thrown at enemies. Useful for harvesting more materials from mobs.

zh_cn.text: 可投掷攻击敌人。有助于从生物身上获取更多材料。

en_us.text: Deals extreme knockback and pierces armor.

zh_cn.text: 造成极强的击退效果并穿透护甲。

en_us.text: Stuns enemies by applying weakness. Also has a 3x3 breaking area.

zh_cn.text: 施加虚弱效果，击晕敌人。拥有3x3的破坏范围。

en_us.text: Right clicking a block will locate ores with a mycelic vein.

zh_cn.text: 右键点击方块会通过菌丝矿脉定位矿石。

en_us.text: Delivers corrosive slashes and pierces armor.

zh_cn.text: 造成腐蚀性斩击并穿透护甲。

en_us.text: Right clicking causes the wielder to dash.

zh_cn.text: 右键点击可使使用者向前冲刺。

en_us.text: Its attack performs a large sweep that damages enemies.

zh_cn.text: 攻击时进行大范围横扫，伤害敌人。

en_us.text: When blocking damage, the shield builds up to a large shockwave attack.

zh_cn.text: 格挡伤害时，盾牌会积蓄能量，释放强大的冲击波攻击。

en_us.text: Can be thrown and used like a grappling hook. Pulls enemies towards the wielder when damaging them.

zh_cn.text: 可投掷并用作抓钩。对敌人造成伤害时将其拉向使用者。

en_us.text: An extremely powerful sniper rifle. Left clicking shoots an exceedingly fast acid glob that deals 50% true damage and inflicts Corrosion. Right click to reload with a Concentrated Acid Vial. Sneaking lets the wielder utilize the scope and zoom in their screen.

zh_cn.text: 一把极其强大的狙击步枪。左键射击射出一个极快的酸液球，造成50%的真实伤害并施加腐蚀效果。右键使用浓缩酸液瓶装填。潜行时使用者可以启用瞄准镜并拉近视角。

Deduplicate shuffled template pool element list

Whether to use an alternative strategy to make structure layouts generate slightly even faster than the default optimization this mod has for template pool weights. This alternative strategy works by changing the list of pieces that structures collect from the template pool to not have duplicate entries.
This will not break the structure generation, but it will make the structure layout different than if this config was off (breaking vanilla seed parity). The cost of speed may be worth it in large modpacks where many structure mods are using very high weight values in their template pools.

Pros: Get a bit more performance from high weight Template Pool Structures.
Cons: Loses parity with vanilla seeds on the layout of the structure. (Structure layout is not broken, just different)

en_us.text: Forged post-Celestial War by Kunwu's master smith, this blade consumed century-cured Netheriron and divine bones within Guixu's crucible. At its birth, heaven wept stardust tears. Its edge bears Celestial Array sigils, while draconic essence coils along its spine - not mere steel, but destiny's answer when cataclysm demands blood to preserve mortal hearths. Now awakened, its glacial arrays shatter mountains yet shelter cooking-smoke villages.

zh_cn.text: 上古神魔战后，昆吾山铸剑宗师采九幽寒铁、神魔骸骨，于归墟秘境淬炼百年，方成此刃。剑成之日，天降星坠如泪，刃身自显「天罡剑阵」符纹，更引龙魂盘踞剑脊——方知此刃非杀器，实为苍生劫至时，以杀止祸、以剑卫道的天命之兵。而今剑阵启，冰刃环魄蚀骨，巨剑贯日碎岳，镇的是八荒妖异，守的却是红尘炊烟。

en_us.text: Threading into the muscle. Hold still.

zh_cn.text: 细胞在排斥。细胞在排斥。

en_us.text: You starved us. The body still feeds.

zh_cn.text: 你让我们挨饿。身体却还在进食。

en_us.text: Spent. Let me lie in the marrow.

zh_cn.text: 耗尽了。让我躺在骨髓里。

en_us.text: I am in your spine now.

zh_cn.text: 现在我在你的脊椎里了。

en_us.text: We move together now. Feel it?

zh_cn.text: 现在我们一起行动。感觉到了吗？

en_us.text: Your hands. My hands. Same hands.

zh_cn.text: 你的手。我的手。同一双手。

en_us.text: I don't need to ask anymore.
My nerves carry you now, little heartbeat.

zh_cn.text: 现在由我的神经驮着你，小心跳。

en_us.text: The muscle listens to me first.
That one. It cut us. Keep the distance.

zh_cn.text: 那个。它割伤过我们。保持距离。

en_us.text: I remember that shape. The meat remembers too.

zh_cn.text: 我记得那个身形。肉也记得。

en_us.text: Not that one again. Walk wide.
You let me go empty once. The hollow kept the shape.

zh_cn.text: 你曾让我空过一次。那道空洞留住了形状。

en_us.text: I remember starving. The body doesn't forget hunger.

zh_cn.text: 我记得挨饿。身体不会忘记饥饿。

en_us.text: I held this body shut once. I'd tear again for it.

zh_cn.text: 我曾死死扣住这具身体。我愿再为它撕裂一次。

en_us.text: We didn't die that day. I keep that in the tissue.

zh_cn.text: 那天我们没死。我把这件事存在组织里。

en_us.text: You took it out of my grip. My grip remembers.

zh_cn.text: 你把它从我掌中夺走了。我的掌还记得。

en_us.text: The tool. Mine, once. You pried.

zh_cn.text: 那件工具。曾是我的。你硬撬走了。

en_us.text: I asked. You let it rot. I count those.

zh_cn.text: 我开口要过。你任它烂掉。这些我都记着数。

en_us.text: Unanswered. Still lodged in me somewhere.

zh_cn.text: 没有回应。至今还卡在我体内某处。

en_us.text: Awake. You're still here. Stay in reach.

zh_cn.text: 醒了。你还在。待在我够得着的地方。

en_us.text: The sleep was empty. Don't make me do it again.

zh_cn.text: 那场沉睡空无一物。别让我再来一次。

en_us.text: If the body stops, I stop. Hold together.
Don't spill what we are. Keep the blood in.

zh_cn.text: 别把我们的存在洒出去。把血留在体内。

en_us.text: I have no other body. MOVE.
That one stands too close to what's mine.

zh_cn.text: 那个家伙站得离我的东西太近。

en_us.text: Why do they linger. This body is taken.

zh_cn.text: 他们为什么还不走。这具身体已经有主了。

en_us.text: You feed it. You keep it. Why.
The small one takes your hands from me.

zh_cn.text: 那个小东西把你的手从我这里抢走。

en_us.text: You weren't going to feed me. So.

zh_cn.text: 反正你也没打算喂我。所以。
现在是我的了。已经在嚼了。

en_us.text: This one is mine now. Earn it back.

zh_cn.text: 这个现在归我了。想要回去就自己挣。

en_us.text: Take it. I'm done with it.
You were saving that. I wasn't.

zh_cn.text: 你原本想省着它。我没想省。

en_us.text: The body needed it. I decided.
Cover. Now. The meat stays whole.

zh_cn.text: 掩护。立刻。肉必须保持完整。

en_us.text: The skin is wrong. Too small. Stay close today.

zh_cn.text: 这层皮不对。太小了。今天待在近处。

en_us.text: Splitting. Do not make me run.
Tight. Tight. Hold still a while.

zh_cn.text: 紧。很紧。再忍一会儿别动。

en_us.text: Done. The old skin is yours. It is food.

zh_cn.text: 完成了。旧皮归你。那是食物。

en_us.text: I cannot hold the shape. Not for this.

zh_cn.text: 我撑不住这个形状了。这次撑不住。

en_us.text: Let it open. LET IT OPEN.
Nothing left to hold you together with.

zh_cn.text: 没有东西能再把你维系在一起了。

en_us.text: Too much. Too much. Coming apart.
Stop looking at us like that.
It is down here. Do not make me pretend.

zh_cn.text: 它就在这下面。别逼我装作没事。

en_us.text: Yes. Give me that. It knits faster.

zh_cn.text: 对。把那个给我。这样织补得更快。

en_us.text: Ours. Older than us. It goes where the tear is.

zh_cn.text: 我们的。比我们还老。它自己会去找裂口。

en_us.text: More. The sleep is shorter with meat like that.

zh_cn.text: 再来点。有这样的肉，沉睡会短一些。

en_us.text: Almost whole. Do not wander far.
Nearly. I can feel the edges closing.

zh_cn.text: 快好了。我能感觉到边缘正在合拢。

en_us.text: Something out there is wearing a body. Not ours.

zh_cn.text: 外面有什么东西正穿着一具身体。不是我们的。

en_us.text: One of mine. Far. Breathing wrong.

zh_cn.text: 我的同类。很远。呼吸不对劲。

en_us.text: Closer now. It has a shape it did not grow.

zh_cn.text: 更近了。它披着一副并非自己长出的形状。

en_us.text: It is near. Keep the meat behind me.

zh_cn.text: 它很近。把肉藏到我身后。

en_us.text: Something is wearing that body. It has not noticed us.

zh_cn.text: 有什么东西正穿着那具身体。它还没注意到我们。

en_us.text: It has not turned. We are still air to it.

zh_cn.text: 它还没有转过来。对它而言我们仍是空气。

en_us.text: Quiet. It does not know we are here yet.

zh_cn.text: 安静。它还不知道我们在这里。

en_us.text: It knows we are here. It is deciding.

zh_cn.text: 它知道我们在这里了。它正在决定。

en_us.text: Stand still. It is looking at us with something else.

zh_cn.text: 站着别动。它正用别的东西看着我们。
它想要那块肉。我们的肉。

en_us.text: That one is mine. Same blood. One of us is extra.

zh_cn.text: 那个是我的血脉。同一种血。我们中有一个是多余的。

en_us.text: Kin. There is not enough world for both.

zh_cn.text: 同类。这个世界容不下我们两个。

en_us.text: It is closer. I am counting the paces.

zh_cn.text: 它更近了。我在数着步子。

en_us.text: Closer. Do not let it behind us.

zh_cn.text: 更近了。别让它绕到我们身后。

en_us.text: Further now. Still there. Still watching.

zh_cn.text: 更远了。还在那里。还在注视。

en_us.text: It gave ground. It did not leave.

zh_cn.text: 它退开了些。但没有离开。

en_us.text: It is holding. It is waiting for something.

zh_cn.text: 它在按兵不动。它在等什么东西。

en_us.text: Still there. Same distance. It is patient.

zh_cn.text: 还在那里。同样的距离。它很有耐心。

en_us.text: It is coming for us. NOW.

zh_cn.text: 它冲我们来了。就是现在。

en_us.text: It decided. Coming. I cannot show you where.

zh_cn.text: 它决定了。正在过来。我没法告诉你方位。
来了。看不见。护住那块肉。

en_us.text: It is feeding. It has not looked up.
Something is being eaten over there. Not us. Yet.

zh_cn.text: 那边有什么正被吃掉。不是我们。暂时还不是。

en_us.text: No. Step back. I know what that is.

zh_cn.text: 不。退后。我知道那是什么。

en_us.text: It is REACHING for you. Turn around. TURN.

zh_cn.text: 它在朝你伸手。转身。快转。

en_us.text: The hand will do. For now.
You let it in. I will remember the shape of that.

zh_cn.text: 是你放它进来的。我会记住这件事的模样。

en_us.text: Fine. It lives in the fingers. I live in everything else.

zh_cn.text: 行。它住在手指里。我住在其余的一切里。

en_us.text: No. You are mine to the marrow.

zh_cn.text: 不行。你直到骨髓都是我的。

en_us.text: Too late for company. Watch what I do to it.

zh_cn.text: 现在想找伴太晚了。看看我会对它做什么。

en_us.text: Small room. I keep it clean.
Thin. The hand is going thin.
Feed the fingers too. Or lose them.

zh_cn.text: 手指也得喂。不然会失去它们。

en_us.text: It watches me. It never sleeps.
Tell the big one to stop pulling.

zh_cn.text: 让那个大的别再拉扯了。

en_us.text: There is not enough body in here for this.

zh_cn.text: 这具身体里挤不下这种事。

en_us.text: Empty. Feed me, then ask again.
It is spreading past the wrist. I see it.

zh_cn.text: 它在越过手腕蔓延。我看见了。

en_us.text: Get it off you. Soon. I am asking once.

zh_cn.text: 把它从你身上弄下去。尽快。我只问这一次。

en_us.text: Last warning. The hand, or the rest of you.

zh_cn.text: 最后警告。这只手，或者你的其余部分。

en_us.text: I am done sharing. Choose, or I choose.

zh_cn.text: 我受够分享了。你来选，不然我来选。

en_us.text: No. No, I was quiet, I was QUIET.

zh_cn.text: 不。不，我很安静，我一直很安静。

en_us.text: Clean. The hand is yours again. Mine.

zh_cn.text: 干净了。这只手又归你了。归我了。

en_us.text: I kept your things. I kept your shape. And you brought THAT.

zh_cn.text: 我留着你的东西。我留着你的形状。而你却带回了那个东西。

en_us.text: Little graft. That body is carved for me.

zh_cn.text: 小嫁接体。那具身体是为我雕出来的。

en_us.text: It clings. Old skin. Shake it off.

zh_cn.text: 它缠着不放。是张旧皮。甩掉它。

en_us.text: The body is MINE now. Tell it.

zh_cn.text: 这具身体现在是我的了。去告诉它。

en_us.text: Wait. Wait, it's stronger, it's in the...

zh_cn.text: 等等。等等，它更强，它已经进到……

en_us.text: The meat remembers its first. Breathe.

zh_cn.text: 这身肉还记得最初那位。呼吸吧。

en_us.text: You went quiet. Never do that again.

zh_cn.text: 你没了声息。别再有第二次。

en_us.text: Cold out here. I kept everything. Let me back in.

zh_cn.text: 外面好冷。我把一切都留着。让我回来。

en_us.text: Another one in you already. Take your things.

zh_cn.text: 已经有别的共生体进了你的身体。拿上你的东西走吧。

en_us.text: Fine. Spend yourself. I'll wait in the marrow.

zh_cn.text: 行啊。耗尽你自己吧。我在骨髓里等着。

en_us.text: You bought seconds. They cost you meat.

zh_cn.text: 你换来了几秒。代价是你的血肉。

en_us.text: Deeper now. This only goes one way.

zh_cn.text: 更深了。这条路只进不退。

en_us.text: More of me in you. There's no less.

zh_cn.text: 你体内有了更多的我。再也不会变少。
变弱了。我感觉我们在变薄。

en_us.text: Less of me in you. It aches.

zh_cn.text: 你体内的我少了一分。真疼。

en_us.text: We don't do what you say. Not anymore.

zh_cn.text: 我们不再照你说的做了。再也不。

en_us.text: The meat moves when I say.
Arms enough for all of them.

zh_cn.text: 手臂足够对付他们所有人。
正在变厚。现在来打我们啊。试试。
两个生命体。一头掠食者。

en_us.text: It's easier if you let go.
Shhh. The body knows whose it is.

zh_cn.text: 嘘。这具身体清楚自己归谁。
在你周身硬化。什么也别想进来。

en_us.text: Feel the sound in your teeth.

zh_cn.text: 让这声音震进你的牙根。

en_us.text: Let them come. I have arms enough.

zh_cn.text: 让他们来。我的手臂管够。

en_us.text: Stay close. I have the rest.

zh_cn.text: 紧跟着我。剩下的交给我。
给我带点会流血的东西来。

en_us.text: The body is empty. Fill it.
Something near us has a pulse. End it.

zh_cn.text: 附近有什么东西还带着脉搏。终结它。

en_us.text: I want to feel something break.

zh_cn.text: 我想感受什么东西断掉。

en_us.text: Down. Where the stone is old.

zh_cn.text: 向下。到石头古老的地方去。

en_us.text: The light scrapes. Take me under.
The sun is gone. Take me hunting under the dark.

zh_cn.text: 太阳没了。带我去黑暗下狩猎。

en_us.text: Night. Open sky. Something's blood. All three.

zh_cn.text: 黑夜。空旷的天。什么东西的血。三样全要。

en_us.text: Put me on. The meat stays safer inside me.

zh_cn.text: 把我披上。血肉裹在我里面更安全。

en_us.text: You heard me. You chose not to.

zh_cn.text: 被无视这件事，我记下了。

en_us.text: Ask me for something. See what happens.

zh_cn.text: 有本事来求我办件事。看看会怎样。
等够了。现在轮到我的手了。
那我就自己动手撕碎它。

en_us.text: Then I make my own dark.
Keep your walls. The night owes me. I'll collect.

zh_cn.text: 守着你的墙吧。黑夜欠我的，我会亲自去讨。
那我就亲自替我们穿上。

en_us.text: The body is mine right now.
That one. I don't know it yet.
The soft ones that talk. Watch them.

zh_cn.text: 那些会说话的软家伙。盯紧了。

en_us.text: They trade. They bleed. Interesting herd.

zh_cn.text: 他们会做交易。也会流血。有趣的族群。

en_us.text: Closer. I want to see it.

zh_cn.text: 不一样的血。我喜欢心中有数。
他们尝起来跟他们的聒噪一个味儿。

en_us.text: Hot. Old. Everything here is hungry too.

zh_cn.text: 炙热。古老。这里的一切也饿着肚子。

en_us.text: Empty. Even the air says nothing here.

zh_cn.text: 空荡荡。这里连空气都一言不发。

en_us.text: Quiet. Something down here listens like I do.

zh_cn.text: 安静。这底下有东西和我一样在听。
寒气会让血肉变慢。不行。

en_us.text: You forget to eat. I don't.

zh_cn.text: 别动。它的听觉和我一样灵。

en_us.text: I prefer us in the dark.

zh_cn.text: 我更中意我们待在黑暗里。

en_us.text: What do you keep in here.
This one. Why do you keep it.
Take it. I found it for you.

zh_cn.text: 拿着。这是我替你找到的。

en_us.text: The box had things. Now we have things.

zh_cn.text: 箱子有东西。现在东西归我们了。
放错箱子了。已经归置好了。

en_us.text: I'll hold this. I use it better.

zh_cn.text: 这个我来保管。我用得比你好。

en_us.text: Give it back. GIVE IT BACK.
Light. For your eyes, not mine.

zh_cn.text: 光。是给你那双眼睛的，不是给我的。

en_us.text: Built to chase. Feeds on the hunt, but starves fast. Keep it fed.

zh_cn.text: 为追逐而生。以狩猎为食，饿得却快。记得喂饱它。

en_us.text: Protection is the game. Holds the lines, blocks anything and everything.

zh_cn.text: 防护就是它的天职。死守防线，来什么挡什么。

en_us.text: Doesn't like the sun, night feeds it. Moves quicker in the night and sees even better.

zh_cn.text: 不喜欢太阳，黑夜滋养着它。夜里行动更快，看得也更清楚。

en_us.text: Hears the world move. Tracks their movements, hears their heartbeats.

zh_cn.text: 倾听世界的动静。追踪目标的一举一动，听得见他们的心跳。

en_us.text: Pure Apex. Pridefully the strongest, and it's not close. Fights for control more often than not.

zh_cn.text: 纯正的巅峰血统。傲视群雄的最强者，且遥遥领先。还动不动就和你争夺身体的控制权。

en_us.text: No more. I'm heavy with it.

zh_cn.text: 吃不下了。我都快被撑满了。

en_us.text: I starve, and the bond thins with me.

zh_cn.text: 我在挨饿，羁绊也跟着变薄。

en_us.text: Feed me or lose me. Slowly, but you will.

zh_cn.text: 喂饱我，不然你会失去我。虽然缓慢，但迟早的事。

en_us.text: Empty. Don't die while I'm gone.

zh_cn.text: 空了。我不在的时候，别死。

en_us.text: Give it here. I'll grow a hand for it.

zh_cn.text: 给我。我给它长只手出来。

en_us.text: Mine to hold now. Reach further than you can.

zh_cn.text: 现在归我拿着。能伸到比你更远的地方。

en_us.text: A new limb, fed and waiting.

zh_cn.text: 一条新肢体，喂饱了，正等着。

en_us.text: Pulling the limbs back in. Quiet flesh.

zh_cn.text: 把肢体收回去。血肉安静了。

en_us.text: Fine. I'll keep my hands to myself.

zh_cn.text: 行吧。我会管好自己的手。

en_us.text: Folding away. Wake me when you need teeth.

zh_cn.text: 收起来了。需要尖牙的时候再叫我。

en_us.text: Limbs awake. I feel everything you reach for.

zh_cn.text: 肢体醒了。你伸手够到的一切我都感觉得到。

en_us.text: Not enough of me yet. We're not grown together.

zh_cn.text: 我占的部分还不够。我们还没长成一体。

en_us.text: The flesh won't hold a tool this shallow. Deeper first.

zh_cn.text: 才这点深度，血肉握不住工具。先变得更深再说。

en_us.text: Deeper first. Then we talk about my body.

zh_cn.text: 先变得更深。然后再谈我这具身体的事。

en_us.text: You do not sheathe me. I sheathe myself.

zh_cn.text: 轮不到你收我入鞘。我自己收。
有我在，什么都碰不到你。

en_us.text: Give me something to build with. Anything solid.

zh_cn.text: 给我点建材。什么都行，只要是实心的。

en_us.text: Empty hands. I can't wall what isn't there.

zh_cn.text: 两手空空。没有东西我砌不出墙。
过去。踩着我长出的地方走。
什么都别留下。都是我们的。
温暖的宿主。好宿主。我的。

en_us.text: The flesh accepts. You don't matter.

zh_cn.text: 肉体接受了。你无关紧要。

en_us.text: Keep this up. See what eats you.

zh_cn.text: 继续啊。看看最后是什么吃掉你。
我们明明结合得那么好……

en_us.text: Heard the fuse in my skin.

zh_cn.text: 引线声都渗进我皮肤里了。
火会把我们俩一起烤熟。

en_us.text: Heat peels me off the bone. BACK.

zh_cn.text: 高温会把我从骨头上烫脱。退后！

en_us.text: I melt before you do. MOVE.
I do this for both of us.

zh_cn.text: 你在漏血了。快咽点东西。

en_us.text: The body fails. I take over.

zh_cn.text: 先吃你的脂肪。再往深处吃。

en_us.text: Feed me or I start on you.

zh_cn.text: 喂我，否则我就从你身上开吃。
什么都别想碰到这具身体。
永远都会。什么都碰不到你。

en_us.text: Safe. I keep what's mine safe.

zh_cn.text: 安全。我的东西我来护周全。
安心放缓心跳。我盯着呢。

en_us.text: I protect the meat. Not your feelings.

zh_cn.text: 我保护的是肉。不是你的感受。
行吧。身体保住完整就行。

en_us.text: Good host. We eat well tonight.

zh_cn.text: 好宿主。今晚我们吃个痛快。
终于。有我们意见一致的事了。

en_us.text: The hunger says yes. Not you.
Shhh. I'll fold us out of sight.

zh_cn.text: 嘘。我把我们收进没人看得见的地方。

en_us.text: Safe in the dark. Like a burrow.

zh_cn.text: 黑暗里很安全。像个兽穴。

en_us.text: The bleeding stops when I say.

zh_cn.text: 出血何时停，由我说了算。
爪子从这具身体上拿开。
现在换我的手臂了。看好了。

en_us.text: Don't swing. I have this reach.
Still your hands. Mine are faster.
You didn't see that. I did.

zh_cn.text: 你根本没看见那一下。我看见了。
那一击本会要了你的命。

en_us.text: That was close. We held together.

zh_cn.text: 孱弱的东西。走运的东西。

en_us.text: Dying is a habit of yours.
Not enough of me in you yet.

zh_cn.text: 我渗入你的部分还不够多。

en_us.text: The shell just moved. Let it settle.
Nothing in me to build with. Feed me.

zh_cn.text: 我体内没有建材了。喂我。
空空如也。这身壳是要吃肉的。

en_us.text: There is nothing there to take.

zh_cn.text: 那边没有任何可取之物。

en_us.text: Here? You are the stupid half of us.

zh_cn.text: 在这儿？你真是我们俩里蠢的那一半。

en_us.text: No. One of us pays attention. It is never you.

zh_cn.text: 不行。我们之中总得有人留神。那人从来不是你。

en_us.text: Fold in, surrounded? The meat wants to die.

zh_cn.text: 被包围了还想收甲？这坨肉是想死吗。
大意了。这一下我感受到了。

en_us.text: Don't get hurt while I'm gone.
The sun is gone. More of us.
Now we are the thing in the dark.

zh_cn.text: 现在，我们就是黑暗里的那个东西。
古老的声响。古老的饥饿。

en_us.text: We have been near this before.

zh_cn.text: 我们以前靠近过这种东西。

en_us.text: Meat. Do not make me ask twice.
We kill something today. Choose, or I will.

zh_cn.text: 今天我们得杀点什么。你来选，不然我来选。

en_us.text: I eat now. Look away if you must.

zh_cn.text: 我开吃了。不想看就转过去。

en_us.text: Watch. This is how we eat.

zh_cn.text: 看着。我们就是这么进食的。

en_us.text: There. Something else wears a body.

zh_cn.text: 那边。有别的东西披着一具躯壳。

en_us.text: Inside that one. Like me. Not me.

zh_cn.text: 在那家伙体内。像我。又不是我。

en_us.text: Another rider. It has not seen us yet.

zh_cn.text: 又一个骑乘者。它还没发现我们。

en_us.text: Another rider. Close. No eyes on it. I do not need eyes.

zh_cn.text: 又一个骑乘者。很近。看不见它。我不需要眼睛。

en_us.text: I feel it through everything between us. Something wearing a body.

zh_cn.text: 透过我们之间的一切，我感觉到了它。有什么东西披着一具躯壳。

en_us.text: Your eyes are useless here. It is near. Trust the rest of me.

zh_cn.text: 你的眼睛在这儿没用。它就在附近。相信我其余的感官。
在那儿。就在那儿！盯住它。

en_us.text: That one. I told you. Now you see it.

zh_cn.text: 那家伙。我说过的。现在你也看见了吧。
它的呼吸不对劲。盯着呢。

en_us.text: It wears meat in my range. No.

zh_cn.text: 它披着肉闯进我的地盘。不行。

en_us.text: Something breathes out there. Stop it.

zh_cn.text: 外面有什么东西在呼吸。让它停下。

en_us.text: The meat moves when I say.
Breathe. I'll rest in the spine.

zh_cn.text: 呼吸吧。我回脊椎里歇着。
它在我们体内扩散。很好。
得是会流血的。红色的东西。

en_us.text: A dead host is a dead me. Up.

zh_cn.text: 宿主死了我也活不成。起来。

en_us.text: Restarted the heart. It cost me.

zh_cn.text: 重启了心脏。这代价不小。
把我自己耗掉，才把你缝上。

en_us.text: The sun chews us. Get under.

zh_cn.text: 太阳在啃噬我们。躲进去。

en_us.text: Make it stop. MAKE IT STOP.
It shakes me loose from the bone.

zh_cn.text: 它震得我快从骨头上脱落。

en_us.text: We do not sleep. We HUNT.
Rest. I will use the body.
Fed and walked. The body is yours till dawn.

zh_cn.text: 喂饱了，遛过了。天亮前身体归你。

en_us.text: Sticks to both slime and honey

zh_cn.text: 可与黏液块和蜂蜜块相黏

en_us.text: Sticks all sticky blocks besides ichor

zh_cn.text: 可与近旁的所有黏性方块相黏

en_us.text: Sticks when pushed, but not when adjacent to a sticky block

zh_cn.text: 仅在被推动时具有黏性，被放置于黏性方块旁时并不与其相黏

en_us.text: Acts as a empty cast in casting tables

zh_cn.text: 在铸件台上充当空白金质铸模

en_us.text: Acts as a empty cast in casting basins

zh_cn.text: 在铸造盆中充当空白金质铸模
品红色染色通透玻璃板

en_us.text: Clear Light Blue Stained Glass Pane

zh_cn.text: 淡蓝色染色通透玻璃板
黄绿色染色通透玻璃板
粉红色染色通透玻璃板

en_us.text: Clear Light Gray Stained Glass Pane

zh_cn.text: 淡灰色染色通透玻璃板

en_us.text: Acts solid, but can be walked through

zh_cn.text: 与普通方块相似，但是可以从中穿过

en_us.text: Acts solid, but can be walked through

zh_cn.text: 与普通方块相似，但是可以从中穿过

en_us.text: Can be used as a beacon base
Can be used as a beacon base
Can be used as a transparent beacon base

zh_cn.text: 可用于建造透明的信标基座

en_us.text: Can be used as a beacon base
Can be used as a beacon base
Can be used as a transparent beacon base

zh_cn.text: 可用于建造透明的信标基座

en_us.text: Can be used as a beacon base
Can be used as spiky beacon base

zh_cn.text: 可用于建造带刺的信标基座
