en_us.text: Removes a random effect when eaten

zh_cn.text: 食用后随机移除身上的一种状态效果

en_us.text: Shards of metal consumed by skyslimes.

zh_cn.text: 被碧空史莱姆吞食的钢碎片

en_us.text: Natural formation of steel shards. Does not regrow.

zh_cn.text: 自然形成的钢碎片堆。采集后不会再生

en_us.text: Shards of metal found near ichor.

zh_cn.text: 在灵浆周围出现的金属碎片

en_us.text: Natural formation of cobalt shards. Does not regrow.

zh_cn.text: 自然形成的钴碎片堆。采集后不会再生

en_us.text: Shards of metal consumed by enderslimes.

zh_cn.text: 被末影史莱姆吞食的骑士金属碎片

en_us.text: Natural formation of knightmetal shards. Does not regrow.

zh_cn.text: 自然形成的骑士金属碎片堆。采集后不会再生

en_us.text: Reduces chance of a tool taking damage

zh_cn.text: 降低工具消耗耐久度的概率
提升盔甲对火焰的抗性
提升盔甲对弹射物的抗性
提升盔甲对爆炸的抗性
提升盔甲对魔法伤害的抗性

en_us.text: Increases armor resistance against general attacks

zh_cn.text: 提升盔甲对普通攻击的抗性

en_us.text: Prevents a tool from damaging block drops

zh_cn.text: 防止工具损伤方块掉落物
从末影龙身上炸下来的

en_us.text: Missing or invalid NBT defining the modifier type

zh_cn.text: 定义强化类型的NBT缺失或无效

en_us.text: Apply to a tool to gain 1 level of the modifier, consuming the appropriate slots.

zh_cn.text: 加持后工具对应强化等级增加1级并消耗相应的强化槽

en_us.text: Missing or invalid NBT defining the slot type

zh_cn.text: 定义强化槽类型的NBT缺失或无效

en_us.text: In creative, use on a tool in the inventory to grant an additional %s slot, or use a tool on it to remove the slot.

zh_cn.text: 处于创造模式下，在物品栏中对工具使用可增加1个额外的%s槽，或用工具对其使用移除强化槽。

en_us.text: Creative slots only work for players in creative.

zh_cn.text: 创造强化槽仅在玩家处于创造模式下可用。

en_us.text: Stackable container holding 1 ingot of fluid

zh_cn.text: 可堆叠的流体容器，能够盛装1锭的流体

en_us.text: Reusable pattern for making arrow parts in the part builder

zh_cn.text: 在部件制作台上用以制作箭矢部件的模具，使用后不消耗

en_us.text: Small Axe Head Red Sand Cast
Broad Axe Head Red Sand Cast
Blazing blood is an acceptable fluid for combat, but it really shines as a light source.

zh_cn.text: 烈焰血不仅适合于战斗，更适合做一个光源。

en_us.text: Powder snow is a useful fluid for nether combat, dealing bonus damage to blazing mobs.

zh_cn.text: 细雪在下界战斗时效果不错，可以对烈焰生物造成额外伤害。

en_us.text: So sweet, and removes toxins, what not to love with slurping honey?

zh_cn.text: 香甜适口，清热解毒，还有什么理由不会爱上蜂蜜这口感呢？

en_us.text: Beetroot soup is an easily farmable slurpable food option.

zh_cn.text: 甜菜汤，原料简单，美味又香甜。

en_us.text: Mushroom stew is a very affordable soup option for slurping on the go.

zh_cn.text: 蘑菇煲，经济实惠，旅行必备。

en_us.text: Rabbit stew is the best liquid food available, ideal for slurping.

zh_cn.text: 兔肉煲，上等汤品，宜大口啜饮。

en_us.text: Don't ask what is in the meat soup; just enjoy the flavor as you slurp this down.

zh_cn.text: 肉汤，不必询问原料，只需享受入口那一瞬的美味。

en_us.text: Potions allow a wide variety of effects crafted in a brewing stand. Can dump potions into tanks to fill tools.

zh_cn.text: 药水可通过酿造台制得，具有不同效果，可以从储罐里装填工具。

en_us.text: Earthslime is a portable piston, ideal for simple flying carpets. Well, assuming bricks count as carpet.

zh_cn.text: 大地黏液像是某种便携活塞，可以当作简易飞毯。好吧……假如你能接受把 地板当作地毯的话。

en_us.text: Skyslime is a portable piston, ideal for when you built your base just 1 block away from where it belongs.

zh_cn.text: 碧空黏液像是某种便携活塞，非常适合建设基地时手滑，放偏了1格的状况。

en_us.text: Venom pairs very well with venombone, the hint is in the name.

zh_cn.text: 毒液和毒之骨是一对好搭档，它们的名字足以证明这一点。

en_us.text: Ichor is a reverse gravity fluid, helping you also reverse gravity. Surviving the trip back down is on you.

zh_cn.text: 灵浆是一种反重力流体，还可以助你抵抗重力。怎么活着下来就看你本事 了。

en_us.text: Most unusual method of smeltery construction.

zh_cn.text: 极具特色的冶炼炉搭建方式。
剑走偏锋的熔铸炉创造方式。

en_us.text: Great for quickly building a wall, or just solidifying clay without a cast.

zh_cn.text: 能快速筑起一道墙，或者在没有铸模的情况下固化黏土。

en_us.text: Molten glass can quickly solidify into an easily removable window.

zh_cn.text: 熔融玻璃可以快速固化成某种可拆卸的玻璃。

en_us.text: Liquid soul lets you greatly slow opponents, at least that is the hope.

zh_cn.text: 液态灵魂会全力帮你拖住敌人，以此为你留下一线生机。

en_us.text: Molten obsidian becomes a very difficult to remove blockage.

zh_cn.text: 熔融黑曜石会冷却成一种难以破坏的方块。

en_us.text: Molten emerald is the choice for mining when you need silk touch.

zh_cn.text: 熔融绿宝石，在你需要精准采集时，不失为一种选择。

en_us.text: Molten quartz is a modest mining fluid, not too expensive and not too strong.

zh_cn.text: 熔融石英是一种平凡的采掘用流体，造价不贵，但它的强度有限。

en_us.text: Molten amethyst is the cheapest mining fluid, but its not very strong.

zh_cn.text: 熔融紫水晶是最易得的采掘用流体，但它的强度有限。

en_us.text: Molten diamond lets you maximize the drops of your ores, but is it worth the cost of the fluid?

zh_cn.text: 熔融钻石可以增加矿石的掉落物，但与其开销相比真的划算吗？

en_us.text: Placing blocks turns a slimestaff into a building wand.

zh_cn.text: 让黏液手杖和建筑手杖一样，能够放置方块。

en_us.text: Molten iron is used to draw nearby items towards you, though in a pinch it can be useful in combat.

zh_cn.text: 熔融铁可以吸引附近的物品，或许在战斗的紧要关头能有些用处。

en_us.text: Molten gold first hurts you, then it heals you back more. Is it worth it? Up to you.

zh_cn.text: 熔融金会先灼伤你，随后回复更多生命值。这么做值得吗？由你自行判断。

en_us.text: Molten copper is a good emergency air supply for long underwater journeys.

zh_cn.text: 熔融铜能够在你长时间的水下旅途中为你提供应急氧气值。

en_us.text: Inhaling the lingering cloud is the safest way to use molten cobalt for haste, or just use it as a weapon.

zh_cn.text: 最安全的急迫获取方式是吸入熔融钴的区域效果云；拿它作武器也不错。

en_us.text: Molten debris is the strongest fluid for mining, even capable of mining obsidian.

zh_cn.text: 熔融残骸是最强的采掘用流体，它的强度足以挖掘掉黑曜石。
流动的熔融紫水晶青铜

en_us.text: Sometimes you really want to fight some phantoms, drinking a lot of molten amethyst bronze can help that happen.

zh_cn.text: 有时候你真的想打几只幻翼，那就喝一点熔融紫水晶青铜；不久后奇迹就 会发生。

en_us.text: Molten rose gold lets you lose a small amount of health for a temporary edge.

zh_cn.text: 熔融玫瑰金，让你牺牲少量生命值，以此作为代价得到临时优势。

en_us.text: Molten pig iron is the tastiest of molten metals. Not that its much of a competition.

zh_cn.text: 熔融生铁是最美味的熔融金属，不容争辩。

en_us.text: Molten manyullyn has the most damage potential between flat damage and damage over time.

zh_cn.text: 熔融玛玉灵有极高的基本伤害与持续伤害。
流动的熔融黑色科林斯青铜
熔融黑色科林斯青铜桶

en_us.text: Is molten hepatizon best for defense, or combat? Either is a risk reward setup.

zh_cn.text: 熔融黑色科林斯青铜是更适合防御，还是更适合进攻？两种选择都是风险 与机遇并举。

en_us.text: Ironically, Knightmetal is most suited to killing those from who it comes.

zh_cn.text: 极具讽刺意味的一点，熔融骑士金属正好克制能产出它的那些生物。
流动的熔融皇后史莱姆

en_us.text: Molten netherite is the highest base damage, for when you cannot wait for your target to bleed out.

zh_cn.text: 熔融下界合金拥有最高的基础伤害，来不及等待敌人流血而死的话，就用 它吧。
流动的熔融骑士史莱姆

en_us.text: They say carrots are good for your eyes, but molten tin is better.

zh_cn.text: 他们说多吃胡萝卜对眼睛好，但熔融锡对眼睛更好。

en_us.text: Molten aluminium is like milk, but aggressive. Ideal for combat when your opponents have too many effects.

zh_cn.text: 熔融铝像奶一样，但更具刺激性。适合应对那些有太多增益的对手。

en_us.text: Molten lead gives your attacks a little extra boost, if you are willing to wait.

zh_cn.text: 如果你愿意等，熔融铅会给你的攻击带来一点额外的提升。

en_us.text: Molten silver removes toxins without removing helpful effects.

zh_cn.text: 熔融银可以做到只排出毒素，而不影响正面效果。

en_us.text: Molten nickel lets you harm your enemies and reduce the risk of retaliation, what's not to love?

zh_cn.text: 熔融镍，可以打击敌人，还不用担心被打回来，有什么理由不爱呢？

en_us.text: Molten zinc is probably not the best choice to boost your speed, perhaps the speed will throw off an opponent.

zh_cn.text: 熔融锌也许并不是提升速度的最佳选择，但至少能让敌人眼花缭乱。

en_us.text: Not sure the applications of molten platinum slowing your enemies' mining speed, but you can probably figure one out.

zh_cn.text: 熔融铂能降低敌人的挖掘速度，不确定有什么用，但你可以试试看。

en_us.text: Molten tungsten is one of the heaviest metals, hopefully it will keep your enemies still.

zh_cn.text: 熔融钨是最“重”的重金属之一，希望它能让敌人定在那里。

en_us.text: Molten osmium keeps your enemies still for a future blow.

zh_cn.text: 熔融锇可以定住敌人，任你处置。

en_us.text: Radioactive decay from molten uranium isn't safe to be around, so dump it on your enemies.

zh_cn.text: 熔融铀产生的放射性衰变对人有害，不宜在附近逗留，最好还是浇到你的 敌人头上。

en_us.text: If only luck was actually a useful effect, this fluid would be great to drink!

zh_cn.text: 要是幸运效果有用的话，这种流体便是最棒的饮料！

en_us.text: Molten bronze is the perfect dark brown beverage for when you need to stay away and stave off phantoms.

zh_cn.text: 当你躲避幻翼的追踪时，熔融青铜便是最佳的深棕色饮料。

en_us.text: Molten brass helps you resist the heat, and the second sip is free if you time it right.

zh_cn.text: 熔融黄铜能帮你抵御高温；如果时机得当，第二口流体将不需要付出代价。

en_us.text: Molten electrum is great for when you need to mine fast on a budget.

zh_cn.text: 要想更节约地获得高速采掘效果，那么熔融琥珀金绝对是不二之选。

en_us.text: Molten invar may be useful if you are trying to eat that powerful cake, but otherwise is an odd fluid.

zh_cn.text: 想立即吃掉美味蛋糕的话，熔融殷钢也许派的上用场。除此之外，它只是 一种古怪的流体。

en_us.text: Molten constantan is useful against human opponents perhaps, but not so much against monsters.

zh_cn.text: 熔融康铜也许对真人对手还有点用，对怪物就说不准了。

en_us.text: Molten pewter is probably lower risk than venom to boost your strength, but not by much.

zh_cn.text: 相比于毒液，熔融白镴在获取力量这件事上风险更低，当然没低到哪去。

en_us.text: Molten steel lets you clear out enemies around you, or spread out bunched up enemies.

zh_cn.text: 熔融钢能清理你周围的敌人，也可以分散聚集的敌人。

en_us.text: Molten enderium is ideal as a weapon, keeping enemies from teleporting as you fight.

zh_cn.text: 熔融末影很适合当作武器使用，有效防止敌人一攻击就传送的状况。

en_us.text: Molten lumium is either used to keep your eye on the target or make a quick but obvious escape.

zh_cn.text: 熔融流明，上可用于追踪目标，下可用于迅速但显眼地撤离。

en_us.text: Molten refined glowstone is great for tracking targets without sacrificing much damage.

zh_cn.text: 熔融强化荧石十分适合追踪目标，并且不会丢伤害。
流动的熔融强化黑曜石

en_us.text: Molten refined obsidian maximizes damage against armored targets.

zh_cn.text: 熔融强化黑曜石能最大程度地打击那些有盔甲的目标。

en_us.text: Nicrosil has an innate pull on magic, seems like a waste to use it like this.

zh_cn.text: 镍铬合金对魔法有天然的亲和力，这么做实属有些浪费。
让你断开与世界的连接。

en_us.text: A perfect snack for the middle of a battle.
Useful both for you and your target to maximize gained experience.

zh_cn.text: 你与对手都能获得尽可能多的经验。

en_us.text: You might think this is a fantastic deal, so many extra ingots! But remember, fiery is really hard to get.

zh_cn.text: 超多额外金属！你可能觉得赚翻了。但别忘了，炽热的液体同样很稀缺。

en_us.text: Applies effects from potion, scaled by level
Pushes target with distance based on level
Pulls target with distance based on level
Mines up to hardness %s per level

zh_cn.text: 采掘硬度最高为%s的方块

en_us.text: Mines up to hardness %s per level with %s

zh_cn.text: 附带%2$s采掘硬度最高为%1$s的方块

en_us.text: Turns invisible when containing an item

zh_cn.text: 永远明亮的物品展示框

en_us.text: Turns invisible when any item is equipped
Has two arms for holding tools

zh_cn.text: 爆破！一种安全的采矿方式

en_us.text: A throwable weapon with higher damage
A throwable weapon with high knockback
Use on a mob to pick it up

zh_cn.text: 对生物使用来驮起它们

en_us.text: Holds up to 256 different tool parts

zh_cn.text: 可容纳256个不同的工具部件

en_us.text: Holds up to 64 stacks of 16 items

zh_cn.text: 存储所有可重复使用的铸模

en_us.text: These format allows you to have more control over separators in material names. By default we separate with space. You can use %1$s and %2$s if you wish to change the order.

zh_cn.text: These format allows you to have more control over separators in material names. By default we separate with space. You can use %1$s and %2$s if you wish to change the order.

en_us.text: Used to create casts, cannot be used to create tools.

zh_cn.text: 用于铸造铸模，但不能用于制造工具。

en_us.text: Use on a tool in the inventory to repair it the equivalent of %s ingots

zh_cn.text: 修复物品栏工具时，可提供等同%s锭的修复量

en_us.text:
The Pickaxe is a precise mining tool. It is effective on stone and ores.
It breaks blocks, OK?

zh_cn.text:
镐是一种精准型采掘工具，能够高效挖掘石头、矿石等石质方块。
挖方块用的，懂？

en_us.text:
The Sledge Hammer is a broad mining tool. It harvests blocks in a wide range.
Also effective against undead.

zh_cn.text:
大锤是一种范围型采掘工具，能单次挖掘一整片区域内的方块。
攻击亡灵生物有奇效。

en_us.text: The Vein Hammer is a broad mining tool. It harvests many connected blocks of the same type, perfect for ores.

zh_cn.text: 矿脉锤是一种范围型采掘工具，能一次挖掘多块相连的同类型方块，用以采集矿石收效甚佳。

en_us.text:
The Cutter Mattock is a versatile farming tool. It is effective on logs, dirt, sand, gravel, and plants.
Just don't dig your own grave!

zh_cn.text:
鹤嘴锄是一种多用途农耕工具，适用于挖掘木头、泥土、沙子、沙砾等方块，亦可用以收割作物。
请勿自掘坟墓！

en_us.text: The Pickadze is a versatile mining tool. It is effective on rock, dirt, sand and gravel, but is not sharp enough to mine tougher stone blocks like many ores.

zh_cn.text: 凿石锹是一种多用途采掘工具，适用于挖掘岩石、泥土、沙子和沙砾，但是其锐利程度不足以挖掘更硬的石质方块，比如各种矿石。

en_us.text:
The Excavator is a broad digging tool. It digs up large areas of soil and snow in a wide range.
Terraforming!

zh_cn.text:
开掘铲是一种范围型采掘工具，能单次挖掘一整片区域内的泥土和雪。
改天换地！

en_us.text:
The Hand Axe chops up wood and makes short work of leaves. It also makes for an effective weapon.
Chop chop!

zh_cn.text:
短柄斧能砍伐木材，也能高效清理树叶，更是一件趁手的兵器。
快劈，快！

en_us.text:
The Broad Axe fells small trees in a single swing, and makes quick work of large trees. It makes for a powerful heavy weapon.
Timber!

zh_cn.text:
一棵小树的倒伏，只在板斧一挥之间。对付较大的树木，板斧也能极大地提升砍伐效率。厚重有力的斧刃作为武器亦不在话下。
成吨木料！

en_us.text:
The Kama is a precision reaping tool, mowing down plants and shearing animals.
Right Click: Harvest and replant crops

zh_cn.text:
短刃镰是一种精准型收割工具，能够收割作物与剃取畜毛。
右击：收获并补种作物

en_us.text:
The Scythe is a broad reaping tool, mowing down plants in a wide area.
Right Click: Harvest and replant crops

zh_cn.text:
镰刀是一种范围型收割工具，能单次收割一整片区域内的植物。
右击：收割并补种作物

en_us.text:
The Dagger is a light weapon, capable of quick strikes from either hand.
Also good for cutting glass and some plants!

zh_cn.text: 匕首是一种轻型武器，无论主副手持握，皆可施展快速攻击。

en_us.text:
The Sword is a universal weapon. Sweep attacks keep enemy hordes at bay.
Also good against cobwebs!

zh_cn.text:
剑是一种泛用型武器，其横扫攻击能阻截成群结队的敌人。
还能高效清理蜘蛛网！

en_us.text: The Cleaver is a weapon for a smeltery master. High range attacks keep cut through the toughest of foes.

zh_cn.text: 弩是一种轻型远程武器，能快速发射箭或烟花。

zh_cn.text: 钓鱼竿是一种轻型远程武器，无需弹药即可对近处的目标实施打击。如果你想的话，还可以拿来钓鱼。

zh_cn.text: 标枪是一种兼具近战与远程能力的武器。既可以造成近战伤害，也能投掷出去造成弹射物伤害。请注意，不要在标枪脱手后没武器可用！

en_us.text: Arrows are your standard single-use projectile weapon, fired from both longbows and crossbows.

zh_cn.text: 箭矢是最基础的一次性使用的弹射物，可以通过长弓或弩发射。

en_us.text: Plate armor is a highly defensive armor set with limited ability slots.

zh_cn.text: 镶板盔甲是一种防御较高但能力槽有限的盔甲。

en_us.text: Shurikens and throwing axes are simple, disposable projectiles that can be thrown directly without any other tools. Shurikens fly a bit further, while axes deal more damage.

en_us.text: Increases melee damage by 0.5% per level times the square root of lost durability. Tool durability multiplier will divide the lost durability.

zh_cn.text: 每级使近战伤害额外增加已损失耐久度与工具耐久系数之比的平方根的0.5%。

en_us.text: Allows casting potion on the ammo to tip it. Tipped ammo will apply a potion effect in addition to its damage.

zh_cn.text: 可向弹药类工具浇注药水。令其在造成伤害的同时施加药水效果。

en_us.text: I am the bone of my sword
Increases melee damage by 0.5 and grants 1 armor pierce per level for 4 seconds.

zh_cn.text: 每级近战伤害+0.5，接下来的攻击无视目标等同于等级的护甲值，持续4秒。

en_us.text: Arrows apply 1 armor pierce per level for 4 seconds.

zh_cn.text: 箭矢命中后， 接下来的攻击无视目标 等同于等级的护甲值，持续4秒。

en_us.text: Has a 15% chance when hit for attackers receive 1 armor pierce per level for 4 seconds (or 8 seconds if blocking).

zh_cn.text: 受到攻击后，有15%概率使得接下来的攻击无视攻击者等同于等级的护甲值，持 续4秒（成功格挡则改为8秒）。

en_us.text: Causes the arrow to pierce through the first target it hits, while thrown projectiles disable shields.

zh_cn.text: 箭矢能穿过命中的第一个目标；掷出的武器可以禁用目标盾牌。

en_us.text: Grants resistance for 1 minute after drinking milk.

zh_cn.text: 饮用奶后获得1分钟抗性提升。

en_us.text: Increases unarmed damage by 0.5 and grants 1 armor pierce per level for 4 seconds.

zh_cn.text: 每级使空手攻击伤害增加0.5，且接下来4秒获得1×等级的穿甲。

en_us.text: Do you have a bone to pick with me?
Heals 5% per level of damage dealt from critical hits.

zh_cn.text: 暴击时，每级回复等于当次伤害5%比例的生命值。

en_us.text: Heals 5% per level of damage dealt from successful arrow hits.

zh_cn.text: 箭矢命中时，每级回复等于当次伤害5%比例的生命值。

en_us.text: Has a 15% chance when hit to heal over time 25% of damage received before armor.

zh_cn.text: 受到攻击后，在其他盔甲能力结算前，15%概率逐渐回复当次受伤最多25%比例 的生命值。

en_us.text: Heals 5% per level of damage dealt from successful hits.

zh_cn.text: 命中时，每级回复等于当次伤害5%比例的生命值。

en_us.text: Makes you immune to Wither I. Melee attacks cause 6 seconds wither to the target.

zh_cn.text: 受到伤害后，在其他盔甲能力结算完成后，15%概率逐渐回复当次最终受伤最多 50%比例的生命值。

en_us.text: Heals 5% per level of damage dealt from unarmed critical hits.

zh_cn.text: 暴击时，每级回复等于当次伤害5%的生命值。

en_us.text: Not just the endermen, but the enderwomen, and the enderchildren

zh_cn.text: 不只是末影人，还有末影娘和末影孩

en_us.text: Prevents the target from teleporting for a 5 seconds per effect level.

zh_cn.text: 防止目标传送，每级使效果持续时间延长5秒。

en_us.text: Prevents the target from teleporting for a 5 seconds per effect level and allows damaging endermen with arrows.

zh_cn.text: 防止目标传送，每级使效果持续时间延长5秒；使箭矢可以命中末影人。

en_us.text: Has a 25% chance randomly teleporting attackers away, or a 50% chance when blocking.

zh_cn.text: 有25%的概率将攻击者随机传送，成功格挡则概率改为50%。

en_us.text: Prevents the target from teleporting for 5 seconds per level, and can be fired at endermen.

zh_cn.text: 防止目标传送，每级使效果持续时间延长5秒；使弹射物可以命中末影人。

en_us.text: Allows the tool to be repaired using string in the tinker station or crafting table.

zh_cn.text: 工具可在工匠站和工作台上用线修复。

en_us.text: Spiders are a master of potions, maybe their secret can help me enhance potions...

zh_cn.text: 蜘蛛是药水大师，也许它们的秘密可以帮助我增强药水……

en_us.text: Causes positive potion effects to last 25% longer.

zh_cn.text: 使正面药水效果的持续时间延长25%。

en_us.text: Increases step height by 0.5 blocks per level.

zh_cn.text: 每级增加0.5格最大行走高度。

en_us.text: Killed a cow, tanned it's hide.
Prevents the tool from taking more than 1 damage in an action.

zh_cn.text: 所有操作中，工具最多只会消耗1点耐久度。

en_us.text: How do you do, fellow zombies?

zh_cn.text: 小僵僵们，最近过得怎么样啊？
使来自亡灵生物的伤害减少10%。

en_us.text: Keeps living, unlike the social network.

zh_cn.text: 朝气蓬勃，不像那死气沉沉的社交网络。

en_us.text: Tool has up to a 75% chance to resist damage in full sunlight.

zh_cn.text: 在太阳光完全照射的情况下，工具最高有75%的概率在使用时不消耗耐久度。

en_us.text: Ironic. He could save others from death, but not himself.

zh_cn.text: 真是讽刺。他能让别人起死回生，但却救不了他自己。

en_us.text: Causes mining blocks and hitting mobs to attract nearby items.

zh_cn.text: 挖掘方块与攻击生物时吸引周围物品。

en_us.text: Causes firing arrows to attract nearby items to the holder.

zh_cn.text: 箭矢射出时，吸引周围物品到持有者。

en_us.text: Reduces damage from projectiles by 8% per level, and grants 5% knockback resistance times the max level.

zh_cn.text: 每级使受到的弹射物伤害-8%；按等级最高的盔甲，每级增加5%击退抗性。

en_us.text: When taking damage, heals over time 50% of damage received after armor.

zh_cn.text: 近战攻击将穿戴者携带的所有负面效果复制到攻击目标身上。

en_us.text: Gives +6 mining speed against blocks that can be melted in a melter.

zh_cn.text: 挖掘的方块可以熔化时，每级使挖掘速度+6。

en_us.text: Reduces damage from fire by 10% per level, and reduces fire burn time.

zh_cn.text: 每级使受到的火焰伤害-10%；缩短自己的着火时间。

en_us.text: Gives +2 damage per level against burning targets.
Reduces damage from fire immune mobs by 5% per level, and reduces fire burn time.

zh_cn.text: 被免疫火焰的生物攻击时，每级使伤害-5%；缩短自己的着火时间。

en_us.text: Don't let this tarnish your day.
Grants bonus mining speed at lower depth, +6 per 64 blocks below 64.

zh_cn.text: 在低海拔处额外增加挖掘速度，每低于海平面64格，挖掘速度+6。

en_us.text: Grants bonus velocity at lower depth, +0.05 per 64 blocks below 64.

zh_cn.text: 在低海拔处额外增加箭矢初速度，每低于海平面64格，箭矢初速度+0.05。

en_us.text: Grants bonus protection at lower depth, +5% per 64 blocks below 64.

zh_cn.text: 在低海拔处额外增加保护属性，每低于海平面64格，保护+5%。

en_us.text: Grants an extra 30 seconds of air underwater.

zh_cn.text: 在水下获得额外的30点氧气值。

en_us.text: Grants 10% protection per level against magic damage and reduces negative potion duration. Also makes piglins friendly.

zh_cn.text: 每级对魔法伤害保护+10%，减少负面效果时间。让猪灵变得友好。

en_us.text: Causes some gold ores to drop extra gold nuggets, and increases drop chance of gold armor by 4%. Nuggets and armor drops are further boosted if trimmed and by each piece of golden armor worn.

zh_cn.text: 金矿石掉落额外的金粒，金盔甲的掉落概率+4%。每件正在穿戴的金盔甲额外增加金粒和金盔甲的掉落概率。

en_us.text: Is this the wood of a slime or slime that's been infused with wood?

zh_cn.text: 究竟是木头长出了黏液，还是黏液生出了木头？

en_us.text: Gives a 5% chance per level of regenerating overslime each second.

zh_cn.text: 每秒有等级×5%的概率回复黏液覆层。

en_us.text: Causes projectiles moving fast enough to bounce off blocks they hit up to 3 times.

zh_cn.text: 使弹射物飞行速度快到可以在方块上弹跳，最多3次。

en_us.text: Gives a 5% chance per level of regenerating overslime each second.

zh_cn.text: 有概率每秒自行再生黏液覆层，每级 概率+5%。

en_us.text: Become the bane of your enemies
Boosts melee damage when poisoned by 0.5 plus the level of poison.

zh_cn.text: 中毒时，近战伤害增加0.5+中毒等级。

en_us.text: Boosts drawspeed when poisoned by 0.05 plus 0.1 per level of poison.

zh_cn.text: 中毒时，拉弓速度将增加0.05+0.1×中毒等级。

en_us.text: Has a 15% chance when hit to venom the attacker making them take 200% magic damage for the next 5 to 10 seconds (or up to 15 seconds if blocking).

zh_cn.text: 受到攻击后，有15%概率对攻击者施加毒素效果，该效果会让它在接下来5至10秒 内受到的魔法伤害增加到200%（成功格挡则最长持续时间改为15秒）。

en_us.text: Applies venom to the target, causing them to take 200% magic damage for the next 5 to 10 seconds.

zh_cn.text: 对目标施加毒素效果，该效果会让它在接下来5至10秒内受到的魔法伤害增加到200%。

en_us.text: Boosts unarmed damage when poisoned by 0.5 plus the level of poison.

zh_cn.text: 中毒时，空手攻击伤害增加0.5+中毒等级。

en_us.text: Disclaimer: Not actually made with roses.

zh_cn.text: 免责声明：不是真的用玫瑰做的。

en_us.text: Grants 1 extra upgrade slot per part.

zh_cn.text: 每个部件增加1个额外的升级槽。

en_us.text: Putting that arm shield to good use

zh_cn.text: 把那件臂铠拿来物尽其用

en_us.text: Boosts health by 2 hearts, plus an additional 2 hearts when trimmed and per piece of golden armor.

zh_cn.text: 最大生命值增加1颗心。每件正在穿戴的金盔甲继续增加1颗心。

en_us.text: Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee.
Cancels out the mining speed reduction when not on the ground.

zh_cn.text: 离开地面时，不再受到挖掘速度削减惩罚。

en_us.text: Grants +0.1 velocity when not on the ground or a ladder.

zh_cn.text: 离开地面或攀附梯子时，让工具的箭矢初速度+0.1。

en_us.text: Grants +0.5 blocks jump height at first level, and +1 at second level. Increases the safe fall distance by 1 block per level.

zh_cn.text: 第一级增加0.5格跳跃高度，第二级增加1格跳跃高度。每级增加1格安全摔落高度。

en_us.text: Grants up to +1.25 melee damage in hot biomes, but lose up to -1.25 melee damage in cold biomes.

zh_cn.text: 在炎热的生物群系增加近战伤害，最多 增加1.25点； 在寒冷的生物群系减少近 战伤害，最多减少1.25点。

en_us.text: Grants +0.75 power in hot biomes, but lose up to -0.75 power in cold biomes.

zh_cn.text: 在炎热生物群系增加弹射物力量，最多 增加0.75点； 在寒冷生物群系减少弹射 物力量，最多减少0.75点。

en_us.text: Grants up to +5% protection in hot biomes, but lose up to -5% protection in cold biomes.

zh_cn.text: 在炎热生物群系提供的保护最多+5%；在寒冷生物群系提供的保护最多-5%。

en_us.text: Grants +40.5% speed on soul sand, plus an additional 10.5% added for each additional level. Reduces the slowdown from walking on soulsand.

zh_cn.text: 第一级使在灵魂沙上的移动速度+40.5%，后续每级增加10.5%。减少在灵魂沙上移动的减速效果。

en_us.text: Grants +6 mining speed at the cost of losing 1 health when you put down the tool.

zh_cn.text: 工具获得+6挖掘速度；代价是每次放下工具时流失1点生命值。

en_us.text: Grants +15% draw speed at the cost of losing 1 health when you put down the tool.

zh_cn.text: 工具获得+15%拉弓速度；代价是每次放下工具时流失1点生命值。

en_us.text: Grants +10% knockback resistance at the cost of losing 2 health when you remove the armor.

zh_cn.text: 盔甲获得+10%击退抗性；代价是每次卸下盔甲时流失2点生命值。

en_us.text: Increases movement speed by 15% per level, but deals 2 damage per level when unequipped.

zh_cn.text: 每级增加15%移动速度，代价是每次卸下盔甲时流失2点生命值。

en_us.text: Multiplies the projectile damage by 0. Note damage may still be increased by bow power, and it may still aggravate mobs.

zh_cn.text: 弹射物伤害会乘以0。注意，实际伤害仍可能因弓提供的弹射物力量而增加， 且仍会激怒特定生物。

en_us.text: Has no special effect, but unlike other fletching choices lacks a downside.

zh_cn.text: 没有特殊效果，相较其他箭羽材料而言也没有缺陷。

en_us.text: Grants you half as many arrows when crafting or part swapping, though they might be gained back if swapping from leaves.

zh_cn.text: 合成或部件替换时获得箭矢数量减半；由树叶部件换走时重新得到这些箭矢。

en_us.text: Protects you from bad aim, provided you were aiming straight ahead

zh_cn.text: 抛开只能向正前方发射不谈，确实不用担心瞄不准了

en_us.text: Grants +0.75 projectile damage per level, but restricts the angles the projectile may be thrown at. Stacks with amethyst bronze bows to further restrict angles.

zh_cn.text: 每级+0.75弹射物伤害，但限制弹射物可投掷的方向。与紫水晶青铜的效果叠加 将进一步限制瞄准角度。

en_us.text: Lets the ammo move freely underwater and grants +1 projectile damage per level to underwater targets. Fishing rods instead gain a level of lure.

zh_cn.text: 弹药类工具能自如地在水下运动，并且每级+1对水下目标的弹射物伤害。钓鱼 竿改为获得1级饵钓。

en_us.text: Adds a 15% chance per level to deal 1-4 damage on counterattacks, or a 30% chance when blocking.

zh_cn.text: 反击时，每级增加15%概率造成1-4点伤害，成功格挡则改为每级增加30%概率。

en_us.text: Causes the arrow to explode at a radius of 1 plus 1 per level. Explosion damage is based on projectile power.

zh_cn.text: 令箭矢在落点处爆炸，爆炸范围取等级+1格。爆炸伤害取决于弹射物力量。

en_us.text: Whose nice things are being destroyed now, creeper?

zh_cn.text: 现在是谁炸谁了，苦力怕？

en_us.text: Holding the helmet interact key while sneaking causes the wearer to explode.

zh_cn.text: 潜行并按住“头盔交互”键一段时间，可以使穿戴者爆炸

en_us.text: Grants +10% velocity per level to arrows, and +20% velocity per level to thrown projectiles.

zh_cn.text: 每级让箭矢获得+10%初速度；每级让掷出的武器获得+20%初速度。

en_us.text: Causes the target to be knocked back in the opposite direction.

zh_cn.text: 使目标沿相反方向击退。

en_us.text: Gives a 5% chance per level of regenerating overslime each second.

zh_cn.text: 每秒有等级×5%概率回复黏液覆层

en_us.text: Increases the knockback of the projectile.

zh_cn.text: 增强弹射物的击退效果。

en_us.text: Reduces gravity by 5% plus 10% per level per piece.

zh_cn.text: 使重力减少5%，每件盔甲每级再减少10%。

en_us.text: Grants +10% resistance while underwater, and increases swim speed by 5% per level based on the highest piece.

zh_cn.text: 按等级最高的盔甲，每级使穿戴者在水下时获得+10%抗性，且每级使游泳速度 增加5%。

en_us.text: Grants 1 respiration and +10% swim speed per level.

zh_cn.text: 每级获得1水下呼吸和10%游泳速度。

en_us.text: Master the cuisine of the sea
Grants immunity to Poison I, Hunger II, and Nausea I, increasing the max level of each when trimmed.

zh_cn.text: 免疫中毒 I、饥饿 II 与反胃 I，镶边后提升可免疫的等级上限。

en_us.text: Causes arrows to ignite, burning targets for 5 seconds per level.

zh_cn.text: 箭矢会燃烧且会点燃目标，每级使目标的燃烧时间+5秒。

en_us.text: Find yourself lighting on fire too much? Or perhaps not enough? Either way this is for you.

zh_cn.text:
你是不是动不动就头上冒火？
又或者觉得自己还不够燃？
不管怎样，这都是为你量身定制的。

en_us.text: Makes you immune to Conductive I and being lit on fire.

zh_cn.text: 近战攻击或远程攻击使目标着火，持续5秒。穿戴者免疫火焰伤害。

en_us.text: Gives +2 unarmed damage per level against burning targets.

zh_cn.text: 每级使对燃烧中的目标的空手伤害+2。

en_us.text: Causes you to teleport to the location the projectile lands, destroying it. If it hits a monster, swaps places.

zh_cn.text: 落地时摧毁自身，并使你传送到弹射物的落点。命中怪物时，与它交换位置。

en_us.text: Endermen know how to stay away from harm, and scientists. They have been ignoring my interview requests for weeks!

zh_cn.text: 末影人会回避危险，这帮搞科学的也是。他们几周都没接受我的采访邀请！

en_us.text: Allows teleporting a short distance in the direction you face by holding then releasing the helmet keybind.

zh_cn.text: 按住并释放“头盔交互”键，可朝视线方向进行一次短距离传送。

en_us.text: Grants 10% protection per level against magic damage and reduces the time of negative potion effects.

zh_cn.text: 每级获得10%对魔法伤害的抗性，缩短负面药水效果持续时间。

en_us.text: Decreases projectile damage by 0.75 per level, but gives it a tank. Upon impact, applies fluid effects from the fluid in the tank. Ammo breaks upon hitting a block when filled.

zh_cn.text: 每级-0.75弹射物伤害，但为工具增加一个储罐。命中目标时，对它造成储罐内 流体所对应的效果。充填流体时，击中 方块就会碎裂。

en_us.text: You must steal the slime to get slimesteel.

zh_cn.text: 你要把钢黏到一起才能获得黏钢。

en_us.text: Grants 25 extra overslime, +50% of the total per level.

zh_cn.text: 使黏液覆层最大值增加+25×等级，然后每级让最大值继续增加50%。

en_us.text: This is not an obsidian part, if it was it would say "Obsidian."

zh_cn.text: 这真的不是黑曜石，如果是的话，它的名字应该是“黑曜石”。

en_us.text: Causes 1 damage per second over time for 2 seconds per level. Consecutive hits add instead of replacing the time.

zh_cn.text: 目标受到1点/秒的持续伤害，持续时间为等级×2秒。连续攻击延长持续时间。

en_us.text: Has a 25% chance per level (50% if blocking) of doing up to 5 damage over time.

zh_cn.text: 每级提供25%概率（成功格挡则改为50%概率），造成总计最多5点持续伤害。

en_us.text: This is an obsidian part, if it was not it would not say "Obsidian."

zh_cn.text: 这真的是黑曜石，如果不是的话，它的名字不应该是“黑曜石”。

en_us.text: Grants 10% protection per level against explosions, and reduces explosion knockback.

zh_cn.text: 每级对爆炸伤害保护+10%；同时减弱受到的爆炸击退效果。

en_us.text: Not to be confused with bronze.
Grants +1 mining speed per level to blocks that don't require tools, notably ones where the tool is not effective.

zh_cn.text: 挖掘不需要工具采集的方块，尤其是与当前工具类型不匹配的方块时，每级使 工具的挖掘速度+1。

en_us.text: Adds +0.1 velocity per level at the cost of limiting arrow angles to 32, 16, or 8 directions at the first 3 levels respectively.

zh_cn.text: 每级使箭矢初速度+0.1；代价是箭矢只能以固定角度出射， 前三级分别使得 出射方向限定为32、16、8向。

en_us.text: Grants +5% attack speed per level at the cost of +5% duration on negative effects and limiting taken knockback angles to 32, 16, 8, or 4 directions.

zh_cn.text: 每级使攻击速度+5%；代价是负面效果持续时间延长5%，且只能以固定角度 被击退，前四级分别将方向限定为32、 16、8、4向。

Here you can craft tool parts to fulfill your tinkering fantasies.

To craft a part simply put a blank pattern into the left slot and select the part you want. The remaining slot holds the material you want to craft your part out of.

en_us.text: Waystone not found at this position
Set to true if experience cost should be inverted, meaning the shorter the distance, the more expensive. Can be used to encourage other methods for short-distance travel.

zh_cn.text: 设为 true 时，经验消耗将反转，即距离越短消耗越高。可用于鼓励玩家短途出行时改用其他方式。

en_us.text: The amount of blocks per xp level requirement. If set to 500, the base xp cost for travelling 1000 blocks will be 2 levels.

zh_cn.text: 每级经验需求对应的方块距离。若设为 500，则传送 1000 格的基础经验消耗为 2 级。

en_us.text: The minimum base xp cost (may be subceeded by multipliers defined below).

zh_cn.text: 最低基础经验消耗（下方定义的倍率可使其低于该值）。

en_us.text: The maximum base xp cost (may be exceeded by multipliers defined below), set to 0 to disable all distance-based XP costs.

zh_cn.text: 最高基础经验消耗（下方定义的倍率可使其超过该值）；设为 0 可禁用所有基于距离的经验消耗。

en_us.text: How much xp is needed per leashed animal to travel with you.

zh_cn.text: 每只被拴绳牵引、随你一同传送的动物所需的经验消耗。

en_us.text: The base xp level cost when travelling between dimensions. Ignores block distance.

zh_cn.text: 跨维度传送的基础经验等级消耗。无视方块距离。
全局传送石碑经验花费倍率

en_us.text: The multiplier applied to the cooldown when teleporting to a global waystone via inventory button or warp stone.

zh_cn.text: 通过物品栏按钮或传送石传送至全局路石时应用于冷却时间的倍率。

en_us.text: The multiplier applied to the base xp cost when teleporting using a Warp Stone item (not the Waystone block, Konstantin)

zh_cn.text: 使用传送石物品（而非路石方块，Konstantin）传送时应用于基础经验消耗的倍率。
共享石碑经验花费倍率

en_us.text: The multiplier applied to the base xp cost when teleporting from one sharestone to another.

zh_cn.text: 从一个共享路石传送到另一个时应用于基础经验消耗的倍率。
传送石碑经验花费倍率

en_us.text: The multiplier applied to the base xp cost when teleporting from one waystone to another.

zh_cn.text: 从一个路石传送到另一个时应用于基础经验消耗的倍率。
单向传送石碑经验花费倍率

en_us.text: The multiplier applied to the base xp cost when teleporting from a portstone.

zh_cn.text: 从港石传送时应用于基础经验消耗的倍率。
传送石板经验花费倍率

en_us.text: The multiplier applied to the base xp cost when teleporting from one warp plate to another.

zh_cn.text: 从一个传送板传送到另一个时应用于基础经验消耗的倍率。
背包按钮经验花费倍率

en_us.text: The multiplier applied to the base xp cost when teleporting via the inventory button.

zh_cn.text: 通过物品栏按钮传送时应用于基础经验消耗的倍率。

en_us.text: If enabled, only creative players can place, edit or break waystones. This does NOT disable the crafting recipe.

zh_cn.text: 启用后，仅创造模式玩家可以放置、编辑或破坏路石。这不会禁用其合成配方。

en_us.text: If enabled, only the owner of a waystone (the one who placed it) can rename it.

zh_cn.text: 启用后，只有路石的所有者（即放置者）可以重命名它。
生成无法破坏的传送石碑

en_us.text: If enabled, waystones generated in worldgen are unbreakable.

zh_cn.text: 启用后，世界生成中生成的路石将无法被破坏。

en_us.text: If enabled, leashed mobs will be teleported with you.

zh_cn.text: 启用后，被拴绳拴住的生物将随你一同传送。

en_us.text: Whether to take leashed mobs with you when teleporting between dimensions.

zh_cn.text: 跨维度传送时是否携带被拴绳拴住的生物。

en_us.text: List of leashed mobs that cannot be taken with you when teleporting.

zh_cn.text: 传送时不能随你一同传送的被拴绳生物列表。

en_us.text: Set to 'ALLOW' to allow dimensional warp in general. Set to 'GLOBAL_ONLY' to restrict dimensional warp to global waystones. Set to 'DENY' to disallow all dimensional warps.

zh_cn.text: 设为 'ALLOW' 表示总体允许跨维度传送；设为 'GLOBAL_ONLY' 表示跨维度传送仅限全局路石；设为 'DENY' 表示禁止所有跨维度传送。

en_us.text: List of dimensions that players are allowed to warp cross-dimension from and to. If left empty, all dimensions except those in dimensionalWarpDenyList are allowed.

zh_cn.text: 允许玩家跨维度传送往来于其中的维度列表。若留空，则允许除 dimensionalWarpDenyList 中维度以外的所有维度。

en_us.text: List of dimensions that players are not allowed to warp cross-dimension from and to. Only used if dimensionalWarpAllowList is empty.

zh_cn.text: 不允许玩家跨维度传送往来于其中的维度列表。仅在 dimensionalWarpAllowList 为空时生效。
允许传送石碑到传送石碑传送

en_us.text: Set to true if players should be able to teleport between waystones by simply right-clicking a waystone.

zh_cn.text: 设为 true 后，玩家只需右键点击路石即可在路石之间传送。

en_us.text: Global Waystone Setup Requires Creative Mode

zh_cn.text: 全局传送石碑设置需要创造模式

en_us.text: Set to false to allow non-creative players to make waystones globally activated for all players.

zh_cn.text: 设为 false 后，允许非创造模式玩家将路石设为对所有玩家全局激活。

en_us.text: The multiplier applied to the cooldown when teleporting to a global waystone via inventory button or warp stone.

zh_cn.text: 通过物品栏按钮或传送石传送至全局路石时应用于冷却时间的倍率。

en_us.text: The cooldown between usages of the warp stone in seconds. This is bound to the player, not the item, so multiple warp stones share the same cooldown.

zh_cn.text: 两次使用传送石之间的冷却时间（秒）。冷却与玩家绑定而非物品，因此多个传送石共享同一冷却。

en_us.text: The time in ticks that it takes to use a warp stone. This is the charge-up time when holding right-click.

zh_cn.text: 使用传送石所需的时间（刻）。即按住右键时的蓄力时间。

en_us.text: The time in ticks it takes to use a scroll. This is the charge-up time when holding right-click.

zh_cn.text: 使用卷轴所需的时间（刻）。即按住右键时的蓄力时间。

en_us.text: The time in ticks that it takes to use a warp plate. This is the time the player has to stand on top for.

zh_cn.text: 使用传送板所需的时间（刻）。即玩家需要站在其上的时长。

en_us.text: The cooldown between usages of the inventory button in seconds.

zh_cn.text: 物品栏按钮两次使用之间的冷却时间（秒）。

en_us.text: Set to 'NONE' for no inventory button. Set to 'NEAREST' for an inventory button that teleports to the nearest waystone. Set to 'ANY' for an inventory button that opens the waystone selection menu. Set to a waystone name for an inventory button that teleports to a specifically named waystone.

zh_cn.text: 设为 'NONE' 表示没有物品栏按钮；设为 'NEAREST' 表示按钮传送至最近的路石；设为 'ANY' 表示按钮打开路石选择菜单；设为某个路石的名称则按钮传送至该指定名称的路石。

en_us.text: The x position of the warp button in the inventory.

zh_cn.text: 传送按钮在物品栏界面中的 x 坐标。

en_us.text: The y position of the warp button in the inventory.

zh_cn.text: 传送按钮在物品栏界面中的 y 坐标。

en_us.text: Creative Mode Warp Button X Position

zh_cn.text: 创造模式传送按钮X位置

en_us.text: The x position of the warp button in the creative menu.

zh_cn.text: 传送按钮在创造模式物品栏中的 x 坐标。

en_us.text: Creative Mode Warp Button Y Position

zh_cn.text: 创造模式传送按钮Y位置

en_us.text: The y position of the warp button in the creative menu.

zh_cn.text: 传送按钮在创造模式物品栏中的 y 坐标。

en_us.text: Set to 'DEFAULT' to only generate the normally textured waystones. Set to 'MOSSY' or 'SANDY' to generate all as that variant. Set to 'BIOME' to make the style depend on the biome it is generated in.

zh_cn.text: 设为 'DEFAULT' 表示只生成默认材质的路石；设为 'MOSSY' 或 'SANDY' 表示全部生成为对应变体；设为 'BIOME' 表示样式取决于生成时所处的生物群系。

en_us.text: Approximate chunk distance between waystones generated freely in world generation. Set to 0 to disable generation.

zh_cn.text: 世界生成时自由生成的路石之间的大致区块距离。设为 0 可禁用生成。

en_us.text: List of dimensions that waystones are allowed to spawn in through world gen. If left empty, all dimensions except those in worldGenDimensionDenyList are used.

zh_cn.text: 允许路石通过世界生成在其中出现的维度列表。若留空，则使用除 worldGenDimensionDenyList 中维度以外的所有维度。

en_us.text: List of dimensions that waystones are not allowed to spawn in through world gen. Only used if worldGenDimensionAllowList is empty.

zh_cn.text: 不允许路石通过世界生成在其中出现的维度列表。仅在 worldGenDimensionAllowList 为空时生效。

en_us.text: Set to 'PRESET_FIRST' to first use names from the custom names list. Set to 'PRESET_ONLY' to use only those custom names. Set to 'MIXED' to have some waystones use custom names, and others random names.

zh_cn.text: 设为 'PRESET_FIRST' 表示优先使用自定义名称列表中的名称；设为 'PRESET_ONLY' 表示只使用这些自定义名称；设为 'MIXED' 表示部分路石使用自定义名称，其余使用随机名称。

en_us.text: These names will be used for the PRESET name generation mode. See the nameGenerationMode option for more info.

zh_cn.text: 这些名称将用于 PRESET 名称生成模式。详见 nameGenerationMode 选项。

en_us.text: Set to true if waystones should be added to the generation of villages. Some villages may still spawn without a waystone.

zh_cn.text: 设为 true 后，路石将被加入村庄的生成中。部分村庄可能仍不会生成路石。

en_us.text: Ensures that pretty much every village will have a waystone, by spawning it as early as possible. In addition, this means waystones will generally be located in the center of the village.

zh_cn.text: 通过尽早生成路石，确保几乎每个村庄都有一个路石。此外，这也意味着路石通常会位于村庄的中心。

en_us.text: If enabled, the text overlay on waystones will no longer always render at full brightness.

zh_cn.text: 启用后，路石上显示的文字将不再始终以最大亮度渲染。
在旅行地图(Journey Map)上显示传送石碑

en_us.text: If enabled, JourneyMap waypoints will be created for each activated waystone.

zh_cn.text: 启用后，将为每个已激活的路石创建 JourneyMap 路径点。

en_us.text: If enabled, JourneyMap waypoints will only be created if the mod 'JourneyMap Integration' is not installed.

zh_cn.text: 启用后，仅当未安装 'JourneyMap Integration' 模组时才会创建 JourneyMap 路径点。
击杀 5 只狼人并疾跑 20 千米

en_us.text: Slaught 6 Elder Guadian and swim 6 km

zh_cn.text: 击杀 6 只远古守卫者并游泳 6 千米
击杀 100 只苦力怕和 300 只生物
击杀 10 只女巫和 300 只生物
击杀 10 只邪恶骷髅和 900 只生物

en_us.text: Increase your stamina by 2 per level.

zh_cn.text: 每级使你的体力提高 2 点。

en_us.text: Enhance the strengh of his wielder.
Enhance the speed of his wielder.
Enhance the resistance of his wielder.

"Death will be a sweet gift.."

 The spear moves you around regarldes of gavity's rules.
 Allowing you to make your target bleed in all direction.
 Giving you the choice of watching them suffer or give them the mercy of death...

zh_cn.text:
"死亡将是一份甜美的礼物……"

 这杆长枪带你无视重力法则，辗转腾挪。
 让你能从四面八方令目标血流不止。
 是旁观其受尽折磨，还是赐予死亡的慈悲……尽由你抉择。

en_us.text:
"Disappear in the sky before diving on your enemies."

 Attacking enemies will charge this for up to 3 times.
The Final damage is multiplied by the number of charges

zh_cn.text:
"消失于天际，再俯冲向你的敌人。"

 攻击敌人可为该技能蓄力，最多 3 次。
最终伤害将乘以蓄力次数

en_us.text:
"Only for mass murder and act of abomination."

 The axe have absorbed the Wrath of its former bearer.
 Holding it will cause destruction in an endless concentration of rage...

zh_cn.text:
"专为屠杀与暴行而生。"

 这柄斧已将前任持有者的怒火尽数吸纳。
 握住它，无尽的狂怒将凝作毁灭……

en_us.text:
"May the god fear you..."

Torment wrath makes the skill gauge unreadable.

zh_cn.text:
"愿诸神亦对你心生畏惧……"

Torment 的怒火会使技能条变得无法判读。

en_us.text:
An ancient weapon, forged with forgotten knowledge and infused with enderman power.
Its balance and design allow for maximum efficiency and accuracy in combat.

zh_cn.text:
一件古老的武器，以失传的知识锻造，并灌注了末影人的力量。
其平衡与设计使其在战斗中发挥出极致的效率与精准。

en_us.text:
"Own the ancient arcane of the endermen."

 When triggering this skill, you can choose
 between 4 different type of actions:
  - in neutral and rather close to target, you'll do an [Ender Assault]
    while alternating between left swing and right swing. 
  - While sprinting, you will do an [Ender Assault] and,
    if the attack connect, trigger positive [Ender Snatch].
  - While rising in the air, you will trigger aerian
    [Ender Assault] and, trigger negative [Ender Snatch].
  - While sneaking and with 10 stored stack,
    you'll summon Ender Hands under targets around you.
   Then the hands grasps their respective targets,
    Damagind them and inflicting them with mining fatigue and slowness.

 [Ender Assault] - Teleport you around your target depending
 on the direction you are look at.

 [Ender Snatch] -

zh_cn.text:
"习得末影人的古老奥术。"

 触发此技能时，你可以从
 4 种不同的行动方式中选择：
  - 常规姿态且距离目标较近时，将施展[末影突袭]
    并左右挥击交替出手。 
  - 疾跑时，将施展[末影突袭]，
    若攻击命中，将触发正面[末影夺取]。
  - 腾空上升时，将触发空中的
    [末影突袭]，并触发负面[末影夺取]。
  - 潜行且蓄有 10 层储备时，
    会在周围目标的脚下召唤末影之手。
   随后末影之手会各自抓住对应目标，
    对其造成伤害，并施加挖掘疲劳与缓慢。

 [末影突袭] - 依据你注视的方向，
 将你传送至目标周围。

 [末影夺取] -

en_us.text:
The demon is sealed inside this blade.
Strengthening the blade and increasing it's effectivness
but, as the demon is still sealed, he can't provide much more power...

Passive: Sheath your blade after 4sec of inactivity.
Sheath the blade after a shorter period
at the end of a sheathed attack.

zh_cn.text:
恶魔被封印在这柄刀刃之中。
刀刃因此得到强化、效能更为出众，
但恶魔仍被封印着，无法再提供更多力量……

被动：闲置 4 秒后自动收刀。
收刀攻击结束时，刀刃会在
更短的时限内再度入鞘。

en_us.text:
"Sharpest blade forged in absolute serenity"

 On cast, you'll perform a Sakura slash.
 Sakura slashes can be declined in 2 form
  - while sprinting,
  you will fastly pass through enemys in front of you, slashing them along the way.  - while sprinting, (cost 2 stack)
  you will fastly pass through enemys in front of you,
  slashing them along the way.
  - while standing or walking, (cost 1 stack)
  you'll fastly slash in front of you.
 Sakura slashes automaticaly sheath your blade afterward.

 You can stack a total of 12 sakura slashes and Sweeping edge
 on your blade will grant you extra stack depending
 on the amount of stack you have on the first cast.
([initial amont of stack] * 1/3 of the sweeping edge levels)

 After the innitial draw, you'll enter sakura state.
 If you don't draw a Sakura slash again within 4 seconds, you loose all your
 stacks and get out of sakura state.

 Slashing a target with a Dash attack or a Sakura slash,
 will stack Perpetual slashes on the target.
 (3 on dashes and sakura slash.
 6 on sakura dash slash
 this value is then multiply by 1/3 of the Sweeping edge lvl).
 If no action is performed for a set of time after landing perpetual slashes,
 All Perpetual slashes stacked on the target are triggered,
 slashing it in sequence for each stacks of Perpetual slashes

zh_cn.text:
"于绝对静谧中锻成的至锋之刃"

 施放时，你将使出一段樱斩。
 樱斩可演化出 2 种形态
  - 疾跑时，
  你会飞速穿过身前的敌人，沿途将其斩落。  - 疾跑时，（消耗 2 层）
  你会飞速穿过身前的敌人，
  沿途将其斩落。
  - 站立或行走时，（消耗 1 层）
  你会在身前快速斩出一击。
 樱斩出手后会自动收刀。

 你总共可叠加 12 段樱斩，且刀上的横扫之刃
 会依据你首次施放时已有的层数
 为你提供额外的层数。
（[初始层数] * 横扫之刃等级的 1/3）

 完成初次拔刀后，你将进入樱花状态。
 若 4 秒内未再次使出樱斩，你将失去
 全部层数并退出樱花状态。

 用突进攻击或樱斩命中目标时，
 会向目标叠加永续斩层数。
 （突进攻击与樱斩为 3 层。
 樱花突进斩为 6 层
 该数值再乘以横扫之刃等级的 1/3）。
 叠加永续斩后，若在一定时间内没有任何动作，
 目标身上已叠加的全部永续斩将被触发，
 按每一层永续斩依次对其施以斩击

en_us.text:
This weapon has transcended time and space
in order to find someone who can control its power at its peak.

zh_cn.text:
这件武器超越了时间与空间，
只为寻得能驾驭其巅峰之力之人。

en_us.text:
"The zenith of the End world technological power."

The blaster loader is composed of 12 chambers.
Kinetic energy is stored in them and transmuted into endpower.
When the trigger is pressed, half of the converted endpower
is condensed into end bullets.
The other half is transfered into a particle accelerator that overcharges
the endpower until it blasts the bullet out with tremendous force and precision.
All of that in just a fraction of a second ... outstanding!

zh_cn.text:
"末地科技力量的至高结晶。"

爆能枪的装填机构由 12 个膛室组成。
动能储存于膛室之中，并转化为末影能。
扣下扳机时，一半的末影能
会凝聚成末影弹丸。
另一半则被送入粒子加速器，将末影能
过载充能，直至以惊人的力量与精准将弹丸轰出。
这一切仅在须臾之间……令人叹为观止！

en_us.text:
"The zenith of the End world technological power."

Two blaster loader with 12 chambers each for 24 in Total.
the Kinetic energy stored is shared between both Blasters
and transmuted into endpower for each.
When the trigger is pressed, half of the converted endpower
is condensed into end bullets.
The other half is transfered into a particle accelerator that overcharges
the endpower until it blasts the bullet out with tremendous force and precision.
All of that in just a fraction of a second ... outstanding!

zh_cn.text:
"末地科技力量的至高结晶。"

两具装填机构各有 12 个膛室，合计 24 个。
储存的动能由两把爆能枪共享，
并各自转化为末影能。
扣下扳机时，一半的末影能
会凝聚成末影弹丸。
另一半则被送入粒子加速器，将末影能
过载充能，直至以惊人的力量与精准将弹丸轰出。
这一切仅在须臾之间……令人叹为观止！

en_us.text:
Sharp and light sword that performs very well in combat....
but... it seams to need something in order to release it's full potential.

zh_cn.text:
轻巧而锋利的剑，在战斗中表现出众……
但……它似乎还需要些什么，方能释放全部潜能。

en_us.text:
Strong and resistent shield that block even the strongest attack....
but... it seams to need something in order to release it's full potential.

zh_cn.text:
坚固而强韧的盾，连最强悍的攻击也能挡下……
但……它似乎还需要些什么，方能释放全部潜能。

en_us.text:
"Unbreakable defense combined with overwhelming offense rules over battle."

 On cast, you'll perform shield attacks in front of you.
 There is 3 Basic attacks, 1 Dash attack and
 1 Jump attack for both the sword and the shield.

 Some attacks (shields or sword attacks) will move your in front of you.
 While this occure, the shield will have a slight red field around it as an indicator.
 During this short period,you will block incoming attacks and
 perform an automatic counter attack.

 Depending on how you block an attack, you will increase you Shield Charges by a certain amount.
 (increased with sweeping edge lvl)
 Shield Charges can be stored for up to 90 and used in 2 ways:
  - With the Shield, by holding guard and casting a shield attack.
    You will convert all Shield charge into shield Overcharge,
    granting you damage resistance.
  - With the Sword, by holding guard and casting a sword attack.
    You will charge your sword and consume your
     shield charges slowly to perform a spin attack.

 While your shield is Overcharged, your shield attack will do
 increase damage after a sword attack based on the Overcharge amount.

 Getting damaged reduce your Shield Overcharge by 5.
 ( Sweeping edge on your Sword reduce this by 1 per level )

zh_cn.text:
"坚不可摧的防御与势不可挡的进攻，共同主宰战场。"

 施放时，你将向前方发动盾牌攻击。
 剑与盾各自拥有 3 段普通攻击、1 段冲刺攻击
 和 1 段跳跃攻击。

 部分攻击（盾击或剑击）会使你向前突进。
 此时，盾牌周围会泛起一层淡红色的光场作为指示。
 在这段短时间内，你会格挡来袭的攻击，
 并自动发动一次反击。

 依据你格挡攻击的方式，你将获得一定数额的盾牌充能。
 （数额随横扫之刃等级提高）
 盾牌充能最多可储存 90 点，并有两种用法：
  - 使用盾牌：按住格挡并施放盾牌攻击。
    你会将所有盾牌充能转化为盾牌超载，
    使你获得伤害抗性。
  - 使用剑：按住格挡并施放剑击。
    你将为剑蓄力并缓慢消耗盾牌充能，
    以发动一次旋转攻击。

 当盾牌处于超载状态时，在剑击之后施放的盾牌攻击
 将依据超载数值造成更高的伤害。

 受到伤害会使你的盾牌超载减少 5 点。
 （剑上的横扫之刃每级可减少 1 点）

en_us.text:
"What is a blade without a handle,
 a light without any shadow..
 a night without a moon."

 Moonless have 2 set of attacks, Recto and verso.
 Dash attack to switch beetwen them.

zh_cn.text:
"无柄之刃算什么刀，
 无影之光算什么亮，
 无月之夜又算什么夜。"

 Moonless 拥有两套攻击：正位与逆位。
 使用冲刺攻击即可在两者之间切换。

en_us.text:
"Moonlight shadowing the night"

 Strike foes in front of you
 and makes them glow for 7sec.

 In Recto : 
  - Attaking Glowing targets, stack your damage
    and increase their Glowing lvl.
  - Attaking Blind targets, stack your damage
    and remove their Blindness.

 In Verso: 
  - Attaking Glowing targets, stack your damage
    and remove their Glowing.
  - Attaking Blind targets, increase their Blindness lvl

 Recto Jump attack ( Crescent )
  Unleash all stacked damage on the target.
  If it kills the target, it bounce to the closest target
  and loose 5% of its damage.
    Glowing increase the bounce range.
    Blindness increase the damage.

 Verso Jump attack ( Fullmoon )
  Unleash 70% of the stacked damage in Aoe.
    Blindness increase the damage.

zh_cn.text:
"月光为夜蒙上阴影"

 打击前方的敌人，
 并使其发光 7 秒。

 正位：
  - 攻击发光的目标，叠加伤害，
    并提升其发光等级。
  - 攻击失明的目标，叠加伤害，
    并移除其失明效果。

 逆位：
  - 攻击发光的目标，叠加伤害，
    并移除其发光效果。
  - 攻击失明的目标，提升其失明等级。

 正位跳跃攻击（新月）
  对目标释放全部叠加伤害。
  若此击击杀了目标，伤害会弹射至最近的目标，
  并损失 5% 的伤害。
    发光可延长弹射距离。
    失明可提高伤害。

 逆位跳跃攻击（满月）
  以范围伤害的形式释放 70% 的叠加伤害。
    失明可提高伤害。

en_us.text: "The power of the sun, in the palm of my hand"

"Witness the full force of a star"

 After each basic attack, a special icon will apear within a short period.
 Press the Skill button when you see it to perform a timed Solar attack.
 Solar attack cycle between ignites ( Polvora ) and explode ( Chispear ):

    Polvora : set the target in fire. if target is
    allready in fire, increase ignitions level by 1.
    (can only go up to 2)

    Chispear: if target is in fire, extinguish the fire and
    explode for a set of damage depending on the ignitions level.
    (3 => 6 => 9, +1 per sweeping edge lvl)

 Solar have a unique skill meter mechanique.
 Heat level, wich is showed by the percentage number on the skill,
 can change color (from red to white) depending on the Heating speed.
 Increase Heat level by increasing heating speed above
 the orange lvl by successfully performing Chispear.
 The heating speed increase depends on the target ignition level.

 Hold guard and press skill to perform Solar Brasero.
 Solar Brasero harvest heat level to perform incendiary spell:

    Obscuridad: Infuse your blade with soul fire,
    melting it into a new form.
    All attacks within this form trigger Chispear.
    Lock your heating speed to red.

    Crematorio: breath soul fire in front of you.
    Burns targets to ignitions level 3.
    Durations depends on the amount of time
    they stay in the flame.

    Infierno: Burn target around you in a spherical shape.
    The area of effect will keep growing until 10 sec.
    Every 2sec, target within the area are affected by polvora.
    (can increase ignition level to 3)
    During infierno, all the speed at wich heat level is affected is doubled.

zh_cn.text:
"见证一颗恒星的全部伟力"

 每次普通攻击后，一个特殊图标会在短时间内出现。
 看到它时按下技能键，即可打出一次限时的 Solar 攻击。
 Solar 攻击在点燃（Polvora）与迸爆（Chispear）之间循环：

    Polvora（点燃）：使目标着火。若目标
    已经在燃烧，则点燃等级 +1。
    （最高只能到 2）

    Chispear（迸爆）：若目标在燃烧，则熄灭火焰，
    并依据点燃等级爆炸，造成对应档位的伤害。
    （3 => 6 => 9，每级横扫之刃 +1）

 Solar 拥有一套独特的技能计量表机制。
 热度等级显示为技能图标上的百分比数字，
 其颜色会随升温速度变化（由红变白）。
 成功施放 Chispear（迸爆），将升温速度提升至橙色档以上，
 即可提高热度等级。
 升温速度的提升幅度取决于目标的点燃等级。

 按住格挡并按下技能键，即可施放 Solar Brasero（日之火盆）。
 Solar Brasero 会汲取热度等级来施放纵火法术：

    Obscuridad（暗蚀）：将灵魂之火注入你的剑，
    把它熔铸成新的形态。
    此形态下的所有攻击都会触发 Chispear（迸爆），
    并将你的升温速度锁定在红色档。

    Crematorio（焚炉）：向面前喷吐灵魂之火。
    将目标烧至点燃等级 3。
    持续时间取决于目标
    在火焰中停留的时长。

    Infierno（炼狱）：以球形范围灼烧你周围的目标。
    作用范围会持续扩大，最长 10 秒。
    每 2 秒，范围内的目标都会受到 Polvora（点燃）效果。
    （可将点燃等级提升至 3）
    炼狱持续期间，热度等级的一切变化速度都会加倍。

en_us.text:
"Harvest life in the most horrible and obnoxious way."

 Attacks have 20% chance to cause wither for 6sec.
 If the entity allready has wither effect, then it
 reapply a stronger wither effect with the duration refreshed.

 Each Sweeping edge lvl, give 10% more chance to cause Wither
 and increase the duration by 2sec.

zh_cn.text:
"以最可怖、最可憎的方式收割生命。"

 攻击有 20% 几率造成凋零，持续 6 秒。
 若该实体已带有凋零效果，则会
 重新施加更强的凋零效果，并刷新其持续时间。

 横扫之刃每级使造成凋零的几率额外提高 10%，
 并使持续时间延长 2 秒。

en_us.text:
"The scythe takes possession of your body
 and use it to perform terrible things...."

Ascenscion :
 on a large area, try to Apply Wither effect
 before applying 50% catharsis* on affected entity.

In Demon form:
 Base Duration is equal to 20s x (1 + (Sweeping edge level) / 3).
 Dash attack have twice the chance to apply wither effect but
 will consume more and more health if used multiple times.
 Other attacks will cause 80% Catharsis* on withered entitys if they hit.

 *Catharsis: Reap of the wither effect from the target
 dealing the remaining damage depending on the catharsis percentage at once
 and heal you for the remaining of that percentage.
 catharsis also increase the Demon form
 duration depending on their wither state
 (+3s for wither II and +6s for wither III).

zh_cn.text:
"镰刀占据了你的躯体，
 驱使它行尽骇人之事……"

飞升：
 在大范围内尝试施加凋零效果，
 随后对受影响的实体施加 50% 净除*。

恶魔形态：
 基础持续时间为 20 秒 x (1 + (横扫之刃等级) / 3)。
 冲刺攻击施加凋零效果的几率翻倍，
 但若连续使用，将消耗越来越多的生命值。
 其他攻击若命中凋零中的实体，将造成 80% 净除*。

 *净除（Catharsis）：从目标身上收割凋零效果，
 按净除百分比一次性结算其剩余伤害，
 并以相同比例为你恢复生命。
 净除还会依据目标的凋零状态
 延长恶魔形态的持续时间
 （凋零 II +3 秒，凋零 III +6 秒）。

en_us.text:
"Il n'y a que deux puissances au monde, le sabre et l'esprit : à la longue, le sabre est toujours vaincu par l'esprit."

 After attacking performing skill will reload ammunition
 depending on the attack made before it.

  - 1 ammo after first attack.
  - 2 ammo after the second attacks.
  - 3 ammo afer the third one.

 The last attack of the normal combo will also realod 3 ammo.

 To shoot your ammo, you must perform an attack or a reload first.
 You can also shoot right after sprinting or if you are rising in the air (jumping).

 Dealing damage with a shot will increase [Heatdrive] depending on the bullet type.
 [Heatdrive] slowly decrease if no shot damage is dealt within 4 sec.
 When fully charged, [Heatdrive] become [Souldrive]:
  during that state, the drive will quickly decrease but,
  every second during that state will reload 1 ammo.

 Ammo can be overcharged if rechargement is performed when 6 ammo is allready loaded.
 Overcharged Ammo deal more damage and bypass guards.

 Reloading to reach exactly 6 ammo or 6 overcharged ammo will double
 the reload ammount for as long as you keep your reloads to reach exactly 6.

zh_cn.text:
"世间唯有两种力量：剑与精神。长远来看，剑终将被精神所征服。"

 在攻击之后施放技能，即可依据此前进行的攻击装填弹药。

  - 第一段攻击后装填 1 发。
  - 第二段攻击后装填 2 发。
  - 第三段攻击后装填 3 发。

 普通连段的最后一击也会装填 3 发。

 要射出弹药，你必须先进行一次攻击或装填。
 你也可以在冲刺后立即射击，或是在腾空上升时（跳跃中）射击。

 用射击造成伤害会依据子弹类型积累 [热驱]。
 若 4 秒内没有造成射击伤害，[热驱] 会缓慢衰减。
 [热驱] 充满后变为 [魂驱]：
  处于该状态时，驱动值会快速下降，
  但状态期间每秒会装填 1 发弹药。

 若在已装有 6 发弹药时执行装填，弹药将被超载。
 超载弹药伤害更高，并能无视格挡。

 当一次装填使你恰好达到 6 发（普通或超载）时，装填数量会翻倍——
 只要你让每次装填都恰好达到 6 发，该效果就会一直持续。

en_us.text: Even so far appart, even on constant motion.. terra never leave's sol, luna never leaves terra. Forever far from each other, yet linked all together.

zh_cn.text: 纵使相隔如此遥远，纵使永远处于运动之中……大地从未离开太阳，月亮也从未离开大地。永远彼此相隔，却又永远彼此相连。

en_us.text: Call an orbital beam that strike foes in your gaze.

zh_cn.text: 召唤一道轨道光束，打击你目光所及的敌人。

en_us.text: Lost in the void, burning forever... waiting for darkness, predators of their power. Scourges of shadows in eternity, bursting their halo thru the field of infinity.

zh_cn.text: 迷失于虚空，燃烧至永远……它们静候黑暗，是力量的掠食者。身为永世中的暗影灾厄，将光晕迸散于无垠之境。

en_us.text: Teleport yourself around a target before performing a spin attack.

zh_cn.text: 在目标周身传送，随后发动一次旋转攻击。

en_us.text: Within the silent emptyness, dark giants are ingaged in ominous danses. Masters of art and desrtuctions, they shake the void and absorb all matter. Horrible, yet, absolutely magneficent... nothing can stop their malevolent riffs.

zh_cn.text: 寂静的虚无深处，黑暗巨人们正踏着不祥之舞。他们是艺术与毁灭的主宰，撼动虚空，吞纳万物。可怖，却又无比壮丽……没有什么能止息他们那邪恶的乐声。

en_us.text:
Give you 3 charge of protection that grant you resistance and stun immunity uppon taking damage.
Lose a charge when taking damage.

zh_cn.text:
赋予你 3 层守护充能，使你获得伤害抗性与眩晕免疫。
每受到一次伤害便失去 1 层充能。

en_us.text: An old demon is sealed inside this.

zh_cn.text: 其中封印着一头古老的恶魔。

en_us.text:
In this book, is writen the arcane for endless blaze fire.
Title says:"Encarnacion solar infinita".

zh_cn.text:
书中记载着无尽烈焰的奥术。
标题写着："Encarnacion solar infinita"（无尽的太阳化身）。

en_us.text: This cylinder is way to large for anything...

zh_cn.text: 这个圆筒对任何东西来说都太大了……
化卡律布狄斯为斯库拉

en_us.text: Consume Stamina to perform a whirlwind of hit for a total of 8 strikes. Reduce the stamina consumption with sweeping edge.

zh_cn.text: 消耗体力，挥出旋风般的连击，总计 8 段打击。横扫之刃可降低体力消耗。

en_us.text:
Cycle between 2 phase while facing a target.

 [Lunatic Rush] Decrease your stamina consumption by 85%.
 Not facing target will stop the timer but not grant any stamina reduction.

 [Lunatic Linger] Increase your stamina consumption by 85%.
 Facing a target will double the speed of the timer.

zh_cn.text:
面向目标时，在两个阶段之间循环。

 [癫狂疾冲] 体力消耗降低 85%。
 未面向目标时计时会停止，但不会提供任何体力减免。

 [癫狂滞留] 体力消耗提高 85%。
 面向目标时，计时速度加倍。

en_us.text:
Loosing Health increase Stamina by half,
Loosing Stamina increase Health by half.

Sneak to transfer health into stamina at double rate.

Disable stamina auto recovery.

zh_cn.text:
失去生命时，体力回复其中的一半，
失去体力时，生命回复其中的一半。

潜行即可将生命转化为体力，转化速率加倍。

禁用体力自动恢复。

en_us.text:
Allow you to blackout your target after reaching a certain distance from it.

Attack your target once then move away from it.
Once the distance beetween you and your target is greater than 20,your next dash attack will be a strong stun that blackout your target for 5sec.

zh_cn.text:
与目标拉开一定距离后，你可以使目标昏厥。

先攻击目标一次，然后远离它。
一旦你与目标的距离超过 20，你的下一次冲刺攻击将化作强力眩晕，使目标昏厥 5 秒。

en_us.text:
When empty handed, holding sneak while attacking will do kicks.

 The combo contain 3 different kick.

zh_cn.text:
空手时，攻击的同时按住潜行键即可使出踢击。

 该连段包含 3 种不同的踢技。

en_us.text: For each living things within 5 blocks of you, regenerate 3 innate power every 0.5s sec.

zh_cn.text: 以你为中心 5 格内的每个生物，都会使你每 0.5 秒恢复 3 点固有能量。

en_us.text:
Blocking or dodging 4 different attack will trigger "And watch over you".

 And watch over you :
  Regenerate your stamina and innate power slowly over 8 sec.

zh_cn.text:
格挡或闪避 4 次不同的攻击，将触发"守望于你"。

 守望于你 ：
  在 8 秒内缓慢恢复你的体力与固有能量。

en_us.text:
dealing damage with 8 different attack will trigger "look - at - me".

 look - at - me :
  Regenerate your health, stamina and innate power moderably over 4 sec however, performing action during that time will cancel that effect.

zh_cn.text:
用 8 次不同的攻击造成伤害，将触发"看 - 着 - 我"。

 看 - 着 - 我 ：
  在 4 秒内适度恢复你的生命、体力与固有能量；但在此期间进行任何动作都会取消该效果。

en_us.text: Holding sneak for 2 sec will release a chockwave that pushes enemy away and grant you with Stun immunity for a short period.

zh_cn.text: 按住潜行键 2 秒，将释放出一道冲击波，把敌人击退，并在短时间内为你提供眩晕免疫。

en_us.text: A fast teleportion away from the danger. While executing this skill, player become immune from physical attacks.

zh_cn.text: 快速传送以远离危险。施展此技能期间，玩家免疫物理攻击。

en_us.text:
Teleport you behind the last hitted target within 30 blocks (in radius from your position).

While executing this skill, player become immune from physical attacks.

zh_cn.text:
将你传送到 30 格半径内（以你的位置为圆心）最后一个被你击中的目标背后。

施展此技能期间，玩家免疫物理攻击。

en_us.text:
§oSink in the shadows.§r
Moving in the shadow will twist space to make you move faster than the light itself.

While executing this skill, player become immune from physical attacks.

zh_cn.text:
§o沉入暗影之中。§r
在暗影中穿行会扭曲空间，使你的速度超越光本身。

施展此技能期间，玩家免疫物理攻击。

en_us.text:
Charge forward pushing away any entity that come across your path.

You are immune to stun effect during the charge and take 40% less damage

zh_cn.text:
向前冲锋，推开路径上遭遇的所有实体。

冲锋期间你免疫眩晕效果，且受到的伤害减少 40%

en_us.text:
Faster, further and cheaper roll.

 Perform acrobatic Roll like a true expert.

zh_cn.text:
更快、更远且更省体力的翻滚。

 像真正的行家一样做出杂技般的翻滚。

en_us.text:
Instinctly dodge a small distance if you would take damage after the cast within a window of 0.30s. Continuesly dodge all attack after the first one within a window of 0.50s and after each succesful dodge.

Double stamina consumption on multiple cast.

zh_cn.text:
施放后的 0.30 秒内，若你将会受到伤害，便会本能地闪避一小段距离。首次闪避后的 0.50 秒内以及每次成功闪避之后，都会连续闪避所有攻击。

连续施放时体力消耗加倍。

en_us.text:
Register your position and health on cast.
After 5sec you'll be teleported back to your previus position and half of all damage taken within this time is healed.

Cast again to teleport early or sneak to cancel.

zh_cn.text:
施放时记录你的位置与生命值。
5 秒后，你将被传送回先前的位置，且这段时间内所受伤害的一半会被治愈。

再次施放可提前传送，按潜行键则取消。

en_us.text: Kick in front of you with force. Cause strong Stun and can blackout if perform during enemy attack.

zh_cn.text: 向前方猛力踢击，造成强力眩晕；若在敌人出招时施放，还可使其眼前一黑。

en_us.text:
Perfect Guard will trigger a counter attack based on weapons attacks.

Available Weapon Types : %s

完美格挡将触发一次基于武器攻击的反击。

可用武器类型：%s

en_us.text:
Holding Guard stance will block attacks from all directions at low progressive stamina cost.
Releasing guard after being hit 5 times will send a shockwave that pushes enemys away. 

Available Weapon Types : %s

zh_cn.text:
保持格挡姿态时，将以较低且逐次递增的体力消耗格挡来自所有方向的攻击。
被击中 5 次后松开格挡，将释放一道冲击波把敌人击退。

可用武器类型：%s

en_us.text:
Put you in a guarding stance for 2sec.
You will hold your position during that time blocking all attack at no stamina cost.
After that you'll be able to send back all the damage in your next attack.
Refresh damage on recast.
1sec cooldown.

Available Weapon Types : %s

zh_cn.text:
使你进入格挡姿态，持续 2 秒。
期间你将原地坚守，以零体力消耗格挡所有攻击。
之后，你的下一次攻击会把积攒的伤害尽数奉还。
再次施放会刷新积攒的伤害。
冷却 1 秒。

可用武器类型：%s

en_us.text:
Loose the ability to guard.

 Each second you summon a soul that give 1% damage negation.
Your own soul give you 20% damage negation.

 Getting damaged will remove 3 souls.

zh_cn.text:
失去格挡能力。

每秒召唤一个灵魂，提供 1% 伤害减免。
你自身的灵魂为你提供 20% 伤害减免。

受到伤害会移除 3 个灵魂。

en_us.text:
Loose the ability to guard.

 Every 5 sec, You gain one level of shulker resistance. 

If you have at least 1 level of Shulker resistance, you will negate 60% of damage.

Getting damaged reduce the level by 1.

zh_cn.text:
失去格挡能力。

每 5 秒获得 1 级潜影贝抗性。

只要拥有至少 1 级潜影贝抗性，即可减免 60% 的伤害。

受到伤害会使该等级降低 1 级。

en_us.text:
Windup your weapon for 1 to 2s, then, release a powerfull attack that bypass guard and cause blackout if the target was blocking or attacking.

 Available Weapon Types : %s

zh_cn.text:
将武器蓄力 1 至 2 秒，随后释放一记强力攻击，可无视格挡；若目标当时正处于格挡或攻击状态，还会使其眼前一黑。

可用武器类型：%s

en_us.text: Prevent the stun from arrows damage. This skill is permanent, thus you can use another passive on top of it but, you'll only keep the current passive if you die.

zh_cn.text: 免疫箭矢伤害造成的眩晕。此技能永久生效，因此你可以在其之上再启用另一个被动；但死亡时只会保留当前被动。

en_us.text:
If no action is performed within 2 sec, your next action will trigger "Anticipation".
 Anticipation :
  For 2 sec, gives stun immunity and decrease damage recieved by 40%.

zh_cn.text:
若 2 秒内没有任何动作，你的下一个动作将触发“预判”。
 预判：
  持续 2 秒免疫眩晕，并使受到的伤害降低 40%。

en_us.text:
If no action is performed within 4 sec, your next action will trigger "Retribution".
 Retribution :
  For 4 sec, gives stun immunity and increase your attack by 40%.

zh_cn.text:
若 4 秒内没有任何动作，你的下一个动作将触发“天罚”。
 天罚：
  持续 4 秒免疫眩晕，并使你的攻击伤害提高 40%。

en_us.text: You heal yourself by 20% of the damage you deal.

zh_cn.text: 你造成伤害的 20% 将转化为对自身的治疗。

Give you %s%% chance to deal %s%% more damage.

Critical chance is increased with Fire protection.

Critical damage is increased with Blast protection

zh_cn.text:
使你有 %s%% 几率造成 %s%% 的额外伤害。

火焰保护可提高暴击几率。

爆炸保护可提高暴击伤害

en_us.text:
Give you 20 shield point that will recover if no action is performed for %ssec at the rate of 1 point every %ssec.

Shield recovery rate can be improved with Protection enchantment.

赋予你 20 点护盾；在 %s 秒内没有任何动作后开始回复，速度为每 %s 秒回复 1 点。

保护附魔可提高护盾的回复速度。

en_us.text:
While above 80% Health,
gain mindest which will increase your damage by 30% and decrease the damage recieved by 20%

zh_cn.text:
生命值高于 80% 时，
获得“心境”：伤害提高 30%，受到的伤害降低 20%

en_us.text:
While under 20% Health,
gain adrenanline wich will increase your damage by 60% and decrease the damage recieved by 40%

zh_cn.text:
生命值低于 20% 时，
获得“肾上腺素”：伤害提高 60%，受到的伤害降低 40%

"Dance on the sound of death"

Gain 80% damage on every 4th successfull attack.

zh_cn.text:
“踏着死亡之音起舞”

每第 4 次成功攻击时，伤害提高 80%。

en_us.text:
Sneak for 2 second without moving to enter in state of meditation. the longer you meditate the longer the buff.
There is 3 stage of meditation each giving different effect:

 Stage 1: 40% damage dealing.

 Stage 2: 30% attack speed and Movement speed I

 Stage 3: 50% damage reduction and Regeneration I

zh_cn.text:
保持潜行且不移动 2 秒，即可进入冥想状态。冥想越久，增益持续越长。
冥想分为 3 个阶段，各自提供不同效果：

 阶段 1：伤害提高 40%。

 阶段 2：攻击速度提高 30%，并获得速度 I

 阶段 3：伤害减免 50%，并获得生命恢复 I

Regenerate 2.0 innate power per second. (+0.1 per Lvl of blast protection)

 Currently: %s /s

每秒恢复 2.0 点固有之力。（爆炸保护每级 +0.1）

当前：%s /s

Convert the damage dealt with a dash attack into stamina.

 Afterward, get in cooldown for 4sec.

zh_cn.text:
将冲刺攻击造成的伤害转化为体力。

随后进入 4 秒冷却。

en_us.text:
Blocking an attack will grant you stamina based on the timming of the block and your missing stamina.

 Perfect block = 60% missing stamina 

 Regular block = 0~30% missing stamina

zh_cn.text:
格挡攻击将根据格挡时机和你缺失的体力为你恢复体力。

完美格挡 = 恢复 60% 的缺失体力

普通格挡 = 恢复 0~30% 的缺失体力

en_us.text:

 If no action is performed within 2sec, the damage will decrease rapidly.

Damage addup is increased with Fire protection.

Damage max is increased with blast protection lvl.

zh_cn.text:
每次造成伤害都会使你的伤害提高 %s%%，直至达到 %s%%。
若 2 秒内没有任何动作，加成将迅速衰减。

火焰保护可提高叠加量。

爆炸保护等级可提高加成上限。

en_us.text:
Allow you to run on walls.

 Hold sprint and jump toward a wall to run on it.
 Release sprint to fall or release movement input to slide slowly.
 Sneak to reduce the slide fall even more.

 You can jump from a wall to another by adjusting horizontal view angle.
 The position you jump from will adjust the hight of the wall jump.

zh_cn.text:
让你能够在墙壁上奔跑。

按住疾跑键并朝墙壁跳跃，即可在墙上奔跑。
松开疾跑键会坠落，松开移动键则会缓慢滑落。
潜行可进一步减缓滑落速度。

调整水平视角，即可从一堵墙跳向另一堵墙。
起跳的位置将决定蹬墙跳的高度。

en_us.text:
Improve swiming ability.

 Swim faster under water or a little less faster above water.

 Release jump button to propel under water or butterfly swim above water.

zh_cn.text:
提升游泳能力。

在水下游得更快，在水面上也稍快一些。

松开跳跃键可在水下向前推进，或在水面上以蝶泳姿势前进。

en_us.text:
Improve running ability.

 While [HOLDING] your sprint key for 1 sec,
 burst into a faster sprinting motion.

 -  Short Boost forward at the cost of stamina.

持续[长按]疾跑键 1 秒，
便会爆发出更快的疾跑步伐。

疾跑中跳跃可让你跃得更远且略高。
疾跑中潜行可让你滑行钻入 1 格宽的缝隙。

en_us.text: §6Gauntlets of Bulwark (Dual):§f Both heavily armored fist weapons made from a mech used by shulkers, they are offence and defence in one through blunt force and with built in means to close the distance if needed. Dawning the full gauntlets allows the full utility and power of the gauntlets and more freedom of how you wanna punch something down. They now give more teleporting, mobility, and manupulation to your advantage and more combos to use. zh_cn.text: §d双持VASW：§f由自主超级士兵打造的武器，当一台发射器不够用时的最后手段。双手各持一台发射器对常人而言过于沉重，但它并未因此限制使用者的机动性，而是以牺牲自由射击换取垂直作战能力。这些发射器不仅弹药更多（代价是移动更僵硬），还能通过联动推进器与下界之星的残余能量悬浮于空中。

en_us.text: §cDual WASW:§f A weapon made from an autonomous super soldier, the last resort should one launcher not be enough. Holding two launchers would have been to heavy for any man, but instead of limiting the user's mobility, it trades free shooting with verticality. Not only the launchers has more to shoot with the cost of stiffer movement, but also gains the ability to levitate via combined thrusters and the energy left over by the nether star.

zh_cn.text: §c双持WASW：§f 由自主超级士兵打造的武器，是单具发射器不够用时的最终手段。双手各持一具发射器本会重得常人无法承受，但它并未限制使用者的机动性，而是以自由射击换取了垂直机动。这不仅让发射器拥有更多弹药、代价是动作更为僵硬，还通过双推进器与下界之星残留的能量获得了滞空能力。

en_us.text: Action-bar-like system of key bindings that lets you automatically use a specified item from your hotbar without having to switch away from your currently held item. en_us.text: Mapping mode that can go deeper than the surface blocks, mainly to display underground caves and interiors of buildings. The ceiling size refers to the size of a horizontal "square" of solid blocks that has to be detected above you to activate the cave mode.

en_us.text: Mapping mode that can go deeper than the surface blocks, mainly to display underground caves and interiors of buildings. The ceiling size refers to the size of a square ceiling of solid blocks that has to be detected above you to activate the cave mode. The solid blocks don't have to be on the same Y level.

en_us.text: Connect/disconnect selected sub-world to/from the current auto one. Connect only sub-worlds that are from the same sub-server/world save. For example, if a vanilla Nether portal takes you from sub-world A to sub-world B, then you can safely connect them. Other sub-worlds connected to the current one are always at the top of the list and are marked by an asterisk (symbol: *).

zh_cn.text: 连接/断开连接选择的子世界与当前auto世界。仅连接来自同一子服务器/世界存档的子世界。例如，如果一个普通的下界传送门将你从子世界 A 带到子世界 B，那么你可以安全地连接它们。连接到当前子世界的其他子世界始终位于列表顶部，并用星号（符号：*）标记。

en_us.text: You are trying to teleport to a sub-world that is not connected to the current auto one. If you are sure that this sub-world is from the same sub-server/world save as the auto one, then you can enable teleportation by adding a connection in the waypoint screen -> Options -> Add Sub-World Connection. But beware, if you connect unrelated sub-worlds and teleport, then there is a good chance you will suffocate in a block or die from fall damage, so be careful and connect only the right ones.

zh_cn.text: 你正试图传送到一个未连接到当前auto子世界的子世界。如果你确定这个子世界来自auto子服务器/世界，那么你可以通过在路径点界面 -> 选项 -> 添加子世界连接中添加连接来启用传送。但请注意，如果你连接不相关的子世界并进行传送，那么你很有可能会在方块中窒息或因坠落伤害而死亡，因此请小心并仅连接正确的子世界。

en_us.text: Some servers put custom values in the world heightmaps, which may result in incorrectly rendered maps. Sometimes it may even happen in heavily modded singleplayer worlds. This option should fix such issues at the expense of a bit of performance. Do not use unless you have to. Reenter the world after toggling this option! Stored per world/server, not part of the config profile.

The screen depth at which in-world waypoints stop getting smaller when you go further away from them. 
 Use this if you want to make waypoints that are far away bigger/smaller on the screen. Use the "Waypoint In-World Scale" setting to also affect the size of waypoints when you are close to them. 
 
 For the "Auto" option, go all the way to the left. 
 The automatic option attempts to give you the best value for the default values of scale types, taking your FOV and screen height into account. 
 
 Default values in older mod versions: 
 Clamp Depth: 12 
 In-World Scale: 2.5 
 Name Text Scale: 0.5 
 Distance Text Scale: 0.8

当你远离它们时，游戏内路径点停止变小的屏幕深度。

药水效果状态栏碰撞箱

en_us.text:
An invisible box around the vanilla boss health display that pushes the mod's interfaces out of the way. 
 
 Normal type's collision box is equal to its size and only pushes interfaces by the necessary distance. 
 
 Screen Height type's collision box is stretched across the whole screen height and always shifts colliding interfaces vertically by the Normal type's height. This can be very useful when you have multiple interfaces in a column and want all of them to be pushed.

zh_cn.text:
原版Boss生命条周围有一个隐形碰撞箱将模组的界面推开。 
 
 正常类型的碰撞箱等于它的大小，并且只将界面推开必要的距离。 
 
 屏幕高度类型的碰撞箱拉伸到整个屏幕高度，并且总是以正常类型的高度垂直移动碰撞的界面。 当你在一列中有多个界面并希望所有这些界面都被推开时，这将非常有用。

en_us.text:
An invisible box around the vanilla potion effects display that pushes the mod's interfaces out of the way. 
 
 Normal type's collision box is equal to its size and only pushes interfaces by the necessary distance. 
 
 Screen Height type's collision box is stretched across the whole screen height and always shifts colliding interfaces vertically by the Normal type's height. This can be very useful when you have multiple interfaces in a column and want all of them to be pushed.

zh_cn.text:
原版药水效果状态栏周围有一个隐形碰撞箱将模组的界面推开。 
 
 正常类型的碰撞箱等于它的大小，并且只将界面推开必要的距离。 
 
 屏幕高度类型的碰撞箱拉伸到整个屏幕高度，并且总是以正常类型的高度垂直移动碰撞的界面。 当你在一列中有多个界面并希望所有这些界面都被推开时，这将非常有用。

en_us.text: You can't teleport to a waypoint that doesn't specify the Y coordinate. Edit the waypoint to be able to teleport to it.

zh_cn.text: 游戏内路径点名称文本显示缩放。

近距离游戏内路径点缩放

en_us.text: Scale of the waypoints in world when you are very close to them. To change the scale of waypoints that are far away, use the "In-World Waypoint Icon Scale", "Waypoint Distance Text Scale" and "Waypoint Name Text Scale" settings.

zh_cn.text: 当你非常靠近它们时，游戏内路径点的缩放。 要更改远处路径点的缩放，请使用 “游戏内路径点图标缩放”、“路径点距离文本缩放”和“路径点名称文本缩放”设置。
找不到图标时使用实体名称

en_us.text: Whether the distance can be displayed for multiple waypoints in world at once. By default, only the distance to the closest waypoint to the crosshair is displayed. Use the "Distance to WP" setting to configure which waypoints the distance could even be shown for.

zh_cn.text: 是否可以同时显示多个游戏内路径点的距离。 默认情况下，仅显示离十字准星最近的路径点的距离。 使用“到路径点的距离”设置来配置可以显示到哪些路径点的距离。

en_us.text: A list of entities to include in the (sub-)category on top of the entities included by the "Hard Include".

zh_cn.text: 要包含在“硬包含”所包含的实体之上的（子）类别中的实体类型列表。

en_us.text: A list of entities to exclude from the entities already included in the (sub-)category. Can work both as a "whitelist" and a "blacklist" depending on the exclusion mode you choose. This does not remove entities from the entity radar, unless you're excluding from the root "Any" category. The "Display" setting can remove entities from the radar.

zh_cn.text: 要从已包含在（子）类别中的实体类型中排除的实体类型列表。 根据你选择的排除模式，可以同时用作“白名单”和“黑名单”。 这不会从实体雷达中删除实体，除非你从根“任何”类别中排除。 “显示”设置可以从雷达中排除实体。

en_us.text: Controls which entities to automatically include in the (sub-)category without having to put them in the include list manually.

zh_cn.text: 控制哪些实体自动包含在（子）类别中，无需手动将它们放入包含列表中。

zh_cn.text: 自定义类别将被删除，默认类别将被重置。

en_us.text: Controls the order in which the radar categories are rendered. A lower number means being rendered earlier. However, in the newer Minecraft versions dots are always rendered on top of the icons. The order still applies within dot or icon rendering though.

zh_cn.text: 控制雷达类别的渲染顺序。较低的数字意味着更早地渲染。 然而，在较新的Minecraft版本中，点总是显示在图标之上。 该顺序仍然适用于点或图标渲染。

en_us.text: Always render names for entities with name tags regardless of what the name setting is set to.

zh_cn.text: 无论名称设置是什么，始终为带有命名牌的实体显示名称。

en_us.text: Press LEFT and RIGHT buttons to select a column within the entry.

zh_cn.text: 按下“左”和“右”按钮选择条目中的一列。

en_us.text:
Select a sub-category and go to its Settings to configure things like dot color, names, icons etc. 
 
 Sub-categories that are higher on the list are prioritized when multiple sub-categories include the same entity! Keep that in mind when creating custom categories. Usually, a new custom category should be placed at the top.

zh_cn.text:
选择一个子类别并转到其设置以配置点颜色、名称、图标等内容。 
 
 当多个子类别包含同一实体时，列表中较高的子类别优先！ 创建自定义类别时请记住这一点。 通常，新的自定义类别应该会被放在顶部。
为矮的方块调整 Y 值

en_us.text: Subtract 1 from the height value for short carpetlike blocks, e.g. carpet, 1-layer snow, lilypad etc. This prevents such blocks from causing harsh shading on the map like a full block.

zh_cn.text: 类似地毯的矮方块的高度值减去1，例如地毯、1层雪、睡莲等。 这可以防止这些方块像一个完整的方块一样在地图上显示明显的阴影。

en_us.text: Minimum Y level difference requirement for an entity to start darkening on the radar when the "Show Entity Depth" setting is enabled.

zh_cn.text: 当启用“显示实体深度”设置时，实体在雷达上开始变暗的最小Y高度差距。

zh_cn.text: 传送时使用偏移的 Y 值

en_us.text: When teleporting to a waypoint, offset the Y coordinate by 0.5 to avoid falling through carpet-like blocks into the void. Otherwise, the integer Y coordinate is used.

zh_cn.text: 传送到路径点时，将 Y 坐标偏移 0.5 以避免穿过地毯状方块掉入虚空。否则，使用整数 Y 坐标。
删除到达过的死亡地点

en_us.text: Automatically delete deathpoints when you are within 4 blocks from them. This requires the deathpoint to be visible in world or on the minimap. A deathpoint is protected from deletion for 5 seconds after its creation.

zh_cn.text: 当你靠近到4个方块内时自动删除死亡地点。 这要求死亡地点在游戏中或小地图上可见。 死亡地点在创建后5秒内不会被删除。
位于其他界面下方时隐藏

en_us.text: Hide the minimap when a GUI screen is open, e.g. the inventory, with the exception of minimap-related screens and the chat screen.

zh_cn.text: 当GUI界面打开时隐藏小地图，例如物品栏，与小地图相关的界面和聊天界面除外。

en_us.text:
Supports player names, entity/item identifiers or patterns with special characters * ) ( and |. 
 
 * - matches anything. 
 )( - parenthesis, mostly for usage with |. 
 | - the OR operator to match different sequences in the same location. 
 
 For example: 
 minecraft:creeper 
 minecraft:zombie(_villager|_horse) - zombie villagers and horses. 
 minecraft:a*l - any vanilla entity which starts with 'a' and ends with 'l'.

zh_cn.text:
支持带有特殊字符 * ) ( 和 | 的实体标识符或匹配模式。 
 
 * - 匹配任何内容。 
 ) ( - 括号，主要与 | 一起使用。 
 | - “或”运算符以匹配相同位置的不同序列。 
 
 例如： 
 minecraft:creeper 
 minecraft:zombie(_villager|_horse) - 僵尸村民和马。 
 minecraft:a*l - 任何以“a”开头并以“l”结尾的原版实体。

en_us.text: Which Y level to start mapping blocks from when the manual cave mode is enabled. Manual cave mode can be toggled with a key binding. For the "Auto" option, go all the way to the left.

zh_cn.text: 启用手动洞穴模式时，从哪个Y高度开始绘制方块。 手动洞穴模式可以通过按键绑定进行切换。 对于“自动”选项，一直拉到左边。
在小地图边框之上渲染

en_us.text:
Render the entities over the minimap frame instead of rendering them inside the frame. Entities rendered this way act similarly to the waypoints and stick to the border when out of bounds. Visible entities are still limited to the ones loaded on the game client side though. 
 
 Option "Player List" - render over minimap only when the "List Players" key binding (TAB by default) is pressed.

zh_cn.text:
允许在小地图边框上渲染实体，而不只是在边框内渲染它们。 以这种方式渲染的实体的行为类似于路径点，并且在超出边界时会粘在边界上。 可见实体仍然仅限于游戏客户端加载的实体。 
 
 选项“玩家列表” - 仅当按下“玩家列表”键绑定（默认为 TAB）时才在小地图上如此渲染。

en_us.text: Render the cardinal direction letters (N, E, S, W) above all map elements, as opposed to under some, e.g. waypoints.

zh_cn.text: 在所有地图元素上方渲染罗盘文字（东、西、南、北），而不是在某些元素下方，例如路径点。

en_us.text: Display players whose locations are shared with you in one way or another (usually your party) when they are out of the minimap frame bounds or not visible for another reason.

zh_cn.text: 当与你以某种方式共享了位置信息的玩家（通常是你的队伍成员）超出小地图边框范围或因其他原因不可见时，显示这些玩家。

en_us.text: Display chunk claims from the Open Parties and Claims mod as a colored overlay.

zh_cn.text: 将来自 Open Parties and Claims 模组的区块认领显示为彩色叠加层。
区块认领边界不透明度

en_us.text: The opacity of the chunk claims overlay border color. Chunk claims require the Open Parties and Claims mod.

zh_cn.text: 区块认领叠加层的边缘不透明度。区块认领需要 Open Parties and Claims 模组。
区块认领填充不透明度

en_us.text: The opacity of the chunk claims overlay fill color. Chunk claims require the Open Parties and Claims mod.

zh_cn.text: 区块认领叠加层的填充颜色不透明度。区块认领需要 Open Parties and Claims 模组。

en_us.text: Display claim information about the chunk that you are in. Chunk claims require the Open Parties and Claims mod.

zh_cn.text: 显示有关你所在区块的认领信息。区块认领需要 Open Parties and Claims 模组。

en_us.text: Automatically include all entities from this list, and other lists included in this category, in the super-category/parent of this category, except the entities in the exclude list. That way you don't have to manually add duplicates on each level.

zh_cn.text: 自动将此列表中的所有实体以及此类别中包含的其他列表 包含在此类别的超类别/父级中，排除列表中的实体除外。 这样你就不必在每个级别上手动添加重复项。

en_us.text: Automatically include all elements from this list, and other sub-lists included in this category, in the super-category/parent of this category. That way you don't have to manually add duplicates on each level. Keep in mind that super-categories are not going to check the exclusion lists of this category.

zh_cn.text: 自动将此列表中的所有元素以及此类别中包含的其他子列表纳入此类别的上级类别/父类别中。这样你就不必在每一级手动添加重复项。请注意，上级类别不会检查此类别的排除列表。

en_us.text: When enabled, temporary waypoints are treated as global waypoints and ignore the waypoint render distance limits.

zh_cn.text: 启用后，临时路径点将被视为全局路径点并忽略路径点渲染距离限制。

en_us.text: Do not lock the minimap to north when enlarged if possible, which is only when using the circle shape at the time of writing this.

zh_cn.text: 如果可能的话，在放大时不要将小地图锁定在北方，这只适用于圆形小地图。
放大小地图键视为切换

en_us.text: Treat the "Enlarge Minimap" key binding as a toggle instead of having to hold it.

zh_cn.text: 将“放大小地图”键视为切换，而不用按住它。

In-World/Minimap Visibility Type

 Global - always visible

游戏内/小地图可见性类型

zh_cn.text: 此选项要求你已进入游戏。
死亡时自动切换子世界

zh_cn.text: 是否在创建死亡点时将路径点子世界切换为自动。这不会影响死亡点创建于哪个子世界。

zh_cn.text: 在信息显示管理器中启用了背景的信息类型，其彩色背景的不透明度。

en_us.text: The minimum time to wait between toggles of cave mode to prevent flickering when quickly switching between being under blocks and not. The latest world map mod has a separate setting for this as well.

zh_cn.text: 切换洞穴模式之间的最小等待时间，用于防止在方块下方与否之间快速切换时出现闪烁。最新的世界地图模组中也有一个单独的此设置。

en_us.text: Use depth-based lighting in cave mode instead of actual block lighting, making it easier to mentally separate the different cave layers.

zh_cn.text: 在洞穴模式中使用基于深度的光照而非实际的方块光照，使你更容易在头脑中区分不同的洞穴层。

zh_cn.text: 设置值取自世界地图界面！

zh_cn.text: 通过为地图上的每个方块采样多个方块的生物群系颜色来平滑生物群系颜色的边缘。当生物群系颜色的计算被其他模组修改得比原版复杂得多时，关闭此选项可以显著提升性能。

en_us.text: Configure and/or rearrange different types of info displayed under the minimap, such as current coordinates, facing angles, dimension, biome, weather, light level, game time, real time and more.

zh_cn.text: 配置和/或重新排列小地图下方显示的各类信息，例如当前坐标、朝向角度、维度、生物群系、天气、光照等级、游戏时间、现实时间等。

zh_cn.text: 分别配置特定的实体类别（通常是玩家、敌对生物、友好生物、物品或其他实体），而不是对所有实体使用相同的配置。你甚至可以为特定实体类型创建自己的自定义类别。

zh_cn.text: 显示在小地图上的基本方位。

zh_cn.text: 本地路径点的最大渲染距离。全局路径点不受影响。默认情况下，最大距离会按当前维度的坐标比例缩放。你可以通过“按维度缩放的最大路径点距离”来切换此行为。
