en_us.text: A single pixel on the map can contain multiple transparent layers and an opaque block under them. In older non-cache map data files, only the Y level (height) of the opaque block is stored in such cases, which often makes it unsafe to blindly teleport to the stored Y coordinate. When this setting is ON, the mod treats such map pixels as it would undiscovered chunks. It defaults to 2D waypoints and disables direct teleportation to such pixels. Disable this at your own risk!

zh_cn.text: 地图上的单个像素可能包含多个透明层及其下方的实心方块。在较旧的非缓存地图数据文件中，这种情况下只存储了实心方块的 Y 等级（高度），这使得盲目传送到存储的 Y 坐标通常不安全。当此设置开启时，模组会将此类地图像素视为未发现的区块。它会默认为 2D 路径点，并禁用直接传送到此类像素的功能。请自行承担禁用风险！

en_us.text: Subtract 1 from the height value for short carpetlike blocks, e.g. carpet, 1-layer snow, lilypad etc. This prevents such blocks from causing harsh shading on the map like a full block. Waypoints and teleportation over these blocks should make more sense too.

en_us.text:
The cave mode type to use when cave mode is enabled. 
 
 OFF - display above ground even when cave mode is automatically or manually enabled (same as old world map versions without cave mode) 
 Layered - separate cave maps into multiple layers depending on the used top Y 
 Full - ignore the used top Y, use a single layer for cave maps and map everything from the world top to the world bottom

zh_cn.text:
启用洞穴模式时要使用的洞穴模式类型。

关 - 即使自动或手动启用了洞穴模式，也显示地表以上内容（与没有洞穴模式的旧版世界地图相同）
分层 - 根据使用的顶部 Y 值将洞穴地图分成多个图层
完整 - 忽略使用的顶部 Y 值，为洞穴地图使用单个图层，并从世界顶部映射到世界底部

en_us.text: The default cave mode type assigned to dimensions visited for the first time in a world/server. You can read more about cave mode types by clicking the cave mode icon on the map screen.

en_us.text:
How the mod should determine the "auto" top Y when viewing the full screen map. The ceiling size refers to the size of a square ceiling of solid blocks that has to be detected above you to activate the cave mode. The solid blocks don't have to be on the same Y level. 
 
 Minimap - if installed, match the minimap mod's cave mode, otherwise use the ceiling size 3x3

zh_cn.text:
模组应如何决定在全屏地图上查看时的“自动”顶部 Y 值。天花板大小指的是必须在你上方检测到的实心方块构成的正方形天花板的尺寸。这些实心方块不必位于同一 Y 高度。

小地图 - 如果安装了小地图模组，则匹配其洞穴模式，否则使用 3x3 的天花板尺寸
显示洞穴模式顶部 Y 值

en_us.text: The minimum time to wait between toggles of cave mode to prevent flickering when quickly switching between being under blocks and not. This only applies when "Auto Cave Mode" isn't redirecting to the minimap mod. The latest minimap mod has a separate setting for this as well.

zh_cn.text: 在快速进出方块下方时，为防止闪烁，两次洞穴模式切换之间的最短等待时间。这仅在“自动洞穴模式”未重定向到小地图模组时适用。最新的小地图模组也有一个单独的设置。

en_us.text: Smooth out biome color edges by sampling biome colors for multiple blocks for every block on the map. Turning this off can significantly improve performance when biome color calculation is modded to be much more heavyweight than vanilla.

en_us.text:
The size, in regions, of a square image equivalent to the resolution that a large exported map will be scaled down to if necessary. For example, 20x20 stands for 400 regions, 512x512 blocks/pixels each. The resulting image doesn't have to be a square. 10x40 is also 400 regions. 
 
 Your computer or the Java heap size might not be able to handle higher export resolutions.

zh_cn.text:
以区域为单位表示的正方形图像的尺寸，相当于必要时大型导出地图将被缩小到的分辨率。例如，20x20 代表 400 个区域，每个区域 512x512 方块/像素。生成的图像不必是正方形。10x40 也是 400 个区域。

你的计算机或 Java 堆大小可能无法处理更高的导出分辨率。

en_us.text: Export the map with all currently enabled highlights (e.g. claims) applied to the map. When exporting the full map, highlights very far from your discovered map won't be included.

en_us.text: Reload all regions on the map without having to manually view them. The reloading process will work in the background and turn off when it's done. It is important to note that going to another dimension will pause it until you come back and changing maps will fully cancel it.

zh_cn.text: 无需手动查看即可重新加载地图上的所有区域。重新加载过程将在后台运行，完成后自动关闭。需要注意的是，前往其他维度会暂停此过程，直到你返回；切换地图则会完全取消它。

en_us.text: Reload and resave all regions on the map without having to manually visit them. World save maps will be converted into normal map data saved to a separate map instance "Converted World Save", stored in the folder "cm$converted", which can be transferred to multiplayer map instances for the same world, using file manager. The reloading process will work in the background and turn off when it's done. It is important to note that going to another dimension will pause it until you come back and changing maps will fully cancel it.

zh_cn.text: 无需手动访问即可重新加载并重新保存地图上的所有区域。世界保存地图将被转换为正常的地图数据，并保存到一个名为“转换后的世界存档”（存储在 "cm$converted" 文件夹中）的独立地图实例中，之后可以使用文件管理器将其转移到同一世界的多人游戏地图实例。重新加载过程将在后台工作，完成后自动关闭。需要注意的是，前往其他维度会暂停此过程，直到你返回；切换地图则会完全取消它。

en_us.text: You are trying to teleport to a map that is not connected to the current confirmed/auto one. If you are sure that this map is from your current sub-server/world save, then you can enable teleportation by adding a connection in the map selection screen -> Connect. But beware, if you connect unrelated maps and teleport, then there is a good chance you will suffocate in a block or die from fall damage, so be careful and connect only the right ones.

en_us.text: Cave mode on the full screen world map. It's a mapping mode that can go deeper than the surface blocks, mainly to display underground caves and interiors of buildings. en_us.text: Skip rendering the world in the background while the world map screen is open which significantly increases the framerate. However, when this is enabled, the framerate is also manually limited to around 625 to avoid issues that come from very high framerates (such as with video recording or streaming). Some mods might not be compatible with this feature and turning it off should fix any issues but with the drawback of (usually) worse framerates.
